entries: Shadows cling to one creature Qazyldrath can see within 120 feet of them. The target must succeed on a {@dc 19} Dexterity saving throw or be {@condition blinded} and vulnerable to necrotic damage until the start of Qazyldrath's next turn.

reaction.name: Thwart Healing
entries: When a creature within 60 feet of Qazyldrath regains hit points, Qazyldrath forces them to make a {@dc 19} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature regains half the number of hit points instead.

legendaryHeader: Qazyldrath has three villain actions. They can take each action once during an encounter after an enemy's turn. They can take these actions in any order but can use only one per round.

legendary.name: Action 1: Burning Globs
entries: Qazyldrath spits acid globules at each enemy they can see within 90 feet of them. Each target must succeed on a {@dc 19} Dexterity saving throw or have a globule attached to their body. A creature attached to a globule takes 14 ({@damage 4d6}) acid damage at the start of their turns. A creature can use an action to remove a globule from themself or a creature they can reach.

legendary.name: Action 2: Shadow Form
entries: Qazyldrath becomes semiincorporeal, gaining resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage until the end of their next turn. Qazyldrath then teleports up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space that they can see.

legendary.name: Action 3: Sinking Gloom
entries: Qazyldrath summons sticky black acid centered on a point they can see on the ground within 120 feet of them, creating a 5-foot-deep, 20-foot-radius pool. The pool is difficult terrain and lasts for 1 minute. An enemy who starts their turn in the pool takes 24 ({@damage 7d6}) acid damage and must succeed on a {@dc 19} Strength saving throw or be {@condition restrained} until the start of their next turn. An enemy who starts their turn flying within 30 feet of the pool must succeed on a {@dc 19} Dexterity saving throw or be pulled down by living acid, landing in the nearest unoccupied space of their choice within the pool, take 24 ({@damage 7d6}) acid damage, and be {@condition restrained} until the start of their next turn.

hp.special: 7 + seven times caregiver's level (number of d8 Hit Dice equal to their caregiver's level)

action.name: Signature Attack (Bite)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3 plus PB} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 1d6 plus PB} piercing damage.

action.name: 1st Level: Tail Whip (2 Ferocity)
entries: The lightbender makes a signature attack. On a hit, the attack deals an extra {@damage 0d1 + PB|PB} radiant damage to the target, and a different creature the lightbender chooses within 15 feet of them takes PB radiant damage.

action.name: 3rd Level: Silent Pounce (5 Ferocity)
entries: The lightbender teleports 30 feet to an unoccupied space they can see. Before or after teleporting, the lightbender can make a signature attack. If the attack hits, the target is knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: 5th Level: Hypnotic Mane (8 Ferocity)
entries: Each creature within 10 feet of the lightbender must succeed on a {@dc 10 plus PB} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition charmed} by the lightbender until the end of the lightbender's next turn. While {@condition charmed} in this way, a creature is {@condition incapacitated} and has a speed of 0. If a creature {@condition charmed} in this way takes damage or if someone else uses an action to shake the creature out of their stupor, the condition ends on that creature.

reaction.name: Shared Afterimage (Recharges after a Long Rest)
entries: When the lightbender and their caregiver are within 30 feet of each other and one of them is hit by an attack, the lightbender reveals that both they and their caregiver are past visual imprints. The lightbender and the caregiver each appear in an unoccupied space they can see within 30 feet of their imprints, the attack misses, then the imprints disappear. The lightbender can't use this reaction if the attacker relies on senses other than sight, such as blindsight, or if they can perceive illusions as false, as with truesight.

trait.name: Avoidance
entries: If the lacuna is subjected to an effect that allows them to make a saving throw to take only half damage, they instead take no damage if they succeed on the saving throw, and only half damage if they fail.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the lacuna remains motionless, they are indistinguishable from a normal statue.

trait.name: Fiend Between
entries: The lacuna doesn't have a walking speed and can't benefit from any bonus to their speed.

trait.name: Supernatural Resistance
entries: The lacuna has advantage on saving throws against powers, spells, and other supernatural effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The lacuna makes three Grief-Eater attacks and uses Infuse Sadness, if available.

action.name: Grief-Eater
entries: {@atk ms,rs} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20 ft., one creature. {@h}29 ({@damage 4d10 + 7}) psychic damage, and the target's speed is reduced by 10 feet until the end of their next turn.

action.name: Infuse Sadness (1/Day)
entries: Each enemy the lacuna can see within 30 feet of them must succeed on a {@dc 20} Wisdom saving throw or be overwhelmed with grief for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn). While a creature is overwhelmed, attacks against them are made with advantage.

bonus.name: Slip Between
entries: The lacuna teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space they can see.

reaction.name: Slip Away
entries: When a creature within 60 feet of the lacuna targets them with an attack, the lacuna teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space they can see. If the lacuna is no longer a valid target for the triggering attack, the attacker must choose a new target or the attack misses.

trait.name: Flowing Form
entries: The essence can enter an enemy's space and stop there, and they can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Gasping Aura
entries: While within 10 feet of the essence, creatures who need to breathe can't take reactions or speak.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The essence makes two Breathless Rend attacks.

action.name: Breathless Rend
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) slashing damage plus 22 ({@damage 4d10}) psychic damage.

bonus.name: Convocation of Breath (2/Day)
entries: The essence imbues the power of breath in themself or another Elemental they can see within 30 feet of them, granting one of the following effects of that Elemental's choice:

items: {@b Hide in Breath.} The Elemental tries to hide inside the body of a creature within 10 feet of them who isn't a Construct, an Elemental, an Ooze, or an Undead. The target must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or the Elemental retreats inside the target until the start of the Elemental's next turn. While inside the target, the Elemental can't take actions and has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the target.

{@b Toxic Breath.} The Elemental exudes a noxious aura 10 feet in every direction for 1 minute or until dispersed by a moderate or stronger wind. That area is lightly obscured, and each creature who needs to breathe who starts their turn in that area must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} until the end of their next turn.

bonus.name: Breathstealer's Shimmer (1/Day)
entries: The essence becomes {@condition invisible} then takes the Hide action. This invisibility ends if the essence makes an attack or uses Convocation of Breath.

trait.name: Supernatural Resistance
entries: The stag has advantage on saving throws against powers, spells, and other supernatural effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The stag makes three Ram or Lightburst attacks.

action.name: Ram
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}25 ({@damage 4d8 + 7}) piercing damage.

action.name: Lightburst
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 10} to hit, range 120 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 3d8 + 5}) radiant damage, and the target is outlined in a golden light, giving attack rolls against them advantage until the start of the stag's next turn.

action.name: Starcall (1/Day)
entries: The stag calls down a magical shower of stars on an area that is 60 feet long and 5 feet wide within 120 feet of the stag. Each enemy in that area must make a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw, taking 28 ({@damage 8d6}) radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Each other willing creature in that area regains 15 hit points.

The stars then create a 10-foot-high wall of opaque radiant light in that area. Each creature in the wall's space is pushed out of it by the shortest route. The creature chooses which side of the wall to end up on. The wall lasts for 1 minute or until the stag is {@condition incapacitated} or dies. Any enemy who enters the wall of light for the first time on a turn must make a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw, taking 14 ({@damage 4d6}) radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

bonus.name: Starlight Infusion
entries: The stag infuses radiant energy into a willing creature they can see within 60 feet of them. That creature deals an extra 5 radiant damage with weapon attacks until the start of the stag's next turn.

reaction.name: Nature's Ward
entries: When the stag or a creature they can see within 30 feet of them takes damage, the stag magically creates a protective barrier around that creature. The barrier reduces that damage to the protected creature by 20, then vanishes.

name: Empowered Bog Body
languages: understands the languages they knew in life but can't speak

trait.name: Acidic Blood
entries: A creature who deals piercing or slashing damage to the bog body while within 5 feet of them takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) acid damage.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 1d6 + 8}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, they are {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 18}). Until this grapple ends, the bog body can't make a Slam attack against another target.

action.name: Sling Mud
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 10} to hit, range 30 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 1d4 + 8}) bludgeoning damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) acid damage.

action.name: Submerge
entries: If the bog body is in swampy terrain, they can submerge themself beneath the water and mud. While submerged, the bog body is heavily obscured.

If the bog body is grappling a target when they submerge, the target submerges with them. While submerged, the target is heavily obscured, {@condition restrained}, and unable to breathe, and takes 4 ({@damage 1d8}) acid damage at the start of each of their turns.
A bog body can resurface as a bonus action. When they do so, a target they have {@condition grappled} also resurfaces.

trait.name: Psionic Shroud
entries: The dreamer is immune to divination spells and to any effect that would sense their emotions or read their thoughts.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dreamer makes two Tendrils attacks and uses Dream Spores, if available.

action.name: Tendrils
entries: {@atk mp} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) slashing damage plus 22 ({@damage 4d10}) psychic damage. If the target is {@condition charmed} by the dreamer, the dreamer regains hit points equal to half the psychic damage dealt.

action.name: *Dream Spores (5th-Order Power; Recharge 5-6)
entries: The dreamer releases a cloud of psionic spores. Each creature within 60 feet of them must succeed on a {@dc 18} Intelligence saving throw or be {@condition charmed} by the dreamer for 1 minute.
While {@condition charmed} in this way, a creature must use their movement during their turn to move within 10 feet of the dreamer by the safest available route.
A creature {@condition charmed} in this way can repeat the saving throw whenever they take damage, ending the effect on themself on a success.

reaction.name: Rouse Dreamer
entries: When a creature makes an attack against the dreamer, the dreamer chooses a creature {@condition charmed} by the dreamer within the attack's range, and the {@condition charmed} creature becomes the target of the attack instead.

name: Wight Deathguard

hp.special: Eight times their level (number of d10 Hit Dice equal to their level)

languages: the languages they knew in life

action.name: Signature Attack (Longsword)
entries: {@atk m} {@hit 3 plus PB} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 1d8 plus PB} slashing damage. Beginning at 7th level, the deathguard can make this attack twice, instead of once, when they take the Attack action on their turn.

action.name: 3rd Level: Blood for Blood (3/Day)
entries: As a reaction to an ally the deathguard can see within 5 feet of them being hit with an attack, the deathguard redirects the attack to themself, potentially causing the attack to miss. If the attacker is within 5 feet of the deathguard, the deathguard can make a signature attack against the attacker.

action.name: 5th Level: Soul Thief (3/Day)
entries: As an action, the deathguard shrouds themself in dark energy. The deathguard regains {@damage PBd6} hit points, and each enemy within 5 feet of the deathguard must make a {@dc 10 plus PB} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes {@damage PBd6} necrotic damage. On a successful save, a target takes half as much damage.

action.name: 7th Level: This Way! (3/Day)
entries: As an action, the deathguard moves up to their speed without provoking opportunity attacks. Each ally the deathguard passes within 5 feet of during the move can use a reaction to move up to their speed in the same direction as the deathguard without provoking opportunity attacks. Until the start of the deathguard's next turn, attacks against these allies have disadvantage.

name: Giant Zombie
languages: understands the languages they knew in life but can't speak

trait.name: Negative Nerves
entries: Whenever a creature deals 7 damage or less to the zombie, the zombie takes no damage instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The zombie makes two Fist attacks.

action.name: Fist
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage, and if the target is Large or smaller, they are {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 14}). The zombie has two fists, each of which can grapple one target.

action.name: Toxic Exhalation {@recharge 5}
entries: The zombie spews toxic vomit in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw, taking 14 ({@damage 4d6}) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

reaction.name: Shove Away
entries: When a Huge or smaller creature within 10 feet of the zombie hits them with a melee attack, the zombie pushes the creature up to 10 feet away.

trait.name: Crush Underfoot
entries: When the wind sprinter enters a Medium or smaller enemy's space, the enemy must choose to either fall {@condition prone} or take 10 ({@damage 3d6}) bludgeoning damage. Each enemy can be affected by this trait only once per turn.

trait.name: Oncoming Storm
entries: Wisps of stinging snow and icy winds surround the wind sprinter. When an enemy {@status concentration||concentrating} on a power, a spell, or a similar effect starts their turn within 15 feet of the wind sprinter, the enemy must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or lose {@status concentration}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The wind sprinter makes two Ice Axe attacks.

action.name: Ice Axe
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}22 ({@damage 3d10 + 6}) slashing damage.

action.name: Rock
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 9} to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. {@h}28 ({@damage 4d10 + 6}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Blizzard Surge {@recharge 5}
entries: The wind sprinter moves up to their speed in a straight line. At any point during this move, they can make up to three Ice Axe attacks against different creatures.

reaction.name: Begone, Smallfolk!
entries: After a Medium or smaller creature makes an opportunity attack against the wind sprinter, the wind sprinter can make an Ice Axe attack against that creature.

name: Durixaviinox

trait.name: Frosted Resistance (3/Day)
entries: When Durixaviinox fails a saving throw, he can succeed instead. When he does, his speed is halved and he can't take the Disengage action until the end of his next turn.

trait.name: Hoarfrost
entries: Cold damage dealt by Durixaviinox ignores damage resistance.

trait.name: Ice Walk
entries: Durixaviinox can move across and climb icy surfaces without needing to make an ability check. Additionally, difficult terrain composed of ice or snow doesn't cost him extra movement.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Durixaviinox makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 14} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}19 ({@damage 2d10 + 8}) piercing damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) cold damage, and the target can't take reactions until the end of their next turn.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 14} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d6 + 8}) slashing damage, and Durixaviinox can move the target up to 15 feet horizontally.

action.name: Numbing Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: Durixaviinox exhales a freezing blast in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 22} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 42 ({@damage 12d6}) cold damage and is {@condition restrained} until the end of their next turn. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't {@condition restrained}.

bonus.name: Icy Grip
entries: Durixaviinox encases a creature he can see within 60 feet of him in ice. The target must make a {@dc 18} Strength saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 22 ({@damage 4d10}) cold damage and is {@condition restrained}. On a successful save, a target takes half as much damage and isn't {@condition restrained}. A creature can use an action to break themself or another creature they can reach out of the ice, ending the {@condition restrained} condition.

reaction.name: Withering Frost
entries: When a creature within 5 feet of Durixaviinox hits him with an attack, Durixaviinox releases a burst of cold energy. Each creature within 5 feet of him must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or take 10 ({@damage 3d6}) cold damage.

legendaryHeader: Durixaviinox has three villain actions. He can take each action once during an encounter after an enemy's turn. He can take these actions in any order but can use only one per round.

legendary.name: Action 1: Raging Blizzard
entries: Durixaviinox beats his wings, and frigid winds and hail swirl around him. Each creature within 120 feet of him must make a {@dc 18} Strength saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 21 ({@damage 6d6}) bludgeoning damage, is pushed 60 feet directly away from Durixaviinox, and is knocked {@condition prone}. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't pushed or knocked {@condition prone}.

legendary.name: Action 2: Royal Defense
entries: Durixaviinox calls the faithful soul of a spectral guard to fight at his side. The guard uses the frost giant wind sprinter stat block, but they are an Undead instead of a Giant. The guard acts immediately after Durixaviinox and follows his verbal commands. While the guard is within 60 feet of Durixaviinox, Durixaviinox gains resistance to all damage. If Durixaviinox dies, the guard is destroyed.

legendary.name: Action 3: Frost Cataclysm
entries: Durixaviinox releases a pulse of frigid energy followed by a shock wave of force in a 120-foot-radius sphere centered on him. Each enemy in that area must make a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw, taking 45 ({@damage 10d8}) cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Immediately after, each enemy in that area must make a {@dc 18} Strength saving throw, taking 45 ({@damage 10d8}) force damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the spark takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, their hit points are reduced to 0. If the spark takes damage from another effect, they die if the damage equals or exceeds their hit point maximum; otherwise they take no damage.

action.name: Wind Sweep (Group Attack)
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 slashing damage, and if this attack was made by more than one air spark against a Large or smaller creature, the sparks can move that creature up to 5 feet horizontally for each spark that joined the attack.

name: Wight
languages: the languages they knew in life

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The wight makes one Longsword attack and one Vitality Theft attack, or they make two Heavy Crossbow attacks.

action.name: Longsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) slashing damage.

action.name: Heavy Crossbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 3} to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d10 + 1}) piercing damage.

action.name: Vitality Theft
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d8}) necrotic damage, and the wight regains a number of hit points equal to half the damage dealt. Until the start of the wight's next turn, the target has disadvantage on attack rolls made against creatures other than the wight.

reaction.name: Decaying Guard
entries: When an ally the wight can see within 5 feet of them is hit by an attack, the wight forces the attacker to reroll the attack and to instead target the wight or a willing ally within 5 feet of the original target.

name: Vampire Spawn
languages: the languages they knew in life

trait.name: Radiant Aversion
entries: Each time the spawn takes radiant damage, they take an extra 10 radiant damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The spawn makes two Claw attacks. They can replace one attack with a Bite attack.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) slashing damage, and if the target is Large or smaller, they are {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 15}). Moving while grappling a Medium or smaller creature doesn't halve the spawn's speed. The spawn can have only one target {@condition grappled} in this way at a time.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature who is {@condition grappled} by the spawn, {@condition incapacitated}, or {@condition restrained}. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) piercing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) necrotic damage. The target's hit point maximum is reduced by a number equal to the necrotic damage taken, and the spawn regains hit points equal to that number. The reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest or is targeted by a {@psionic cure ailment|TalPsi} power of 4th order or higher, a {@spell greater restoration} spell, or a similar supernatural effect. The target dies if this attack reduces their hit point maximum to 0.

bonus.name: Inhuman Speed
entries: The spawn moves up to their speed.

name: Vampire
languages: the languages they knew in life

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting (Utility)
headerEntries: In addition to any other spells in this stat block, the vampire can cast the following spells, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 18}):

trait.name: Radiant Aversion
entries: Each time the vampire takes radiant damage, they take an extra 10 radiant damage.

trait.name: Resting Place
entries: When the vampire drops to 0 hit points and is not in sunlight, running water, or their resting place, the vampire teleports to their resting place. While in their resting place, the vampire is stable. After spending 1 hour in their resting place with 0 hit points, they regain 1 hit point.

trait.name: Turn Resistance
entries: The vampire has advantage on saving throws against any effect that turns undead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The vampire makes two Claw attacks and, if possible, a Bite attack.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) slashing damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) necrotic damage. If the target is Large or smaller, they are {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 18}). While {@condition grappled} in this way, the target is {@condition restrained}. Moving while grappling a Medium or smaller creature doesn't halve the vampire's speed. A vampire can have only one target {@condition grappled} in this way at a time.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature who is {@condition grappled} by the vampire, {@condition incapacitated}, or {@condition restrained}. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d6 + 5}) piercing damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) necrotic damage. The target's hit point maximum is reduced by a number equal to the necrotic damage taken, and the vampire regains hit points equal to that number. The reduction lasts until reversed by a {@psionic cure ailment|TalPsi} power of 4th order or higher, a {@spell greater restoration} spell, or a similar supernatural effect. The target dies if this attack reduces their hit point maximum to 0. A Humanoid slain in this way rises the following midnight as a vampire spawn under the vampire's control.

action.name: Exsanguinating Mist {@recharge}
entries: The vampire, along with anything they are wearing or carrying, turns into a cloud of blood-sucking mist. When they do, they release any creature they were grappling, and if the vampire was {@condition grappled} or {@condition restrained}, that effect ends for them. Then the vampire flies up to twice their speed to an unoccupied space. During this move, the vampire ignores difficult terrain, doesn't provoke opportunity attacks, and can move through creatures and objects. Each creature the vampire passes through must make a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw, taking 35 ({@damage 10d6}) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. At the end of this movement, the vampire transforms back into their previous form.

bonus.name: Beguile
entries: The vampire targets one creature they can see within 30 feet of them and who can see them. The target must make a {@dc 18} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target uses their reaction, if available, to move up to their speed to a location chosen by the vampire, then either makes a melee attack against a target of the vampire's choice or falls {@condition prone} (vampire's choice).

Creatures who can't be {@condition charmed} automatically succeed on this saving throw, and creatures who have advantage on saving throws against being {@condition charmed} make this saving throw with advantage.

bonus.name: Inhuman Agility
entries: The vampire moves up to their speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

reaction.name: Run, My Child
entries: When an ally the vampire can see takes damage, the vampire can command the ally to move up to their speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

name: Count Rhodar von Glauer

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting (Utility)
headerEntries: In addition to any other spells in this stat block, Rhodar can cast the following spells, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 20}):

trait.name: Resting Place
entries: When Rhodar drops to 0 hit points and isn't in his resting place, he teleports to his resting place. While in his resting place, Rhodar is stable. After spending 1 hour in his resting place with 0 hit points, he regains 1 hit point.

trait.name: Spear Sacrifice (3/Day)
entries: Rhodar is surrounded by three floating spears of shimmering darkness, which he can summon to a free hand on his turn (no action required). When Rhodar fails an ability check or saving throw, he can choose to destroy one of these spears and succeed on the ability check or saving throw instead. Once Rhodar destroys all three spears, he can't use his Spear of the Damned attack or Spear Sacrifice until the next dusk, when he manifests any destroyed spears.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Rhodar makes two Sanguinus attacks, and he can make one Spear of the Damned attack for each Spear Sacrifice use he has remaining.

action.name: Sanguinus
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d6 + 6}) slashing damage plus 14 ({@damage 4d6}) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, their hit point maximum is reduced by a number equal to the necrotic damage taken, and Rhodar regains hit points equal to that number. This reduction lasts until reversed by a {@psionic cure ailment|TalPsi} power of 4th order or higher, a {@spell greater restoration} spell, or a similar supernatural effect.
The target dies if this effect reduces their hit point maximum to 0. A humanoid slain in this way rises the following midnight as a vampire spawn under Rhodar's control.

action.name: Spear of the Damned
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 12} to hit, range 60 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 3d6}) force damage, and if the target is a creature, they are knocked {@condition prone} and {@condition restrained} as a spear of darkness impales them. A creature can attempt to free themself or another creature within their reach by using an action or a bonus action to make a {@dc 20} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. On a success, the creature is freed and the {@condition restrained} condition ends for them. The creature is also freed if Rhodar summons that spear to attack another target or destroys it using Spear Sacrifice.

bonus.name: Beguile
entries: Rhodar targets one creature he can see within 30 feet of him and who can see him. The target must make a {@dc 20} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature uses their reaction, if available, to move up to their speed to a location chosen by Rhodar, then either makes a melee attack against a target of Rhodar's choice or falls {@condition prone} (Rhodar's choice).

bonus.name: Inhuman Agility
entries: Rhodar moves up to his speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

reaction.name: Withering Stare
entries: When Rhodar is hit by an attack by a creature he can see within 60 feet of him, his eyes bore into the creature. The target must succeed on a {@dc 20} Wisdom saving throw or take 10 ({@damage 3d6}) necrotic damage.

legendaryHeader: Rhodar has three villain actions. He can take each action once during an encounter after an enemy's turn. He can take these actions in any order but can use only one per round.

legendary.name: Action 1: Bloodstained
entries: Rhodar causes blood to explode in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on a point he can see within 120 feet of him. Creatures who aren't Undead in that area must succeed on a {@dc 20} Dexterity saving throw or be bloodstained until the end of Rhodar's next turn. Rhodar has advantage on attack rolls against bloodstained creatures, and bloodstained creatures have disadvantage on saving throws against Rhodar's Beguile bonus action.

legendary.name: Action 2: Fire Drake
entries: Rhodar, along with anything he is wearing or carrying, turns into a Large dragon made of fire. When he does, he releases any creature he was grappling, and if Rhodar was {@condition grappled} or {@condition restrained}, that effect ends for him. He then flies up to twice his speed to an unoccupied space. During this move, Rhodar ignores difficult terrain, doesn't provoke opportunity attacks, and can move through creatures and objects. Each creature Rhodar passes through must make a {@dc 20} Dexterity saving throw, taking 36 ({@damage 8d8}) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. At the end of this movement, Rhodar transforms back into his previous form.

legendary.name: Action 3: Mist of Blades
entries: Rhodar fills the area within 60 feet of him with thick swirling mists, heavily obscuring that area for other creatures. He can teleport up to four times into any unoccupied space in the mist and make one Sanguinus attack after each teleport. The mist dissipates at the end of this action.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting (Utility)
headerEntries: In addition to any other spells in this stat block, the hag can cast the following spells, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 15}):

trait.name: Supernatural Resistance
entries: The hag has advantage on saving throws against powers, spells, and other supernatural effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hag makes two Dream Claw attacks.

action.name: Dream Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d10 + 4}) slashing damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) psychic damage. If a target is hit by this attack more than once on a turn, they must make a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target falls {@condition unconscious} for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn), until the target takes damage, or until another creature who can reach the target uses their action to wake them. Creatures who can't be supernaturally put to sleep automatically succeed on this saving throw.

action.name: Vicious Visions (1/Day; 6th-Level Spell)
entries: The hag releases magic dream dust in a 60-foot cone. Each creature must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition charmed} for 1 minute or until they deal damage to another creature. While {@condition charmed}, the creature sees all allies as enemies and all enemies as allies.

action.name: Tiny Time
entries: The hag magically shrinks down to a height of 1 inch, becoming Tiny along with any items they wear or carry. While Tiny, the hag has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks made to hide, and they can use a bonus action to enter the head of an {@condition unconscious} Humanoid they can reach or to grow back to the hag's normal size. The hag's game statistics otherwise remain the same.

While the hag is inside a Humanoid's head, that Humanoid is considered haunted by the hag, and the hag has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the head. The hag can speak telepathically to the haunted Humanoid, but the Humanoid is unaware of the source of this telepathic speech. The haunted Humanoid can't gain any benefit from rest unless the hag allows it, and when the Humanoid attempts to sleep, the hag can fill the Humanoid's mind with nightmarish visions.

The hag is expelled from the head and grows back to their normal size if the haunted Humanoid is affected by a {@spell dispel evil and good} spell or similar supernatural effects, or if the hag chooses to exit the head as a bonus action.

bonus.name: Sleepwalk
entries: The hag moves one {@condition unconscious} creature they can see within 60 feet of them up to 30 feet horizontally.

reaction.name: Aren't You Tired?
entries: When a creature within 5 feet of the hag hits them with an attack, the hag spits sleep dust at the attacker. The attacker must make a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, until the end of the hag's next turn, the attacker feels tremendously sleepy, they can't take reactions, and they have disadvantage on attack rolls and saving throws. Creatures who can't be supernaturally put to sleep are immune to this effect.

name: Infernal Chancellor Lazivos

trait.name: Security for Speed (3/Day)
entries: When Lazivos fails a saving throw, he can succeed instead. When he does, his speed is halved and he can't take bonus actions or reactions until the end of his next turn.

trait.name: Supernatural Resistance
entries: Lazivos has advantage on saving throws against powers, spells, and other supernatural effects.

trait.name: True Name
entries: If a creature Lazivos can hear within 60 feet of him speaks his true name aloud, Lazivos loses his damage resistances, damage immunities, and Devilish Charm reaction for 24 hours. Lazivos's true name is Minto Abi.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Lazivos makes three attacks using Infernal Rapier, Chancellor's Decree, or both.

action.name: Infernal Rapier
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d8 + 5}) piercing damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) fire damage, and the target is marked with an infernal sigil until the end of their next turn. While marked, a creature can't hide or benefit from being {@condition invisible}, and attack rolls against them have advantage.

action.name: Chancellor's Decree
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 12} to hit, range 120 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 2d10 + 7}) psychic damage, and the target must make a {@dc 20} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target is {@condition charmed} by Lazivos until the end of his next turn or until Lazivos or one of his allies harms the target.

action.name: Diabolic Deposition {@recharge 5}
entries: Lazivos commands the attention of each enemy within 30 feet of him who can hear him. Each target must make a DC 20 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a creature must choose to either take 27 ({@damage 6d8}) fire damage plus 27 ({@damage 6d8}) psychic damage or be {@condition dazed|FleeMortals} for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn). On a successful save, a creature must either choose to take half as much damage or be {@condition dazed|FleeMortals} until the end of their next turn. Succeed or fail, if a creature is already {@condition dazed|FleeMortals}, they must choose the damage

bonus.name: As I Say
entries: Lazivos commands a creature {@condition charmed} by him to use their reaction, if available, to make a weapon attack against a target of his choice.

reaction.name: Devilish Charm
entries: When Lazivos is targeted by an attack, power, spell, or other supernatural effect by a creature he can see within 60 feet of him, the creature must make a {@dc 20} Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is {@condition charmed} by Lazivos until the start of the creature's next turn, and Lazivos chooses a new target he can see for the triggering effect. The new target must be within the triggering effect's range.

legendaryHeader: Lazivos has three villain actions. He can take each action once during an encounter after an enemy's turn. He can take these actions in any order but can use only one per round.

legendary.name: Action 1: Welcome, Friends
entries: Lazivos invokes an infernal word of power. Up to three enemies within 60 feet of him who can hear him must make a {@dc 20} Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, a target is {@condition charmed} by Lazivos for 1 hour (save ends at end of turn) or until Lazivos or one of his allies harms the target. On a successful save, a target takes 16 ({@damage 3d10}) psychic damage.

legendary.name: Action 2: Heed My Commands!
entries: Lazivos and each ally within 60 feet of him moves up to their speed without provoking opportunity attacks. Each creature {@condition charmed} by Lazivos moves up to half their speed in a direction he chooses (no action required).

legendary.name: Action 3: Deceptive Stratagem
entries: Lazivos switches places with a willing creature of his choice within 120 feet of him. Immediately afterward, up to five creatures of Lazivos's choice within 120 feet of him can make a melee attack (no action required).

trait.name: True Name
entries: If a creature the magistrate can hear within 60 feet of them speaks the magistrate's true name aloud, the magistrate loses their damage resistances, damage immunities, and Devilish Charm reaction for 24 hours.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The magistrate makes two Infernal Knife attacks and one Obsidian Kris attack.

action.name: Infernal Knife
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d8 + 6}) piercing damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) fire damage, and the target is {@condition frightened} of their allies until the end of their next turn.

action.name: Obsidian Kris
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d8 + 6}) piercing damage, and if the target is {@condition frightened}, they can't take reactions until the {@condition frightened} condition ends for them.

reaction.name: Devilish Charm (2/Day)
entries: When the magistrate is targeted by an attack, power, spell, or other supernatural effect by a creature they can see within 60 feet of them, the creature must make a {@dc 16} Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is {@condition charmed} by the magistrate until the start of the creature's next turn, and the magistrate chooses a new target the magistrate can see for the triggering effect. The new target must be within the triggering effect's range.

trait.name: Hellish Resistance
entries: While in Hell or within 60 feet of a devil with a challenge rating of 9 or higher, the legate has advantage on saving throws against powers, spells, and other supernatural effects.

trait.name: True Name
entries: If a creature the legate can hear within 60 feet of them speaks the legate's true name aloud, the legate loses their damage resistances, damage immunities, and Devilish Charm reaction for 24 hours.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The legate makes two Infernal Pike attacks.

action.name: Infernal Pike
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d10 + 4}) piercing damage plus 11 ({@damage 2d10}) fire damage, and the legate chooses one of the following effects:

items.name: Focused Hate
entries: The target has disadvantage on attack rolls made against creatures other than the legate until the end of the legate's next turn.

items.name: Hellbite
entries: The target takes an extra 5 ({@damage 2d4}) fire damage.

items.name: Skewer
entries: The legate deals 5 ({@damage 1d10}) piercing damage plus 5 ({@damage 1d10}) fire damage to another creature within 5 feet of the target.

reaction.name: Devilish Charm (1/Day)
entries: When the legate is targeted by an attack, power, spell, or other supernatural effect by a creature they can see within 60 feet of them, the creature must make a {@dc 15} Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is {@condition charmed} by the legate until the start of the creature's next turn, and the legate chooses a new target the legate can see for the triggering effect. The new target must be within the triggering effect's range.

trait.name: Hellfire
entries: Fire damage dealt by the jurist ignores damage resistance.

trait.name: True Name
entries: If a creature the jurist can hear within 60 feet of them speaks the jurist's true name aloud, the jurist loses their damage resistances, damage immunities, and Devilish Charm reaction for 24 hours.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The jurist makes two Fire and Brimstone attacks.

action.name: Fire and Brimstone
entries: {@atk ms,rs} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 3d8 + 4}) fire damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or gain one festering wound. A creature takes 4 ({@damage 1d8}) fire damage at the start of each of their turns for each festering wound they have. A creature who receives supernatural healing loses all festering wounds.

action.name: Inferno {@recharge 5}
entries: The jurist makes one Fire and Brimstone attack against each enemy they can see within 60 feet of them.

bonus.name: Ashes to Ashes
entries: The jurist chooses a creature they can see within 120 feet of them who has one or more festering wounds. One of the target's wounds ignites and they take 9 ({@damage 2d8}) fire damage.

reaction.name: Devilish Charm (1/Day)
entries: When the jurist is targeted by an attack, power, spell, or other supernatural effect by a creature they can see within 60 feet of them, the creature must make a {@dc 16} Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is {@condition charmed} by the jurist until the start of the creature's next turn, and the jurist chooses a new target the jurist can see for the triggering effect. The new target must be within the triggering effect's range.

trait.name: True Name
entries: If a creature the adjudicator can hear within 60 feet of them speaks the adjudicator's true name aloud, the adjudicator loses their damage resistances, damage immunities, and Devilish Charm reaction for 24 hours.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The adjudicator makes two Infernal Injunction attacks and uses Adjudicator's Interdiction, if available.

action.name: Infernal Injunction
entries: {@atk ms,rs} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. {@h}27 ({@damage 5d8 + 5}) fire damage, and the target must make a {@dc 18} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the adjudicator chooses for the target to become either {@condition charmed} by or {@condition frightened} of them until the end of the target's next turn.

action.name: Adjudicator's Interdiction {@recharge 5}
entries: The adjudicator places an infernal seal on one creature they can see within 120 feet of them. The target must succeed on a {@dc 18} Charisma saving throw or be interdicted until the adjudicator dies. While interdicted, a creature's speed is halved, they can't take reactions, and they can't regain hit points. A {@psionic cure ailment|TalPsi} power, a {@spell lesser restoration} or {@spell remove curse} spell, or a similar supernatural effect ends the effect early.

action.name: Bad Deal (1/Day)
entries: Three creatures the adjudicator can see within 60 feet of them must make a {@dc 18} Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, a target must choose to either take a -5 penalty to AC or a -5 penalty to ability checks and attack rolls. This penalty lasts for 10 minutes (save ends at end of turn).

reaction.name: Devilish Charm (2/Day)
entries: When the adjudicator is targeted by an attack, power, spell, or other supernatural effect by a creature they can see within 60 feet of them, the creature must make a {@dc 18} Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is {@condition charmed} by the adjudicator until the start of the creature's next turn, and the adjudicator chooses a new target the adjudicator can see for the triggering effect. The new target must be within the triggering effect's range.

trait.name: Phasing Rifle (1/Turn)
entries: When the artillerist hits a target with their Psionic Rifle attack, the artillerist can attempt to teleport the target (no action required). The target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw or be teleported to an unoccupied space the artillerist can see within 60 feet of the artillerist.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The artillerist makes two Psionic Rifle attacks, or they manifest a power and make one Phasing Tentacles attack.

action.name: Psionic Rifle
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 9} to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. {@h}21 ({@damage 3d10 + 5}) force damage.

action.name: Phasing Tentacles
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}21 ({@damage 3d10 + 5}) psychic damage, and if the target is Large or smaller, the artillerist can choose one of the following effects: the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 17}) or teleported up to 15 feet to an unoccupied space the artillerist can see.

action.name: *Memory Thief (5th-Order Power)
entries: The artillerist psionically plunders the mind of a creature they can see within 30 feet of them. The target must make a {@dc 17} Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 33 ({@damage 6d10}) psychic damage, and until they finish a long rest or die, their proficiency bonus is lowered by 1 and the artillerist gains a cumulative +2 bonus to damage rolls. On a successful save, a target takes half as much damage and doesn't have their proficiency bonus reduced.
A creature whose proficiency bonus drops to 0 can't form new thoughts or speak, and they have disadvantage on ability checks, attack rolls, and saving throws.

action.name: Guise (3rd-Order Power)
entries: The artillerist projects a psionic image over their body, transforming their appearance for 1 hour into that of a Medium creature they have seen. When they manifest this power, they can also change the appearance of any equipment they carry for the duration.

The changes wrought by this power fail to hold up to physical inspection. A creature can use an action to inspect the artillerist's appearance and make a {@dc 17} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check, noticing the image is a projection on a success.

bonus.name: *Vanish for One (3/Day; 3rd-Order Power; Concentration)
entries: The artillerist cloaks themself from the sight of a creature the artillerist can see within 60 feet of them. The creature must succeed on a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw or the artillerist becomes {@condition invisible} to the creature for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn). This effect ends early if the artillerist attacks the creature, deals damage to them, or creates an effect that forces them to make a saving throw.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The voiceless talker manifests a power and makes one Tentacle or Psionic Pistol attack.

action.name: Tentacle
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d10 + 4}) psychic damage, and if the target is Large or smaller, they are {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 15}).

action.name: Psionic Pistol
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 7} to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d10 + 4}) force damage.

action.name: Memory Thief (4th-Order Power)
entries: The voiceless talker psionically plunders the mind of a creature they can see within 30 feet of them. The target must make a {@dc 15} Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 22 ({@damage 4d10}) psychic damage, and until they finish a long rest or die, their proficiency bonus is cumulatively lowered by 1 and the voiceless talker gains a cumulative +2 bonus to damage rolls. On a successful save, a target takes half as much damage and doesn't have their proficiency bonus reduced.
A creature whose proficiency bonus drops to 0 can't form new thoughts or speak, and they have disadvantage on ability checks, attack rolls, and saving throws.

action.name: Flay (3/Day; 5th-Order Power)
entries: The voiceless talker shoots forth a 15-foot cone of pure psionic energy. Each creature in the area must make a {@dc 15} Intelligence saving throw, taking 28 ({@damage 8d6}) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

action.name: Guise (3rd-Order Power)
entries: The voiceless talker projects a psionic image over their body, transforming their appearance for 1 hour into that of a Medium creature they have seen. When they manifest this power, they can also change the appearance of any equipment they carry for the duration.

The changes wrought by this power fail to hold up to physical inspection. A creature can use an action to inspect the voiceless talker's appearance and make a {@dc 15} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check, noticing the image is a projection on a success.

reaction.name: Brain Drain
entries: When a creature {@condition grappled} by the voiceless talker makes a saving throw against one of the voiceless talker's powers, the voiceless talker momentarily weakens the creature and the creature has disadvantage on the saving throw.

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The whelp can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the whelp takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, their hit points are reduced to 0. If the whelp takes damage from another effect, they die if the damage equals or exceeds their hit point maximum; otherwise they take no damage.

trait.name: Psionic Immunity
entries: The whelp is unaffected by psionic powers manifested by voiceless talkers unless the whelp wishes to be.

trait.name: Resistance Drain
entries: When an enemy within 5 feet of three or more whelps makes a saving throw against a power or psionic effect, the enemy takes a penalty to the save equal to the number of whelps within 5 feet of them.

action.name: Claws (Group Attack)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}2 slashing damage.

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The mindkiller can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Psionic Immunity
entries: The mindkiller is unaffected by psionic powers manifested by voiceless talkers unless the mindkiller wishes to be.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 2d4 + 2}) slashing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) psychic damage, and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature, they are {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 12}).

action.name: Concealing Strike
entries: {@atk rp} {@hit 5} to hit, range 30 ft., one creature. {@h}13 ({@damage 3d6 + 3}) psychic damage, and the mindkiller is {@condition invisible} to the target until the end of the mindkiller's next turn.

action.name: Mindwipe
entries: A Humanoid {@condition grappled} by the mindkiller must succeed on a {@dc 12} Strength saving throw or the mindkiller enters the Humanoid's body. While inside a Humanoid, the mindkiller has total cover against attacks and other effects originating outside the Humanoid, and the only action the mindkiller can take is to leave the body, exiting in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the body.

When a Humanoid ends their turn with the mindkiller inside of them, they must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or take 10 necrotic damage. If the Humanoid is reduced to 0 hit points, they die and the mindkiller takes over the body, which regains hit points equal to the Humanoid's hit point maximum. The mindkiller retains their Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores, their understanding of Deep Speech and Undercommon, and their telepathy. They otherwise adopt the target's statistics and can take the actions the creature could take. They know everything the creature knew, including spells, class features, traits, and languages. If the body is reduced to 0 hit points after the mindkiller takes control, the mindkiller must leave it.

A creature wielding a sharp tool or weapon within reach of a Humanoid host or body with a mindkiller inside can use an action to attempt to remove the mindkiller, making an attack roll against the Humanoid's AC if the host is unwilling. On a hit, the creature deals 11 ({@damage 2d10}) slashing damage to the host and must make a {@dc 15} Wisdom ({@skill Medicine}) check. On a successful check, the creature cuts the mindkiller out of the host. On a faiIed check, if this slashing damage reduced the host to 0 hit points, the mindkiller kills the host; otherwise, there is no effect.

name: Lord Syuul

trait.name: Draw In
entries: If Lord Syuul fails a saving throw while grappling at least one enemy, he can choose to release all {@condition grappled} creatures and succeed on the saving throw instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Lord Syuul makes two Tentacle or two Psionic Repeater attacks then manifests a power or uses Memory Transfer.

action.name: Tentacle
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}28 ({@damage 4d10 + 6}) psychic damage, and if the target is Large or smaller, they are {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 19}).

action.name: Psionic Repeater
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 11} to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. {@h}22 ({@damage 3d10 + 6}) force damage.

action.name: Brain Overload (1/Day; 6th-Order Power)
entries: Lord Syuul creates a sudden surge of energy in the mind of a creature he can see within 120 feet of him. The target must make a {@dc 19} Constitution saving throw, taking 77 ({@damage 14d10}) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If the target has a brain and is reduced to 0 hit points, their brain explodes, and if they can't survive without their brain, they die.

action.name: Flay (6th-Order Power)
entries: Lord Syuul shoots a 15-foot cone of psionic energy from his eyes. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 19} Intelligence saving throw, taking 35 ({@damage 10d6}) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

action.name: Memory Transfer
entries: Lord Syuul psionically plunders the mind of each creature he is grappling. Each target must succeed on a {@dc 19} Intelligence saving throw or take 44 ({@damage 8d10}) psychic damage. If a target fails their saving throw and doesn't escape the grapple by the end of their next turn, they must choose one of these effects:

items: The target's proficiency bonus drops to 0, they can't form new thoughts or speak, and they have disadvantage on all ability checks, attack rolls, and saving throws. Only the {@psionic cure ailment|TalPsi} power, a {@spell lesser restoration} spell, or a similar supernatural effect can end this effect. Additionally, until Lord Syuul finishes a long rest, he gains a cumulative +5 bonus to damage rolls.

The target is {@condition charmed} by Lord Syuul for 1 hour. While the target is {@condition charmed}, Lord Syuul can issue the target telepathic commands (no action required), which the target does their best to obey. Each time the target takes damage, they can make a {@dc 19} Wisdom saving throw, ending the effect on a success.

action.name: Guise (3rd-Order Power)
entries: Lord Syuul projects a psionic image over his body, transforming his appearance for 1 hour into that of a Medium creature he has seen. When he manifests this power, he can also change the appearance of any equipment he carries.

The changes wrought by this power fail to hold up to physical inspection. A creature can use an action to inspect Lord Syuul's appearance and make a {@dc 19} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check, noticing the image is a projection on a success.

bonus.name: Grappling Jaunt
entries: Lord Syuul and each creature {@condition grappled} by him teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space he can see.

reaction.name: Brain Drain
entries: When a creature {@condition grappled} by Lord Syuul makes a saving throw against Memory Transfer, Lord Syuul momentarily weakens the creature and the creature has disadvantage on the saving throw.

legendaryHeader: Lord Syuul has three villain actions. He can take each action once during an encounter after an enemy's turn. He can take these actions in any order but can use only one per round.

legendary.name: Action 1: Mindblind
entries: Each enemy Lord Syuul can see within 60 feet of him must make a {@dc 19} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a creature can't see creatures other than Lord Syuul for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).

legendary.name: Action 2: Was I Ever Here?
entries: Lord Syuul becomes {@condition invisible}, teleports 60 feet to an unoccupied space he can see, and can take the Hide action. At the same time, an illusory psionic image of Lord Syuul appears in the space he left, gesturing, speaking, and behaving as he chooses (no action required). A creature who touches the image for the first time on a turn or makes a melee attack against it must succeed on a {@dc 19} Constitution saving throw or take 21 ({@damage 6d6}) psychic damage because things can pass through it. Lord Syuul's invisibility ends and his image disappears at the end of his next turn.

legendary.name: Action 3: Mindshatter
entries: Each enemy Lord Syuul can see within 60 feet of him must make a {@dc 19} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes 55 ({@damage 10d10}) psychic damage and is {@condition dazed|FleeMortals} for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn). On a successful save, a target takes half as much damage and isn't {@condition dazed|FleeMortals}.

trait.name: Psionic Immunity
entries: The hulking brain is unaffected by psionic powers manifested by voiceless talkers unless the brain wishes to be.

trait.name: Psychic Scream
entries: When the brain drops to 0 hit points, each creature within 30 feet of them must make a {@dc 16} Wisdom saving throw, taking 21 ({@damage 6d6}) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The brain makes three Bash attacks.

action.name: Bash
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) bludgeoning damage, and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 15}). Until the grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained} and has disadvantage on saving throws against psionic powers. The brain can grapple up to four creatures at once.

action.name: Squeeze
entries: Each creature {@condition grappled} by the brain must make a {@dc 16} Strength saving throw, taking 22 ({@damage 4d10}) bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

bonus.name: Psionic Invigoration (1/Day)
entries: Each willing voiceless talker within 60 feet of the brain regains the use of one psionic power of the voiceless talker's choice, and the voiceless talker has advantage on attack rolls until the end of the brain's next turn.

name: Amalgam
languages: speaks all languages but doesn't understand any

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: The amalgam is immune to any power, spell, or effect that would alter their form.

trait.name: Lake Rebirth
entries: If destroyed, the amalgam reforms in the Lake of Rot 24 hours later with all their hit points.

trait.name: Primordial Influence
entries: A {@condition dazed|FleeMortals} enemy who starts their turn within 20 feet of the amalgam must make a {@dc 16} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, that creature's body is altered in an otherworldly way of the GM's choice—they might flicker in and out of reality, sprout miniature fingers from their fingers, or have their physical form altered in a similarly alien way. This alteration doesn't affect the creature's game statistics. A cure ailment power of 4th order or higher, a {@spell greater restoration} spell, or a similar supernatural effect reverses this alteration.

While altered in this way, a creature must repeat the saving throw whenever they finish a long rest. On a failed save, their previous alteration worsens or they experience another chaotic alteration of the GM's choice. If a creature fails this saving throw three times after their initial alteration, they transform into an amalgam controlled by the GM, and only a {@spell wish} spell can restore the creature to their original form.

trait.name: Viscous Vicinity
entries: The amalgam envelops their surroundings in their shifting reality. The area within 20 feet of them is difficult terrain for other creatures.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The amalgam makes two Reality Rend attacks. They can replace one attack with a use of Pull.

action.name: Reality Rend
entries: {@atk mp} +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d10 + 4}) psychic damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 16} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition dazed|FleeMortals} until the start of the amalgam's next turn.

action.name: Pull
entries: The amalgam warps reality around up to three creatures they can see within 60 feet of them. Each target must succeed on a {@dc 16} Strength saving throw or be pulled up to 30 feet directly toward the amalgam.

name: Mummy
languages: the languages they knew in life

trait.name: Flammable
entries: Whenever the mummy takes fire damage, they take an extra 5 ({@damage 1d10}) fire damage.

trait.name: Mummy Dust
entries: Whenever the mummy takes piercing or slashing damage, each creature within 5 feet of them takes 4 ({@damage 1d8}) poison damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The mummy makes two Desiccating Slam attacks and uses Guardian Curse.

action.name: Desiccating Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) bludgeoning damage. Until the start of the mummy's next turn, the target's speed is reduced by 10 feet and the target can't regain hit points.

action.name: Guardian Curse
entries: The mummy calls down a scourge on one creature they can see within 60 feet of them. The target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw or be cursed. While cursed in this way, whenever the target takes damage, they take an extra 3 ({@damage 1d6}) necrotic damage that can't be reduced in any way. The curse lasts until removed by a {@psionic cure ailment|TalPsi} power, a {@spell remove curse} spell, or a similar supernatural effect. A target who succeeds on their saving throw is immune to the Guardian Curse of all mummies for the next 24 hours.

name: Koptourok
languages: understands the languages they knew in life but can't speak

trait.name: Breathless Aura
entries: Enemies within 30 feet of the koptourok can't speak, and if they are a creature who needs to breathe, they also have disadvantage on Constitution saving throws.

trait.name: Wings of Breath
entries: The koptourok gains a flying speed equal to their walking speed if they have at least one enemy within 30 feet of them. If the koptourok starts their turn in the air and doesn't have a flying speed, they fall.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The koptourok makes two Choking Grasp attacks.

action.name: Choking Grasp
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 30 ft., one creature. {@h}14 ({@damage 4d6}) bludgeoning damage, and the target is pulled to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the koptourok and {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 14}). While {@condition grappled} in this way, the target is {@condition restrained} and the koptourok's speed isn't halved by the grapple.

action.name: Last Gasp
entries: The koptourok attempts to steal the breath from each creature they are grappling. Each target must make a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw, taking 14 ({@damage 4d6}) bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The koptourok gains temporary hit points equal to 5 times the number of creatures who failed their save.

reaction.name: Thunderous Deflation
entries: When the koptourok drops to 30 hit points or fewer, they unleash a shrieking wail. Each creature within 30 feet of the koptourok must make a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 16 ({@damage 3d10}) thunder damage and is {@condition deafened} until the end of their next turn. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't {@condition deafened}. The koptourok then releases all creatures they are grappling and flies up to their speed.

name: Ashyra

trait.name: Atonement (3/Day)
entries: If Ashyra fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead. When she does, she must either end the effect of her Ancient Curse on one enemy within 120 feet of her or be {@condition dazed|FleeMortals} until the end of her next turn.

trait.name: Mummy Dust
entries: Whenever Ashyra takes piercing or slashing damage, each creature within 5 feet of her takes 9 ({@damage 2d8}) poison damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Ashyra makes two attacks using Desiccating Slam, Soul Fire, or both, and she uses Ancient Curse.

action.name: Desiccating Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 3d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) necrotic damage. The target's speed is reduced to 0, and they can't regain hit points until the start of Ashyra's next turn.

action.name: Soul Fire (3rd-Level Spell)
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 9} to hit, range 60 ft., one target. {@h}20 ({@damage 3d10 + 4}) radiant damage, and if the target is a creature, their hit point maximum decreases by a number equal to the damage taken. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest or is targeted by a {@psionic cure ailment|TalPsi} power of 4th order or higher, a {@spell greater restoration} spell, or a similar supernatural effect. The target dies if this effect reduces their hit point maximum to 0.

action.name: Ancient Curse
entries: Ashyra inflicts weakness on one creature she can see within 120 feet of her. The target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw or be cursed. While the target is cursed in this way, their attacks deal half damage. The curse lasts until Ashyra chooses to end it or until removed by a {@psionic cure ailment|TalPsi} power, a {@spell remove curse} spell, or a similar supernatural effect.

bonus.name: Misty Step (2nd-Level Spell)
entries: Ashyra teleports up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space she can see.

reaction.name: Weight of Ages
entries: When a creature Ashyra can see within 60 feet of her deals damage to her, Ashyra brings down the weight of ages on them. The creature must succeed on a {@dc 17} Strength saving throw or be {@condition restrained} until the end of their next turn.

legendaryHeader: Ashyra has three villain actions. She can take each action once during an encounter after an enemy's turn. She can take these actions in any order but can use only one per round.

legendary.name: Action 1: Sands of the Ancients
entries: A storm of stinging dirt whirls around Ashyra in a 15-foot-radius until the end of her next turn. For the duration, that area is heavily obscured, and when a creature starts their turn in or enters that area for the first time on a turn, they must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or take 22 ({@damage 4d10}) necrotic damage.

legendary.name: Action 2: Dust to Dust
entries: Ashyra bursts into a cloud of dust and makes one Desiccating Slam attack against each enemy within 60 feet of her, then she reforms in an unoccupied space within 60 feet of her original location.

legendary.name: Action 3: Last Rites
entries: Ashyra commands the land to entomb her foes. Each enemy within 30 feet of her must make a {@dc 17} Strength saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes 21 ({@damage 6d6}) bludgeoning damage and is entombed in stone. On a successful save, a target takes half as much damage and is not entombed. An entombed creature is {@condition restrained}, has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the stone, and takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) necrotic damage at the end of each of their turns. The creature can be freed if the stone is destroyed (AC 17; 30 hit points; immunity to poison and psychic damage).

trait.name: Lethe
entries: When the wobalas's soul count is 0, they have advantage on attack rolls, disadvantage on saving throws, and their Intelligence score becomes 3 (-4). Additionally, the wobalas must use their movement on each of their turns to move as close as possible to the nearest creature they can sense with their soulsight, and then if they are able, they must use their action to attack and attempt to kill that creature. The wobalas can't act with any other purpose until they add 1 to their soul count.

trait.name: Soul Devourer
entries: When the wobalas reduces a creature who isn't a Construct or an Undead to 0 hit points or deals damage to a dying creature, the creature must make a {@dc 11} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the wobalas consumes the creature's soul and adds 1 to the wobalas's soul count. A creature whose soul is consumed in this way immediately dies, and they can't be restored to life by any means short of a {@spell wish} spell.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The wobalas makes three Despair Bolt attacks.

action.name: Despair Bolt
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 10} to hit, range 150/600 ft., one creature. {@h}16 ({@damage 3d6 + 6}) piercing damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) psychic damage. The wobalas can burn 1 soul to make the target {@condition frightened} of them for 1 minute. If the target is immune to being {@condition frightened}, the wobalas regains the burned soul.

action.name: Banishing Touch
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}22 ({@damage 4d10}) psychic damage, and the target is teleported up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space the wobalas can see.

bonus.name: Flee, Mortal (Costs 1 Soul)
entries: The wobalas chooses a creature they can see within 60 feet of them. The target must succeed on a {@dc 16} Charisma saving throw or use their reaction, if available, to move their speed away from the wobalas by the most direct route possible, with no regard for their own safety. Creatures who can't be {@condition frightened} succeed on this saving throw automatically.

trait.name: Lethe
entries: When the tormenauk's soul count is 0, they have advantage on attack rolls, disadvantage on saving throws, and their Intelligence score becomes 3 (-4). Additionally, the tormenauk must use their movement on each of their turns to move as close as possible to the nearest creature they can sense with their soulsight, and then if they are able, they must use their action to attack and attempt to kill that creature. The tormenauk can't act with any other purpose until they add 1 to their soul count.

trait.name: Soul Devourer
entries: When the tormenauk reduces a creature who isn't a Construct or an Undead to 0 hit points or deals damage to a dying creature, the creature must make a {@dc 11} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the tormenauk consumes the creature's soul and adds 1 to the tormenauk's soul count. A creature whose soul is consumed in this way immediately dies, and they can't be restored to life by any means short of a {@spell wish} spell.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The tormenauk makes two Slam attacks and one Many Maws attack.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is Large or smaller, they are {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 15}), and they are {@condition restrained} until the grapple ends. The tormenauk can grapple up to two targets at a time.

action.name: Many Maws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target {@condition grappled} by the tormenauk. {@h}21 ({@damage 3d10 + 5}) piercing damage.

action.name: Agony Wail (Costs 1 Soul)
entries: The tormenauk screeches, broadcasting a consumed soul's lifelong pain. Each creature within 30 feet of the tormenauk who can hear them must make a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw, taking 35 ({@damage 10d6}) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Creatures who knew the owner of the burned soul have disadvantage on the saving throw.

reaction.name: Share Agony (Costs 1 Soul)
entries: When the tormenauk takes damage, they choose a creature they can see within 30 feet of them to share the pain. The target must make a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw, taking psychic damage equal to the triggering damage taken by the tormenauk on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

trait.name: Lethe
entries: When the ruinant's soul count is 0, they have advantage on attack rolls, disadvantage on saving throws, and their Intelligence score becomes 3 (-4). Additionally, the ruinant must use their movement on each of their turns to move as close as possible to the nearest creature they can sense with their soulsight, and then if they are able, they must use their action to attack and attempt to kill that creature. The ruinant can't act with any other purpose until they add 1 to their soul count.

trait.name: Soul Devourer
entries: When the ruinant reduces a creature who isn't a Construct or an Undead to 0 hit points or deals damage to a dying creature, the creature must make a {@dc 11} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the ruinant consumes the creature's soul and adds 1 to the ruinant's soul count. A creature whose soul is consumed in this way immediately dies, and they can't be restored to life by any means short of a {@spell wish} spell.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ruinant makes three Bloodletting Claws attacks.

action.name: Bloodletting Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) piercing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) necrotic damage, and the target can't take reactions this turn.

action.name: Salt Wounds (Costs 1 Soul)
entries: The ruinant chooses up to three creatures they can see within 60 feet of them who don't have all their hit points. Each target must make a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw, taking 16 ({@damage 3d10}) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

reaction.name: Corrupt Healing (Costs 1 Soul)
entries: When a creature within 60 feet of the ruinant regains hit points from a power, a spell, or a similar supernatural effect, the ruinant corrupts the effect. The target regains no hit points, and the target and each of the ruinant's enemies within 5 feet of the ruinant must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or take necrotic damage equal to half the number of hit points the effect would have restored.

trait.name: Horrid Stench
entries: If an enemy starts their turn within 10 feet of three or more pitlings, the enemy is {@condition poisoned} until the start of their next turn.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the pitling takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, their hit points are reduced to 0. If the pitling takes damage from another effect, they die if the damage equals or exceeds their hit point maximum; otherwise they take no damage.

trait.name: Soul Feast
entries: When the pitling reduces a creature who isn't a Construct or an Undead to 0 hit points or deals damage to a dying creature, the creature must make a {@dc 11} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the pitling consumes the creature's soul, and the pitling becomes a Category 2 demon of the GM's choice with 1 soul. A creature whose soul is consumed in this way immediately dies, and they can't be restored to life by any means short of a {@spell wish} spell. If the creature was reduced to 0 hit points by a group attack, the GM picks one pitling who joined the attack to consume the soul.

action.name: Spit (Group Attack)
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 15/30 ft., one target. {@h}4 poison damage.

trait.name: Lethe
entries: While the chimeron's soul count is 0, they have advantage on attack rolls, disadvantage on saving throws, and their Intelligence score becomes 3 (-4). Additionally, the chimeron must use their movement on each of their turns to move as close as possible to the nearest creature they can sense with their soulsight, and then if they are able, they must use their action to attack and attempt to kill that creature. The chimeron can't act with any other purpose until they add 1 to their soul count.

trait.name: Soul Devourer
entries: When the chimeron reduces a creature who isn't a Construct or an Undead to 0 hit points or deals damage to a dying creature, the creature must make a {@dc 11} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the chimeron consumes the creature's soul and adds 1 to the chimeron's soul count. A creature whose soul is consumed in this way immediately dies, and they can't be restored to life by any means short of a {@spell wish} spell.

trait.name: Soul Resistance
entries: While the chimeron's soul count is is 2 or higher, they have advantage on saving throws against powers, spells, and other supernatural effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The chimeron makes up to three attacks using Powerful Bite, Scorching Bite, Booming Bite, or Chilling Bite. They can't use any attack more than once.

action.name: Powerful Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}25 ({@damage 4d8 + 7}) piercing damage.

action.name: Scorching Bite
