entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 1d8 + 7}) piercing damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) fire damage, and the target is set on fire until the target or a creature who can reach them uses an action to extinguish the flames. A creature who is on fire at the start of their turn takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire damage. If a creature who is already on fire is set on fire again on a subsequent turn, the damage isn't cumulative.

action.name: Booming Bite (Costs 1 Soul)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 1d8 + 7}) piercing damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) thunder damage, and the target is knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Chilling Bite (Costs 1 Soul)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 1d8 + 7}) piercing damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) cold damage, the target's speed is halved until the end of their next turn, and they can only make one attack during their next turn.

reaction.name: Pain Absorption (Costs 1 Soul)
entries: When the chimeron takes damage, they reduce the damage taken by 16 ({@damage 3d10}).

name: Aurumvas

trait.name: Abyssal Resistance (Costs 2 Souls)
entries: When Aurumvas fails a saving throw, he succeeds instead.

trait.name: Lethe
entries: When Aurumvas's soul count is 0, he has advantage on attack rolls, disadvantage on saving throws, and his Intelligence score becomes 3 (-4). Additionally, Aurumvas must use his movement on each of his turns to move as close as possible to the nearest creature he can sense with his soulsight, and then if he is able, he must use his action to attack and attempt to kill that creature. Aurumvas can't act with any other purpose until he adds 1 to his soul count.

trait.name: Soul Devourer
entries: When Aurumvas reduces a creature who isn't a Construct or an Undead to 0 hit points or deals damage to a dying creature, the creature must make a {@dc 11} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, Aurumvas consumes the creature's soul and adds 1 to his soul count. A creature whose soul is consumed in this way immediately dies, and they can't be restored to life by any means short of a {@spell wish} spell.

trait.name: Soul Weapons
entries: While Aurumvas's soul count is 2 or higher, his weapon attacks are magical, and allies within 60 feet of him deal an extra 5 ({@damage 1d10}) psychic damage with weapon attacks.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Aurumvas makes three attacks using Greedy Hands, Covetous Bolt, or both.

action.name: Greedy Hands
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d6 + 7}) bludgeoning damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) psychic damage. Aurumvas can burn 1 soul to gain temporary hit points equal to the psychic damage dealt.

action.name: Covetous Bolt
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 11} to hit, range 120 ft., one target. {@h}22 ({@damage 5d8}) force damage. If the target has spell slots, Aurumvas can burn 2 souls to force the target to expend their highest-level spell slot available with no effect.

bonus.name: Greed Is Good
entries: Aurumvas chooses an object he can see within 30 feet of him that is worth at least 100 gp. He teleports to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of that object.

reaction.name: Absorb Soul
entries: If a demon with a soul count of 1 or higher who Aurumvas can see dies within 60 feet of him, Aurumvas gains 1 soul.

legendaryHeader: Aurumvas has three villain actions. He can take each action once during an encounter after an enemy's turn. He can take these actions in any order but can use only one per round.

legendary.name: Action 1: Time Is Money
entries: Aurumvas warps time with his supernatural greed. Each ally he can see within 120 feet of him moves up to their speed. At the end of this round of combat, Aurumvas rearranges the initiative order in any way he chooses.

legendary.name: Action 2: That's Ours
entries: Aurumvas chooses up to three magic items he can see within 30 feet of him that aren't artifacts or of legendary rarity and that don't require attunement. He teleports each item to an ally who he can see within 30 feet of him, placing it either into their hands or at their feet. If a targeted object is being worn or carried by an enemy, the enemy can make a {@dc 19} Charisma saving throw, preventing that object from being teleported on a success.

legendary.name: Action 3: At Any Cost
entries: Aurumvas teleports Tiny explosive treasures from his vault to four different points he can see within 120 feet of him. Each creature within 10 feet of one or more of these points must make a {@dc 19} Dexterity saving throw, taking 33 ({@damage 6d10}) force damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

hp.special: 7 + seven times caregiver's level (number of d8 Hit Dice equal to their caregiver's level)

action.name: Signature Attack (Bite)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3 plus PB} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 1d6 plus PB} piercing damage.

action.name: 1st Level: Unbalancing Attack (2 Ferocity)
entries: The hyena makes a signature attack. On a hit, the target also has disadvantage on the next Strength or Dexterity saving throw they make before the start of their next turn.

action.name: 3rd Level: Gobbling Bite (5 Ferocity)
entries: The hyena makes a signature attack with advantage. On a hit, the attack deals an extra {@damage 0d1 + PB|PB} necrotic damage, and the hyena regains hit points equal to the necrotic damage dealt.

action.name: 5th Level: Cackle (8 Ferocity)
entries: Each enemy within 30 feet of the hyena who can hear them must succeed on a {@dc 10 plus PB} Wisdom saving throw or take {@damage PBd4} psychic damage and be {@condition frightened} of the hyena until the start of the hyena's next turn.

reaction.name: Blood Frenzy (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: When the hyena's caregiver is hit with an attack and the hyena is within 5 feet of the attacker, the hyena can make a signature attack against the attacker.

trait.name: Death Snap
entries: When the hyena is reduced to 0 hit points, they can deal {@damage 1} piercing damage to a creature within 5 feet of them (no action required), provided they weren't {@condition incapacitated} before dropping to 0 hit points.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the hyena takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, their hit points are reduced to 0. If the hyena takes damage from another effect, they die if the damage equals or exceeds their hit point maximum; otherwise they take no damage.

action.name: Bite (Group Attack)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 1} piercing damage. If the target is a creature and two or more hyenas joined the attack, the target must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}. The DC for this saving throw equals 10 plus the number of hyenas who joined the attack.

name: Xorannox

trait.name: Painful Resistance (3/Day)
entries: Eight eyes float around Xorannox and create his Eye Psionics. If Xorannox fails a saving throw, he can destroy a random floating eye (chosen by rolling a {@dice d8}) and succeed instead. If an eye is destroyed, a new eye pops of out of Xorannox's face to replace it 24 hours later.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 4d6}) piercing damage.

action.name: Eye Psionics
entries: Xorannox creates three of the following psionic eye effects. Unless otherwise stated, each eye targets a creature who he can see within 120 feet of him. He can't use the same effect twice on a turn.

items.name: 1. Charm Beam
entries: The targeted creature must succeed on a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition charmed} by Xorannox for 1 hour, or until he harms the creature or one of their allies.

items.name: 2. Compulsion Beam
entries: The targeted creature must succeed on a {@dc 17} Intelligence saving throw or use their reaction, if available, to move up to their speed toward the closest ally they can see and make one weapon attack against them. Creatures who can't be {@condition charmed} are unaffected.

items.name: 3. Memory Beam
entries: The targeted creature must make a {@dc 17} Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, if the creature has unexpended spell slots, they expend a spell slot of their highest remaining level, with no effect. If they don't have unexpended spell slots, they instead lose proficiency with a weapon they're holding or carrying for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).

items.name: 4. Toxic Vapors
entries: Xorannox chooses a point he can see within 120 feet of him. Each creature within 10 feet of the point must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).

items.name: 5. Telekinetic Field
entries: Xorannox chooses a point he can see within 120 feet of him. Each enemy within 10 feet of the point must succeed on a {@dc 17} Strength saving throw or be moved up to 30 feet in any direction and take 7 ({@damage 2d6}) force damage at the end of the move. Additionally, Xorannox can target any object within 10 feet of the point that weighs 300 pounds or less and isn't being worn or carried, moving it up to 30 feet in any direction. Xorannox can also exert fine control on objects with this effect, such as manipulating a simple tool or opening a door or a container.

items.name: 6. Lightning Bolt
entries: Xorannox shoots a 5-foot-wide, 60-foot-long line of lightning. Each creature in the line must succeed on a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw, taking 36 ({@damage 8d8}) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

items.name: 7. Explosion
entries: Xorannox chooses a point he can see within 120 feet of him. Each creature within 10 feet of the point must make a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw, taking 36 ({@damage 8d8}) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

items.name: 8. Necrosis Beam
entries: The targeted creature must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or immediately take 55 ({@damage 10d10}) necrotic damage and lose 7 ({@damage 2d6}) hit points at the start of each of their turns. If this effect reduces a target's hit points to 0, they die. The effect ends if Xorannox dies or can't see the target. This psionic effect can't be used again while this effect persists.

bonus.name: The Great Eye {@recharge}
entries: Xorannox's central eye turns solid black and projects a 150-foot cone of energy. If Xorannox or any creature in that area is affected by a spell, the spell's effects immediately end for that creature.

reaction.name: Cower!
entries: When a creature hits Xorannox with an attack, he shoots a psionic fear beam at them. The creature must succeed on a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw or take 21 ({@damage 6d6}) psychic damage and be {@condition frightened} of Xorannox for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).

legendaryHeader: Xorannox has three villain actions. He can take each action once during an encounter after an enemy's turn. He can take these actions in any order but can use only one per round.

legendary.name: Action 1: Disruption Beams
entries: Xorannox shoots a psionic disruption beam at three creatures he can see within 120 feet of him. Each target must make a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, whenever the target makes more than one weapon attack on a turn or casts a spell that isn't a cantrip, they take 14 ({@damage 4d6}) psychic damage. This effect lasts for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).

legendary.name: Action 2: Disappearing Act
entries: Xorannox turns {@condition invisible} until the end of his next turn and teleports up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space he can see.

legendary.name: Action 3: Megabeam
entries: Xorannox unleashes the effects of all of his remaining psionic eyes at once in a 20-foot-wide, 120-foot-long line. Each creature in that area must make a save against two random eye effects from Xorannox's Eye

legendary.name: Psionics (reroll duplicates for each target)
entries: If the effect usually affects an area, it instead only affects individual creatures.

trait.name: Precog Reflexes
entries: The nemesis adds their Intelligence modifier (+4) to initiative rolls and to their AC (included in Armor Class).

trait.name: Psychic Scar
entries: The nemesis is immune to any effect that would sense their emotions, read their thoughts, reveal they are lying, or reveal their alignment or location.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The nemesis makes two Golden Scythe attacks. They can replace one attack with a use of Kinetic Crush or Phase, if available.

action.name: Golden Scythe
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) slashing damage plus 13 ({@damage 3d8}) necrotic damage. If this attack reduces a creature who is in an astral body (as with the {@spell astral projection} spell) to 0 hit points, that creature's soul returns to their material body, and then their material body is also reduced to 0 hit points.

action.name: Kinetic Crush (4th-Order Power)
entries: The nemesis attempts to telekinetically grip one creature they can see within 60 feet of them. The target must make a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 27 ({@damage 6d8}) force damage, and their speed becomes 0 until the start of the nemesis's next turn. On a successful save, a target takes half as much damage and their speed isn't reduced.

action.name: Phase (1/Day; 4th-Order Power; Concentration)
entries: For 1 minute, the nemesis can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. The nemesis takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) force damage if they end their turn inside an object. If this power ends while the nemesis is inside an object, they are shunted out of the object into the nearest unoccupied space of their choice.

bonus.name: Jaunt (3/Day; 3rd-Order Power)
entries: The nemesis teleports up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space they can see.

hp.special: Seven times their level (number of d8 Hit Dice equal to their level)

action.name: Signature Attack (Cutlass)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3 plus PB} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 1d10 plus PB} slashing damage. Beginning at 7th level, the freebooter can make this attack twice, instead of once, when they take the Attack action on their turn.

action.name: 7th Level: Wraithstep (1/Day)
entries: As an action, the freebooter becomes {@condition invisible} for 1 minute. While {@condition invisible}, the freebooter has resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from mundane attacks, and the freebooter can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. The freebooter takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) force damage if they end their turn inside an object.

bonus.name: 3rd Level: Blip Strike (3/Day)
entries: As a bonus action, the freebooter teleports up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space they can see. If this space is within 5 feet of an enemy the freebooter can see, the freebooter can make a signature attack against them with advantage as part of this bonus action.

bonus.name: 5th Level: Kinetic Clamp (3/Day)
entries: As a bonus action, the freebooter tries to telekinetically grip one creature they can see within 60 feet of them. The target must make a {@dc 10 plus PB} Strength saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes {@damage PBd6} force damage and is {@condition restrained} until the start of the freebooter's next turn. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage and is not {@condition restrained}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The bonesplitter makes two attacks using Bite, Spiked Flail, or both. They can replace one attack with a use of Bloody Roar, if available.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) piercing damage, or 11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) piercing damage if the target is {@condition restrained}.

action.name: Spiked Flail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, they are {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 14}). Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained} and the bonesplitter can't make Spiked Flail attacks.

action.name: Bloody Roar {@recharge}
entries: The bonesplitter roars, spitting a spray of blood. Each ally within 10 feet of them who can see them can make a weapon attack (no action required), provided that ally isn't {@condition incapacitated}.

bonus.name: Over Here!
entries: The bonesplitter yanks a creature they are grappling. The target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Strength saving throw or swap spaces with the bonesplitter.

reaction.name: Death Frenzy
entries: When an ally the bonesplitter can see within 30 feet of them is reduced to 0 hit points, the bonesplitter moves up to half their speed and makes a Bite attack.

trait.name: Commander's Inspiration
entries: Allied Humanoids within 30 feet of the commander who can see or hear them have advantage on Wisdom and Charisma saving throws and gain a +1 bonus to weapon attack and damage rolls.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The commander makes two Greatsword or two Longbow attacks.

action.name: Greatsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) slashing damage, and one ally within 30 feet of the target who can see the commander has advantage on their next melee attack roll made against the target before the start of the commander's next turn.

action.name: Longbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 5} to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Bark Orders {@recharge}
entries: Each ally within 60 feet of the commander who can hear and understand them can use a reaction to move up to their speed and make a weapon attack.

reaction.name: Bolstering Pride
entries: When another creature within 60 feet of the commander who can hear and understand them makes a saving throw, the commander can give that creature advantage on the saving throw.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting (Utility)
headerEntries: In addition to any other spells in this stat block, the channeler can cast the following spells, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 15}):

trait.name: Bugbear's Inspiration
entries: Allied Humanoids within 15 feet of the channeler who can see or hear them have advantage on Wisdom and Charisma saving throws.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The channeler makes two Channeling Staff attacks.

action.name: Channeling Staff
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) bludgeoning damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) lightning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, the channeler can move them up to 10 feet horizontally.

action.name: Vine Eruption (3/Day; 4th-Level Spell)
entries: The channeler attempts to use primal magic to overload a creature they can see within 60 feet of them. The target must make a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw as thorny vines erupt from their body and attempt to envelop them. On a failed save, the target takes 27 ({@damage 5d10}) piercing damage and is {@condition restrained} until the vines are destroyed. On a successful save, a target takes half as much damage and isn't {@condition restrained}. A creature {@condition restrained} in this way takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) piercing damage at the start of each of their turns. The vines have AC 15, 10 hit points, and immunity to psychic damage.

action.name: Ball Lightning (1/Day; 7th-Level Spell; Concentration)
entries: The channeler creates a 20-foot-radius sphere of electricity centered on a point they can see within 120 feet of them. The sphere lasts for 1 minute. When an enemy starts their turn in that area, they must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or take 27 ({@damage 6d8}) lightning damage. As a bonus action, the channeler can move the sphere up to 20 feet.

reaction.name: Shared Shield (2/Day; 2nd-Level Spell)
entries: When a creature the channeler can see within 30 feet of them is hit with an attack, the channeler can create a barrier of magical force around that target. Until the start of the channeler's next turn, the target gains a +5 bonus to AC, including against the triggering attack.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The rampart can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Relentless (1/Turn)
entries: When the rampart isn't {@condition incapacitated} and they are reduced to 0 hit points but not killed outright, they can make an attack against an enemy (no action required) before the hit point reduction is resolved. If the attack hits and its damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, the rampart drops to 1 hit point instead of 0 hit points.

trait.name: Servant Senses
entries: Ithu'rath can sense anything the rampart senses, and Ithu'rath can speak through their body.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The rampart makes two Spear attacks. If the rampart targets the same creature with both attacks, the target has disadvantage on attack rolls against creatures other than the rampart until the start of the rampart's next turn.

action.name: Spear
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) piercing damage, or 8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

reaction.name: No!
entries: When an enemy within 5 feet of the rampart targets another creature with an attack, the attacker must target the rampart instead.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The lackey can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Goring Run
entries: If the lackey moves at least 20 feet straight toward an enemy and then ends their movement within 5 feet of the enemy, the enemy takes 1 piercing damage.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the lackey takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, their hit points are reduced to 0. If the lackey takes damage from another effect, they die if the damage equals or exceeds their hit point maximum; otherwise they take no damage.

trait.name: Servant Senses
entries: Ithu'rath can sense anything the lackey senses, and Ithu'rath can speak through their body.

action.name: Goring Horns (Group Attack)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}3 piercing damage. If this attack was made by more than one lackey, the target must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be moved 5 feet horizontally for each minion who joined the attack. The DC for this saving throw equals 10 plus the number of lackeys who joined the attack.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The bloodeye can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Servant Senses
entries: Ithu'rath can sense anything the bloodeye senses, and Ithu'rath can speak through their body.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The bloodeye makes one Bite or one Bola attack and uses Bloodeye Bolt or Mesmeric Lure, if available.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Bola
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 5} to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) bludgeoning damage, and the target is {@condition restrained} by the bola. A creature can use their action to make a {@dc 10} Strength check, freeing themself or another creature within their reach from the bola on a success. Dealing 5 slashing damage to the bola (AC 10) destroys it and frees a creature {@condition restrained} by it without harming them.

action.name: Bloodeye Bolt (3/Day)
entries: The bloodeye shoots blood from their eyes at one creature they can see within 30 feet of them. The target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition blinded} for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).

action.name: Mesmeric Lure (3/Day)
entries: The bloodeye hypnotically stares at one creature they can see within 30 feet of them. The target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw or all creatures other than the bloodeye are {@condition invisible} to them until the end of the bloodeye's next turn.

reaction.name: Reptilian Escape (1/Day)
entries: If the bloodeye fails a Strength or Dexterity saving throw, they lose their tail and succeed instead. They regrow their tail when they finish a long rest.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The trickshot can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Exploit Opening (3/Day)
entries: When the trickshot makes an attack, they have advantage on the attack roll.

trait.name: Point Blank Shooting
entries: When the trickshot hits a creature within 30 feet of them with a ranged weapon attack, they deal an extra 7 ({@damage 2d6}) piercing damage. Additionally, being within 5 feet of an enemy doesn't impose disadvantage on the trickshot's ranged attack rolls.

trait.name: Servant Senses
entries: Ithu'rath can sense anything the trickshot senses, and Ithu'rath can speak through their body.

action.name: Heavy Crossbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 6} to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d10 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Bayonet
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Ricochet Bolt {@recharge 5}
entries: The trickshot uses a special ricocheting bolt to make one Heavy Crossbow attack against a target within 100 feet of them, then a second Heavy Crossbow attack against a different target within 30 feet of the first target.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The brawler can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Exploit Opening (3/Day)
entries: When the brawler makes an attack, they have advantage on the attack roll.

trait.name: Servant Senses
entries: Ithu'rath can sense anything the brawler senses, and Ithu'rath can speak through their body.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The brawler makes two attacks using Grab, Haymaker, or both.

action.name: Grab
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one Medium or smaller creature. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) bludgeoning damage, and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 13}). Until this grapple ends, the brawler can't grab another creature.

action.name: Haymaker
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) bludgeoning damage, or 10 ({@damage 3d4 + 3}) bludgeoning damage against a {@condition grappled} target.

action.name: Throw
entries: The brawler throws one Medium or smaller creature they are grappling or object they are holding up to 30 feet horizontally. If the thrown target is a creature, they fall {@condition prone} after this throw. If the thrown target would enter the space of a creature or solid object that is no more than one size smaller than it, the thrown target collides with it and stops in the nearest unoccupied space, taking 3 ({@damage 1d6}) bludgeoning damage for every 10 feet it was thrown. A Large or smaller creature hit by this thrown target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw or take the same amount of damage and fall {@condition prone}.

reaction.name: Meat Shield
entries: When the brawler is grappling a target and is hit by a ranged attack made by another creature the brawler can see, the brawler gains a +2 bonus to AC against the triggering attack. If this bonus causes the attack to miss the brawler, it hits the {@condition grappled} target instead.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The underboss can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Crafty
entries: The underboss doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when they move out of an enemy's reach.

trait.name: Servant Senses
entries: Ithu'rath can sense anything the underboss senses, and Ithu'rath can speak through their body.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The underboss makes two Shortsword attacks or two Shortbow attacks. They can replace one attack with a use of Command.

action.name: Shortsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Shortbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 5} to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Command
entries: The underboss chooses one ally they can see within 30 feet of them. If the target can hear the underboss, the target can use their reaction to move up to their speed or make one weapon attack.

bonus.name: Get Reckless {@recharge}
entries: Each willing ally within 30 feet of the underboss who can hear them becomes reckless until the start of the underboss's next turn. While reckless, a creature has advantage on attack rolls, and attack rolls against the creature have advantage.

reaction.name: Cowardly Commander
entries: When a creature the underboss can see hits them with an attack, the underboss chooses a willing ally within 5 feet of them. The attack hits the ally instead.

name: Ithu'rath

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: Ithu'rath can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: Ithu'rath is immune to any power, spell, or effect that would alter their form.

trait.name: Slimy Resistance (3/Day)
entries: When Ithu'rath fails a saving throw, they can succeed on the save by channeling the power of their protective slime. Until the end of Ithu'rath's next turn, creatures have advantage on the saving throw for Ithu'rath's Devolving Tentacle attack.

trait.name: Supernatural Resistance
entries: Ithu'rath has advantage on saving throws against powers, spells, and other supernatural effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Ithu'rath makes six Devolving Tentacle attacks and uses Piscine Transformation.

action.name: Devolving Tentacle
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 3d6 + 6}) piercing damage. The first time a creature is hit with this attack on a turn, they must succeed on a {@dc 19} Constitution saving throw or be injected with a degenerative psionic slime (save ends at end of turn). While slimed, each time the creature makes an attack roll or an ability check, they must roll a {@dice d4} and subtract the number rolled from the {@dice d20} roll. At the end of a slimed creature's turn, the size of the subtracted die increases by one: the {@dice d4} becomes a {@dice d6}, the {@dice d6} becomes a {@dice d8}, and so on, to a maximum of {@dice d12}. The {@psionic cure ailment|TalPsi} power or {@spell lesser restoration} spell also ends this effect.

action.name: Piscine Transformation (3rd-Order Power)
entries: Ithu'rath targets a creature with a head, legs, or torso they can see within 60 feet of them, blasting them with a pulse of transformational energy. The target must succeed on a {@dc 19} Wisdom saving throw or undergo one of the following transformations of the Ithu'rath's choice:

items: {@b Head.} The target's head transforms into the head of a fish, proportionately sized for their body. They can't speak.
{@b Legs.} The target's legs become fins. Their walking speed is reduced to 10 feet (unless their walking speed is slower), and they gain a swimming speed of 30 feet.

{@b Torso.} The target's torso becomes the body of a fish with gills. They can only breathe water and can hold their breath for 1 hour. If the target isn't underwater when this transformation takes effect, they begin suffocating.

entries: The transformation lasts until a {@psionic cure ailment|TalPsi} power of 4th order or higher or the {@spell greater restoration} spell affects the target. A target who suffers all three transformations at once is permanently transformed into a hybrid fishlike creature and can only be returned to their original form by a {@spell wish} spell or similar supernatural effects.

bonus.name: Jaunt (3rd-Order Power)
entries: Ithu'rath teleports 30 feet to an unoccupied space they can see.

reaction.name: Liquefy (3rd-Order Power)
entries: When a creature within 30 feet of Ithu'rath hits them with an attack, Ithu'rath can psionically barrage that creature. That creature must succeed on a {@dc 19} Constitution saving throw or be pushed 5 feet away from Ithu'rath and be {@condition restrained} until the end of the creature's next turn, as their lower body temporarily melts into an immovable goo.

legendaryHeader: Ithu'rath has three villain actions. They can take each action once during an encounter after an enemy's turn. They can take these actions in any order but can use only one per round.

legendary.name: Action 1: Skeletal Collapse
entries: Ithu'rath targets one or more creatures with a skeleton within 60 feet of them, attempting to temporarily melt their ligaments. Each target must succeed on a {@dc 19} Constitution saving throw or take 18 ({@damage 4d8}) necrotic damage and have disadvantage on Strength- and Dexterity-based ability checks, attack rolls, and saving throws for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).

legendary.name: Action 2: Psychic Pulse
entries: Ithu'rath channels a pulse of telekinetic energy to scour and harry their foes. Each enemy within 60 feet of Ithu'rath must succeed on a {@dc 19} Strength saving throw or take 18 ({@damage 4d8}) force damage and be moved up to 30 feet in any direction.

legendary.name: Action 3: Slime Storm
entries: Ithu'rath unleashes a cloud of transformative slime. Each creature within 60 feet of Ithu'rath who isn't an olothec or a slime servant must make a {@dc 19} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes 45 ({@damage 10d8}) piercing damage and is {@condition blinded} until the end of their next turn as their eyes temporarily turn into insectoid feelers. On a successful save, a target takes half as much damage and isn't {@condition blinded}.

trait.name: Incorporeal Cloud
entries: The haunt can occupy another creature's space and vice versa. In addition, the haunt can move through creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain.
The haunt takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) force damage if they end their turn inside an object.

trait.name: Invisibility
entries: The haunt is {@condition invisible}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The haunt makes two Spectral Wrath attacks.

action.name: Spectral Wrath
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 0 ft., one target in the haunt's space. {@h}17 ({@damage 2d12 + 4}) force damage.

action.name: Wave of Despair {@recharge 5}
entries: The haunt unleashes a wave of psychic pain. Each enemy within 20 feet of the haunt must make a {@dc 16} Wisdom saving throw, taking 33 ({@damage 6d10}) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

bonus.name: Possess Object
entries: The haunt can magically manipulate a Large or smaller object within 30 feet of them that isn't being worn or carried by another creature. The haunt can exert fine control on objects under their control, such as playing piano keys, slamming doors, opening windows, or writing with a quill.

As part of this bonus action, the haunt can hurl the object up to 30 feet in any direction or use it as a ranged weapon to attack one creature within 30 feet of the object. The object has a +8 bonus to hit and deals 15 ({@damage 2d10 + 4}) bludgeoning damage on a hit. The GM might rule that a specific object deals piercing or slashing damage based on its form.

name: Ghost Sycophant

hp.special: Six times their level (number of d6 Hit Dice equal to their level)

languages: any two languages they knew in life

action.name: Signature Attack (Dark Essence)
entries: {@atk ms,rs} {@hit 3 plus PB} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d10}) necrotic damage. This spell's damage increases by {@damage 1d10} when the sycophant reaches 5th level ({@damage 2d10}), 11th level ({@damage 3d10}), and 17th level ({@damage 4d10}).

action.name: 3rd Level: Call of the Dead (3/Day)
entries: When the sycophant hits a creature with a signature attack, the target must also succeed on a {@dc 10 plus PB} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} of the sycophant for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).

action.name: 5th Level: Astral Presence (3/Day)
entries: As an action, the sycophant becomes {@condition invisible} for 1 minute or until they use a bonus action to end this effect. While {@condition invisible}, the sycophant can move through creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain, and the sycophant's signature attacks deal an extra {@damage 0d1 + PB|PB} damage to creatures who can't see them. The sycophant takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) force damage if they end their turn inside an object.

action.name: 7th Level: Whispers of the Dead (3/Day)
entries: As an action, the sycophant chooses up to PB creatures they can see within 30 feet of them. Each target must succeed on a {@dc 10 plus PB} Charisma saving throw or make an attack against their nearest ally (no action required). A {@condition frightened} creature has disadvantage on the saving throw.

name: Zenith Aastrika

trait.name: Battle Tranquility (3/Day)
entries: When Aastrika fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead. When she does so, she can't use Sweltering Heat until the end of her next turn.

trait.name: Molten Flesh
entries: The first time a creature other than a fire giant touches Aastrika or hits her with a melee attack on a turn, that creature takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Aastrika takes the Disengage action and makes up to three attacks using Unarmed Strike, Hurl Flame, or both.

action.name: Unarmed Strike
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}21 ({@damage 4d6 + 7}) bludgeoning damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire damage. If the target is a creature, they are outlined in red light until the start of Aastrika's next turn, and for the duration, attack rolls against them have advantage.

action.name: Hurl Flame
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 10} to hit, range 180 ft., one target. {@h}20 ({@damage 4d6 + 6}) fire damage.

action.name: Lava Pillar {@recharge 5}
entries: Aastrika causes a 20-foot-radius, 60-foot-high cylinder of lava to erupt from the ground at a point she can see within 120 feet of her. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw, taking 38 ({@damage 11d6}) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

bonus.name: Sweltering Heat
entries: Aastrika's inner flame pulses harshly. Each creature within 20 feet of her who doesn't have resistance or immunity to fire damage must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or gain a level of {@condition exhaustion}.

reaction.name: Power of Flame
entries: When another fire giant Aastrika can see within 60 feet of her misses with a weapon attack, Aastrika causes flame to trail from the attacker. The attacker rolls damage for the attack as if they had hit, and the target takes half that amount as fire damage instead of taking the full amount of normal damage.

legendaryHeader: Aastrika has three villain actions. She can take each action once during an encounter after an enemy's turn. She can take these actions in any order but can use only one per round.

legendary.name: Action 1: Forward!
entries: Aastrika and up to three creatures she can see can move up to their speed without provoking opportunity attacks and make one melee attack each.

legendary.name: Action 2: The Manifold Self
entries: Aastrika disappears in a flash of light and teleports, reappearing in an unoccupied space she can see within 30 feet of her. At the same time, five {@creature fire giant trooper|FleeMortals}s appear in unoccupied spaces within 30 feet of the space she teleported from. The troopers act immediately after this villain action is taken and on the same initiative count in subsequent rounds.

legendary.name: Action 3: This. Ends. Now
entries: Aastrika and each willing fire giant within 60 feet of her unleashes a burst of heat. Each creature within 10 feet of Aastrika or one of these fire giants must make a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw, taking 55 ({@damage 10d10}) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the trooper takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, their hit points are reduced to 0. If the trooper takes damage from another effect, they die if the damage equals or exceeds their hit point maximum; otherwise they take no damage.

trait.name: Molten Flesh
entries: The first time a creature other than a fire giant touches the trooper or hits them with a melee attack on a turn, that creature takes 7 fire damage.

action.name: Unarmed Strike (Group Attack)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}3 bludgeoning damage plus 3 fire damage, and the target must succeed on a Strength saving throw or fall {@condition prone}. The DC for this saving throw equals 12 + the number of troopers who joined the group attack.

action.name: Rock (Group Attack)
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 10} to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. {@h}6 bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Heat and Pressure
entries: When an enemy moves out of the red fist's reach, the enemy must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or gain a level of {@condition exhaustion}. Creatures with resistance or immunity to fire damage are immune to this effect.

trait.name: Molten Flesh
entries: The first time a creature other than a fire giant touches the red fist or hits them with a melee attack on a turn, that creature takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The red fist makes two Unarmed Strike attacks.

action.name: Unarmed Strike
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}21 ({@damage 4d6 + 7}) bludgeoning damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire damage. If the same creature is hit twice with this attack on a turn, they are {@condition blinded} until the end of their next turn.

action.name: Hurl Flame
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 10} to hit, range 180 ft., one target. {@h}34 ({@damage 8d6 + 6}) fire damage.

reaction.name: Guardian Block (3/Day)
entries: When an enemy within 10 feet of the red fist hits a creature other than the red fist with an attack, the red fist halves the damage dealt by that attack. The red fist then makes an Unarmed Strike against the attacker.

trait.name: Healing Heat
entries: When the lightbearer targets a fire giant with an attack, spell, or other supernatural effect that deals fire damage, that target instead regains a number of hit points equal to the damage that would be dealt. The target can choose to be hit by this attack or fail their saving throw against this effect.

trait.name: Molten Flesh
entries: The first time a creature other than a fire giant touches the lightbearer or hits them with a melee attack on a turn, that creature takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The lightbearer makes two attacks using Slam, Living Blaze, or both. They can replace one attack with a use of Flamelash.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 3d6 + 6}) bludgeoning damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire damage, and if the target is a Huge or smaller creature, the target must choose between being knocked {@condition prone} or pushed 10 feet away from the lightbearer.

action.name: Living Blaze
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 10} to hit, range 180 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 3d6 + 6}) fire damage, and the lightbearer can ricochet the flame toward another target within 5 feet of the first. The lightbearer makes another spell attack roll against the second target with disadvantage, dealing the same damage on a hit.

action.name: Flamelash
entries: The lightbearer extends a whiplike flame to strike a creature they can see within 30 feet of them. The target must make a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 20 ({@damage 4d6 + 6}) fire damage, and if the target is Large or smaller, the lightbearer moves the target up to 10 feet horizontally.

bonus.name: Travel by Fire (3/Day)
entries: The lightbearer chooses two willing creatures they can see within 30 feet of them. Each target takes 14 ({@damage 4d6}) fire damage and teleports, swapping places with the other target.

resist.note: from mundane attacks that aren't adamantine

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While motionless, the giant is indistinguishable from a statue.

trait.name: Stone Flesh
entries: When a creature attacks the giant with a melee weapon that isn't adamantine and rolls a 1 on the {@dice d20} for that attack, that weapon is destroyed if it is mundane. If that weapon is supernatural, it loses all supernatural properties for 1 hour.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The giant makes two Rune-Signed Blade attacks. They can replace one attack with a Forked Knives attack.

action.name: Rune-Signed Blade
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}25 ({@damage 4d8 + 7}) slashing damage. If the target is a creature, each time they are hit by this attack, their movement speed is reduced by a cumulative 10 feet (to a minimum speed of 5 feet) until they regain at least 1 hit point.

action.name: Forked Knives
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft. or range 60/240 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 3d6 + 7}) piercing damage, and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature on the ground, they are knocked {@condition prone} and {@condition restrained} as they are pinned by the knife. The target or a creature who can reach the knife can use an action to make a {@dc 18} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check to try to dislodge the knife, freeing the pinned target and ending the {@condition restrained} condition on a success.

reaction.name: Resonate Rune
entries: When the giant is hit by a melee attack, each creature within 10 feet of them must succeed on a {@dc 17} Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 10 feet away from the giant.

trait.name: Stubborn Rage
entries: The wyvern is immune to the {@condition frightened} and {@condition stunned} conditions while they have fewer than half their hit points or are within 60 feet of another wyvern they can hear or see.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The wyvern makes one Stinger attack and one Bite attack. They can replace one attack with a use of Tail Sweep.

action.name: Stinger
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 3d6 + 3}) piercing damage. The target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or take 7 ({@damage 2d6}) acid damage at the start of each of their turns for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn). A {@psionic cure ailment|TalPsi} power or a {@spell lesser restoration} spell ends this effect on a target.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 2d12 + 3}) piercing damage. If the target is Large or smaller, they are {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 13}). Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained} and the wyvern can't bite another target.

action.name: Tail Sweep
entries: The wyvern swipes their tail in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a {@dc 14} Strength saving throw or take 14 ({@damage 2d10 + 3}) bludgeoning damage and be pushed up to 10 feet away from the wyvern.

bonus.name: Seek
entries: The wyvern takes the Search action.

trait.name: Deadly Leap
entries: The owlbear's long jump is up to 30 feet and their high jump is 15 feet, with or without a running start. If the owlbear leaps at least 20 feet toward a target and then hits them with a Bite or Claw attack, the target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Keen Sight and Smell
entries: The owlbear has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight or smell.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The owlbear makes one Bite and one Claw attack.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 1d12 + 5}) piercing damage, and the owlbear can move the target 5 feet in any direction.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) slashing damage.

action.name: Bear Hug {@recharge 4}
entries: The owlbear attempts to grab and crush a creature they can see within 5 feet of them. The target must make a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 22 ({@damage 4d10}) bludgeoning damage and is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 15}). On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage and is not {@condition grappled}. Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained} and takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) bludgeoning damage at the start of each of their turns. The grapple ends if the owlbear uses Bear Hug on another target or makes a Claw attack against another target.

reaction.name: Hulking Rush
entries: When the owlbear takes damage, they can move up to half their speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

hp.special: Eight times their level (number of d10 Hit Dice equal to their level)

action.name: Signature Attack (Warhammer)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3 plus PB} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 1d10 plus PB} bludgeoning damage. Beginning at 7th level, the blacksmith can make this attack twice, instead of once, when they take the Attack action on their turn.

action.name: 3rd Level: Relentless Rush (3/Day)
entries: When the blacksmith isn't {@condition incapacitated} and they take damage but aren't killed outright, they can make an attack against an enemy (no action required) before the hit point reduction is resolved. If the attack hits, the blacksmith regains twice their PB hit points.

action.name: 5th Level: Reinforce Armor (3/Day)
entries: As a bonus action, the blacksmith touches a piece of armor and fortifies it. For the next 10 minutes, a creature wearing the armor gains a bonus to their AC equal to half the blacksmith's PB.

action.name: 7th Level: Fortify Weapon (3/Day)
entries: As a bonus action, the blacksmith touches a weapon and polishes it. For 1 minute, the weapon is magical and deals an extra {@damage 0d1 + PB|PB} damage.

hp.special: Eight times their level (number of d10 Hit Dice equal to their level)

action.name: Signature Attack (Goring Horns)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3 plus PB} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 1d10 plus PB} piercing damage. Beginning at 7th level, the devastator can make this attack twice, instead of once, when they take the Attack action on their turn.

action.name: 3rd Level: Furious Charge (3/Day)
entries: As an action, the devastator moves up to their speed. At the end of this movement, they can make a signature attack. If that attack hits a Large or smaller creature, the target is pushed up to 10 feet away from the devastator, and the devastator and their allies have advantage on attack rolls against the target until the end of the devastator's next turn.

action.name: 5th Level: Fearsome Gore (3/Day)
entries: As an action, the devastator makes a signature attack against a creature within 5 feet of them. On a hit, the attack deals an extra {@damage PBd10} piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 10 plus PB} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} of the devastator until the end of the devastator's next turn.

action.name: 7th Level: Retaliatory Charge (1/Day)
entries: When a creature the devastator can see within 40 feet of them deals damage to the devastator, the devastator can use a reaction to move up to their speed toward the creature. If the devastator ends this movement within 5 feet of the creature, they can make two signature attacks against the creature with a +PB bonus to those attack and damage rolls.

hp.special: Eight times their level (number of d10 Hit Dice equal to their level)

action.name: Signature Attack (Greatsword)
entries: {@atk m} {@hit 3 plus PB} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 2d6 plus PB} slashing damage. Beginning at 7th level, the hunter can make this attack twice, instead of once, when they take the Attack action on their turn.

action.name: 3rd Level: Wrenching Bite (3/Day)
entries: As an action, the hunter makes a signature attack against a Large or smaller creature. On a hit, the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 10 plus PB}). Until the grapple ends, the target takes PB piercing damage at the end of each of their turns, and the hunter can't use their Wrenching Bite against another target.

action.name: 5th Level: Thrashing Tail (3/Day)
entries: As an action, the hunter makes a signature attack against a Large or smaller creature. On a hit, the target must succeed on a {@dc 10 plus PB} Dexterity saving throw or fall {@condition prone}. While the hunter is within 5 feet of this {@condition prone} target, the target can't stand up unless they use an action to make a {@dc 10 plus PB} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. On a success, the target can stand up.

action.name: 7th Level: Hypnotic Sleep (1/Day)
entries: As a bonus action, the hunter drones lullingly. Each creature within 5 feet of the hunter who can hear them must succeed on a {@dc 10 plus PB} Constitution saving throw or fall {@condition unconscious} for 1 minute. An {@condition unconscious} target wakes up if they take damage, the hunter becomes {@condition incapacitated}, the hunter moves more than 5 feet away from the target, or another creature uses an action to rouse the target.

name: Lady Emer

trait.name: Stone Sacrifice (3/Day)
entries: When Emer fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead by ending the effects of her Stone Gaze on a creature of her choice within 300 feet of her.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Emer uses Pinning Shot or makes three attacks using Snake Bite, Longbow, or both. She also uses Stone Gaze or Envenomed Stone, if available.

action.name: Snake Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. {@h}17 ({@damage 5d6}) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} until the end of Emer's next turn. While {@condition poisoned} in this way, the target can't take reactions.

action.name: Longbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 11} to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 1d8 + 7}) piercing damage plus 14 ({@damage 4d6}) poison damage.

action.name: Pinning Shot
entries: Emer makes three Longbow attacks against a creature touching the ground within 150 feet of her. If at least two of those attacks hit, the target is {@condition restrained} by arrows pinning their limbs to the ground. A creature {@condition restrained} in this way or another creature who can reach them can use an action to pull out the arrows and end the condition.

action.name: Stone Gaze
entries: Emer fires beams of energy from her eyes at up to three creatures she can see within 60 feet of her. Each target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or begin turning to stone (save ends at end of turn). While turning to stone, a creature's speed is reduced by 10 feet and they have disadvantage on Dexterity checks and saving throws. If a creature who is turning to stone is targeted by this action again and fails their save, their speed is reduced by another 10 feet and they are {@condition dazed|FleeMortals} until the effect ends.

If a creature who is turning to stone and {@condition dazed|FleeMortals} in this way is targeted by this action again and fails their save, they are {@condition petrified} and can no longer make saving throws to end the effects of Stone Gaze. The petrification lasts until the creature is restored by Emer's Stone Sacrifice trait, a {@psionic cure ailment|TalPsi} power of 4th order or higher, a {@spell greater restoration} spell, or a similar supernatural effect.

action.name: Envenomed Stone {@recharge 5}
entries: Emer utters an ancient hex. Each creature within 60 feet of her who is being turned to stone by her Stone Gaze must make a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw, taking 44 ({@damage 8d10}) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

bonus.name: Mesmerizing Eyes
entries: The glowing eyes of Emer's snakes gaze at one creature Emer can see within 60 feet of her. If the target can see Emer, they must succeed on a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition charmed} until the start of the target's next turn. A target {@condition charmed} in this way must immediately use their reaction, if available, to move up to their speed in a direction of Emer's choice.

reaction.name: Blinding Mucus
entries: When a creature Emer can see within 5 feet of her hits her with a melee attack, Emer spits venom at their eyes. The target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw or take 7 ({@damage 2d6}) acid damage and be {@condition blinded} until the start of their next turn.

legendaryHeader: Emer has three villain actions. She can take each action once during an encounter after an enemy's turn. She can take these actions in any order but can use only one per round.

legendary.name: Action 1: I See You!
entries: Emer uses Stone Gaze against each enemy she can see within 60 feet of her.

legendary.name: Action 2: Medusa's Evolution
entries: Emer grows wings from her back, gaining a flying speed of 40 feet, then she moves up to her speed without provoking opportunity attacks. After 1 minute, the wings crumble to dust and her flying speed is lost.

legendary.name: Action 3: Stone Puppets
entries: Emer mentally manipulates the stone in each creature who is being turned to stone by her Stone Gaze. Emer and each of those creatures move up to their speed then make a weapon attack against a creature of Emer's choice (no action required).

hp.special: 7 + seven times caregiver's level (number of d8 Hit Dice equal to their caregiver's level)

trait.name: Learning to Fly
entries: The griffon has a flying speed of 10 × PB feet.

action.name: Signature Attack (Beak)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3 plus PB} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 1d6 plus PB} piercing damage.

action.name: 1st Level: Violent Attack (2 Ferocity)
entries: The griffon makes a signature attack. On a hit, the attack deals an extra {@damage 0d1 + PB|PB} slashing damage, and the griffon can move the target 5 feet in any direction.

action.name: 3rd Level: Grabbed from Above (5 Ferocity)
entries: The griffon makes a signature attack against a Medium or smaller creature. On a hit, the target is also {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 10 plus PB}) if they weren't already. While {@condition grappled} in this way, the target is {@condition restrained} and the griffon can't make a signature attack against another target.

action.name: 3rd Level: Bombs Away (5 Ferocity)
entries: The griffon flies up to their speed without provoking opportunity attacks. If the griffon has a creature {@condition grappled}, the grapple doesn't halve the griffon's speed and the griffon can end the grapple at any point during this movement. If the griffon ends the grapple before the end of their turn and the target takes bludgeoning damage from that fall, the target takes an extra {@damage 0d1 + PB|PB} bludgeoning damage.

action.name: 5th Level: Backdraft (8 Ferocity)
entries: The griffon flies up to their speed without provoking opportunity attacks. When the griffon ends this movement, each creature within 15 feet of them must make a {@dc 10 plus PB} Strength saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage PBd6} bludgeoning damage and is knocked {@condition prone}. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't knocked {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Steady
entries: The griffon has advantage on ability checks and saving throws against being knocked {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Swoop
entries: If the griffon flies more than 20 feet in a straight line toward their target and then hits them with a Claw attack on the same turn, the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 14}). While the target is {@condition grappled} in this way, the griffon has advantage on Beak attacks against the target but can't make Claw attacks. Grappling a Medium or smaller creature imposes no penalty on the griffon's speed.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The griffon makes one Beak attack, and they can make one Claw attack, use Buffet, or use Piercing Cry.

action.name: Beak
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d4 + 4}) slashing damage.

action.name: Buffet
entries: The griffon beats their wings in mighty gusts of wind. Each creature not {@condition grappled} by the griffon within a 30-foot cone originating from the griffon must make a {@dc 14} Strength saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 5 ({@damage 2d4}) bludgeoning damage, is pushed 5 feet away from the griffon, and is knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Piercing Cry
entries: The griffon lets out an earsplitting screech. Each enemy within 60 feet of the griffon who can hear them must succeed on a {@dc 12} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} of the griffon for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn). If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for them, they are immune to the Piercing Cry of all griffons for the next 24 hours.

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The gem jelly can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the jelly remains motionless, they are indistinguishable from a natural crystal formation.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The gem jelly makes two Pseudopod attacks.

action.name: Pseudopod (True Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 4d6 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Crystalline Shatter (Crystalline Form Only)
entries: The jelly shatters their hardened outer layer, returning to their true form and sending crystal shrapnel in all directions. Each creature within 10 feet of the gem jelly must make a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw, taking 36 ({@damage 8d8}) piercing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Gem jellies are immune to this damage.

bonus.name: Harden
entries: The gem jelly transforms into a psionically hardened crystalline form or back into their true form. While in crystalline form, the jelly's AC increases to 20, their speed becomes 0, they can't make Pseudopod attacks, they have disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws, and they gain vulnerability to thunder damage.

reaction.name: Reactive Shatter (Crystalline Form Only)
entries: When the jelly takes thunder damage, they use Crystalline Shatter.

name: Crux of Frost
languages: plus the languages known by a creature reflected by Frosted Reflection

trait.name: Scintillating
entries: The crux can't benefit from being {@condition invisible}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The crux makes two Rimeglass Touch attacks, and they can use Frosted Reflection or It Stares Back, if available.

action.name: Rimeglass Touch
entries: {@atk ms,rs} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 3d8 + 4}) cold damage, and the target can't see or hear creatures other than themself and the crux until the start of the crux's next turn.

action.name: Frosted Reflection
entries: The crux reflects the appearance of a specific Medium or Small creature they've seen within the last week. This appearance is illusory and imperfect, showing a frostbitten version of the creature. The illusion lasts until the crux takes thunder damage, uses this action again, or is {@condition incapacitated}. For the duration, the crux additionally knows any languages that creature knows.

action.name: It Stares Back {@recharge 5}
entries: The crux imposes fragility on a creature within 60 feet of them who is reflected by the crux's Frosted Reflection. If the target can see the crux, the target must make a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target is {@condition frightened} of the crux for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn), or until the crux stops reflecting them. While {@condition frightened} in this way, whenever the target takes damage, they take an extra 11 ({@damage 2d10}) psychic damage. On a successful save, the target isn't {@condition frightened}, and they are immune to the It Stares Back of all cruxes for 24 hours.

bonus.name: Convocation of Ice (1/Day)
entries: The crux imbues the power of ice in themself or another Elemental they can see within 30 feet of them, granting one of the following effects of that Elemental's choice:

items: {@b Frigid Sheen.} The Elemental gains a mirror sheen that reflects damage for 1 minute. When the Elemental is hit with an attack by a creature they can see within 30 feet of them, the Elemental can use a reaction to reflect the attack. The Elemental is unaffected by the attack, and the attacker must make a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the attack's damage and effects are reflected back at the attacker as if the attack originated from the Elemental, turning the attacker into the target. On a successful save, the attacker takes half as much damage, but suffers no other effect.

{@b Frost Squall.} Frost swirls around the Elemental for 1 minute. For the duration, each non-Elemental creature who starts their turn within 15 feet of the Elemental has their speed reduced to 15 feet unless it is already lower until the end of their turn, and the first time they willingly move before the start of their next turn, they take 10 ({@damage 3d6}) cold damage.

trait.name: Alchemical Ingredients
entries: After the basilisk dies, a creature can make a {@dc 12} Wisdom ({@skill Medicine}) check using an herbalism kit and the basilisk's gullet, destroying the gullet in the process. On a success, the creature creates three doses of a salve. One dose of this salve can be applied to a {@condition petrified} creature as an action, and 1 minute after the salve is applied, the {@condition petrified} condition ends for that creature.

trait.name: Toxic Ichor
entries: A creature who deals piercing or slashing damage to the basilisk while within 5 feet of them takes 2 ({@damage 1d4}) poison damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The basilisk uses Petrifying Eye Beams and makes one Bite attack or uses Poison Fumes, if available.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage plus 5 ({@damage 2d4}) poison damage.

action.name: Petrifying Eye Beams
entries: The basilisk targets one or two creatures they can see within 30 feet of them. Each target must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition restrained} as they magically begin to turn to stone. Until the end of the {@condition restrained} creature's next turn, they or an ally within 5 feet of them can use an action to cut the encroaching stone from the {@condition restrained} creature's body using a weapon that deals slashing damage. When they do, the {@condition restrained} creature takes 13 ({@damage 2d12}) slashing damage, which can't be reduced in any way, and they are no longer {@condition restrained}.

A creature {@condition restrained} in this way must repeat the saving throw at the end of their turn. On a successful save, the effect ends. On a failed save, this creature is {@condition petrified} until freed by a {@psionic cure ailment|TalPsi} power of 4th order or higher, a {@spell greater restoration} spell, or a similar supernatural effect.

action.name: Poison Fumes {@recharge 4}
entries: The basilisk exhales poisonous fumes in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in this area must make a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw, taking 10 ({@damage 4d4}) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

reaction.name: Poison Splash
entries: When the basilisk takes piercing or slashing damage, their wound spews poison. Each creature within 10 feet of the basilisk must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).

name: Wraith
languages: the languages they knew in life

trait.name: Agonizing Phasing
entries: The wraith can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. The wraith takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) force damage if they end their turn inside an object. A creature takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) psychic damage the first time a wraith passes through them on a turn.

trait.name: Throes of Oblivion
entries: When the wraith dies, they collapse inward, creating a burst of painful psychic energy. Each creature within 20 feet of the wraith must make a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw, taking 18 ({@damage 4d8}) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

action.name: Agonizing Touch
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}14 ({@damage 4d6}) psychic damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition dazed|FleeMortals} (save ends at end of turn).

Each time a target {@condition dazed|FleeMortals} in this way fails a saving throw to end the condition, their hit point maximum is halved. This effect is cumulative, and the reduction lasts until the target finishes a short or long rest.
If a Humanoid dies within 1 minute of being hit by this attack, their spirit rises as a specter under the wraith's control in an unoccupied space nearest to where that Humanoid died.

action.name: Psychic Enervation
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 6} to hit, range 60 ft., one creature. {@h}10 ({@damage 3d6}) psychic damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw or fall {@condition prone} and be {@condition frightened} of the wraith for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn). While {@condition frightened} in this way, the target can't stand up.

reaction.name: Denied Vitality
entries: When a creature who the wraith can see within 30 feet of them regains hit points, the wraith can attempt to sap the life energy restoring the creature. The creature must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or only regain half the number of hit points they otherwise would regain.

name: Specter
languages: the languages they knew in life

trait.name: Corrupting Phasing
entries: The specter can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. The specter takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) force damage if they end their turn inside an object. A creature takes 2 ({@damage 1d4}) necrotic damage the first time a specter passes through them on a turn.

action.name: Decaying Touch
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}7 ({@damage 2d6}) necrotic damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or spend 1 Hit Die without any benefit. If the target has no Hit Dice to spend, they drop to 0 hit points instead.
If a Humanoid dies within 1 minute of being hit by this attack, their spirit rises as a specter under the GM's control in an unoccupied space nearest to where that Humanoid died.

bonus.name: Hidden Movement {@recharge 5}
entries: The specter turns {@condition invisible} and then moves up to their speed. At the end of this movement, the invisibility ends.

name: Shadow
languages: the languages they knew in life

trait.name: Chilling Phasing
entries: The shadow can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. The shadow takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) force damage if they end their turn inside an object. A creature takes 1 cold damage the first time a shadow passes through them on a turn.

trait.name: Dark Stalker
entries: While in dim light or darkness, the shadow has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks.

action.name: Chilling Grasp
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) cold damage, and the target's Dexterity score is reduced by 2. The target dies if this reduces its Dexterity to 0. Otherwise, the reduction lasts until the target finishes a short or long rest.

action.name: Freezing Dark (1/Day)
entries: The shadow pours magical darkness out of their hand in a 15-foot cone. A creature with darkvision who isn't an incorporeal Undead can't see through this darkness, and light can't illuminate it. Each creature in this darkness when it first appears must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or take 7 ({@damage 2d6}) cold damage. The darkness remains in that area for 1 minute or until the shadow is destroyed.

bonus.name: Shadow Bind
entries: The shadow targets one creature they can see within 15 feet of them who is in bright or dim light. The target must succeed on a {@dc 12} Strength saving throw or be {@condition grappled} by their own shadow (escape {@dc 12}). The grapple ends if the target is no longer in bright or dim light, or if the shadow who used this bonus action is destroyed.

name: Shade
languages: the languages they knew in life

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The shade can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. The shade is destroyed if they end their turn inside an object.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the shade takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, their hit points are reduced to 0. If the shade takes damage from another effect, they die if the damage equals or exceeds their hit point maximum; otherwise they take no damage.

trait.name: Terrifying
entries: If an enemy starts their turn within 5 feet of three or more shades, the enemy must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} of the shades until the start of their next turn. The DC for this saving throw equals 10 plus the number of shades within 5 feet of the enemy. On a successful save, the enemy is immune to the Terrifying trait of all shades for the next 24 hours.

action.name: Life Drain (Group Attack)
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}1 necrotic damage.

action.name: Necrotic Drain
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) necrotic damage, or 13 ({@damage 3d6 + 3}) necrotic damage if the target can't see the lightthief.

action.name: Into the Light {@recharge}
entries: The lightthief teleports inside a light source they can see within 15 feet of them that is emitting bright or dim light. While inside the light source, the lightthief has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the light source. If the light source is extinguished by any means other than the lightthief's Steal Light action, the lightthief is forced out, appears in an unoccupied space of their choice within 5 feet of the light source, and is {@condition paralyzed} until the end of their next turn.

action.name: Steal Light (Inside Light Source Only)
entries: The lightthief can cause the light they are inside to erupt in a burst of brilliant radiance. Each creature within 15 feet of the light source must make a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 14 ({@damage 4d6}) radiant damage and loses any darkvision they have for 1 minute. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and doesn't lose their darkvision. After this, the light source extinguishes and the lightthief appears in an unoccupied space of their choice within 5 feet of the light source.

name: Kiona the Dread Lord

trait.name: Corrupting Phasing
entries: Kiona can move through other creatures and objects. Kiona takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) force damage if she ends her turn inside an object. A creature takes 9 ({@damage 2d8}) necrotic damage the first time Kiona passes through them on a turn.

trait.name: Incorporeal Empowerment
entries: Each incorporeal Undead within 120 feet of Kiona ignores difficult terrain.

trait.name: Spiritual Sacrifice (3/Day)
entries: When Kiona fails a saving throw, she can lose 15 hit points and choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Kiona makes two Energy Siphon attacks.

action.name: Energy Siphon
entries: {@atk ms,rs} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft., one creature. {@h}15 ({@damage 3d6 + 5}) necrotic damage, and the target can't regain hit points until the start of Kiona's next turn. Kiona gains temporary hit points equal to half the damage dealt by this attack.

action.name: Rise from Death (1/Day)
entries: Kiona conjures three shadows, two specters, or one wraith under her control. Each summoned creature appears in an unoccupied space within 30 feet of Kiona and acts immediately after her turn on the same initiative count.

bonus.name: Path of Pain
entries: Kiona chooses one other incorporeal Undead within 120 feet of her who can see her. That Undead can move up to their speed.

reaction.name: Death's Breath
entries: When a creature within 5 feet of Kiona hits her with an attack, she breathes a toxin at the creature. The creature must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} until the end of their next turn.

legendaryHeader: Kiona has three villain actions. She can take each action once during an encounter after an enemy's turn. She can take these actions in any order but can use only one per round.

legendary.name: Action 1: Restrain Them!
entries: A 20-foot-radius sphere of spectral arms emerges from a point Kiona can see within 120 feet of her. Each enemy in that area must succeed on a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw or be {@condition restrained} until the end of Kiona's next turn.

legendary.name: Action 2: Ruinous March
entries: Kiona and each ally within 60 feet of her can move up to their speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendary.name: Action 3: Vitality Drain
entries: Kiona and each ally within 60 feet of her can make a melee attack (no action required). A creature hit by one of these attacks gains a level of {@condition exhaustion}.

name: Hellhound
languages: understands Common and Infernal but can't speak

trait.name: Hardened by Flame
entries: When the hound is subjected to fire damage, they take no damage. Instead, their skin darkens and hardens, and their AC increases to 18 until the end of their next turn.

trait.name: Stealthy Hunter
entries: The hound has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Survival}) checks to track other creatures and on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks to hide from creatures who are unaware of their presence.

action.name: Hellish Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage plus 4 ({@damage 1d8}) fire damage.

action.name: Hellfire Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: The hound exhales flame in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 14} Dexterity saving throw, taking 14 ({@damage 3d6 + 4}) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature who isn't a hellhound who fails the saving throw is lit on fire for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn), or until the target or another creature who can reach them uses an action to extinguish the flames. A creature who is on fire at the start of their turn takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire damage. If a creature who is already on fire is set on fire again on a subsequent turn, the damage isn't cumulative, but the duration of the fire resets to 1 minute.

reaction.name: Tug of War
entries: When an enemy within 5 feet of the hound hits the hound with a melee attack, the hound can make a Hellish Bite attack against that enemy.
