headerEntries: The scholar is an 8th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save {@dc 14}, {@hit 6} to hit with spell attacks). It has the following wizard spells prepared:

action.name: Dagger
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The knight is a 5th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 15}). It has the following paladin spells prepared:

trait.name: Bonded Mount
entries: The knight is magically bonded to its pegasus mount, which obeys the knight's commands. If the knight isn't mounted, it can use a bonus action to magically teleport onto its pegasus, provided the two are on the same plane of existence. When it teleports, the knight appears astride its mount, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying. While mounted, the knight can force an attack or spell targeting the pegasus to target the knight instead, and both the knight and its pegasus have advantage on Dexterity saving throws. If its mount dies, the knight can train a new pegasus to serve as its bonded mount over the course of one month.

trait.name: Celestial Favor
entries: When the knight or its mount hit with an attack, the target takes an extra 7 ({@damage 2d6}) radiant damage (included in the attacks below).

trait.name: Militaristic Resolve
entries: The knight has advantage on saving throws against being {@condition charmed} or {@condition frightened}.

trait.name: Pegasus Training
entries: The knight has advantage on ability checks and saving throws it makes to remain mounted on a pegasus. In addition, while mounted, the knight's normal and long ranges of thrown weapons are doubled (included in the attack).

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The knight makes two attacks and uses its Strike Order.

action.name: Javelin
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft. (60/240 ft. while mounted), one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d6 + 5}) piercing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) radiant damage.

action.name: Lance
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit (with disadvantage if the target is within 5 ft.), reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 1d12 + 5}) piercing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) radiant damage.

action.name: Strike Order
entries: The knight chooses one friendly creature within 60 feet of it. If the target can see or hear the knight, the target can immediately use its reaction to make one weapon attack.

action.name: Heroic Rally (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: The knight bellows a command, emboldening each creature it chooses within 60 feet of it that can hear it. Each target gains 15 ({@dice 2d10 + 4}) temporary hit points and becomes immune to being {@condition charmed} or {@condition frightened} for 1 minute.

trait.name: Militaristic Resolve
entries: The knight has advantage on saving throws against being {@condition charmed} or {@condition frightened}.

trait.name: Pegasus Training
entries: The knight has advantage on ability checks and saving throws it makes to remain mounted on a pegasus. In addition, while mounted, the knight's normal and long ranges of thrown weapons are doubled (included in the attack).

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The knight makes two attacks.

action.name: Javelin
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft. (60/240 ft. while mounted), one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Lance
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit (with disadvantage if the target is within 5 ft.), reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 1d12 + 4}) piercing damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Ogden is a 15th-level spellcaster. His spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save {@dc 17}, {@hit 9} to hit with spell attacks). He has the following wizard spells prepared:

trait.name: Empowered Undead
entries: Any undead that is under Ogden's control has advantage on saving throws against any effect that turns undead. In addition, it gains a +5 bonus to its attack and damage rolls, and its hit point maximum increases by 20.

trait.name: Leech (5/Day)
entries: When Ogden hits a creature with his quarterstaff that isn't a construct or undead, he can choose to deal an extra 3 ({@damage 1d6}) necrotic damage and regain hit points equal to the number rolled.

action.name: Leeching Quarterstaff
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) bludgeoning damage, or 6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) bludgeoning damage if used with two hands.

bonus.name: Grave Sacrifice
entries: As a bonus action, Ogden can cause one undead under his control to drop to 0 hit points. When he does so, he gains 14 ({@dice 4d6}) temporary hit points.

reaction.name: Grim Revival (3/Day)
entries: Immediately after Ogden kills a humanoid, he causes it to rise as a zombie under his control, as if by the {@spell animate dead} spell.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Hawkren is an 11th-level spellcaster. His spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save {@dc 15}, {@hit 7} to hit with spell attacks). He has the following wizard spells prepared:

trait.name: Arcane Siphon
entries: Once per turn, when Hawkren deals damage to a creature with a spell, he regains 9 ({@dice 2d8}) hit points.

trait.name: Deathly Resilience (1/Day)
entries: When Hawkren takes damage that would reduce him to 0 hit points, he is reduced to 1 hit point instead and can immediately use his reaction to cast a spell with a casting time of 1 action.

action.name: Dagger
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing damage.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The aqualisk can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The aqualisk has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The aqualisk's weapon attacks are magical.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The aqualisk makes two attacks: one with its bite and one to constrict. If it is grappling a creature, it can also use its Fling.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}29 ({@damage 4d10 + 7}) piercing damage plus 11 ({@damage 2d10}) force damage.

action.name: Constrict
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}33 ({@damage 4d12 + 7}) bludgeoning damage plus 11 ({@damage 2d10}) force damage, and if the target is a Huge or smaller creature, that creature is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 17}). Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained} and the aqualisk can't constrict another target.

action.name: Ethereal Strike (1/Turn)
entries: While on the Ethereal Plane, the aqualisk momentarily shifts to the Material Plane and makes a bite attack against a creature before returning to the Ethereal Plane. Unless the target can see into the Ethereal Plane, the aqualisk has advantage on the attack roll.

action.name: Etherealness
entries: The aqualisk magically enters the Ethereal Plane from the Material Plane. If a creature is {@condition grappled} by the aqualisk when it uses this action, the target must succeed on a {@dc 16} Charisma saving throw or be pulled into the Ethereal Plane with it. The aqualisk and target remain there as long as the aqualisk maintains {@status concentration} (as if {@status concentration||concentrating} on a spell). If its {@status concentration} is broken or it chooses to end its {@status concentration}, the aqualisk and the target both return to the Material Plane.

action.name: Fling
entries: One object held or creature {@condition grappled} by the aqualisk is thrown up to 60 feet in a direction it chooses and knocked {@condition prone}. If a thrown creature strikes a solid surface, the target takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) bludgeoning damage for every 10 feet it was thrown. If the target is thrown at another creature, that creature must succeed on a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw or take the same damage and be knocked {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Enervating Aura
entries: Any creature other than an undead that starts its turn within 30 feet of the phantom must succeed on a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw or take 9 ({@damage 2d8}) necrotic damage. If the saving throw fails by 5 or more, the target falls {@condition unconscious} for 1 minute. Whenever an {@condition unconscious} target takes damage or another creature uses an action to try to shake it awake, the target can make a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success.

trait.name: Ethereal Form
entries: While on the Material Plane, attack rolls against the phantom are made with disadvantage unless the phantom is {@condition incapacitated}. In addition, the phantom can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the phantom fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The phantom has advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects.

trait.name: Spectral Enthrallment
entries: Whenever the phantom reduces a humanoid to 0 hit points, the target dies and a specter rises from its corpse. The specter acts immediately after the phantom's initiative count and is under the phantom's control for 1 hour, after which time it vanishes.

trait.name: Turn Immunity
entries: The phantom is immune to effects that turn undead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The phantom makes two Life Drain attacks. It can use its Dream Eater in place of one attack.

action.name: Life Drain
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}36 ({@damage 8d8}) necrotic damage, and the target must make a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target's hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken, and on a successful save, its hit point maximum is reduced by half that amount. This reduction lasts until the creature finishes a long rest. The creature dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0.

action.name: Dream Eater
entries: The phantom taps into the nightmares of one creature it touches. The target must succeed on a {@dc 20} Wisdom saving throw or be subjected to the effects of the {@spell phantasmal killer} spell for 1 minute (this effect doesn't require the phantom's {@status concentration}). The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. An {@condition unconscious} creature makes its saving throws against this effect with disadvantage, and whenever it takes damage from this effect, the phantom regains hit points equal to half the damage dealt.

bonus.name: Ethereal Jaunt
entries: As a bonus action, the phantom can magically shift from the Material Plane to the Ethereal Plane, or vice versa.

legendary.name: Ghostly Swipe
entries: The phantom makes a Life Drain attack. Before or after the attack, it can move up to half its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendary.name: Ethereal Banishment (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The phantom casts {@spell banishment} (save {@dc 20}), requiring only somatic components and targeting a creature it can see within 5 feet of it. If the target is native to and currently on the Material Plane, it is banished to its corresponding location on the Ethereal Plane, instead of a harmless demiplane. If the target takes any damage while there, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the spell on a success. If the phantom concentrates on the spell for its full duration and the target is in the phantom's Enervating Aura when the spell ends, the target doesn't return.

legendary.name: Devour Dreams (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: The phantom causes a wave of dread to erupt from a point it chooses within 120 feet of it. Each creature within 30 feet of that point is subjected to the phantom's Dream Eater effect.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The hammerhead can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Blood Frenzy
entries: The hammerhead has advantage on melee attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all its hit points.

trait.name: Ethereal Sight
entries: The hammerhead can see 60 feet into the Ethereal Plane when it is on the Material Plane, and vice versa.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The hammerhead has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The hammerhead's weapon attacks are magical.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hammerhead makes three attacks: one with its bite, one with its slam, and one with its tail.

action.name: Banishing Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}27 ({@damage 4d10 + 5}) piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 19} Dexterity saving throw or be swallowed by the hammerhead. A swallowed creature is considered to be on the Ethereal Plane, it is {@condition incapacitated}, and it takes 22 ({@damage 4d10}) force damage at the start of each of the hammerhead's turns. A swallowed creature can make a {@dc 16} Charisma saving throw at the start of each of its turns. On a successful save, the creature reappears in an unoccupied space within 10 feet of the hammerhead.

If the hammerhead takes 50 or more damage in a single turn, it must succeed on a {@dc 22} Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which reappear in an unoccupied space within 10 feet of the hammerhead. If the hammerhead dies, a swallowed creature can make a {@dc 10} Charisma saving throw. On a successful save, the creature reappears in an unoccupied space within 10 feet of the hammerhead. On a failed save, the creature is no longer {@condition incapacitated}, but it is banished to the Ethereal Plane.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}19 ({@damage 4d6 + 5}) bludgeoning damage, and if the target is a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 19} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}. This attack deals double damage to objects and structures.

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}23 ({@damage 4d8 + 5}) force damage.

action.name: Etherealness
entries: The hammerhead enters the Ethereal Plane from the Material Plane, or vice versa.

reaction.name: Spectral Strike
entries: When the hammerhead takes damage from a creature it can see within 120 feet of it, it teleports to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of that creature and immediately makes one slam or tail attack against it.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The fish can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Ethereal Sight
entries: The fish can see 30 feet into the Ethereal Plane when it is on the Material Plane, and vice versa.

action.name: Ether Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}1 piercing damage plus 1 force damage.

action.name: Etherealness
entries: The fish enters the Ethereal Plane from the Material Plane, or vice versa.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The trickster's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma. It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no components:

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The trickster makes two attacks.

action.name: Dagger
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d4 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Etherealness
entries: The trickster enters the Ethereal Plane from the Material Plane, or vice versa.

bonus.name: Spectral Sight (Recharges After a Short or Long Rest)
entries: As a bonus action, the trickster can gain the effects of the {@spell see invisibility} spell for 1 minute or until its {@status concentration} ends (as if {@status concentration||concentrating} on a spell).

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The sanguinor's spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 20}, {@hit 12} to hit with spell attacks). The sanguinor can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

trait.name: Aura of Punishment
entries: Whenever a hostile creature within 10 feet of the sanguinor takes damage, that creature takes an extra 5 ({@damage 1d10}) necrotic damage.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The sanguinor has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The sanguinor's weapon attacks are magical.

trait.name: Reckless
entries: At the start of its turn, the sanguinor can gain advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls during that turn, but attack rolls against it have advantage until the start of its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The sanguinor makes three attacks: one with its sting and two with its trident. It can cast any of its at will spells in place of one trident attack.

action.name: Sting
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 14} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@dice 3d4 + 8}) piercing plus 13 ({@damage 3d8}) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 22} Constitution saving throw or become {@condition poisoned}. The {@condition poisoned} target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Trident
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 14} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 3d6 + 8}) piercing damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Boil Blood {@recharge 5}
entries: The sanguinor attempts to magically boil the blood of up to three creatures it can see within 120 feet of it. Each target must make a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw, taking 39 ({@damage 6d12}) fire damage and 39 ({@damage 6d12}) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature that is {@condition poisoned} by a sanguinor's sting has disadvantage on this saving throw, and a creature that doesn't have blood is immune to this effect.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: Mizanoros's spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 22}, {@hit 14} to hit with spell attacks). Mizanoros can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

trait.name: Aura of Punishment
entries: Whenever a hostile creature within 30 feet of Mizanoros takes damage, that creature takes an extra 5 ({@damage 1d10}) necrotic damage.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Mizanoros has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: Mizanoros's weapon attacks are magical.

trait.name: Reckless
entries: At the start of its turn, Mizanoros can gain advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls during that turn, but attack rolls against it have advantage until the start of its next turn.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If Mizanoros fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Special Equipment
entries: Mizanoros wields Hatred, the Wrathful Edge, a sentient weapon with an Intelligence of 14, a Wisdom of 13, and a Charisma of 17. It has hearing and darkvision out to a range of 120 feet. The weapon communicates telepathically with Mizanoros and can speak, read, and understand Common and Infernal.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Mizanoros makes three attacks: one with its sting and two with Hatred, the Wrathful Edge. It can cast any of its at will spells in place of one Hatred, the Wrathful Edge attack.

action.name: Sting
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 16} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@dice 3d4 + 10}) piercing plus 15 ({@damage 3d8}) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 24} Constitution saving throw or become {@condition poisoned}. The {@condition poisoned} target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Boil Blood {@recharge 5}
entries: Mizanoros attempts to magically boil the blood of up to three creatures it can see within 120 feet of it. Each target must make a {@dc 22} Constitution saving throw, taking 41 ({@damage 6d12}) fire damage and 41 ({@damage 6d12}) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature that is {@condition poisoned} by Mizanoros's sting has disadvantage on this saving throw, and a creature that doesn't have blood is immune to this effect.

action.name: Hatred, the Wrathful Edge
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 17} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 1d12 + 11}) slashing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire or lightning damage (Mizanoros's choice). If this damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, Mizanoros gains temporary hit points equal to the fire or lightning damage dealt.

bonus.name: Blood Transfer (3/Day)
entries: As a bonus action, Mizanoros can cast the {@spell vampiric touch} spell. For the duration, he can repeat the attack on each of his turns as a bonus action.

legendary.name: Hatred Attack
entries: Mizanoros makes one attack with Hatred, the Wrathful Edge.

legendary.name: Move
entries: Mizanoros moves up to his speed.

legendary.name: Cast a Spell (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Mizanoros casts a spell.

legendary.name: Accursed Step (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: Mizanoros magically teleports, along with any equipment he is wearing and carrying, up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space he can see. Mizanoros can then choose one creature he can see within 5 feet of him. The target must make a {@dc 22} Constitution saving throw, taking 44 ({@damage 8d10}) necrotic damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. Mizanoros regains hit points equal to the amount of necrotic damage dealt.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The kiir's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 14}). The kiir can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The kiir has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Planar Grounding
entries: The kiir can't be banished or otherwise unwillingly sent to another plane of existence.

trait.name: Undetectable Nature
entries: The kiir is always under the effects of the {@spell nondetection} spell. In addition, while it's under the effects of disguise self, its illusion isn't automatically detected by truesight, and the DC to discern the illusion increases to 24.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d4 + 4}) slashing damage.

action.name: Teleport
entries: The kiir magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

action.name: Recall (1/Day)
entries: The kiir teleports to its home plane or city, as if by the plane shift or teleport spell.

name: Flintclaw
languages: understands Abyssal and Infernal but can't speak them

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The flintclaw has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on smell.

trait.name: Pounce
entries: If the flintclaw moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a claw attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}. If the target is {@condition prone}, the flintclaw can make one bite attack against it as a bonus action.

trait.name: Running Leap
entries: The flintclaw's long jump is up to 40 feet and its high jump is up to 20 feet when it has a running start.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The flintclaw makes two claw attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) slashing damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) fire damage.

trait.name: Electrical Overload
entries: If the dyra takes 25 lightning damage or more during a single turn, it must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or become {@condition paralyzed} until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: The dyra is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The dyra's weapon attacks are considered magical.

trait.name: Siege Monster
entries: The dyra deals double damage to objects and structures.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dyra uses its Electrostatic Discharge, if available. It then makes two slam attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 2d10 + 5}) bludgeoning damage plus 5 ({@damage 1d10}) fire damage.

action.name: Electrostatic Discharge {@recharge 5}
entries: The dyra expels a burst of electricity in a 15-foot radius around itself. Each creature other than the dyra in the area must make a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 28 ({@damage 8d6}) lightning damage and is {@condition stunned} until the end of the dyra's next turn. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and isn't {@condition stunned}.

reaction.name: Voltaic Grounding
entries: When the dyra is subjected to lightning damage, it makes a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw. On a successful save, it takes no damage instead and its Electrostatic Discharge immediately recharges if it wasn't already charged.

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The dyra can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Damage Transfer
entries: Whenever the dyra takes damage while grappling a creature, the creature {@condition grappled} by it also takes half the damage the dyra took.

trait.name: Lightning Susceptibility
entries: If the dyra takes lightning damage, it has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the start of its next turn, and if it's grappling a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or the grapple ends.

trait.name: Metal Stride
entries: While moving on a metallic object, structure, or surface, the dyra's speed is doubled.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The dyra can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dyra makes two pseudopod attacks.

action.name: Pseudopod
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) bludgeoning damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) fire damage.

action.name: Constrict
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one Large or smaller creature. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) bludgeoning damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 15}). Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained}, the dyra can't constrict another target, and the target takes 4 ({@damage 1d8}) fire damage at the start of each of its turns.

trait.name: Heated Body
entries: A creature that touches the drake or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) fire damage.

trait.name: Stench
entries: Any creature other than a brimstone drake that starts its turn within 10 feet of the drake must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} until the start of the creature's next turn. On a successful saving throw, the creature is immune to the stench of all brimstone drakes for 1 hour.

trait.name: Volcanic Acclimation
entries: Ash, dust, fog, and other particles suspended in the air don't impede the drake's vision, and it can breathe normally in ash and under lava.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The drake makes three attacks: one with its bite, one with its claws, and one with its tail.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d10 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d4 + 4}) slashing damage plus 5 ({@damage 2d4}) fire damage.

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage, and if the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Ashen Eruption {@recharge 5}
entries: The drake exhales a cloud of electrically charged ash in a 30-foot cone, creating an area that is heavily obscured until the end of the drake's next turn. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes 35 ({@damage 10d6}) lightning damage and is {@condition blinded} until the end of the drake's next turn. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't {@condition blinded}.

trait.name: Feral Instinct
entries: The gladiator has advantage on initiative rolls. Additionally, if the gladiator is {@status surprised} at the beginning of combat and isn't {@condition incapacitated}, it can act normally on its first turn, but only if it enters its rage before doing anything else on that turn.

trait.name: Hellborn
entries: The gladiator has advantage on any Charisma ({@skill Intimidation}) or Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) check it makes when interacting with fiends.

trait.name: Planar Conspirator (1/Day)
entries: The gladiator can cast the {@spell contact other plane} spell, but only as a ritual.

trait.name: Rage (4/Day)
entries: As a bonus action, the gladiator can enter a rage that lasts for 1 minute. The rage ends early if the gladiator is knocked {@condition unconscious} or if its turn ends and it hasn't attacked a hostile creature or taken damage since its last turn. While raging, the gladiator gains the following benefits:

items: It has advantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws.
It gains a +3 bonus to the damage roll of any melee weapon attacks it makes (included in the attack).
It has resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.
If it succeeds on a grapple check, the target takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) fire damage, and it takes another 3 ({@damage 1d6}) fire damage at the end of each of its turns until the grapple ends.

trait.name: Reckless
entries: At the start of its turn, the gladiator can gain advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls during that turn, but attack rolls against it have advantage until the start of its next turn.

trait.name: Unarmored Defense
entries: While the gladiator isn't wearing any armor, its AC includes its Constitution modifier. It can use a shield and still gain this benefit.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The gladiator makes two melee attacks. While the barbarian is raging, it can make one additional attack with its claw.

action.name: Greataxe
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) slashing damage, or 14 ({@damage 2d6 + 7}) slashing damage while raging.

action.name: Hellfire Claw (While Raging Only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) bludgeoning or slashing damage (gladiator's choice) plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) fire damage.

trait.name: Hellborn
entries: The barbarian has advantage on any Charisma ({@skill Intimidation}) or Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) check it makes when interacting with fiends.

trait.name: Rage (3/Day)
entries: As a bonus action, the barbarian can enter a rage that lasts for 1 minute. The rage ends early if the barbarian is knocked {@condition unconscious} or if its turn ends and it hasn't attacked a hostile creature or taken damage since its last turn. While raging, the barbarian gains the following benefits:

items: It has advantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws.
It gains a +2 bonus to the damage roll of any melee weapon attacks it makes (included in the attack).
It has resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.

trait.name: Reckless
entries: At the start of its turn, the barbarian can gain advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls during that turn, but attack rolls against it have advantage until the start of its next turn.

trait.name: Unarmored Defense
entries: While the barbarian isn't wearing any armor, its AC includes its Constitution modifier. It can use a shield and still gain this benefit.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: While the barbarian is raging, it makes two melee attacks, one of which must be with its claw.

action.name: Greataxe
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) slashing damage, or 12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) slashing damage while raging.

action.name: Hellfire Claw (While Raging Only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}3 bludgeoning or slashing damage (barbarian's choice) plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) fire damage.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: Elson's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma. It can innately cast the following spells (spell save {@dc 17}, {@hit 9} to hit with spell attacks), requiring no material components:

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Elson is an 18th-level spellcaster. His spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 17}, {@hit 9} to hit with spell attacks). Elson regains his expended spell slots when he finishes a short or long rest. He knows the following warlock spells:

spells: {@spell eldritch blast} (4 beams, +5 to each damage roll)

trait.name: Eldritch Heads (6/Day)
entries: When Elson hits a creature with an attack, he can cause the target to take an extra 11 ({@damage 2d10}) psychic damage. Alternatively, as a bonus action, Elson can regain 11 ({@dice 2d10}) hit points. While Elson has at least one use of this trait remaining, he can't be {@status surprised} and creatures with the Pack Tactics trait gain no benefit from that trait against him.

action.name: Dagger
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Eldritch Frenzy {@recharge 5}
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 9} to hit, range 120 ft., up to four targets. {@h}22 ({@damage 5d8}) force damage, and if the target is a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 17} Intelligence saving throw or become {@condition stunned} until the end of Elson's next turn.

variant.name: Ochre Elson with Morath, Scepter of the Soul Vortex
entries: Morath, Scepter of the Soul Vortex is an artifact born from a fragment of the Thousand Voices. At the GM's discretion, Elson can wield the scepter, causing the following changes to his stat block:

items: He has a challenge rating of 12 (8,400 XP).
He has resistance to necrotic damage.
He gains a +3 bonus to his spell attack rolls and spell save DC, including for his Eldritch Roar action option (spell save {@dc 20}, +12 to hit with spell attacks).
He knows the {@spell chill touch} cantrip, and can cast the {@spell finger of death} spell once per day.
He has the Bestow Greater Curses and Morath, Scepter of the Soul Vortex traits, as well as the Phantasmal Skull action option (all described below).

entries.name: Bestow Greater Curse (1/Day)
entries: When Elson casts {@spell bestow curse} he can force the target to make its saving throw with disadvantage. On a failed save, the target is simultaneously cursed by all four of the spell's listed options.

entries.name: Morath, Scepter of the Soul Vortex
entries: The rod has 8 charges and regains {@dice 1d3 + 1} expended charges daily at dawn. When Elson reduces a humanoid to 0 hit points, the rod regains 1 expended charge. While holding the rod, Elson can use an action to expend 1 or more of its charges to cast one of the following spells (save {@dc 20}, attack bonus +12) from it: bestow curse (1 charge), circle of death (4 charges), confusion (2 charges), insect plague (3 charges), ray of enfeeblement (1 charge), or speak with dead (1 charge).

entries.name: Phantasmal Skull
entries: Ranged Spell Attack: +12 to hit, range 30 ft., one target. Hit: 13 ({@damage 3d8}) necrotic damage, and Elson regains hit points equal to half the necrotic damage dealt.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The leader's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma. It can innately cast the following spells (spell save {@dc 15}), requiring no material components:

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The leader is a 9th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 15}, {@hit 7} to hit with spell attacks). It regains its expended spell slots when it finishes a short or long rest. It knows the following warlock spells:

trait.name: Eldritch Heads (3/Day)
entries: When the leader hits a creature with an attack, the leader can cause the target to take an extra 9 ({@damage 2d8}) psychic damage. Alternatively, as a bonus action, the leader can regain 9 ({@dice 2d8}) hit points. While the leader has at least one use of this trait remaining, it can't be {@status surprised} and creatures with the Pack Tactics trait gain no benefit from that trait against the leader.

action.name: Dagger
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one creature. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing damage.

trait.name: Three Heads
entries: The cerberus pup has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks and on saving throws against being {@condition blinded}, {@condition deafened}, and {@condition stunned}.

trait.name: Wakeful
entries: When one of the cerberus pup's heads is asleep, its other heads are awake. In addition, magic can't put it to sleep.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The cerberus pup makes three attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}3 ({@damage 1d4 + 1}) piercing damage.

action.name: Hellfire Breath {@recharge}
entries: The cerberus pup exhales debilitating fire in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 11} Dexterity saving throw, taking 3 ({@damage 1d6}) fire damage and 3 ({@damage 1d6}) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

variant.name: Alternative Familiars
entries: Warlocks that have sworn a pact of the chain and align with the chaotic nature of Grihoo and Vaanor can occasionally bind a cerberus pup or analeptic lizard familiar. They typically prefer to bond with those who can provide for their physical and emotional needs—specifically high-enrichment activities like hunting with the pup or providing plenty of bugs for the lizard's diet. A cerberus pup or regenerative lizard serving as a familiar has the following trait.

entries.name: Familiar
entries: At the GM's discretion, warlocks with the Pact of the Chain feature can choose a cerberus pup or regenerative lizard as their familiar, in addition to the forms listed in their class. While the two are bonded, the master can sense what the familiar senses as long as they are within 1 mile of each other. If its master causes it physical harm, the pup or lizard will end its service as a familiar, breaking the telepathic bond.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: Vaanor's innate spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save {@dc 22}, {@hit 14} to hit with spell attacks). Vaanor can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If Vaanor fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Vaanor has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Soul Sentry
entries: Vaanor's weapon attacks are magical. When Vaanor hits an undead with a weapon attack, the target takes an extra 7 ({@damage 2d6}) force damage.

trait.name: Sure-Footed
entries: Vaanor has advantage on Strength and Dexterity saving throws made against effects that would knock it {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Three Heads
entries: Vaanor has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks, as well as Constitution saving throws made to maintain {@status concentration} on spells.

trait.name: Wakeful
entries: When one of Vaanor's heads is asleep, its other heads are awake. In addition, magic can't put it to sleep.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Vaanor can use its Inescapable Presence. It then makes three bite attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 3d6 + 6}) piercing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire damage. If this is the first attack Vaanor has made as part of its Multiattack, the target must succeed on a {@dc 20} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}. If this is the second attack, the target must succeed on a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition stunned} until the start of Vaanor's next turn. If this is the third attack, the target must succeed on a {@dc 20} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition paralyzed} until the start of Vaanor's next turn.

action.name: Inescapable Presence
entries: Vaanor magically restricts one creature it can see within 120 feet of it from fleeing. The target must succeed on a {@dc 22} Wisdom saving throw or become unable to willingly move or teleport away from Vaanor for 1 minute. Creatures that can't be {@condition frightened} are immune to this effect. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to Vaanor's Inescapable Presence for the next 24 hours.

action.name: Hellfire Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: Vaanor exhales debilitating fire in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 20} Dexterity saving throw, taking 35 ({@damage 10d6}) fire damage and 35 ({@damage 10d6}) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

action.name: Summon Hounds (1/Day)
entries: Vaanor magically summons ({@dice 4d4}) hell hounds. A summoned hell hound appears in an unoccupied space within 60 feet of Vaanor and acts as Vaanor's ally. It remains for 1 minute, until it or Vaanor dies, or until Vaanor dismisses it as an action.

legendary.name: Bite
entries: Vaanor makes one bite attack.

legendary.name: Move
entries: Vaanor moves up to its speed.

legendary.name: Trailblaze (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Vaanor moves up to twice its speed, leaving a trail of fire in its wake. During this movement, Vaanor doesn't provoke opportunity attacks, and it can move through the space of any creature that is Huge or smaller. Each creature in its path must make a {@dc 20} Dexterity saving throw, taking 15 ({@damage 2d8 + 6}) bludgeoning damage and 22 ({@damage 5d8}) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Until the end of Vaanor's next turn, each space it moved through is filled with an opaque, 20-foot-high wall of fire. Whenever a creature enters the wall for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there, it takes 22 ({@damage 5d8}) fire damage.

legendary.name: Release the Hounds (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: Vaanor uses its Summon Hounds.

name: The Thousand Voices, Supreme Soul Vortex

spellcasting.name: Remembered Spellcasting
headerEntries: At the start of each of the Thousand Voices's turns, it rolls a {@dice d4} to determine which list of spells is available to it until the start of its next turn. The Thousand Voices's innate spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save {@dc 24}, {@hit 16} to hit with spell attacks). The Thousand Voices can innately cast the following spells as a 20th-level spellcaster, requiring no material components:

trait.name: Deathly Chills
entries: At the start of each of the Thousand Voices's turns, each creature within 10 feet of the Thousand Voices takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) cold damage.

trait.name: Incorporeal Form
entries: The Thousand Voices can occupy another creature's space and vice versa. The Thousand Voices can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the Thousand Voices fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Limited Magic Immunity
entries: The Thousand Voices is immune to spells of 6th level or lower unless it wishes to be affected. It has advantage on saving throws against all other spells and magical effects.

trait.name: Multiversal Intellect
entries: The Thousand Voices's AC includes its Intelligence modifier. In addition, when the Thousand Voices takes damage other than radiant damage while {@status concentration||concentrating} on a spell, it automatically succeeds on the Constitution saving throw made to maintain {@status concentration}.

trait.name: Necrotic Absorption
entries: When the Thousand Voices is subjected to necrotic damage, it takes no damage and instead regains a number of hit points equal to the necrotic damage dealt.

trait.name: 1 Bard
entries: The Thousand Voices can cast {@spell vicious mockery} or thunderwave as a 3rd-level spell (at will). It can also cast {@spell hypnotic pattern} (3/day) and power word kill (1/day).

trait.name: 2 Cleric
entries: The Thousand Voices can cast {@spell sacred flame} or guiding bolt as a 3rd-level spell (at will). It can also cast {@spell spirit guardians} (3/day) and inflict wounds as a 9th-level spell (1/day).

trait.name: 3 Sorcerer
entries: The Thousand Voices can cast firebolt and burning hands as a 3rd-level spell (at will). It can also cast {@spell fireball} (3/day) and finger of death (1/day).

trait.name: 4 Wizard
entries: The Thousand Voices can cast {@spell shocking grasp} and magic missile as a 3rd-level spell (at will). It can also cast {@spell lightning bolt} (3/day) and plane shift (1/day).

trait.name: Turn Immunity
entries: The Thousand Voices is immune to effects that turn undead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Thousand Voices can use its Terrifying Visage. It then uses its Cacophonous Shriek or casts two spells of 3rd level or lower.

action.name: Cacophonous Shriek
entries: Each non-undead creature within 60 feet of the Thousand Voices must make a {@dc 21} Constitution saving throw, with disadvantage if the target is within 5 feet of the Thousand Voices. A target takes 28 ({@damage 8d6}) necrotic damage and 28 ({@damage 8d6}) thunder damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

action.name: Extraplanar Shift
entries: The Thousand Voices enters the space between the planes from the Material Plane, or vice versa. It can remain in the space between the planes for up to 1 minute, and when it returns to the Material Plane, it reappears in a space of its choice within 60 feet of the space it left. While it is in the space between the planes, it can't affect or be affected by anything on any other plane.

action.name: Terrifying Visage
entries: Each non-undead creature within 60 feet of the Thousand Voices that can see it must succeed on a {@dc 20} Wisdom saving throw or become {@condition frightened} for 1 minute. If the save fails by 5 or more, the target's speed is also reduced to 0 for the duration. A {@condition frightened} target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, with disadvantage if the Thousand Voices is within line of sight, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a target's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the target is immune to the Thousand Voices's Terrifying Visage for the next 24 hours.

legendary.name: Shift
entries: The Thousand Voices uses its Extraplanar Shift.

legendary.name: Cast a Spell (Costs 1-3 Actions)
entries: The Thousand Voices casts a cantrip (1 action), a 3rd-level spell (2 actions), or a spell it can cast once per day (3 actions).

legendary.name: Shriek (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The Thousand Voices uses its Cacophonous Shriek.

legendary.name: Maddening Outburst (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: Each creature within 10 feet of the Thousand Voices must make a {@dc 20} Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, a target takes 14 ({@damage 4d6}) psychic damage, can't take reactions until the start of its next turn, and rolls a {@dice d4} to determine what it does during its next turn. On a 1 or 2, the target falls {@condition prone} and then ends its turn. On a 3, the target takes no action or bonus action and uses all its movement to move in a randomly determined direction. On a 4, the target uses all of its movement to move within reach of a random creature, and then uses its action to make a melee weapon attack against that creature; if the target can't move within reach of another creature, it drops whatever it is holding and then ends its turn.

legendaryGroup.name: The Thousand Voices, Supreme Soul Vortex

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: Feluciana's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 22}, {@hit 14} to hit with spell attacks). Feluciana can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If Feluciana fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Feluciana has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Petrifying Glare
entries: When a creature that can see Feluciana's eyes starts its turn within 60 feet of her, she can force the creature to make a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw if she isn't {@condition incapacitated} and can see the creature. If the saving throw fails by 5 or more, the creature is instantly {@condition petrified}. Otherwise, a creature that fails the save begins to turn to stone and is {@condition restrained}. The {@condition restrained} creature must repeat the saving throw at the end of its next turn, becoming {@condition petrified} on a failure or ending the effect on a success. The petrification lasts until the creature is freed by a {@spell greater restoration} spell cast at 7th level or higher spell or other magic.

Unless {@status surprised}, a creature can avert its eyes to avoid the saving throw at the start of its turn. If the creature does so, it can't see Feluciana until the start of its next turn, when it can avert its eyes again. If the creature looks at Feluciana in the meantime, it must immediately make the save.

trait.name: Serpentine Reactiveness
entries: Once per turn, Feluciana can make an opportunity attack with her snake hair without expending her reaction.

trait.name: Virulent Weapons
entries: Feluciana's weapon attacks are magical. In addition, damage from her weapon attacks ignores resistance to poison damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Feluciana makes four attacks: one with her bident and three with her snake hair. When available, she can use her Petrifying Beam in place of her three attacks with her snake hair.

action.name: Bident
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d6 + 5}) piercing damage, and the target must make a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw, taking 14 ({@damage 4d6}) poison damage and 14 ({@damage 4d6}) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The bident flies back to Feluciana's hand immediately after making a ranged attack with it.

action.name: Snake Hair
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d6 + 5}) piercing damage plus 14 ({@damage 4d6}) poison damage.

action.name: Petrifying Beam {@recharge 5}
entries: Feluciana's snakes focus a beam of petrifying energy at one creature she can see within 90 feet of her. A creature that has averted its eyes from Feluciana gains no benefit against this effect. The targeted creature must make a {@dc 20} Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the creature begins to turn to stone and is {@condition restrained}. It must succeed on a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw at the end of its next turn or become {@condition petrified} until freed by a {@spell greater restoration} spell cast at 7th level or higher or other magic.

reaction.name: Retaliating Lash
entries: When a creature within 15 feet of Feluciana deals damage to her, one of her snakes lashes out, coiling itself around the creature. The target must succeed on a {@dc 20} Dexterity saving throw or become {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 15}) and be pulled up to 10 feet toward Feluciana.

legendary.name: Move
entries: Feluciana moves up to her speed.

legendary.name: Snake Hair
entries: Feluciana makes an attack with her snake hair.

legendary.name: Summon Snakes (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: Feluciana magically summons 4 ({@dice 1d4 + 2}) flying snakes or 1 swarm of poisonous snakes. A summoned creature appears in an unoccupied space within 30 feet of Feluciana, acts as her ally, and shares her Virulent Weapons trait. It remains for 1 minute, until it or Feluciana dies, or until she dismisses it as an action.

trait.name: Hold Breath
entries: The lizard can hold its breath for 15 minutes.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The lizard regains 1 hit point at the start of its turn. If the lizard takes fire damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of its next turn. The lizard dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The lizard can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}3 ({@damage 1d4 + 1}) piercing damage.

action.name: Invigorate (1/Day)
entries: The lizard regains all its hit points. Until the start of its next turn, the lizard has resistance to all damage and advantage on all saving throws.

variant.name: Alternative Familiars
entries: Warlocks that have sworn a pact of the chain and align with the chaotic nature of Grihoo and Vaanor can occasionally bind a cerberus pup or analeptic lizard familiar. They typically prefer to bond with those who can provide for their physical and emotional needs—specifically high-enrichment activities like hunting with the pup or providing plenty of bugs for the lizard's diet. A cerberus pup or regenerative lizard serving as a familiar has the following trait.

entries.name: Familiar
entries: At the GM's discretion, warlocks with the Pact of the Chain feature can choose a cerberus pup or regenerative lizard as their familiar, in addition to the forms listed in their class. While the two are bonded, the master can sense what the familiar senses as long as they are within 1 mile of each other. If its master causes it physical harm, the pup or lizard will end its service as a familiar, breaking the telepathic bond.

trait.name: Hold Breath
entries: Grihoo can hold its breath indefinitely.

trait.name: Infinite Heads
entries: Grihoo has an infinite number of heads. Whenever it takes 60 or more damage in a single turn, one of its heads dies. On its next turn, the number of attacks it makes as part of its Multiattack decreases by one (to a minimum of three) and it can't use its Snapping Frenzy. At the end of Grihoo's turn, it replaces all of its missing heads that died since its last turn.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (5/Day)
entries: If Grihoo fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Grihoo has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: Grihoo's weapon attacks are magical.

trait.name: Reactive
entries: Grihoo can take one reaction on every turn in a combat.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Grihoo makes five bite attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 18} to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. {@h}20 ({@damage 2d10 + 9}) piercing damage plus 11 ({@damage 2d10}) force damage.

action.name: Snapping Frenzy
entries: Grihoo unleashes a flurry of bites in its vicinity, making one bite attack against any number of creatures within 30 feet of it, with a separate attack roll for each target.

action.name: Transpositional Swallow {@recharge 5}
entries: Grihoo chooses one creature it can see within 120 feet of it. The target must succeed on a {@dc 21} Charisma saving throw or be teleported inside of Grihoo's stomach. While inside Grihoo, the creature is {@condition blinded} and {@condition restrained}, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside Grihoo, and it takes 28 ({@damage 8d6}) acid damage and 28 ({@damage 8d6}) force damage at the start of each of Grihoo's turns.

If Grihoo takes 60 damage or more on a single turn, it must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or expel all creatures that were teleported inside of it, teleporting them to a random space on the ground within 60 feet of Grihoo. If Grihoo dies, a creature that was teleported inside of it is no longer {@condition restrained} and can escape from the corpse by using 60 feet of movement, exiting {@condition prone}.

reaction.name: Counter Conjuration
entries: When a creature Grihoo can see or hear within 300 feet of it casts a conjuration spell or magically summons a creature, Grihoo interrupts the casting or summoning, causing it to fail and have no effect. Grihoo then regains hit points equal to 15 times the spell slot's level, if it interrupted a spell, or equal to the challenge rating of the creatures being summoned, if it interrupted a summoning.

legendary.name: Bite
entries: Grihoo makes one bite attack.

legendary.name: Teleport (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Grihoo magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

legendary.name: Crushing Infinity (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: Grihoo channels the overwhelming weight of infinity, crushing each creature inside of it. A swallowed creature must make a {@dc 24} Constitution saving throw, taking 55 ({@damage 10d10}) force damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: Dray's innate spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save {@dc 21}, {@hit 13} to hit with spell attacks). Dray can innately cast any cleric cantrip as a 20th-level spellcaster, as well as the following spells, requiring no material components:

trait.name: Hungering Frenzy
entries: When Dray scores a critical hit with a weapon attack or reduces a creature to 0 hit points, his spell save DC increases to 23 and he has advantage on all attack rolls until the end of his next turn.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If Dray fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Dray has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: Dray's weapon attacks are magical.

trait.name: Three Heads
entries: Dray has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks and on Constitution saving throws made to maintain {@status concentration} on spells.

trait.name: Touch of Death
entries: When damage Dray deals reduces a creature to 0 hit points, it automatically suffers one death saving throw failure.

trait.name: Wakeful
entries: When one of Dray's heads is asleep, his other heads are awake. In addition, magic can't put him to sleep.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Dray makes two attacks: one with his fist and one with his dagger.

action.name: Fist
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 14} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}28 ({@damage 6d6 + 7}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on {@dc 22} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Ritual Dagger
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 14} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}22 ({@damage 6d4 + 7}) piercing damage plus 14 ({@damage 4d6}) necrotic damage. The target's hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken, and Dray regains hit points equal to half that amount. The reduction lasts for 1 hour. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0.

legendary.name: Cantrip
entries: Dray casts a cantrip.

legendary.name: Move
entries: Dray moves up to half his speed.

legendary.name: Punch
entries: Dray makes one fist attack.

legendary.name: Summon Minions (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: Dray magically summons ({@dice 2d4}) orcs or 1 ogre. A summoned creature appears in an unoccupied space within 60 feet of Dray and acts as his ally. It remains for 1 minute, until it or Dray dies, or until Dray dismisses it as an action.

name: H'rethi, Soul of the Desert
languages: telepathy 1 mile and understands Common and Terran but can't speak

trait.name: Immovable
entries: H'rethi can't move or be moved by any means short of a {@spell wish} spell.

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: H'rethi is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: When H'rethi fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: H'rethi has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Shattering Destruction
entries: When H'rethi drops to 0 hit points, it shatters and is destroyed. Any creature on the ground within 30 feet of H'rethi must make a {@dc 20} Dexterity saving throw, taking 22 ({@damage 4d10}) piercing damage and 22 ({@damage 4d10}) radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: H'rethi makes three Soul Ray attacks.

action.name: Soul Ray
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 11} to hit, range 120 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 4d6}) force damage plus 14 ({@damage 4d6}) radiant damage, and the target is pushed up to 10 feet away.

action.name: Fortify {@recharge 5}
entries: H'rethi gains 50 temporary hit points, and all attack rolls made against it have disadvantage until the start of its next turn.

reaction.name: Absorb Magic (3/Day)
entries: When H'rethi takes damage from a spell or other magical effect, it instead takes no damage and regains a number of hit points equal to the damage dealt. H'rethi is still subject to any other effects that might accompany the damage.

legendary.name: Sand Lash
entries: A tendril-like whip rises from the ground, striking at one creature within 120 feet of H'rethi. The target must make a {@dc 19} Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) slashing damage, and if it is Large or smaller, it is also {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 15}). If the target is already {@condition grappled}, it becomes {@condition restrained} until the grapple ends.

legendary.name: Create Sentry (2 Actions)
entries: H'rethi creates a 5-foot-radius, 15-foot-high pillar of compacted sand in an unoccupied space it can see within 60 feet of it. When H'rethi uses its Multiattack on its turn, it can make one additional SouI Ray attack for each pillar that exists. Each of these additional attacks originates from a different pillar and only deals the force damage from the attack. The pillar is an object that can be damaged and thus destroyed. It has AC 15 and 30 hit points. Reducing the pillar to 0 hit points causes it to crumble into dust.

legendary.name: Dispel Magic (2 Actions)
entries: H'rethi casts {@spell dispel magic}. Its spellcasting ability is Charisma for this spell.

trait.name: Ambusher
entries: The spider has advantage on attack rolls against any creature it has {@status surprised}.

trait.name: Nimble Escape
entries: The spider can take the Disengage or Hide action as a bonus action on each of its turns.

trait.name: Seize
entries: If the spider has advantage on an attack roll and hits a creature that is Large or smaller, the creature is also {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 14}).

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The spider can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d8 + 3}) piercing damage, and the target must make a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw, taking 9 ({@damage 2d8}) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If the poison damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, the target is stable but {@condition poisoned} for 1 hour, even after regaining hit points, and is {@condition paralyzed} while {@condition poisoned} in this way.

trait.name: Desert Camouflage
entries: The lizard has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks made to hide in sandy terrain.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The lizard makes two attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d8 + 2}) piercing damage plus 18 ({@damage 4d8}) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} for 1 hour. While {@condition poisoned} in this way, the target takes another 4 ({@damage 1d8}) poison damage at the start of each of its turns. Each time the lizard hits the {@condition poisoned} target with this attack, the damage dealt at the start of each of its turns increases by 4 ({@dice 1d8}). If the {@condition poisoned} target receives magical healing or a creature uses a healer's kit on the target, the target can repeat the Constitution saving throw, ending the {@condition poisoned} condition on a success.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) slashing damage.

action.name: Spit Venom
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 4} to hit, range 15/30 ft., one target. {@h}The target must make a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw, taking 18 ({@damage 4d8}) acid damage and 18 ({@damage 4d8}) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

name: Desert Cat
languages: Terran and understands Common but can't speak it

trait.name: Desert Camouflage
entries: The desert cat has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks made to hide in sandy terrain.

trait.name: Earth Glide
entries: The desert cat can burrow through nonmagical, unworked earth and stone. While doing so, the desert cat doesn't disturb the material it moves through.

trait.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
entries: The desert cat has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) slashing damage, and the target must make a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target has disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before the start of the desert cat's next turn.

action.name: Sand Step
entries: The desert cat teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space it can see that contains dirt, sand, or other fine earth.

variant.name: Desert Cat Familiar
entries: Spellcasters who are particularly attuned to the elemental planes or are inherently familiar with the desert's dunes may occasionally find and bind a desert cat familiar, especially those spellcasters who embody the desert cat's curiosity and propensity for chaos. A bound desert cat's behavior is erratic and varies greatly depending on its master's influence. Desert cats also are exceptionally skilled at reaching otherwise difficult-to-reach locations to cause trouble, especially around precious gems and metals. A desert cat serving as a familiar has the following trait.

entries.name: Familiar
entries: At the GM's discretion, warlocks with the Pact of the Chain feature can choose a desert cat as their familiar, in addition to the forms listed in their class. While the two are bonded, the master can sense what the desert cat senses as long as they are within 1 mile of each other. If its master causes it physical harm, the desert cat will end its service as a familiar, breaking the telepathic bond.

trait.name: Ambusher
entries: The antlion has advantage on attack rolls against any creature it has {@status surprised}.

trait.name: Burrowed Camouflage
entries: While it is at least partially burrowed, the antlion has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks made to hide in sand or loose earth.

trait.name: Surprise Attack
entries: If the antlion surprises a creature and hits it with an attack during the first round of combat, the target takes an extra 16 ({@damage 3d10}) damage from the attack.

trait.name: Antlion Cone
entries: The antlion can spend 10 minutes digging a cone-shaped pit in the sand, or some other loose earth. The cone is 20 feet deep and 40 feet across, and the sides are steep enough that the loose earth they are made with is a falling hazard. A standing creature that moves within the cone (even if by forced movement) for the first time on a turn must succeed on a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw or fall {@condition prone}. A creature that falls {@condition prone} while within the cone rolls to the bottom.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}20 ({@damage 3d10 + 4}) piercing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 15}). Until this grapple ends the antlion can't bite another target or use its sand throw, and if the target is a creature, it is {@condition restrained}.

action.name: Sand Throw
entries: One creature the antlion can sense within 30 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 14} Dexterity saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

reaction.name: Snapping Jaws
entries: When a creature the antlion can sense moves to within the reach of the antlion's bite and the antlion is not grappling a creature, it can make a bite attack against that creature.

trait.name: Ambusher
entries: The antlion has advantage on attack rolls against any creature it has {@status surprised}.

trait.name: Burrowed Camouflage
entries: While it is at least partially burrowed, the antlion has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks made to hide in sand or loose earth.

trait.name: Surprise Attack
entries: If the antlion surprises a creature and hits it with an attack during the first round of combat, the target takes an extra 26 ({@damage 4d12}) damage from the attack.

trait.name: Sure-Footed
entries: The antlion has advantage on Strength and Dexterity saving throws made against effects that would knock it {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Antlion Cone
entries: The antlion can spend 10 minutes digging a cone-shaped pit in the sand, or some other loose earth. The cone is 30 feet deep and 60 feet across, and the sides are steep enough that the loose earth they are made with is a falling hazard. A standing creature that moves within the cone (even if by forced movement) for the first time on a turn must succeed on a {@dc 14} Dexterity saving throw or fall {@condition prone}. A creature that falls {@condition prone} while within the cone rolls to the bottom.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The antlion makes three attacks: one with its bite, and two with its claws.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}31 ({@damage 4d12 + 5}) piercing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 17}). Until this grapple ends the antlion can't bite another target or use its sand throw, and if the target is a creature, it is {@condition restrained}.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 15 feet., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 3d6 + 5}) slashing damage.

action.name: Sand Throw
entries: One creature the antlion can sense within 30 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

reaction.name: Snapping Jaws
entries: When a creature the antlion can sense moves to within the reach of the antlion's bite and the antlion is not grappling a creature, it can make a bite attack against that creature.

trait.name: Ambusher
entries: The antlion has advantage on attack rolls against any creature it has {@status surprised}.

trait.name: Burrowed Camouflage
entries: While it is at least partially burrowed, the antlion has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks made to hide in sand or loose earth.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d8 + 2}) piercing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 12}). Until this grapple ends the antlion can't bite another target.

reaction.name: Snapping Jaws
entries: While the antlion is benefiting from its Burrowed Camoflage and not grappling a creature, when a creature the antlion can sense moves into the antlion's space, it can make a bite attack against that creature.

trait.name: Keen Sight
entries: The wyvernfly has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight.

trait.name: Prescience
entries: The wyvernfly can't be {@status surprised}.

trait.name: Steady Flight
entries: While flying, the wyvernfly has advantage on ability checks and saving throws made against effects that would push it, pull it, or knock it {@condition prone}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The wyvernfly makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws. It can use its Mark in place of one attack.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d10 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) slashing damage.

action.name: Mark
entries: The wyvernfly marks a creature it can see as its prey. Until it marks a different creature, it has advantage on attack rolls against the target, and the target has disadvantage on attack rolls against the wyvernfly. In addition, its attacks against the target score a critical hit on a roll of 18-20.

trait.name: Bird Caller
entries: The soldier can cast the {@spell animal messenger} spell, but only as a ritual and only targeting a beast that has an innate flying speed.

trait.name: Launch (3/Day)
entries: As a bonus action while on the ground, the soldier jumps up to 15 feet. This movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks, and the soldier takes no falling damage when it lands. The soldier can't use this trait if its speed is 0.
If the soldier hits a target with an attack immediately after it lands or during the leap's movement, the target takes an extra 5 ({@damage 1d10}) damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The soldier makes two attacks.

action.name: Glaive
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d10 + 3}) slashing damage.

action.name: Longbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 3} to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d8 + 1}) piercing damage.

trait.name: Bird Caller
entries: The captain can cast the {@spell animal messenger} spell, but only as a ritual and only targeting a beast that has an innate flying speed.

trait.name: Indomitable (2/Day)
entries: The captain rerolls a failed saving throw.

trait.name: Launch (5/Day)
entries: As a bonus action while on the ground, the captain jumps up to 30 feet. This movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks, and the captain takes no falling damage when it lands. The captain can't use this trait if its speed is 0.

If the captain hits a target with an attack immediately after it lands or during the leap's movement, the target takes an extra 5 ({@damage 1d10}) damage, and it must succeed on a {@dc 16} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Steel Jump (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: When the captain uses its Launch trait, it can choose to jump 90 feet, instead of 30.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The captain makes three attacks.

action.name: Silver Eagle Greatsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d6 + 6}) slashing damage. Scoring a critical hit with this weapon doesn't double the weapon's damage dice. Whenever the same number is rolled on both of the weapon's damage dice, the target takes an extra 3 ({@damage 1d6}) damage.

action.name: Longbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 5} to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) piercing damage.

name: Lava Wurm
languages: and Terran but can't speak them

trait.name: Hold Breath
entries: The wurm can hold its breath for 30 minutes.

trait.name: Noxious Resilience
entries: The wurm has advantage on saving throws made against harmful gases and vapors (such as the effects of a stinking cloud or a green dragon's poison breath).

trait.name: Tunneler
entries: The wurm can burrow through solid rock at half its burrowing speed and leaves a 5-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

trait.name: Volcanic Body
entries: The wurm sheds bright light in a 5-foot radius and dim light for an additional 5 feet. In addition, whenever a creature enters the area within 5 feet of the wurm for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, that creature takes 2 ({@damage 1d4}) fire damage.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) piercing damage plus 4 ({@damage 1d8}) fire damage.

action.name: Molten Spray {@recharge 5}
entries: The wurm exhales molten metal in a 15-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes 14 ({@damage 4d6}) fire damage and its speed is reduced by 10 feet. If a target's speed is reduced to 0 by this effect, it becomes {@condition restrained}. A creature can take an action to scrape or wash off the metal, ending the effect. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and its speed isn't reduced.

name: Elder Lava Wurm
languages: and Terran but can't speak them

trait.name: Hold Breath
entries: The wurm can hold its breath for 1 hour.

trait.name: Limited Flight
entries: The wurm can only fly for up to 1 minute at a time. If it ends its turn in the air after 1 minute of consecutive flight and nothing else is holding it aloft, it falls.

trait.name: Noxious Resilience
entries: The wurm has advantage on saving throws made against harmful gases and vapors (such as the effects of a stinking cloud or a green dragon's poison breath).

trait.name: Tunneler
entries: The wurm can burrow through solid rock at half its burrowing speed and leaves a 5-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

trait.name: Volcanic Body
entries: The wurm sheds bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for an additional 10 feet. In addition, whenever a creature enters the area within 10 feet of the wurm for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, that creature takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) fire damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The wurm makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d10 + 4}) piercing damage plus 5 ({@damage 1d10}) fire damage.

action.name: Molten Spray {@recharge 5}
entries: The wurm exhales molten metal in a 30-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes 38 ({@damage 11d6}) fire damage and its speed is reduced by 15 feet. If a target's speed is reduced to 0 by this effect, it becomes {@condition restrained}. A creature can take an action to scrape or wash off the metal, ending the effect. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and its speed isn't reduced.

name: Alceton
languages: Giant Elk understands Common and Elvish but can't speak them

trait.name: Charge
