entries: If the alceton moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a ram attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 7 ({@damage 2d6}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 14} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Sure-Footed
entries: The alceton has advantage on ability checks and saving throws made against effects that would knock it {@condition prone}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The alceton makes two attacks: one with its ram and one with its talons.

action.name: Ram
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d10 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Talons
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) slashing damage, and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature that is {@condition prone}, it is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 14}). Until this grapple ends, the alceton can't use its talons on another target.

trait.name: Flyby
entries: The psybird doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

trait.name: Limited Telepathy
entries: The psybird doesn't understand any languages, but can communicate telepathically with other creatures it chooses within its telepathy range. This telepathy can convey emotions or fleeting sensory memories, such as faint echoes of sounds it has heard, or flashes of images it has seen.

action.name: Beak
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Hypnotizing Plumage {@recharge}
entries: The psybird attempts to vex nearby creatures with its psionic calls and dazzling plumage. Each creature within 30 feet of the psybird that can see or hear it must succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw or become {@condition charmed} by the psybird for 10 minutes.
When a creature becomes {@condition charmed} by this effect, apply one of the effects below at random for as long as the creature remains {@condition charmed}.

action.name: 1 Hazy Sight
entries: The creature is unable to see with any definition further than 10 feet from itself. The affected creature is considered to be {@condition blinded} to any creature or object further than 10 feet from itself, as they appear to it only as blurry, amorphous blobs of color.

action.name: 2 Confusion
entries: The creature suffers the effects of the {@spell confusion} spell, though the psybird doesn't need to maintain {@status concentration} on it. The affected creature can repeat its save at the end of each of its turns, ending the charm on itself on a success.

action.name: 3 Stupefaction
entries: The creature suffers disadvantage on all attack rolls and ability checks it makes that use either Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma. The creature also temporarily forgets any languages it knows except for the one it has known the longest.

action.name: 4 Dizziness
entries: Any turn in combat during which the creature uses more than half of its movement speed, it must succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw or fall {@condition prone}. Each time this happens, the creature can repeat its save, ending the effect on a success.

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: The grymhare can use a bonus action to polymorph into a Tiny rabbit, or back into its true form, which is Medium. Its statistics, other than its size and its available actions, are the same in either form. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

trait.name: Grappler
entries: The grymhare has advantage on attack rolls against any creature {@condition grappled} by it.

trait.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
entries: The grymhare has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The grymhare has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Surprise Attack
entries: If the grymhare surprises a creature and hits it with a beak attack during the first round of combat, the target takes an extra 14 ({@damage 4d6}) damage from the attack.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The grymhare makes one attack with its tentacles against each creature of its choice within its reach simultaneously. It then makes one beak attack.

action.name: Beak (True Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Bite (Rabbit Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Tentacle (True Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, it is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 14}) and the grymhare pulls it up to 5 feet straight toward it.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The tyrannosaur's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 14}, {@hit 6} to hit with spell attacks). The tyrannosaur can innately cast the following spells, requiring only somatic components:
footerEntries: *The tyrannosaur casts barkskin before combat

trait.name: Enraged Casting {@recharge 4}
entries: While the tyrannosaur has half of its hit points or fewer, it can cast one of its innate spells as a bonus action, even if the normal casting time for that spell is an action.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The tyrannosaur has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The tyrannosaur makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its tail. It can't make both attacks against the same target.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}32 ({@damage 4d12 + 6}) piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 16}). Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained}, and the tyrannosaur can't bite another target.

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}19 ({@damage 3d8 + 6}) bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Dungeon Born
entries: The geleton has advantage on any ability checks it makes to locate or identify hidden features of dungeons, such as traps or secret passageways.

trait.name: Ooze Ancestry
entries: The geleton doesn't need to breathe. The geleton doesn't require sleep, gaining the benefits of a long rest after spending 4 hours in a trance-like state. The geleton has advantage on saving throws against disease.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The geleton makes two weapon attacks.

action.name: Longsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) slashing damage, or 8 ({@damage 1d10 + 3}) slashing damage if wielded with two hands.

action.name: Javelin
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage.

trait.name: Ooze Ancestry
entries: The cyglops doesn't need to breathe. The cyglops doesn't require sleep, gaining the benefits of a long rest after spending 4 hours in a trance-like state. The cyglops has advantage on saving throws against disease.

trait.name: Poor Depth Perception
entries: The cyglops has disadvantage on any attack roll against a target more than 30 feet away.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The cyglops makes two pseudopod attacks and uses its eye ray, if recharged. The eye ray can be replaced by its Release Skeletons action.

action.name: Pseudopod
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 3d8 + 4}) bludgeoning damage plus 11 ({@damage 2d10}) acid damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, it must succeed on a {@dc 14} Strength saving throw or be pushed 5 feet from the cyglops and knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Eye Ray {@recharge 4}
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 8} to hit, range 60 ft., one target. {@h}27 ({@damage 6d8}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Release Skeletons
entries: The cyglops ejects {@dice 1d3} sets of skeletal remains from inside itself to an unoccupied space it can see within 10 feet of it, losing 4 ({@dice 1d8}) hit points for each one. The remains then animate, each becoming a skeleton loyal to the cyglops. Each skeleton remains for up to 1 hour, or until the cyglops reabsorbs it as an action. All skeletons created this way share one turn in combat, which takes place immediately following the cyglops in initiative.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The toad can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Corrosive Mucus
entries: Any creature that touches the toad or hits it with a melee attack takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) acid damage.

trait.name: Standing Leap
entries: The toad's long jump is up to 20 feet and its high jump is up to 10 feet, with or without a running start.

trait.name: Plant Camouflage
entries: The toad has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks it makes in any terrain with ample obscuring plant life.

trait.name: Tongue Barb Regrowth
entries: The toad has eighteen tongue barbs. Used barbs regrow when the toad finishes a long rest.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Tongue Barb
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 4} to hit, range 30/60 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing damage, and the target must make a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 9 ({@damage 2d8}) poison damage and is {@condition poisoned} for 1 minute. On a successful save, the target takes half as much poison damage and isn't {@condition poisoned}.
Until this poison ends, the target is {@condition paralyzed}. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the poison on itself on a success.

trait.name: Ambusher
entries: The creeper has advantage on attack rolls against any creature it has {@status surprised}.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the creeper remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from normal cluster of vines.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The creeper can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Thorns
entries: At the start of each of its turns, the creeper deals 7 ({@damage 2d6}) piercing damage to any creature grappling it, or that it has {@condition grappled}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The creeper makes two attacks with its strangling bramble. It can't make both attacks against the same target.

action.name: Strangling Bramble
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 10 ft., one Large or smaller target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage, and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 14}). Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained} and at risk of suffocating. If the creeper is grappling a Large creature, or two Medium or smaller creatures, it can't use this attack against another creature.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the flower remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal shrub.

trait.name: Rooted
entries: The flower is unaffected by forced movement and can't be detached while it lives. If the flower is rooted to a wall or ceiling, it doesn't need to make ability checks to maintain its grip.

action.name: Flytrap
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) piercing damage, and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 12}).

action.name: Acid Spit
entries: One creature within 60 feet of the flower that the flower can see must make a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw. A creature that fails its save takes 4 ({@damage 1d8}) acid damage and is knocked {@condition prone}. If the creature is climbing, it instead loses its grip and falls. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much acid damage and suffers no other effects.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The pixie's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 13}). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

trait.name: Drunken Confessions
entries: Each creature within 15 feet of the tipsy that has two or more levels of {@condition drunkenness|GriffonsSaddlebag2} (as per the Drunkenness rules from page 274 of this book) is under the effect of a {@spell zone of truth} spell. Whenever an affected creature tells the truth as a result of this effect, it must succeed on a {@dc 13} Charisma saving throw or also be compelled to share a true feeling it has about one or more of the creatures to whom it's speaking.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The tipsy has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Charm
entries: One humanoid the tipsy can see within 30 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw or be magically {@condition charmed}. If the {@condition charmed} creature is under the effect of a {@spell zone of truth} spell, it isn't aware of the spell and thus won't intentionally avoid answering questions to which it would normally respond with a lie.

Each time the tipsy or its allies ask the target a question, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success. Otherwise, the effect lasts for 1 hour or until the tipsy dies, is on a different plane of existence from the target, or ends the effect as a bonus action. If the target successfully saves against the effect, or if the effect on it ends, the target is immune to this tipsy's Charm for the next 24 hours. The tipsy can have no more than three creatures {@condition charmed} at a time.

action.name: Invisibility
entries: The tipsy magically turns {@condition invisible} until it attacks or casts a spell, or until its {@status concentration} ends (as if {@status concentration||concentrating} on a spell). Any equipment the tipsy wears or carries is {@condition invisible} with it. Creatures with two or more levels of {@condition drunkenness|GriffonsSaddlebag2} are unaffected by this effect and can see the tipsy as if it wasn't {@condition invisible}.

trait.name: Keen Sight and Smell
entries: The rot monster has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight or smell.

trait.name: Limited Flight
entries: The rot monster can only fly for up to 1 minute at a time. While flying, it has disadvantage on ability checks and saving throws against effects that would knock it {@condition prone}. If it ends its turn in the air after 1 minute of consecutive flight and nothing else is holding it aloft, it falls.

trait.name: Rot Wood
entries: Any nonmagical weapon made of wood that hits the rot monster rots and deteoriates. After dealing damage, the weapon takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to damage rolls. If its penalty drops to -5, the weapon is destroyed. Nonmagical ammunition made of wood that hits the rot monster is destroyed after dealing damage.

trait.name: Waste Scent
entries: The rot monster can pinpoint, by scent, the location of rotting food and other decaying organic matter within 1 mile of it.

action.name: Beak
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d6 + 1}) piercing damage, plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Talons
entries: The rot monster touches a nonmagical object made of organic matter that it can see within 5 feet of it, causing it to rot and deteriorate. If the object isn't being worn or carried, the touch destroys a 1-foot cube of it. If the object is being worn or carried by a creature, the creature can make a {@dc 12} Dexterity saving throw to avoid the rot monster's touch.

If the object touched is either armor made of leather or hide, or a wooden shield being worn or carried, it takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to the AC it offers. Armor reduced to an AC of 10 or a shield that drops to a +0 bonus is destroyed. If the object touched is a held wooden weapon, it deteriorates as described in the Rot Wood trait.

immune.note: from nonmagical attacks that aren't adamantine

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the golem remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary pile of garbage.

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: The golem is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The golem has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The golem's weapon attacks are magical.

trait.name: Stench
entries: Any creature other than a refuse golem that starts its turn within 10 feet of the golem, must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned|phb} until the start of the creature's next turn. On a successful saving throw, the creature is immune to the stench of all refuse golems for 1 hour.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The golem makes two slam attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) bludgeoning damage, plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) piercing or slashing damage (golem's choice).

action.name: Hurl Junk
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 7} to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. {@h}26 ({@damage 4d10 + 4}) bludgeoning damage.

reaction.name: Missile Absorption
entries: When the golem is hit by a ranged weapon attack, it absorbs the projectile into its form. When it does so, the damage it takes from the attack is reduced by 11 ({@dice 2d10}). A creature within 5 feet of the golem can take an action to pull an absorbed projectile out of it with a successful {@dc 15} Strength check.

trait.name: Shapechanger (Mimic)
entries: The mimic can use its action to polymorph into a keg, mug, vat, or other alcohol-related object or back into its true, amorphous form. Its statistics are the same in each form, except when it polymorphs into an object it can choose to change its size to Tiny or Small until it polymorphs back into its true form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

trait.name: Adhesive (Object Form Only)
entries: The mimic adheres to anything that touches it. A Huge or smaller creature adhered to the mimic is also {@condition grappled} by it (escape {@dc 13}). Ability checks made to escape this grapple have disadvantage.

trait.name: False Appearance (Object Form Only)
entries: While the mimic remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary alcohol-related object.

trait.name: Grappler
entries: The mimic has advantage on attack rolls against any creature {@condition grappled} by it.

action.name: Pseudopod
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) bludgeoning damage. If the mimic is in object form, the target is subjected to its Adhesive trait.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) piercing damage plus 4 ({@damage 1d8}) poison damage.

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The jam can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the jam remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a mass of grape jam.

trait.name: Limited Spell Resistance
entries: The jam has advantage on saving throws against spells of 1st level or lower.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The jam regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hit point. If the jam takes necrotic damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the jam's next turn.

trait.name: Rejuvenation
entries: If the jam dies, it regains all its hit points and becomes active again in 24 hours unless its remains are eaten, destroyed, or targeted by a {@spell dispel magic} spell.

action.name: Pseudopod
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d6 + 1}) bludgeoning damage, plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) poison damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The battlechef is an 8th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save {@dc 14}, {@d20 +6} to hit with spell attacks). It has the following cleric spells prepared:

trait.name: Divine Strike (1/Turn)
entries: When the battlechef hits a creature with a weapon attack, the battlechef can cause the attack to deal an extra 4 ({@damage 1d8}) acid or poison damage (battlechef's choice) to the target.

trait.name: Poison Resilience
entries: The battlechef has advantage on saving throws against {@condition poisoned|PHB|poison}.

trait.name: Strong Stomach (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: While the battlechef is {@condition drunkenness|GriffonsSaddlebag2|drunk}, it can choose to magically suppress the alcohol's effects for 1 minute.

action.name: Handaxe
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) slashing damage.

action.name: Create Healing Draft (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: The battlechef creates a magical potion in its free hand or at its feet (battlechef's choice). A creature that drinks this potion regains 15 ({@dice 2d6 + 8}) hit points. The potion turns to dust and is lost if the battlechef finishes a short or long rest before it is consumed.

reaction.name: Table-Turner (3/Day)
entries: When the battlechef is hit by an attack from a creature within 5 feet of it, the creature must make a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 6 ({@damage 1d12}) poison damage and is {@condition poisoned|PHB} until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and isn't {@condition poisoned|PHB}.

trait.name: Alcohol Form
entries: The elemental can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. It can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Freeze
entries: If the elemental takes cold damage, it partially freezes; its speed is reduced by 20 feet until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The elemental makes two slam attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) bludgeoning damage, plus 4 ({@damage 1d8}) poison damage.

action.name: Whelm {@recharge 4}
entries: Each creature in the elemental's space must make a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw. On a failure, a target takes 13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) bludgeoning damage. If it is Large or smaller, it is also {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 14}). Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained} and unable to breathe unless it can breathe water. If the saving throw is successful, the target is pushed out of the elemental's space.

The elemental can grapple one Large creature or up to two Medium or smaller creatures at one time. At the start of each of the elemental's turns, each target {@condition grappled} by it takes 8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) bludgeoning damage plus 4 ({@damage 1d8}) poison damage and must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or gain one level of {@condition drunkenness|GriffonsSaddlebag2}. A creature within 5 feet of the elemental can pull a creature or object out of it by taking an action to make a {@dc 14} Strength check and succeeding. Any levels of {@condition drunkenness|GriffonsSaddlebag2} caused by this effect go away when the grapple ends.

variant.name: Wine Elemental
entries: Taking the form of bubbling liquids of various colors, wine elementals are a more potent and rare version of the ale elemental. More intelligent and attuned to nature than their fellows, their appearance is usually in reaction to the destruction of nature. . Bacchanalian parties that damage the environment often attract their ire, resulting in many party-goers getting far more than they reckoned. Whatever their perceived or actual motivations, these elementals are a formidable force and especially dangerous for those with a low tolerance for alcohol.
A wine elemental has the same statistics as an ale elemental, with the following changes:

items: Its Intelligence and Charisma scores increase to 10 (+0).
It can speak Druidic.
It replaces the Freeze trait with the Partial Freeze trait (detailed below).

While a creature is {@condition grappled} by the elemental's Whelm, it gains two levels of drunkenness if it fails the Constitution saving throw at the start of each of the elemental's turns, and one level if it succeeds.

entries.name: Partial Freeze
entries: If the elemental takes 10 cold damage or more during a single turn, it partially freezes. Until the end of its next turn, its speed is reduced by 20 feet.

name: The Wild Hunt

trait.name: Hunter's Prowess
entries: The Wild Hunt have advantage on attack rolls against a target if they are occupying the same space as the target and there are not other hostile creatures in The Wild Hunt's space.

trait.name: Incorporeal Swarm
entries: The Wild Hunt can occupy another creature's space and vice versa. The Wild Hunt can also move through any opening large enough for a Medium creature, and they can move through other creatures and objects as if they were {@quickref difficult terrain||3}. The Wild Hunt take 5 ({@damage 1d10}) force damage if they end their turn inside an object.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The Wild Hunt have advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Wild Hunt make two mauling rend attacks. They can use their Volley in place of one attack.

action.name: Mauling Rend
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) piercing damage, plus 9 ({@damage 2d4 + 4}) slashing damage, or 7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) piercing damage plus 6 ({@damage 1d4 + 4}) slashing damage if The Wild Hunt have half their hit points or fewer.

action.name: Volley
entries: The Wild Hunt releases a flurry of arrows, targeting a point they can see within 120 feet of them. Each creature in a 20-foot-radius, 20-foot-high cylinder centered on that point must make a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw, taking 14 ({@damage 4d6}) piercing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If The Wild Hunt have half their hit points or fewer, a target instead takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) piercing damage on a failed save, or no damage on a successful one.

legendaryHeader: The Wild Hunt can take 2 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. The Wild Hunt regain spent legendary actions at the start of their turn.

legendary.name: Move
entries: The Wild Hunt moves up to its speed.

legendary.name: Rallying Horn (Below Half Hit Points Only)
entries: The Wild Hunt gain 13 ({@dice 2d12}) temporary hit points.

legendary.name: War Horn (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Whenever a target takes damage from The Wild Hunt before the end of their next turn, the target takes an extra 4 ({@damage 1d8}) force damage.

name: Haunted Reflection
languages: understands any languages it knew in life but can't speak

trait.name: Limited Telepathy
entries: The reflection can magically communicate simple ideas, emotions, and images telepathically with any creature within 100 feet of it that can understand a language.

trait.name: Death Shift
entries: If damage reduces the reflection to 0 hit points, it can make a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 5 + the damage taken, unless the damage is thunder or from a critical hit. The reflection automatically fails this saving throw if there are no other reflective surfaces within 60 feet of it. On a success, the reflection regains 10 hit points and uses its Mirror Step (no action required) as the previous reflective surface that contained it is destroyed.

trait.name: Unsettling Glare
entries: When a creature that can see the reflection starts its turn within 60 feet of the reflection, the reflection can force the creature to make a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw if the reflection isn't {@condition incapacitated}. A target automatically succeeds on this saving throw if it can't be {@condition frightened}. On a failed save, the creature has disadvantage on ability checks and its speed is halved until the start of its next turn.

Unless {@status surprised}, a creature can avert its eyes to avoid the saving throw at the start of its turn. If the creature does so, it can't see the reflection until the start of its next turn, when it can avert its eyes again. If the creature looks at the reflection in the meantime, it must immediately make the save.

action.name: Concentrated Ire
entries: The reflection focuses a wave of psychic fury at one creature it can see within 120 feet of it. The target must make a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw, taking 18 ({@damage 4d8}) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature that has averted its eyes from the reflection has advantage on this saving throw, and takes no damage if it succeeds on the save.

action.name: Mirror Step
entries: The reflection teleports into another nonmagical, metallic reflective surface of its choice that it can see within 60 feet of it.

reaction.name: Magic Reflection
entries: When the reflection is the only target of a spell or other magical effect that misses it or whose saving throw it succeeds, the reflection reflects the spell or effect back at its source. The source must be within 120 feet of the reflection or this effect fails. The reflection uses the spell save DC, attack bonus, and spellcasting ability of the original source.

name: Ghost Dragon

trait.name: Ethereal Sight
entries: The dragon can see 60 feet into the Ethereal Plane when it is on the Material Plane, and vice versa.

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The dragon can move through other creatures and objects as if they were {@quickref difficult terrain||3}. It takes 5 ({@dice 1d10}) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dragon can use its Horrifying Presence. It then makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

action.name: Withering Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 2d10 + 6}) necrotic damage, plus 5 ({@damage 1d10}) cold damage.

action.name: Withering Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d6 + 6}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Withering Tail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d8 + 1}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Horrifying Presence
entries: Each creature of the dragon's choice that is within 120 feet of the dragon and aware of it must succeed on a {@dc 20} Wisdom saving throw or become {@condition frightened} for 1 minute. If the save fails by 5 or more, the target also ages {@dice 1d4 × 10} years. A {@condition frightened} creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the {@condition frightened} condition on itself of a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the dragon's Horrifying Presence for the next 24 hours. The aging effect can be reversed with a {@spell greater restoration} spell, but only within 24 hours of it occurring.

action.name: Chilling Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: The dragon exhales deathly cold energy in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 20} Dexterity saving throw, taking 63 ({@damage 18d6}) cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

legendaryHeader: The dragon can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. The dragon regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

legendary.name: Detect
entries: The dragon makes a Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check.

legendary.name: Tail Attack
entries: The dragon makes a tail attack.

legendary.name: Etherealness (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The dragon enters the Ethereal Plane from the Material Plane, or vice versa. It is visible on the Material Plane while it is in the Border Ethereal, and vice versa, yet it can't affect or be affected by anything on the other plane.

legendary.name: Wing Attack (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The dragon beats its wings. Each creature within 10 feet of the dragon must succeed on a {@dc 20} Dexterity saving throw or take 13 ({@damage 2d6 + 6}) necrotic damage and be knocked {@condition prone}. The dragon can then fly up to half its flying speed.

trait.name: Evasion
entries: If the leader is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, the leader instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if it fails.

trait.name: Spirit Hand
entries: The leader can cast {@spell mage hand} at will, requiring no verbal or somatic components. The leader can cast this spell and control the hand as a bonus action, and when the leader casts the spell, it can make the hand {@condition invisible}.

trait.name: Stunning Strike (1/Turn)
entries: When the leader hits a creature with a melee attack, it can force the target to make a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target is {@condition stunned} until the end of the leader's next turn.

trait.name: Supernatural Attacks
entries: The leader's weapon attacks are magical, and its Spirit Strike can hit targets on the Ethereal Plane.

trait.name: Unarmored Defense
entries: While the leader is wearing no armor and wielding no shield, its AC includes its Wisdom modifier.

trait.name: Invisibility (3/Day)
entries: As a bonus action, the leader can magically turn {@condition invisible} until the start of its next turn, or until it makes an attack or casts a spell.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The leader makes four attacks.

action.name: Spirit Strike
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 1d10 + 5}) force damage.

action.name: Unarmed Strike
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d10 + 4}) bludgeoning damage.

reaction.name: Deflect Missile
entries: When the leader is hit by a ranged weapon attack, it deflects the missile, reducing the damage by 26 ({@dice 1d10 + 21}). If the damage is reduced to 0, the leader catches the missile if it's small enough to hold in one hand and the leader has a hand free. It can then make a ranged weapon attack with the caught missile, which has an attack bonus of {@d20 +8}, a normal range of 20 feet, and a long range of 60 feet. On a hit, the target takes 9 ({@damage 1d10 + 4}) damage of the missile's type.

reaction.name: Phase (5/Day)
entries: When the leader is hit by an attack, it partially slips into the Border Ethereal, reducing the damage it takes from the attack by 16 ({@dice 2d10 + 5}).

variant.name: Durheim Leader with Lightseer's Gaze
entries: The {@item lightseer's gaze|GriffonsSaddlebag2} is a precious and heavily guarded artifact within Durheim Monastery, originally worn by Lightseer Attiskin. He left explicit provision that only in times of dire need should the mantle of Lightseer be taken up. Wearing the {@item lightseer's gaze|GriffonsSaddlebag2} causes {@condition blinded|PHB|blindness}, but the stars and celestial bodies in the heavens are still visible. The mysterious item also rewrites history, forcing the bearer to select a new name - only the bearer is aware that they ever had a different name.
At the GM's discretion, a Durheim Leader can wield the {@item lightseer's gaze|GriffonsSaddlebag2}, causing the following changes to its stat block:

items: It has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) checks.
It has {@sense blindsight} out to a range of 120 feet, but is blind beyond this radius.
It gains the Innate Spellcasting trait below.

entries.name: Innate Spellcasting
entries: The leader's spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save {@dc 17}). The leader can innately cast the following spells, requiring no components:
2/day: {@spell spirit guardians}
4/day: {@spell calm emotions}

trait.name: Spirit Hand
entries: The initiate can cast {@spell mage hand} at will, requiring no verbal or somatic components. The initiate can cast this spell and control the hand as a bonus action, and when the initiate casts the spell, it can make the hand {@condition invisible}.

trait.name: Unarmored Defense
entries: While the initiate is wearing no armor and wielding no shield, its AC includes its Wisdom modifier.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The initiate makes two attacks.

action.name: Spirit Strike
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) force damage.

action.name: Shortsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) piercing damage.

trait.name: Ethereal Sight
entries: The guide can see up to 60 feet into the Ethereal Plane.

trait.name: Evasion
entries: If the guide is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, the guide instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if it fails.

trait.name: Spirit Hand
entries: The guide can cast {@spell mage hand} at will, requiring no verbal or somatic components. The guide can cast this spell and control the hand as a bonus action, and when the guide casts the spell, it can make the hand {@condition invisible}.

trait.name: Stunning Strike (1/Turn)
entries: When the guide hits a creature with a melee attack, it can force the target to make a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target is {@condition stunned} until the end of the guide's next turn.

trait.name: Supernatural Attacks
entries: The guide's weapon attacks are magical, and its Spirit Strike can hit targets on the Ethereal Plane.

trait.name: Unarmored Defense
entries: While the guide is wearing no armor and wielding no shield, its AC includes its Wisdom modifier.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The guide makes three attacks.

action.name: Spirit Strike
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) force damage.

action.name: Unarmed Strike
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) bludgeoning damage.

reaction.name: Deflect Missile
entries: In response to being hit by a ranged weapon attack, the guide deflects the missile. The damage it takes from the attack is reduced by 18 ({@dice 1d10 + 13}). If the damage is reduced to 0, the guide catches the missile if it's small enough to hold in one hand and the guide has a hand free. It can then make a ranged weapon attack with the caught missile, which has an attack bonus of {@d20 +5}, a normal range of 20 feet, and a long range of 60 feet. On a hit, the target takes 6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) damage of the missile's type.

name: Death Coach

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The death coach's spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 20}. The death coach can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The death coach can move through other creatures and objects as if they were {@quickref difficult terrain||3}. It takes 5 ({@dice 1d10}) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the death coach fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The death coach has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Silencing Aura
entries: The area within 60 feet of the death coach is under the effects of a {@spell silence} spell. The death coach is immune to this effect.

trait.name: Trampling Charge
entries: If the death coach moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a hooves attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a {@dc 20} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}. If the target is {@condition prone}, the death coach can make another attack with its hooves against the target as a bonus action.

action.name: Hooves
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}28 ({@damage 4d10 + 6}) force damage.

action.name: Etherealness (Ghost)
entries: The death coach enters the Ethereal Plane from the Material Plane, or vice versa. It is visible on the Material Plane while it is in the Border Ethereal, and vice versa, yet it can't affect or be affected by anything on the other plane.

legendaryHeader: The death coach can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. The death coach regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

legendary.name: Move
entries: The death coach moves up to its speed.

legendary.name: Dreadful Presence (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Each creature of the death coach's choice that is within 30 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 20} Wisdom saving throw or become {@condition frightened} for 1 minute. If the save fails by 5 or more, the target's speed is also reduced to 0 until this {@condition frightened} effect ends for it. A {@condition frightened} creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the {@condition frightened} condition on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the death coach's Dreadful Presence for the next 24 hours.

legendary.name: Cast a Spell (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: The death coach casts a spell.

name: Lothrem, the Wreathed Dragon

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (1/Day)
entries: If Lothrem fails a saving throw, they can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Nature's Restoration
entries: Lothrem regains 10 hit points at the start of their turn if they have at least 1 hit point. If they are in sunlight, they instead regain 20 hit points.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Lothrem can use their Frightful Presence. They then make three attacks: one with their bite and two with their claws.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 16} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}19 ({@damage 2d10 + 8}) piercing damage, plus 5 ({@damage 1d10}) lightning damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 16} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d6 + 8}) slashing damage.

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 16} to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 2d8 + 8}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Frightful Presence
entries: Each creature of Lothrem's choice that is within 120 feet of Lothrem and aware of them must succeed on a {@dc 23} Wisdom saving throw or become {@condition frightened} for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to Lothrem's Frightful Presense for the next 24 hours.

action.name: Ensnaring Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: Lothrem exhales enriching breath on the ground in a 120-foot line that is 10 feet wide, causing a thick wall of tangled, thorny brush to magically grow in the area. The wall is 20 feet high and blocks line of sight. Each creature in the area must make a {@dc 25} Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 63 ({@damage 14d8}) piercing damage and is {@condition restrained} in the wall. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't {@condition restrained}.

The wall remains until the end of Lothrem's next turn, at which point it withers and disappears. A creature {@condition restrained} in the wall or one that is within 5 feet of the creature can use its action to make a {@dc 19} Strength check, freeing the creature on a success. For the duration, the area is {@quickref difficult terrain||3}, and when a creature moves into or within the area, it takes 9 ({@damage 2d8}) piercing damage for every 5 feet it travels.

action.name: Change Shape
entries: Lothrem magically polymorphs into a humanoid or beast that has a challenge rating no higher than their own, or back into their true form. Lothrem reverts to their true form if they die. Any equipment Lothrem is wearing or carrying is absorbed or borne by the new form (Lothrem's choice).

In a new form, Lothrem retains their own alignment, hit points, Hit Dice, ability to speak, proficiencies, Legendary Resistance, lair actions, and Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores, as well as this action. Lothrem's statistics and capabilities are otherwise replaced by those of the new form, except and class features or legendary actions of that form.

legendaryHeader: The dragon can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. Lothrem regains spent legendary actions at the start of their turn.

legendary.name: Detect
entries: Lothrem makes a Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check.

legendary.name: Tail Attack
entries: Lothrem makes a tail attack

legendary.name: Wing Attack (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Lothrem beats their wings. Each creature within 10 feet of Lothrem must succeed on a {@dc 24} Dexterity saving throw or take 15 ({@damage 2d6 + 8}) bludgeoning damage and be knocked {@condition prone}. Lothrem can then fly up to half their flying speed.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting (Humanoid Form Only)
headerEntries: Vincent is a 12th-level spellcaster. His spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save {@dc 16}), and he can't cast spells that require material components while in dragon form. He has the following druid spells prepared:
footerEntries: *This spell requires material components.

trait.name: Draconic Weapons (Dragon Form Only)
entries: While in dragon form, Vincent's attacks count as magical for the purpose of overcoming resistance and immunity to nonmagical attacks.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: In dragon form, Vincent makes two attacks: one with his bite and one with his claws. In humanoid form, he makes two sickle attacks.

action.name: Sickle (Humanoid Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit ({@hit 8} to hit with {@spell shillelagh}), reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}2 ({@damage 1d4}) slashing damage, or 8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) slashing damage with {@spell shillelagh}.

action.name: Bite (Dragon Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 1d12 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Claw (Dragon Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Breath Weapon {@recharge 6} (Dragon Form Only)
entries: Vincent exhales a plume of energy in a 25-foot cone. Each creature in the area must make a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw, taking 14 ({@damage 4d6}) damage of the type associated with Vincent's dragon type (see the {@table Dragon Damage Type|GriffonsSaddlebag2} table) on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

action.name: Change Shape (2/day)
entries: Vincent uses his action to magically polymorph into a Medium dragon of any type of his choice (see the {@table Dragon Damage Type|GriffonsSaddlebag2} table), or back into his humanoid form. When Vincent polymorphs, it gains 120 temporary hit points, and he can choose whether his equipment falls to the ground, melds into his new form, or is worn by the new form (if possible). He reverts to his humanoid form after 6 hours, if he dies, or if he falls {@condition unconscious}. His statistics are the same in each form, other than his AC and speed, as noted.

entries: When determining what dragon color and damage type a Crest City druid or similar creature should use when they use their Change Shape ability, use the table below.

action.name: Change Shape (2/Day)

action.name: Bite (Dragon Form Only)

name: Malfuriel the Betrayer

resist.note: from nonmagical attacks not made with silvered weapons

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: Malfuriel's spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 17}). Malfuriel can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

trait.name: Bloodmire Adaptation
entries: Malfuriel is immune to the diseases described in the {@table Bloodmire Diseases|GriffonsSaddlebag2} table.

trait.name: Devil's Sight
entries: Magical darkness doesn't impede Malfuriel's darkvision.

trait.name: Divine Awareness
entries: Malfuriel knows if he hears a lie.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (1/Day)
entries: If Malfuriel fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Malfuriel has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Forsaken Weapons
entries: Malfuriel's weapon attacks are magical. When Malfuriel hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra 3 ({@damage 1d6}) necrotic damage (included in the attack).

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Malfuriel makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Greatsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 3d6 + 5}) slashing damage, plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Corrupting Touch (2/Day)
entries: Malfuriel touches a creature, and that creature must succeed on a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw or be magically {@condition charmed} for 1 hour. The {@condition charmed} target obeys Malfuriel's spoken or telepathic commands.

If the target suffers any harm, or receives a command to harm itself, the target can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a target successfully saves against the effect, or if the effect ends for it, the target is immune to Malfuriel's Corrupting Touch for the next 24 hours.

legendaryHeader: Malfuriel can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. Malfuriel regains spent legendary actions at the start of his turn.

legendary.name: Move
entries: Malfuriel moves up to half his speed.

legendary.name: Greatsword (2 Actions)
entries: Malfuriel makes one greatsword attack.

legendary.name: Accursed Step (3 Actions)
entries: Malfuriel magically teleports, along with any equipment he is wearing and carrying, up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space he can see. Malfuriel can then choose one creature he can see within 5 feet of him. The target must make a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw, taking 10 ({@damage 3d6}) necrotic damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. Malfuriel regains hit points equal to the amount of necrotic damage dealt.

variant.name: Optional: Malfuriel's Weakened State
entries: At your discretion, Malfuriel may be in a weakened state from his battle with Syre when the party first encounters him. If so, his hit point maximum is reduced to 109, making him a CR 9 encounter worth 5,000 XP.

trait.name: Bloodmire Adaptation
entries: The mosquito is immune to the diseases described in the {@table Bloodmire Diseases|GriffonsSaddlebag2} table.

trait.name: Swarm
entries: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Small mosquito. The swarm can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.

action.name: Bites
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 0 ft., one creature in the swarm's space. {@h}14 ({@damage 4d6}) piercing damage, or 7 ({@damage 2d6}) if the swarm has half of its hit points or fewer.

trait.name: Bloodmire Adaptation
entries: The mosquito is immune to the diseases described in the {@table Bloodmire Diseases|GriffonsSaddlebag2} table.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}3 ({@damage 1d6}) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 11} Constitution saving throw or take 3 ({@damage 1d6}) poison damage.

trait.name: Bloodmire Adaptation
entries: The eel is immune to the diseases described in the {@table Bloodmire Diseases|GriffonsSaddlebag2} table.

trait.name: Water and Blood Breathing
entries: The eel can breathe only underwater or under bloodwater.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The eel makes two bite attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) piercing damage, and the target must make a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw, taking 7 ({@damage 2d6}) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a  successful one.

resist.note: from nonmagical attacks not made with silvered weapons

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: The imp can use its action to polymorph into a beast form that resembles a giant rat (speed 30 ft.), a blood hawk (10 ft., fly 60 ft.), or a giant centipede (30 ft., climb 30 ft.), or back into its true form. Its statistics are the same in each form, except for the speed changes noted. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

trait.name: Bloodmire Adaptation
entries: The imp is immune to the diseases described in the {@table Bloodmire Diseases|GriffonsSaddlebag2} table.

trait.name: Devil's Sight
entries: Magical darkness doesn't impede the imp's darkvision.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The imp has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The imp has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the imp's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't {@condition incapacitated}.

action.name: Sting (Bite or Beak in Beast Form)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) piercing damage, and the target must make a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw, taking 14 ({@damage 4d6})  necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

action.name: Invisibility
entries: The imp magically turns {@condition invisible} until it attacks or until its {@status concentration} ends (as if {@status concentration||concentrating} on a spell). Any equipment the imp wears or carries is {@condition invisible} with it.

trait.name: Bloodmire Adaptation
entries: The treant is immune to the diseases described in the {@table Bloodmire Diseases|GriffonsSaddlebag2} table.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the treant remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal Bloodmire tree.

trait.name: Siege Monster
entries: The treant deals double damage to objects and structures.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The treant makes two slam attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 3d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Mudball
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 7} to hit, range 60/180 ft., one target. {@h}20 ({@damage 3d10 + 4}) bludgeoning damage, and the target's speed is halved until the start of the treant's next turn.

action.name: Animate Blood (2/Day)
entries: The treant magically animates a pool of blood it can see within 60 feet of it. The blood congeals into a viscous form and has the statistics of a {@creature gelatinous cube}, except its Ooze Cube, Pseudopod, and Engulf trait and action options deal necrotic damage instead of acid damage, and its Transparent trait doesn't function unless it's in blood or bloodwater.

The animated blood acts as an ally of the treant. The blood remains animate for 8 hours or until it dies; until the treant dies or is more than 120 feet from the blood; or until the treant takes a bonus action to turn it back into an inanimate pool of blood.

name: Germination Stall
languages: the languages its staff knew in life

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The stall's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 15}). The stall can innately cast the following spells, requiring no components:

trait.name: Alluring Affluence
entries: Whenever a humanoid ends its turn within 60 feet of the stall, it must make a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature has no hint that it is gradually falling under the effects of the stall's enchantment. If a creature succeeds on three of these saves, it is immune to this effect for the next 24 hours. If the creature fails three of these saves, it becomes {@condition charmed} by the stall and must use all its movement on its turns to get as close to the stall as possible. The effect lasts for 24 hours or until the stall dies, is on a different plane of existence than the target, or ends the effect on the creature as a bonus action.

trait.name: Dedicated Staff
entries: The stall comprises a staff of 5 ({@dice 2d4}) {@creature seed coin pollinator|GriffonsSaddlebag2|seed coin pollinators}. This staff collectively shares the stall's Innate Spellcasting and Magic Resistance traits, they can't willingly move more than 150 feet away from the stall, and they seek to defend the stall at all costs, including to their own peril. Some of the stall's effects can use a member or members of its staff as the point of origin.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: The stall is indistinguishable from a normal merchant stall. However, a creature that has {@sense truesight} sees a deep red aura radiating from the stall, and a creature within 30 feet of it that is under the effect of a {@spell detect poison and disease} spell senses the insidious nature of the stall and knows it is a plant creature.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The stall has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Unusual Nature
entries: The stall doesn't require sleep. If the stall spends 1 hour in direct sunlight, it receives enough nourishment to sustain itself for one day. If the stall dies, it decomposes and is reduced to dirt within 7 days.

action.name: Enthralling Vines
entries: The stall causes dark, creeping vines to protrude from itself and its staff, lashing out at creatures nearby. Each creature of the stall's choice within 10 feet of it or a member of its staff must succeed on a {@dc 14} Strength saving throw or be {@condition restrained} by the vines for 1 minute. While {@condition restrained} in this way, a creature has disadvantage on saving throws against the stall's Alluring Affluence. A creature {@condition restrained} by the vines can use its action to make a {@dc 14} Strength check, freeing itself on a success. These vines disappear if the stall dies, or if it uses this action again. It can also choose to end the effect early on any number of {@condition restrained} creatures it chooses as a bonus action.

action.name: Hostile Takeover
entries: The stall attempts to magically compel one creature {@condition charmed} by it that is within 5 feet of the stall or a member of its staff to swallow a {@creature seed coin|GriffonsSaddlebag2}. The target must make a {@dc 10} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target swallows the coin and is subjected to the seed coin's Infestation. When subjected to the effect in this way, the diseased creature is killed in a number of hours equal to half its Wisdom score, unless the disease is removed. If the target successfully saves against this effect or the effect ends for it, it regurgitates the coin and is no longer {@condition charmed} by the stall, and it is immune to the stall's Alluring Affluence for the next 24 hours.

name: Seed Coin Pollinator
languages: the languages its host knew in life

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: The pollinator is indistinguishable from a normal commoner, and it appears and sounds exactly like the creature it was before becoming infested. However, a creature that has {@sense truesight} sees a deep red aura radiating from the pollinator, and a creature within 30 feet of it that is under the effect of a {@spell detect poison and disease} spell senses the insidious nature of the pollinator and knows it is a plant creature.

trait.name: Unusual Nature
entries: The pollinator doesn't require sleep. If the pollinator spends 1 hour in direct sunlight, it receives enough nourishment to sustain itself for one day. When the pollinator dies, it becomes an ordinary humanoid corpse.

action.name: Dagger
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 2} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}2 ({@damage 1d4}) damage.

action.name: Coin Spray {@recharge}
entries: The pollinator hurls a flurry of {@creature seed coin|GriffonsSaddlebag2|seed coins} at one creature it can see within 10 feet of it. The target must make a {@dc 10} Dexterity saving throw, taking 10 ({@damage 4d4}) bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If the saving throw fails by 5 or more, one of the seed coins gets lodged on the target's body (for example, in a pocket or a fold in its clothing).

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: The seed coin is indistinguishable from a normal copper piece. However, a creature that has {@sense truesight} sees a deep red aura radiating from the seed coin, and a creature within 30 feet of it that is under the effect of a {@spell detect poison and disease} spell senses the insidious nature of the seed coin and knows it is a plant creature.

trait.name: Unusual Nature
entries: The seed coin doesn't require sleep. If the seed coin spends 1 minute in direct sunlight or a creature spends 1 hour in direct sunlight while the seed coin is on the creature's person, the seed coin receives enough nourishment to sustain itself for one day. When the seed coin dies, it becomes an ordinary copper piece.

action.name: Infestation
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 0} to hit, reach 0 ft., one humanoid that has the seed coin on its person. {@h}The creature must succeed on a {@dc 10} Wisdom saving throw or its mind becomes imperceptibly infected with a disease until the seed coin is no longer on the creature's person or the creature dies. Creatures immune to the {@condition charmed} condition are immune to this disease, and a creature that succeeds on the saving throw is immune to this disease for the next 30 days. The seed coin's influence invades a diseased creature's mind, killing the creature in a number of hours equal to {@dice 1d12} + the creature's Wisdom score, unless the disease is removed. In half that time, the creature becomes {@condition charmed} for the rest of the duration and refuses to part with the seed coin.

If a diseased creature dies while the seed coin is on its person, it immediately regains all its hit points and becomes a {@creature seed coin pollinator|GriffonsSaddlebag2}, as the seed coin takes over its body. The seed coin doesn't gain access to the creature's knowledge, class features, or proficiencies while controlling a creature in this way. This infestation lasts until the {@creature seed coin pollinator|GriffonsSaddlebag2} dies, killing the seed coin.

variant.name: Silver Seed Coin
entries: A rare breed, these seed coins bear an uncanny resemblance to a typical silver piece. Though less prevalent, they are even more potent than their copper kin. Such a silver seed coin uses the seed coin stat block, with the following changes:

items: It has a challenge rating of 1 (200 XP).
Its Intelligence and Charisma scores each increase to 14.
It has immunity to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks.
It is indistinguishable from a normal silver piece, and it becomes an ordinary silver piece when it dies.
It has the Innate Spellcasting trait below, which it retains after it becomes a seed coin pollinator.
The saving throw for its Infestation increases to DC 12, and it kills a diseased creature in a number of hours equal to {@dice 1d6} + the creature's Wisdom score, rather than {@dice 1d12}.

entries.name: Innate Spellcasting
entries: The seed coin's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 12). The seed coin can innately cast the following spells, requiring no components:

items: At will: {@spell prestidigitation}
3/day each: {@spell comprehend languages}, {@spell misty step}
1/day each: {@spell locate creature}, {@spell suggestion}

trait.name: Ambusher
entries: In the first round of a combat, the scarapit has advantage on attack rolls against any creature it has {@quickref Surprise|PHB|3|0|surprised}.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The scarapit has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on smell.

trait.name: Noxious Resilience
entries: The scarapit can breathe normally in any environment, and it has advantage on saving throws made against harmful gases and vapors (such as {@spell cloudkill} and {@spell stinking cloud} effects, inhaled poisons, and the breath weapons of some dragons).

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The scarapit can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Subterranean Explorer
entries: While the scarapit is underground, it always knows how far it is from the surface, it can't be {@quickref Surprise|PHB|3|0|surprised} while it isn't {@condition incapacitated}, and it has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Survival}) checks made to track creatures.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d8 + 3}) piercing damage, or 21 ({@damage 4d8 + 3}) piercing damage if the target is {@quickref Surprise|PHB|3|0|surprised}, and the target must make a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw, taking 9 ({@damage 2d8}) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If the poison damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, the target is stable but {@condition poisoned} for 1 hour, even after regaining hit points, and is {@condition paralyzed} while {@condition poisoned} in this way.

Alternatively, the merchant can use an action to see and hear through the enchanted coin until the start of its next turn, using its own senses as if it were in the coin's space. During this time, the merchant is {@condition deafened|PHB|deaf} and {@condition blinded|PHB|blind} with regard to its own senses.

If it's tails, one random creature within 60 feet of the merchant gains a {@dice d8}, which it can roll and add to one ability check, attack roll, or saving throw it makes before the end of its next turn.

entries: The swarm can't be affected or detected by spells of 2nd level or lower unless it wishes to be. It has advantage on saving throws against all other spells and magical effects. In addition, if the swarm is subjected to a spell or other magical effect that allows it to make a saving throw to take only half damage, it instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw.

trait.name: Scornful Reinforcement
entries: When the swarm kills a creature that has a familiar, the familiar joins the swarm, causing the swarm's hit point maximum and current hit points to increase by 10.

trait.name: Spell Detection
entries: The swarm immediately knows when a spell of 3rd-level or higher has been cast within 1000 feet of it, and it can sense the direction to the spellcaster's location.

trait.name: Swarm
entries: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny familiar.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The swarm makes two attacks.

action.name: Spiteful Touch
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 0 ft., one target in the swarm's space. {@h}14 ({@damage 4d6}) force damage plus 14 ({@damage 4d6}) necrotic damage, or 7 ({@damage 2d6}) force damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) necrotic damage if the swarm has half of its hit points or fewer.

action.name: Drain Magic
entries: The swarm attempts to siphon some magical power from a creature it can see within 10 feet of it. If the target has any remaining spell slots, it must make a {@dc 16} saving throw using its spellcasting ability. The target makes this saving throw with disadvantage if it has less than half of its spell slots remaining. On a failed save, the target loses one spell slot. Roll a {@dice d6} to determine the level of the spell slot lost. If the target has no remaining spell slots of that level, it instead loses its highest remaining spell slot below that level. The swarm then regains ({@dice 1d8}) hit points per level of the spell slot lost.

reaction.name: Arcane Barrier
entries: The swarm adds 3 to its AC against one attack that would hit it, as it creates an instantaneous shield of force around itself.

trait.name: Flora Flit
entries: Once on each of its turns, the lizard can use 10 feet of its movement to step magically into any living flora (such as a plant, mold, or fungus) within 5 feet of it and emerge from a second living flora within 60 feet of it, appearing in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the second flora. Both florae must be Medium or larger. If the lizard takes fire damage, this trait doesn't function until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Nature Stride
entries: Moving through nonmagical {@quickref difficult terrain||3} costs the lizard no extra movement. It can also pass through nonmagical plants without being slowed by them and without taking damage from them if they have thorns, spines, or a similar hazard.

trait.name: Organic Camouflage

action.name: Bite
