If the target is Huge or smaller, it has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 15}), and it has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition until the grapple ends. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only. {@actSaveSuccessOrFail} The reveler gains {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to the Necrotic damage taken.

action.name: Heroic Charge (Hero Only)
entries: The reveler moves up to its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} in a straight line without provoking {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB|Opportunity Attacks}, and it can move through other creatures without expending extra movement to do so. {@actSave str} {@dc 17}, each creature whose space the reveler enters. {@actSaveFail} 26 ({@damage 4d12}) Force damage, and the target has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

action.name: Wicked Storm (Witch Only)
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 17}, each creature in a 60-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}. {@actSaveFail} 27 ({@damage 6d8}) Lightning damage, and the target has the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition. While {@condition Frightened|XPHB} in this way, the target's {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is 0. A {@condition Frightened|XPHB} target repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

reaction.name: Dramatic Reversal
entries: {@actTrigger} The reveler is hit by an attack roll. {@actResponse} The reveler adds 4 to its AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss.

trait.name: Compelled Contest
entries: The reveler can't refuse a contest of skill with Musical Instruments. As an {@action Influence|XPHB} action, a creature can make a Charisma ({@skill Performance|XPHB}) check using a Musical Instrument. The reveler must succeed on a Charisma saving throw with a DC equal to the check's total or take 20 Psychic damage and have the {@condition Stunned|XPHB} condition until the end of the creature's next turn.

trait.name: Dancing Step
entries: The reveler doesn't provoke {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB|Opportunity Attacks} when it leaves an enemy's reach.

trait.name: Ensemble Form
entries: The reveler takes on a specific form: Drone, Drum, or Bell. The form determines certain traits and actions, as well as the instrument the reveler plays (hurdy gurdy, frame drum, or handbells, respectively).

trait.name: Droning Swarm (Drone Only)
entries: A droning swarm of bees surrounds the reveler. {@actSave con} {@dc 16}, each creature that ends its turn in a 10-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the reveler. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The reveler makes two Instrumental Blast attacks.

action.name: Instrumental Blast
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 8}, reach 5 ft. or range 90 ft. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) Thunder damage.

action.name: Infectious Rhythm (Drum Only)
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 16}, up to two creatures the reveler can see within 30 feet. {@actSaveFail} 18 ({@damage 4d8}) Psychic damage, and the target is affected by the {@spell Otto's Irresistible Dance|XPHB|Irresistible Dance} spell (no {@status Concentration|XPHB} required to maintain the spell). {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

action.name: Stunning Clangor (Bell Only)
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 16}, one creature the reveler can see within 60 feet. {@actSaveFail} 40 ({@damage 9d8}) Thunder damage, and the target has the {@condition Stunned|XPHB} condition until the end of the reveler's next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

name: Pumpkin Head
languages: understands Common plus one other language but only speaks using Mimicry

trait.name: Mimicry
entries: The pumpkin head can mimic the voice of the person it replaced or someone it used Personality Consumption on. A creature that hears the voice can tell it's an imitation only with a successful {@dc 14} Wisdom ({@skill Insight|XPHB}) check.

trait.name: Sorrowful Memento
entries: If the pumpkin head can see a creature holding a possession of the person the pumpkin head replaced, it has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB|D20 Tests}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The pumpkin head makes one Claw attack and one Pitchfork attack, and it can use Personality Consumption if available.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) Slashing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Necrotic damage.

action.name: Pitchfork
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 10 ft. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) Piercing damage, and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature, the pumpkin head can push or pull it 5 feet.

action.name: Personality Consumption {@recharge 5}
entries: The pumpkin head consumes a victim's memories. {@actSave int} {@dc 12}, one creature the pumpkin head can see within 30 feet. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Stunned|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn, and its Intelligence score decreases by {@dice 1d4}. The target dies if this reduces that score to 0. A Humanoid slain in this way is replaced by a {@creature Pumpkin Head|CrookedMoon24} {@dice 1d8} hours later unless its body is burned.

spellcasting.name: Coven Magic
headerEntries: While within 30 feet of at least two hag allies, the hag can cast one of the following spells, requiring no Material components, using the spell's normal casting time, and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability: {@spell Augury|XPHB}, {@spell Find Familiar|XPHB}, {@spell Identify|XPHB}, {@spell Locate Object|XPHB}, {@spell Lucky Charm|CrookedMoon24} (lasts until the hag casts it again, or chooses to end it with no action required), or {@spell Unseen Servant|XPHB}. The hag must finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} before using this trait to cast that spell again.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The hag casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 19}):

trait.name: Disarming Vanity
entries: As an {@action Influence|XPHB} action, a creature that flatters the hag forces it to succeed on a {@dc 17} Charisma saving throw or have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition until the end of the hag's next turn.

trait.name: Harrying Wings
entries: When the hag rolls {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB}, it is surrounded by fey spirits in the form of angry pigeons.

The hag's enemies within a 10-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from it have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on ability checks and attack rolls. This trait doesn't function if the hag has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hag makes three Claw attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting (at will spells only).

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 10}, reach 5 ft. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) Slashing damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Psychic damage.

action.name: Agonizing Cackle (1/Day)
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 19}, each creature in a 60-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}. {@actSaveFail} A target takes 45 ({@damage 10d8}) Psychic damage and has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition until the start of the hag's next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

bonus.name: Shape-Shift
entries: The hag shape-shifts into a Small or Medium Humanoid, or it returns to its true form. Other than its size, its game statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

trait.name: Breathless Warding
entries: A creature holding its breath has the {@condition Invisible|XPHB} condition to the hearse. If the creature takes damage while holding its breath, it must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or let out its breath and become visible to the hearse until the start of the creature's next turn, when it can hold its breath again.

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The hearse can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hearse makes two Ghostly Coachman attacks. It can replace one of the attacks with a use of Trample, if available.

action.name: Ghostly Coachman
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 8}, reach 10 ft. or range 60 ft. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) Cold damage. If the target is a creature, it can't regain {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} until the start of the hearse's next turn.

action.name: Trample {@recharge 5}
entries: The hearse moves in a straight line up to its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}. {@actSave dex} {@dc 16}, each creature whose space the hearse enters during this action. {@actSaveFail} 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Cold damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, it has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 14}), and it has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition until the grapple ends. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

action.name: Tolling Bell (1/Day)
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 16}, each creature of the hearse's choice that it can see in a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the hearse. {@actSaveFail} 44 ({@damage 8d10}) Psychic damage, and the creature's {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is halved until the start of the hearse's next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

bonus.name: Entomb
entries: {@actSave str} {@dc 16}, one creature {@condition Grappled|XPHB} by the hearse (it can have up to three creatures entombed at a time). {@actSaveFail} The target is entombed in a coffin in the hearse, and the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition ends.

An entombed target has the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} and {@condition Restrained|XPHB} conditions, has {@variantrule Cover|XPHB|Total Cover} against attacks and other effects outside the hearse, and at the start of each of the hearse's turns it takes 21 ({@damage 6d6}) Necrotic damage and gains 1 {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} level.

If the hearse takes 20 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside a coffin, the hearse must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or release all entombed creatures, each of which falls in a space within 5 feet of the hearse and has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition. If the hearse dies, any entombed creature falls to the ground with the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition in the hearse's former space.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting (Requires Animal Mask)
headerEntries: The chosen casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components other than its Animal Mask and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 15}, {@hit 7} to hit with spell attacks):

trait.name: Animal Mask
entries: The chosen wears the mask of an animal, imbuing it with the strength of the old gods. When a creature is grappling the chosen, the creature can remove the mask as an action, or as an attack during the Attack action, with a successful {@dc 12} Strength ({@skill Athletics|XPHB}) check. Without its mask, the chosen can't cast spells, its {@status Concentration|XPHB} on any existing spells ends, and the save DC of Song of the Old Ways is reduced by 4.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The chosen makes three {@variantrule Ritual|XPHB} Dagger attacks.

action.name: Ritual Dagger
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 7}, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d4 + 4}) Piercing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Radiant or Necrotic damage (the chosen's choice).

action.name: Songs of the Old Ways {@recharge 5}
entries: The chosen sings one of the following songs:

action.name: Blessing of the Harvest
entries: Each creature of the chosen's choice in a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the chosen regains 14 ({@dice 4d4 + 4}) {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}.

action.name: Song of Sacrifice
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 14}, one creature within 30 feet. {@actSaveFail} 40 ({@damage 9d8}) Necrotic damage, and the target has the {@condition Paralyzed|XPHB} condition until the end of the chosen's next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

action.name: Wicker Chant
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 14}, each creature of the chosen's choice in a 20-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the chosen. {@actSaveFail} 31 ({@damage 9d6}) Fire damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

bonus.name: Jump (Requires Animal Mask)
entries: The chosen casts {@spell Jump|XPHB}, using the same spell components and spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

vulnerable.special: Damage from weapons wiped with salt

trait.name: Blood Stalker
entries: The night creature has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Wisdom checks made to find or track a creature that is missing any {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}.

trait.name: Salt Susceptibility
entries: The night creature has {@variantrule Vulnerability|XPHB} to damage from weapons wiped with salt. A creature can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to wipe salt onto a weapon, which remains coated for 1 minute, or until it hits a creature.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The night creature can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Sunlight Hypersensitivity
entries: The night creature takes 20 Radiant damage if it starts its turn in sunlight. While in sunlight, it has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on attack rolls and ability checks.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The night creature makes one Claw attack and uses Bite.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) Slashing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 14}) from one of two claws.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 14}, one creature within 5 feet that is willing or that has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB}, {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB}, or {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition. {@actSaveFail} 6 ({@damage 1d4 + 4}) Piercing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Necrotic damage. The target's {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} maximum decreases by an amount equal to the Necrotic damage taken, and the night creature regains {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to that amount.

bonus.name: Shape-Shift
entries: If the night creature isn't in sunlight, it shape-shifts into a Medium Humanoid or returns to its true form. Its game statistics, other than its size, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

trait.name: Entrapping Saliva
entries: The necrolisk ignores {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} and {@condition Restrained|XPHB} conditions of a creature with the Incorporeal Movement trait. Creatures swallowed by the necrolisk can't pass through it using Incorporeal Movement or through the Ethereal Plane, and creatures can't teleport out of its stomach.

trait.name: Herb Allergy
entries: If the necrolisk eats a specific concoction of herbs worth 25 GP (such as if a swallowed creature pours them into its stomach as a Utilize action), at the end of the turn, the necrolisk regurgitates anything in its stomach as if it failed the saving throw described in its Swallow {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The necrolisk can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Tunneler
entries: The necrolisk can burrow through solid rock at half its {@variantrule Burrow Speed|XPHB} and leaves a 10-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The necrolisk makes one Bite attack and one Claws attack.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 10}, reach 15 ft. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d8 + 6}) Piercing damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) Force damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 16}). Until the grapple ends, it has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 10}, reach 10 ft. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d6 + 6}) Slashing damage plus 4 ({@damage 1d8}) Force damage.

action.name: Ephemeral Spit {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 16}, each creature in a 60-foot-long, 5-foot-wide {@variantrule Line [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Line}. {@actSaveFail} 42 ({@damage 12d6}) Force damage, and the target has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

bonus.name: Swallow
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 18}, one Large or smaller creature {@condition Grappled|XPHB} by the necrolisk (the necrolisk can only have one creature swallowed at a time). {@actSaveFail} The necrolisk swallows the target, which is no longer {@condition Grappled|XPHB}. While swallowed, the creature has the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} and {@condition Restrained|XPHB} conditions, has {@variantrule Cover|XPHB|Total Cover} against attacks and other effects outside the necrolisk, and takes 21 ({@damage 6d6}) Force damage at the start of each of the necrolisk's turns.

If the necrolisk takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from the swallowed creature, the necrolisk must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate the creature, which falls in a space within 10 feet of the necrolisk and has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition. If the necrolisk dies, a swallowed creature is no longer {@condition Restrained|XPHB} and can escape from the corpse by using 15 feet of movement, exiting {@condition Prone|XPHB}.

trait.name: Anchoring Mask
entries: The nurse has a porcelain mask (AC 15; HP 15; {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to Poison and Psychic damage). If the nurse starts its turn and isn't wearing its mask, it must move as far as possible to retrieve its mask if possible, or to reach the closest creature it can see or hear, and it must attack that creature. If it can't see or hear any other creatures, it either stands still and does nothing, or it destroys any objects in its vicinity (50 percent chance of either).

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The nurse makes two Stab attacks. If it hits a creature with a Stab attack, it can use Inject if available.

action.name: Stab
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) Piercing damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) Poison damage.

action.name: Inject {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 13}, a creature the nurse hit with a Stab attack this turn. {@actSaveFail} 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Psychic damage, and the target has the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition for 1 hour. Failure by 5 or More: The {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} target also has the {@condition Unconscious|XPHB} condition until it takes damage or a creature within 5 feet of it takes an action to shake it awake. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

action.name: Mutation
entries: The nurse has one of the following mutation action options:

items.name: Cerebral Graft
entries: Part of a psionic creature's brain is grafted to the nurse's own. {@actSave int} {@dc 13}, one creature within 30 feet. {@actSaveFail} 11 ({@damage 2d10}) Psychic damage, and the target has the {@condition Stunned|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

items.name: Tentacle Lash
entries: A tentacle writhes beneath the nurse's skin or clothes. {@actSave dex} {@dc 13}, each creature in a 30-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}. {@actSaveFail} 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

bonus.name: Catalyst (Recharge after Short or Long Rest)
entries: The nurse injects itself with a stimulant. Until the start of the nurse's next turn, its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is doubled, it can make one extra Stab attack when it takes the Multiattack action, and it gains a +2 bonus to AC.

trait.name: Undoing Gift (1/Day)
entries: The maidenwood must accept and eat an apple offered to it or to its lure. The maidenwood then takes 55 ({@damage 10d10}) Poison damage and has the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition for 1 minute.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The maidenwood makes two Tendril attacks. It can replace one attack with a Chew attack.

action.name: Tendril
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 10}, reach 10 ft. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d8 + 6}) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 16}) from one of two tendrils. Until the grapple ends, it has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Chew
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 10}, reach 5 ft. {@h}11 ({@damage 1d10 + 6}) Piercing damage. If the target has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition, it takes an extra 18 ({@damage 4d8}) Piercing damage.

bonus.name: Lure
entries: The maidenwood shapes its lure into a Small or Medium Humanoid, or it retracts the lure. The maidenwood can speak through the lure and move it anywhere within reach of its tendrils, and it causes the following effect—{@actSave int} {@dc 15}, one creature within 30 feet of the lure. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition until the start of the maidenwood's next turn. The {@condition Charmed|XPHB} target must approach the lure as closely as it can. The maidenwood has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on attack rolls against the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} target. If the target takes damage, the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition ends at the end of the current turn.

reaction.name: Absorb Magic
entries: {@actTrigger} The maidenwood succeeds on a saving throw against a spell or other magical effect, or a spell attack roll misses it. {@actResponse} The maidenwood gains 10 {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}.

trait.name: Nightmarish Contortion
entries: The lurker can fit into a space as small as a 1-foot {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cube} and can pass through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The lurker can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Ward of Innocence
entries: The lurker can't attack or willingly move to a space within 10 feet of a creature holding a stuffed animal once owned by a child.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The lurker makes two Claw attacks.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 10 ft. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d10 + 4}) Slashing damage, and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 14}) from one of two claws. Until the grapple ends, the target has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition.

bonus.name: Dark Teleport
entries: While the lurker isn't in {@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB}, it teleports up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space it can see. If the destination space isn't in {@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB}, the lurker doesn't need to see it. A creature the lurker is grappling must succeed on a {@dc 13} Charisma saving throw or teleport with the lurker to an unoccupied space closest to the lurker's destination.

trait.name: Depicted Demise
entries: The lake dredger takes 20 Force damage at the start of its turn if it can see a creature holding a created depiction (such as a drawing, painting, or carving) of the lake dredger.

trait.name: Silt Stealth
entries: The lake dredger has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth|XPHB}) checks made when in an area with aquatic plants or seaweed.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The lake dredger makes one Bite attack and one Tail attack.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 10}, reach 10 ft. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d8 + 6}) Piercing damage plus 4 ({@damage 1d8}) Necrotic damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 16}), and it has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition until the grapple ends.

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 10}, reach 15 ft. {@h}24 ({@damage 4d8 + 6}) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

bonus.name: Swallow
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 18}, one Large or smaller creature {@condition Grappled|XPHB} by the lake dredger (the lake dredger can only have one creature swallowed at a time). {@actSaveFail} The lake dredger swallows the target, which is no longer {@condition Grappled|XPHB}. While swallowed, the creature has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition, has {@variantrule Cover|XPHB|Three-Quarters Cover} against attacks and other effects outside the lake dredger, and takes 21 ({@damage 6d6}) Necrotic damage at the start of each of the lake dredger's turns.

As an action, the swallowed creature can escape through the lake dredger's ribcage. The creature takes 11 ({@damage 2d10}) Piercing damage and emerges in a space within 5 feet of the lake dredger. If the lake dredger dies, a swallowed creature is no longer {@condition Restrained|XPHB} and can escape from the corpse by using 15 feet of movement, exiting {@condition Prone|XPHB}.

spellcasting.name: Invisibility
headerEntries: The ketgrinn casts {@spell Invisibility|XPHB} on itself, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The ketgrinn has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Mimicry
entries: The ketgrinn can mimic any voice it has heard, or a voice it has stolen (see Consume Voice below). A creature that hears the voice can tell it's an imitation with a successful {@dc 14} Wisdom ({@skill Insight|XPHB}) check. The DC increases to 19 for a voice the ketgrinn has stolen.

trait.name: Riddle Bound
entries: As an {@action Influence|XPHB} action, a creature that poses a riddle to the ketgrinn and succeeds on a {@dc 16} Charisma ({@skill Deception|XPHB}) check gives the ketgrinn the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition until the start of the creature's next turn. Each riddle posed increases the DC for future riddles by 1 for 24 hours.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ketgrinn makes two Claw attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Consume Voice.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d4 + 4}) Slashing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Psychic damage, and if the target is a creature, it has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on the next saving throw the ketgrinn forces it to make before the end of the ketgrinn's next turn.

action.name: Consume Voice
entries: {@actSave cha} {@dc 14}, one creature within 5 feet. {@actSaveFail} 18 ({@damage 4d8}) Psychic damage, and the ketgrinn steals the target's voice. The target can't speak or make any verbal sound while its voice is stolen.

The target repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If it fails three of these saving throws, the loss is permanent, and its voice only returns when the ketgrinn dies. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

bonus.name: Teleport
entries: The ketgrinn teleports up to 40 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The keeper casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 16}, {@hit 8} to hit with spell attacks):

trait.name: Blight Dependent
entries: If the keeper is targeted by an effect that ends the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition, it takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Force damage and has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB|D20 Tests} until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Fungal Step
entries: The keeper ignores {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB} caused by plants or fungi.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The keeper makes two attacks, using Blight Staff or Spore Spray in any combination, and it uses Rotting Ritual.

action.name: Blight Staff
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 8}, reach 5 ft. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d8 + 5}) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Necrotic damage.

action.name: Spore Spray
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 8}, range 60 ft. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d8}) Poison damage. If the target is a creature, it has the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition until the end of the keeper's next turn.

action.name: Rotting Ritual
entries: The keeper magically creates one of the following effects of its choice. It can't use the same effect twice in a row.

action.name: Frenzying Spores
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 16}, a creature the keeper can see within 30 feet. {@actSaveFail} 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Psychic damage, and the target must immediately take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to make a melee or ranged attack against a creature of the keeper's choice that is within reach or range of the attack. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

action.name: Blight Spawn
entries: The keeper magically summons a Rotweaver (lacks a Hunting Horn) in an unoccupied space within 30 feet of itself. The rotweaver takes its turn immediately after the keeper on the same {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} count, and it obeys the keeper. The rotweaver vanishes after 1 minute, or when it or the keeper dies.

action.name: Devouring Fungus
entries: Life-sapping fungus sprouts from the ground in a 60-foot radius centered on the keeper.

The area is {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB}, and a creature has the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition while within the area. The fungus remains for 1 minute, until the keeper uses this effect again, or until it dies.

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The kackle can move through other creatures and objects as if they were {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB}. It takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

trait.name: Lantern Vulnerability
entries: The kackle's lantern has AC 15 and {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to Poison and Psychic damage. Any damage the lantern takes deals half that amount of Force damage to the kackle.

action.name: Lantern Flame
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 7}, reach 5 ft. or range 90 ft. {@h}Varies by lantern color (kackle's choice):

action.name: Blue
entries: 7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) Cold damage, and the target has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Green
entries: 20 ({@damage 3d10 + 4}) Necrotic damage, and the target's {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is 0 until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Purple
entries: 10 ({@damage 1d12 + 4}) Psychic damage, and the target has the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Red
entries: 15 ({@damage 2d10 + 4}) Fire damage, and the target starts {@hazard burning|XPHB}, taking 5 ({@damage 1d10}) Fire damage instead of the regular burning damage.

bonus.name: Flickering Teleport
entries: The kackle teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space it can see. The kackle can then change its lantern color, and it can create the following—{@actSave dex} {@dc 15}, each creature in a 5-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the kackle's destination space. {@actSaveFail} 13 ({@damage 3d8}) damage of the same type as the current Lantern Flame color. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

trait.name: Alien Mind
entries: If a creature tries to read the intruder's mind or deals Psychic damage to it, that creature must succeed on a {@dc 16} Intelligence saving throw or have the {@condition Stunned|XPHB} condition for 1 minute. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

trait.name: Gliding Levitation
entries: The invader hovers 6 inches above the ground and leaves no tracks. It ignores {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB} caused by conditions on the ground, can move over liquids, and takes no damage from falling.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The invader has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Weak Constitution
entries: The invader has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on saving throws to avoid or end the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition. If the invader is {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} at the start of its turn, it takes 20 Necrotic damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The invader makes three Disrupting Touch attacks and uses Unnerving Glare if available.

action.name: Disrupting Touch
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 8}, reach 5 ft. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d10 + 4}) Force damage. A creature killed or an object destroyed by this damage is reduced to a fine gray dust.
Magic items, and any equipment worn or carried by a disintegrated creature, don't disintegrate.

action.name: Unnerving Glare {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 16}, one creature the invader can see within 60 feet. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition until the start of the invader's next turn.

reaction.name: Otherworldly Slip
entries: {@actTrigger} The invader takes damage. {@actResponse} The invader teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 60 feet and can cause the following—{@actSave int} {@dc 16}, each creature within a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the space where the invader vanished or appeared (invader's choice). {@actSaveFail} 16 ({@damage 3d10}) Psychic damage, and the target's {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is halved until the end of its next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The hypnovulfen has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hypnovulfen makes one Bite attack and one Claw attack, and it can use Swallow.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 12}, reach 5 ft. {@h}18 ({@damage 2d10 + 7}) Piercing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Psychic damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 17}), and it has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition until the grapple ends.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 12}, reach 5 ft. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d6 + 7}) Piercing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Psychic damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Swallow
entries: {@actSave str} {@dc 20}, one Medium or smaller creature {@condition Grappled|XPHB} by the hypnovulfen (the hypnovulfen can have only one creature swallowed at a time). {@actSaveFail} The hypnovulfen swallows the target, which is no longer {@condition Grappled|XPHB}. While swallowed, a creature has the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} and {@condition Restrained|XPHB} conditions, has {@variantrule Cover|XPHB|Total Cover} against attacks and other effects outside the hypnovulfen, and takes 21 ({@damage 6d6}) Psychic damage at the start of each of the hypnovulfen's turns. If the creature dies from this damage, the hypnovulfen absorbs its memories and regains 25 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}.

If the hypnovulfen takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from the swallowed creature, the hypnovulfen must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate the creature, which falls in a space within 10 feet of the hypnovulfen and has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition. If the hypnovulfen dies, a swallowed creature is no longer {@condition Restrained|XPHB} and can escape from the corpse by using 15 feet of movement, exiting {@condition Prone|XPHB}.

bonus.name: Hypnotic Gaze {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 19}, each creature in a 30-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}. A creature holding a keepsake from a loved one succeeds automatically. {@actSaveFail} The creature has the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition until it takes damage. While {@condition charmed}, it has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition and must move as close to the hypnovulfen as possible by the safest route. The creature repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically.

name: House of Horror
languages: understands Common plus one other language but can't speak

trait.name: Construction
entries: Creatures can enter the house's space and navigate it as a normal building. The house makes attacks from any surface or object that isn't being worn or carried within its space. It doesn't have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on ranged attack rolls due to an enemy being within 5 feet of it.

If a creature deals 30 or more damage in a single turn to a 5-foot section of the house's structure, the house must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or a 5-foot opening appears in that space until the start of the creature's next turn.

trait.name: Exorcism Susceptibility
entries: If the house is targeted by a {@spell Dispel Evil and Good|XPHB} spell, it has the {@condition Stunned|XPHB} condition. At the end of each of its turns, it can make a {@dc 15} Charisma saving throw, ending the condition on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically. As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, a creature inside the house that throws a flask of Holy Water against the house and succeeds on a {@dc 20} Charisma check affects the house as above.

trait.name: Soul Trap
entries: A Humanoid that dies within the house has its soul trapped there until the house dies. The creature can't be returned to life by any means short of a {@spell True Resurrection|XPHB} or {@spell Wish|XPHB} spell.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The house makes three attacks, using Structure Slam or {@variantrule Object|XPHB} Fling in any combination, and it uses Agonized Souls.

action.name: Structure Slam
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 11}, reach 5 ft. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d8 + 6}) Bludgeoning damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) Force damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 16}). The house can grapple up to two creatures at a time, using animated furniture, objects, or fixtures such as stair railings.

action.name: Object Fling
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 11}, range 20/60 ft. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d4 + 6}) Bludgeoning or Piercing damage (house's choice). If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Agonized Souls
entries: The house's stolen souls torment a victim. {@actSave wis} {@dc 16}, a creature within 10 feet of the house. {@actSaveFail} 36 ({@damage 8d8}) Necrotic damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

bonus.name: Alter Structure
entries: The house can reshape itself to change the location of walls, doors, floors, and other features of its construction. When one of these features appears or disappears, a creature within 5 feet of a changing feature can make a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw. On a successful save, the creature chooses which side of a feature it ends up on, or it moves to the nearest unoccupied space to avoid falling.

name: Hospital Horror
languages: understands Common and Deep Speech but can't speak

trait.name: Aversion to Needles
entries: If the horror takes Piercing damage, it has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on attack rolls until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The horror has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the horror's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The horror makes two Graft Blade attacks.

action.name: Graft Blade
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) Slashing damage.

bonus.name: Stim Burst
entries: The horror takes the Dash action and can jump up to 30 feet by spending 10 feet of movement.

trait.name: Endless Footwork
entries: When the herald's {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is 0, attack rolls made against it have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB}, and if its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is 0 at the start of its turn, it takes 20 Necrotic damage.

trait.name: Perfect Grace
entries: The herald doesn't provoke an {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB} when it leaves an enemy's reach.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The herald makes three Banner Pole attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Lethal Jape.

action.name: Banner Pole
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 10} (with {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} if the target's {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is 0), reach 10 ft. {@h}11 ({@damage 1d10 + 6}) Slashing damage plus 13 ({@damage 3d8}) Thunder damage, and if the target is a Large or smaller creature, the herald can move it to any other unoccupied space within the Banner Pole's reach.

action.name: Lethal Jape
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 15}, a creature the herald can see within 60 feet. {@actSaveFail} 24 ({@damage 7d6}) Psychic damage, and the target's {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is 0 until the end of its next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

reaction.name: Wave the Banner
entries: {@actTrigger} An ally of the herald's within 60 feet misses with an attack roll or fails a saving throw. {@actResponse} The ally can reroll the {@dice d20} and must use the new roll.

trait.name: Flyby
entries: The gobblegeist doesn't provoke an {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB} when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

trait.name: Repelled by Stars
entries: The gobblegeist can't willingly move to a space within 10 feet of a seven-pointed star drawn on a surface or woven from wicker.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The gobblegeist makes two Beak attacks. It can replace one attack with a Talons attack.

action.name: Beak
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 8}, reach 5 ft. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d8 + 5}) Piercing damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Necrotic damage. The target's {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the Necrotic damage taken, and the gobblegeist regains {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to that amount.

action.name: Talons
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 8}, reach 5 ft. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 15}) from both talons, and it has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition until the grapple ends.

action.name: Eye Beam
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 14}, each creature in a 120-foot-long, 5-foot-wide line. {@actSaveFail} 6 ({@damage 1d12}) Psychic damage, and the target has the {@condition Stunned|XPHB} condition until the start of the gobblegeist's next turn.

trait.name: Blighted Aura
entries: The ground in a 20-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the gloomwood is {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB} from mushrooms and fungus that grow in the area. A creature that ends its turn in the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) Necrotic damage.

trait.name: Carved Past
entries: As an action, a creature can use a Dagger or Woodcarver's Tools to carve the name in Sylvan of the ancient home of the gloomwoods into the gloomwood's trunk. Until the gloomwood finishes a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, it can't use its Fungal Fling or Spore Stomp actions.

trait.name: Fungal Step
entries: The gloomwood ignores {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB} caused by plants or fungi.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The gloomwood makes two attacks, using Slam or Fungal Fling in any combination.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 10}, reach 10 ft. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d6 + 6}) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Necrotic damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 16}) from one of two branches. Until the grapple ends, the target has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Fungal Fling
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 10}, range 60/180 ft. {@h}23 ({@damage 5d6 + 6}) Bludgeoning damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Necrotic damage.

action.name: Spore Stomp {@recharge 5}
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 10}, reach 5 ft. {@h}17 ({@damage 2d10 + 6}) Bludgeoning damage. {@hom}Each creature within a 20-foot {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on the target must make the following saving throw. {@actSave con} {@dc 15}. {@actSaveFail} 36 ({@damage 8d8}) Poison damage, and the target has the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

trait.name: Bridle Binding
entries: If a creature puts a bridle on the fleshdobbin (treat as securing {@item Manacles|XPHB}), the fleshdobbin has the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition while it wears the bridle, and it can't take the bridle off on its own.

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: The fleshdobbin can't shape-shift.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The fleshdobbin makes one Claw attack and one Wailing Halberd attack.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 8}, reach 10 ft. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d6 + 5}) Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Wailing Halberd
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 8}, reach 15 ft. {@h}10 ({@damage 1d10 + 5}) Slashing damage plus 5 ({@damage 1d10}) Psychic damage.

action.name: Shriek {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 15}, each creature in a 30-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}. {@actSaveFail} 28 ({@damage 8d6}) Psychic damage. In addition, the target has the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition and repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

reaction.name: Parry
entries: {@actTrigger} A creature the fleshdobbin can see hits it with a melee attack roll while the fleshdobbin is wielding a Melee weapon. {@actResponse} The fleshdobbin adds 3 to its AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss.

name: Festerhulk
languages: understands Common and Giant but can't speak

trait.name: Fungal Step
entries: The festerhulk ignores {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB} caused by plants or fungi.

trait.name: Spore Cloud
entries: At the end of each of the festerhulk's turns, each creature in a 5-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the festerhulk takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Necrotic damage and has the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn. A Giant or Humanoid killed by this damage rises as a new creature 24 hours later: Festerhulk (if a Giant), {@creature Zombie|XMM} (if a Humanoid).

trait.name: Sunlight Hypersensitivity
entries: The festerhulk takes 10 Radiant damage if it starts its turn in sunlight. While in sunlight, it has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on attack rolls and ability checks.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The festerhulk makes two Fetid Slam attacks and uses Slime Mold if available.

action.name: Fetid Slam
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 11}, reach 10 ft. Hit:20 ({@damage 2d12 + 7}) Bludgeoning damage plus 13 ({@damage 3d8}) Necrotic damage.

action.name: Slime Mold (1/Day)
entries: The festerhulk disgorges a mass of ravenous slime mold into an unoccupied space within 20 feet. This mass uses the Black Pudding stat block except it is a Plant, and its size is Medium. The mass acts on the festerhulk's {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB}. It, and any masses it Split into, dries up and dies in 1 hour.

trait.name: Coffin Boat
entries: The ferryman rides an open coffin on a swell of swamp water, allowing it to travel with a {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} of 40 feet over any surface, including liquids, ignoring {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB}. The coffin can hold two other Medium creatures. Two Small creatures or four Tiny creatures count as one Medium creature.

While riding the coffin, the ferryman has {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition, and the coffin moves with the ferryman unless the ferryman has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition. The coffin has AC 15; HP 25; {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to Necrotic, Poison, and Psychic damage.
If the coffin is destroyed, the ferryman can magically create a new one using a 10-minute ritual.

trait.name: Payment
entries: The ferryman must peacefully offer a ride in its boat to a creature that takes the {@action Influence|XPHB} action to offer it 3 CP. If that creature is cursed by the ferryman, the curse ends. If the boat is full, the ferryman must return to offer the creature a ride once its current passengers leave the boat. If the creature or its allies damage the ferryman or force it to make a saving throw, this effect ends and the creature can't use that ferryman's Payment trait again.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The ferryman regains 10 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} at the start of each of its turns if it has at least 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ferryman makes two Lantern Pole attacks and uses Hexed Lantern if available.

action.name: Lantern Pole
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, reach 10 ft. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d10 + 4}) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Necrotic damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Hexed Lantern (1/Day)
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 13}, each creature of the ferryman's choice in a 30-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}. {@actSaveFail} The creature is cursed for 1 minute and must subtract {@dice 1d4} from {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB|D20 Tests}.

trait.name: Flyby
entries: The dream eater doesn't provoke an {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB} when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

trait.name: Moth Ward
entries: A creature holding a moth's wing automatically succeeds on saving throws against the dream eater's Hypnotic Wings.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The dream eater can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dream eater makes two Talons attacks and can use Devour Dreams.

action.name: Talons
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 8}, reach 5 ft. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) Slashing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 14}) from one of two talons, and it has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition until the grapple ends.

action.name: Devour Dreams
entries: The dream eater unfurls its tongue and devours the dreams from a creature's mind. {@actSave cha} {@dc 16}, a creature the dream eater is grappling, or a creature within 5 feet of it that has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition ({@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} creatures fail automatically). {@actSaveFail} 18 ({@damage 4d8}) Psychic damage, and the creature's Charisma score decreases by {@dice 1d6}. A creature reduced to 0 Charisma by this effect doesn't recover lost Charisma when it finishes a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, and it has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition until its mind is restored with a {@spell Greater Restoration|XPHB}, {@spell Heal|XPHB}, or {@spell Wish|XPHB} spell. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

bonus.name: Hypnotic Wings
entries: The dream eater's wings shine with dazzling rainbow colors until the start of its next turn, emitting {@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB} in a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the dream eater and {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} for an additional 30 feet. {@actSave wis} {@dc 16}, each creature in the dream eater's {@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB}. {@actSaveFail} Until the start of the dream eater's next turn, the target has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition, and its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is 0.

trait.name: Irresistible Payment
entries: As an {@action Influence|XPHB} action, a creature that offers the drakkenhob alcohol or any amount of gold and succeeds on a {@dc 16} Charisma ({@skill Persuasion|XPHB}) check forces the drakkenhob to accept the offer and immediately take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to move up to half its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} to get away from the creature by the safest route possible.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The drakkenhob makes two Rend attacks.

action.name: Rend
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 9}, reach 5 ft. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) Piercing damage plus 11 ({@damage 2d10}) Psychic damage.

action.name: Terrifying Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 15}, each creature in a 30-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}. {@actSaveFail} 14 ({@damage 4d6}) Psychic damage, and the target drops whatever it is holding and has the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition. A {@condition Frightened|XPHB} target takes the Dash action and moves away from the drakkenhob by the safest route on each of its turns unless there's nowhere to move. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

bonus.name: Call the Hounds
entries: The drakkenhob lets out a wolf-like howl and magically summons three hunting hounds (use the Wolf stat block) that appear in unoccupied spaces within 60 feet of it. The hounds take their turn immediately after the drakkenhob on the same {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} count, and they obey the drakkenhob's mental commands. The hounds vanish when they or the drakkenhob drop to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, or when the drakkenhob uses this {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} again.

trait.name: Explosive Death
entries: The deepdreck explodes when it dies. {@actSave dex} {@dc 14}, each creature in a 15-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the deepdreck. {@actSaveFail} 13 ({@damage 3d8}) Poison damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

trait.name: Fragrance Aversion
entries: The deepdreck has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on attack rolls and saving throws while within 10 feet of burning incense or a creature wearing Perfume.

trait.name: Tunneler
entries: The deepdreck can burrow through solid rock at half its {@variantrule Burrow Speed|XPHB} and leaves a 5-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The deepdreck makes two attacks, using Claw or Putrid Emission in any combination.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) Slashing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Poison damage.

action.name: Putrid Emission
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 6}, range 60 ft. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) Poison damage, and the target has the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition until the start of the deepdreck's next turn.

trait.name: False Crows
entries: The swarm can't enter a space with a drawn or painted image or crafted effigy of a crow. A creature holding such an icon has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws the swarm forces it to make.

trait.name: Swarm
entries: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny crow. The swarm can't regain {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} or gain {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}.

trait.name: Wing Bind
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 13}, any creature (other than a Fiend) with a {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB} that starts its turn in a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the swarm. {@actSaveFail} The target's {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB} is 0 until the start of its next turn.

action.name: Peck
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d8 + 3}) Piercing damage, or 7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) Piercing damage if the swarm is {@status Bloodied|XPHB}. If the target is a creature, it has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on attack rolls until the start of the swarm's next turn.

action.name: Cacophony {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 13}, each creature in a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the swarm. {@actSaveFail} 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Psychic damage, and the target has the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition until the start of the swarm's next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

spellcasting.name: Confusion (1/Day)
headerEntries: The crooked man casts {@spell Confusion|XPHB}, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 17}).

trait.name: Aversion to Self-Sacrifice
entries: The crooked man takes 20 Necrotic damage if he can see a creature willingly take damage or gain a condition in place of someone else, or to someone else's benefit.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The crooked man has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The crooked man makes two Crooked Claw attacks, and he can replace one attack with a use of Snap Limb. He can also use {@spell Confusion|XPHB} if available.

action.name: Crooked Claw
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 11}, reach 5 ft. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d8 + 6}) Slashing damage plus 21 ({@damage 6d6}) Psychic damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 16}) from one of two claws. Until the grapple ends, the target has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Snap Limb
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 19}, one creature the crooked man is grappling, and that has limbs that can break. {@actSaveFail} 35 ({@damage 10d6}) Force damage, and the bones (or equivalent) in one of the target's limbs (crooked man's choice) breaks, causing an appropriate effect below. A broken limb heals in 40 days, or when the creature regains any {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} from magic or Regeneration. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

action.name: Broken Arm
entries: {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on attack rolls. Can't hold anything or manipulate objects with the limb.

action.name: Broken Leg
entries: {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} halved. If the creature takes the Dash action, it must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or have the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Broken Wing
entries: {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB} reduced to 0.

bonus.name: Blinking Teleport
entries: The crooked man has the {@condition Invisible|XPHB} condition for 1 minute and teleports to an unoccupied space he can see within 60 feet. The condition ends immediately after the crooked man deals any damage.

trait.name: Crooked Thorns
entries: At the start of each of its turns, the effigy deals 5 ({@damage 1d10}) Psychic damage to any creature it is grappling or any creature grappling it.

trait.name: Old Bindings
entries: The effigy takes an extra 10 Force damage if it's hit by an attack roll using {@item Smith's Tools|XPHB} or {@item Tinker's Tools|XPHB} (treat as a {@item Club|XPHB} or {@item Light Hammer|XPHB}).

action.name: Impale
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d10 + 3}) Piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 13}) from one of two branch arms. Until the grapple ends, the target has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The clergy casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 13}):

spellcasting.name: Crimson Blessing (1/Day)
headerEntries: The clergy casts {@spell Bless|XPHB} using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The clergy can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Vampire Weakness
entries: The clergy has the following weaknesses:

items.name: Self-Loathing
entries: The clergy has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB|D20 Tests} if it can see its reflection.

items.name: Sunlight Hypersensitivity
entries: The clergy takes 20 Radiant damage if it starts its turn in sunlight. While in sunlight, it has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on attack rolls and ability checks.

action.name: Consume
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) Necrotic damage. The target's {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} maximum decreases by an amount equal to the damage taken, and the clergy regains {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to that amount.

trait.name: Ashen Forbiddance
entries: The corvodaemon can't cross a line of ashes created by burning feathers sprinkled with Holy Water.

trait.name: Demonic Restoration
entries: If the corvodaemon dies outside the Abyss, its body dissolves into ichor, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} somewhere in the Abyss.

trait.name: Devour Anima
entries: A creature the corvodaemon reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} is cursed until it regains any {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. When the cursed creature fails a {@variantrule Death Saving Throw|XPHB} at the start of its turn, it dies regardless of how many failures it has.

trait.name: Mimicry
entries: The corvodaemon can mimic the voice of any creature it has heard, or of a creature known to one of the creatures within range of its telepathy. A hearer can discern the voices are imitations with a successful {@dc 14} Wisdom ({@skill Insight|XPHB}) check.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The corvodaemon can use Feeding Frenzy if available. It then makes one Beak attack and one Claws attack.

action.name: Beak
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) Piercing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Psychic damage.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}8 ({@damage 2d4 + 3}) Slashing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Feeding Frenzy {@recharge 5}
entries: The corvodaemon enters a voracious feeding frenzy, driven by its insatiable hunger for souls. Until the start of its next turn, the corvodaemon's {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} doubles, and when it damages a creature, it gains {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to half the damage taken.

spellcasting.name: Coven Magic
headerEntries: While within 30 feet of at least two hag allies, the hag can cast one of the following spells, requiring no Material components, using the spell's normal casting time, and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability: {@spell Augury|XPHB}, {@spell Find Familiar|XPHB}, {@spell Identify|XPHB}, {@spell Locate Object|XPHB}, {@spell Lucky Charm|CrookedMoon24} (lasts until the hag casts it again, or chooses to end it with no action required), or {@spell Unseen Servant|XPHB}. The hag must finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} before using this trait to cast that spell again.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The hag casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 17}):

trait.name: Scoured Filth
entries: The hag is burned by soapy water. Treat a bucket or flask of it splashed on the hag as a vial of Acid. If the hag is fully immersed in soapy water at the start of its turn, it takes 20 Acid damage.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The hag can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hag makes two Bite attacks or uses Spellcasting to cast {@spell Contagion|XPHB}. It can also use Warping Caress.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 9}, reach 5 ft. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) Piercing damage plus 4 ({@damage 1d8}) Necrotic damage, and the target has the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition until the start of the hag's next turn.

action.name: Warping Caress
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 17}, one creature within 5 feet. {@actSaveFail} 19 ({@damage 4d6 + 5}) Necrotic damage, and the target gains 1 {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} level. Until the target's {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} level is reduced to 0, its body is warped and twisted, and it has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on ability checks and saving throws that use Strength or Dexterity. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only. {@actSaveSuccessOrFail} If a Humanoid dies from this action, the hag can spend 2 days of work to shape its corpse into a {@creature Deepdreck|CrookedMoon24}, or it can combine it with the corpse of a horse to create a {@creature Fleshdobbin|CrookedMoon24}.

name: Boogleswarm
languages: understands Common but can only speak if the swarm has gathered at least one Humanoid tooth

trait.name: Mimicry (Only if the Swarm Can Speak)
entries: The swarm can speak in the voice of a creature whose tooth it has implanted (see the Bite action). Listeners must succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom ({@skill Insight|XPHB}) check to discern the mimicry.

trait.name: Swarm
entries: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny {@creature weasel|XMM}. The swarm can't regain {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} or gain {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}.

trait.name: Sweet Tooth
entries: If the swarm can see or smell sugar at the start of its turn, it must use all its movement to move closer to the sugar. If it reaches the sugar, the swarm has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition until the start of its next turn as it consumes the sugar, and this trait doesn't function again until the swarm finishes a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The swarm makes two Bite attacks that must have different targets.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4}, reach 5 ft. {@h}10 ({@damage 4d4}) Piercing damage, or 5 ({@damage 2d4}) Piercing damage if the swarm is {@status Bloodied|XPHB}. If the target is a creature that has teeth, it must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or lose one of its teeth. The swarm immediately implants the tooth into one of its mouths. A creature that has already lost a tooth to this attack automatically succeeds on the saving throw.

name: Boneflayer
languages: Sylvan; understands Common but can't speak it

trait.name: Flyby
entries: The boneflayer doesn't provoke an {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB} when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

trait.name: Thunderous Ward
entries: When the boneflayer hears a drum or gong, or takes Thunder damage, it has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB|D20 Tests} until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The boneflayer makes one Beak attack and one Talons attack.

action.name: Beak
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, reach 5 ft. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) Slashing damage, and the target has the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Talons
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, reach 5 ft. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) Piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 14}) from both talons. While {@condition Grappled|XPHB}, the target has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition.

bonus.name: Swoop {@recharge 5}
entries: If the boneflayer has a creature {@condition Grappled|XPHB}, the boneflayer flies up to half its {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB} without provoking {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB|Opportunity Attacks} and drops that creature.

trait.name: Spirits Susceptibility
entries: The elemental takes 9 ({@damage 2d8}) Force damage for every bottle of alcohol splashed onto it, and its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is reduced to 0 until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The elemental makes two Hexed Slam attacks.

action.name: Hexed Slam
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 8}, reach 10 ft. {@h}18 ({@damage 3d8 + 5}) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 16} Wisdom saving throw or be cursed until the start of the elemental's next turn. While cursed, the creature subtracts {@dice 1d4} from its attack rolls and saving throws.

action.name: Swamp Grasp {@recharge 5}
entries: Swamp water and plants roil around the elemental. {@actSave str} {@dc 16}, each creature on the ground in a 20-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the elemental. {@actSaveFail} 11 ({@damage 2d10}) Poison damage, and the target has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition for 1 minute, until the elemental has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition, or until the elemental dies. The target or a creature within 5 feet of it can take an action to make a {@dc 16} Strength ({@skill Athletics|XPHB}) check, ending the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition on the target on a success.

name: Bat Hound
languages: understands Common plus one other language but can't speak

trait.name: Barred by Water
entries: The bat hound can't willingly move into running water or to a space up to 20 feet above running water. If it starts its turn in running water, it takes 10 Acid damage and has the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition until the start of its next turn.

trait.name: Glide
entries: If it doesn't have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition and isn't wearing heavy armor, the bat hound can extend its membranous wings to move up to 5 feet horizontally for every 1 foot it descends in the air.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The bat hound can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d10 + 3}) Piercing damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) Necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, the bat hound regains a number of {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to the Necrotic damage taken, and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 13}).

bonus.name: Outmaneuver
entries: The bat hound takes the {@action Dash|XPHB} and {@action Disengage|XPHB} actions, and until the end of the turn, needn't spend extra movement to move a creature it is grappling.

reaction.name: Safe Descent
entries: {@actTrigger} The bat hound takes damage from a fall and isn't wearing heavy armor. {@actResponse} The bat hound extends its wings and reduces the fall's damage to 0.

trait.name: Aversion to Faith
entries: The alpengrendel has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on attack rolls while in a consecrated area or on attack rolls against a creature holding or wearing a {@item Holy Symbol|XPHB}.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The alpengrendel regains 10 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} at the start of each of its turns. If the alpengrendel takes Acid or Lightning damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of its next turn. The alpengrendel dies only if it starts its turn with 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} and doesn't regenerate.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The alpengrendel makes one Claws attack and one Tusks attack.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 8}, reach 5 ft. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) Slashing damage plus 5 ({@damage 1d10}) Cold damage.

action.name: Tusks
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 8}, reach 5 ft. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d8 + 5}) Piercing damage plus 5 ({@damage 1d10}) Cold damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Frost Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 15}, each creature in a 30-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}. {@actSaveFail} 21 ({@damage 6d6}) Cold damage. Until the start of the alpengrendel's next turn, the target's {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is halved, and it has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on attack rolls. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

trait.name: Training
entries: Geneva has proficiency in one skill of the DM's choice and has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} whenever it makes an ability check using that skill.

action.name: Club
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 2}, reach 5 ft. {@h}2 ({@damage 1d4}) Bludgeoning damage.

spellcasting.name: Etherealness
headerEntries: Isolde casts the {@spell Etherealness|XPHB} spell, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability. Isolde is visible on the Material Plane while on the Border Ethereal and vice versa, but it can't affect or be affected by anything on the other plane.

trait.name: Ethereal Sight
entries: Isolde can see 60 feet into the Ethereal Plane when it is on the Material Plane.

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: Isolde can move through other creatures and objects as if they were {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB}. It takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Isolde makes two Withering Touch attacks.

action.name: Withering Touch
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}19 ({@damage 3d10 + 3}) Necrotic damage.

action.name: Horrific Visage
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 13}, each creature in a 60-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone} that can see Isolde and isn't an Undead. {@actSaveFail} 10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) Psychic damage, and the target has the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition until the start of Isolde's next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} The target is immune to this ghost's Horrific Visage for 24 hours.

action.name: Possession {@recharge}
entries: {@actSave cha} {@dc 13}, one Humanoid Isolde can see within 5 feet. {@actSaveFail} The target is possessed by Isolde; Isolde disappears, and the target has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition and loses control of its body. Isolde now controls the body, but the target retains awareness. Isolde can't be targeted by any attack, spell, or other effect, except ones that specifically target Undead. Isolde's game statistics are the same, except it uses the possessed target's {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}, as well as the target's Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution modifiers.

The possession lasts until the body drops to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} or Isolde leaves as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}. When the possession ends, Isolde appears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the target, and the target is immune to this ghost's {@variantrule Possession|XPHB} for 24 hours. {@actSaveSuccess} The target is immune to this ghost's {@variantrule Possession|XPHB} for 24 hours.

trait.name: Anchoring Mask
entries: Godlee has a porcelain mask (AC 15; HP 15; {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to Poison and Psychic damage). If Godlee starts its turn and isn't wearing its mask, it must move as far as possible to retrieve its mask if possible, or to reach the closest creature it can see or hear, and it must attack that creature. If it can't see or hear any other creatures, it either stands still and does nothing, or it destroys any objects in its vicinity (50 percent chance of either).

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Godlee makes two Stab attacks. If it hits a creature with a Stab attack, it can use Inject if available.

action.name: Stab
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) Piercing damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) Poison damage.

action.name: Inject {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 13}, a creature Godlee hit with a Stab attack this turn. {@actSaveFail} 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Psychic damage, and the target has the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition for 1 hour. Failure by 5 or More: The {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} target also has the {@condition Unconscious|XPHB} condition until it takes damage or a creature within 5 feet of it takes an action to shake it awake. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

action.name: Mutation
entries: Godlee has one of the following mutation action options:

items.name: Cerebral Graft
entries: Part of a psionic creature's brain is grafted to Godlee's own. {@actSave int} {@dc 13}, one creature within 30 feet. {@actSaveFail} 11 ({@damage 2d10}) Psychic damage, and the target has the {@condition Stunned|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

items.name: Tentacle Lash
entries: A tentacle writhes beneath Godlee's skin or clothes. {@actSave dex} {@dc 13}, each creature in a 30-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}. {@actSaveFail} 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

bonus.name: Catalyst (Recharge after Short or Long Rest)
entries: Godlee injects itself with a stimulant. Until the start of Godlee's next turn, its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is doubled, it can make one extra Stab attack when it takes the Multiattack action, and it gains a +2 bonus to AC.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: Belkin regains 10 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} at the start of each of its turns. If it takes Poison damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of its next turn. Belkin dies only if it starts its turn with 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} and doesn't regenerate.

trait.name: Veiled Ignorance
entries: A creature whose mind can't be read, or that is under the effect of a {@spell Mind Blank|XPHB} or {@spell Nondetection|XPHB} spell, has the {@condition Invisible|XPHB} condition toward Belkin (this ignores Belkin's Blindsight).

action.name: Multiattack

action.name: Bone Saw
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, reach 5 ft. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) Slashing damage plus 4 ({@damage 1d8}) Psychic damage.
Critical {@h}If the target is a creature, its Intelligence score decreases by {@dice 1d4}. The target dies if this reduces that score to 0.

action.name: Infested Spray {@recharge 5}
entries: Belkin unleashes a spray of worm-ridden cerebral fluid. {@actSave dex} {@dc 14}, each creature in a 20-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}. {@actSaveFail} 17 ({@damage 5d6}) Psychic damage, and the target is infested with larval parasitic worms. The target takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Psychic damage at the end of each of its turns as the worms burrow toward its brain. The ongoing damage ends when the target takes Poison damage or is targeted by an effect that ends the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only. {@actSaveSuccessOrFail} If the target is reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} by this Psychic damage, the worms reach its brain and it dies. A Humanoid slain in this way rises 24 hours later as a wormhost surgeon.

reaction.name: Protective Parasite
entries: {@actTrigger} Belkin is reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. {@actResponse} The parasite worm emerges from Belkin's exposed brain and spits acid—{@actSave dex} {@dc 14}, each creature in a 20-foot-long, 5-foot-wide {@variantrule Line [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Line}. {@actSaveFail} 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Acid damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

name: Hugo

trait.name: Curse Dependent

trait.name: Stimulant Rush
