trait.name: Surgical Strike
entries: The surgeon has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if no other creature is within 5 feet of the target.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The surgeon makes two melee or ranged attacks.

action.name: Poison Needle
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 2d4 + 2}) piercing damage, and the target must make a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw, taking 10 ({@damage 3d6}) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

action.name: Fetid Blade
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 2d4 + 2}) piercing damage, and 4 ({@damage 2d4}) acid damage.

action.name: Poison Needle
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing damage, and the target must make a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw, taking 10 ({@damage 3d6}) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

action.name: Medical Treatment (3/Day)
entries: The doctor touches another creature. The target magically regains 20 ({@dice 4d8 + 2}) hit points, and the doctor ends either one disease or one condition afflicting it. The condition can be {@condition blinded}, {@condition deafened}, {@condition paralyzed}, or {@condition poisoned}.

bonus.name: Diagnosis
entries: The doctor takes the Help action.

name: Far Dweller
languages: understands all languages but does not speak; telepathy 120 ft.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting (Psionics)
headerEntries: The far dweller casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Intelligence as its spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 16}, {@hit 8} to hit with spell attacks):

3e: {@spell vanish to the space between worlds|GuideDrakkenheim}
1e: {@spell banish to the space between worlds|GuideDrakkenheim}

trait.name: Delirium Healing
entries: As an action, the far dweller can touch a delirium shard to regain 10 ({@dice 3d6}) hit points. Once the far dweller has used a delirium shard in this way, the shard can't be used in this manner again for 24 hours.

trait.name: Fully Contaminated
entries: The far dweller is immune to contamination, and has advantage on saving throws against contaminated spells.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The far dweller has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The far dweller makes two contaminated touch attacks. It can replace one of these attacks with mind scramble, if available.

action.name: Contaminated Touch
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}10 ({@damage 3d6}) necrotic damage. On a hit, the target must make a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it gains one Contamination Level.

action.name: Mind Scramble {@recharge 5}
entries: The far dweller launches a psychic barrage in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 16} Intelligence saving throw. A creature takes 21 ({@damage 6d6}) psychic damage on a failed saving throw, or half as much on a successful one. If a creature in the area is {@status concentration||concentrating} on a spell, it makes the saving throw with disadvantage, and suffers an additional 21 ({@damage 6d6}) psychic damage on a failed saving throw.

bonus.name: Pluck the Puppet Strings
entries: The far dweller chooses one creature it can see within 60 feet of it and attempts to seize temporary control over it. The target must make a {@dc 16} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed saving throw, it suffers 14 ({@damage 4d6}) psychic damage, and must immediately use its reaction to move up to its speed directly towards a creature mentally chosen by the far dweller. If the target ends this movement with the chosen creature within its reach, it must make one melee weapon attack against that creature with advantage.

trait.name: Delirium Healing
entries: As an action, the maw vermin can touch a delirium shard to regain 10 ({@dice 3d6}) hit points. Once the maw vermin has used a delirium shard in this way, the shard can't be used in this manner again for 24 hours.

trait.name: Fully Contaminated
entries: The maw vermin is immune to contamination, and has advantage on saving throws against contaminated spells.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The maw vermin has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The maw vermin makes one bite attack and three claw attacks, and it can use its grasping maw or glob launcher.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}22 ({@damage 3d10 + 6}) piercing damage, and the target is swallowed if it is a Medium or smaller creature. A swallowed creature is {@condition blinded} and {@condition restrained}, has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the maw vermin. At the start of each of the maw vermin's turns, any creature inside its maw takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) acid damage and must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or suffer one Contamination Level.

The maw vermin's mouth can hold up to three creatures at a time. If the maw vermin takes 20 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the maw vermin must succeed on a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, each of which falls {@condition prone} in a space within 10 feet of the maw vermin. If the maw vermin dies, any swallowed creature is no longer {@condition restrained} by it and can escape from the corpse using 10 feet of movement, exiting {@condition prone}.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}19 ({@damage 3d8 + 6}) slashing damage, and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 16}) if it is a Huge or smaller creature. Until the grapple ends, the maw vermin can't use this claw on another target. The maw vermin has 3 claws.

action.name: Grasping Maw
entries: The maw vermin targets one Medium or smaller creature that it can see within 15 feet of it. The target must make a {@dc 18} Strength saving throw. On a failed save, the target is pulled into an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the maw vermin.

action.name: Glob Launcher
entries: The maw vermin coats a creature in its mouth with a glob of acidic goo, and launches it at a point it can see within 120 feet of it. Each creature within 10 feet of that point must make a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw. The launched creature automatically fails this saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes 21 ({@damage 6d6}) acid damage and becomes {@condition restrained} by the acidic goo until freed. The target can use its action to make a {@dc 15} Strength check to free itself. A {@condition restrained} creature takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) acid damage if it ends its turn {@condition restrained} by the goo.

trait.name: Delirium Healing
entries: As an action, the eldritch crawler can touch a delirium shard to regain 10 ({@dice 3d6}) hit points. Once a monster has used a delirium shard in this way, the shard can't be used in this manner again for 24 hours.

trait.name: Fully Contaminated
entries: The eldritch crawler is immune to contamination, and has advantage on saving throws against contaminated spells.

trait.name: Insectoid Limbs
entries: The eldritch crawler can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check. Additionally, it ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d10 + 2}) piercing damage, and the target must make a {@dc 11} Constitution saving throw, taking 18 ({@damage 4d8}) necrotic damage on a failed save and gains one Contamination Level, or half as much damage and gaining no Contamination Levels on a successful one.

action.name: Contaminated Venom
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 4} to hit, range 20/40 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing damage, and the target must make a {@dc 11} Constitution saving throw, taking 18 ({@damage 4d8}) necrotic damage on a failed save and suffering one Contamination Level, or half as much damage and gains no Contamination Levels on a successful one.

bonus.name: Void Walker
entries: The eldritch crawler magically transports itself from the Material Plane to the Space Between Worlds, or vice versa.

reaction.name: Fractured Reality
entries: Whenever an attack that targets the eldritch crawler misses, the eldritch crawler can teleport 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see, momentarily leaving behind a fractured image of itself being hit by the attack in its place.

name: Lurker on the Threshold
languages: understands all languages but does not speak; telepathy 120 ft.

trait.name: Delirium Healing
entries: As an action, the Lurker on the Threshold can touch a delirium shard to regain 10 ({@dice 3d6}) hit points. Once a monster has used a delirium shard in this way, the shard can't be used in this manner again for 24 hours.

trait.name: Fully Contaminated
entries: The Lurker on the Threshold is immune to contamination, and has advantage on saving throws against contaminated spells.

trait.name: Eldritch Blood
entries: A creature within 5 feet of the Lurker on the Threshold takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) necrotic damage whenever it hits the Lurker with a melee attack that deals piercing or slashing damage.

trait.name: Eldritch Sight
entries: Magical darkness doesn't impede the Lurker on the Threshold's darkvision.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The Lurker on the Threshold has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Lurker on the Threshold makes two attacks with its tendrils, or it uses its cosmic rays three times.

action.name: Tendrils
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 30 ft., one creature. {@h}8 ({@damage 2d8}) bludgeoning damage and 4 ({@damage 1d8}) necrotic damage, and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 16}) if it is a Huge or smaller creature. Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained}, and the Lurker on the Threshold can't use the same tentacle on another target. The Lurker on the Threshold has ten tentacles.

action.name: Cosmic Rays
entries: The Lurker on the Threshold shoots one magical ray at random (roll a {@dice d4}, and reroll if the ray has already been used this turn), choosing one target it can see within 120 feet of it.

action.name: Disintegrating Ray
entries: The target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw or take 27 ({@damage 6d8}) force damage. A target reduced to zero hit points by this damage is reduced to dust and dies.

action.name: Memory Lapse Ray
entries: The target must make a {@dc 17} Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, the target's memories become distant for 1 minute. While its memories are distant, the target can't cast spells, activate magic items, use its class features, or understand language, and makes ability checks with disadvantage. The target can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

action.name: Contaminating Ray
entries: The target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 16 ({@damage 3d10}) necrotic damage, and gains one Contamination Level. On a successful save, they take half as much damage and do not gain any Contamination Levels.

action.name: Existential Dread Ray
entries: During the target's next turn, each time it takes an action other than the dodge action, moves more than 5 feet, or takes a bonus action, it suffers 14 ({@damage 4d6}) psychic damage.

name: Liminal Herald
languages: understands all languages but does not speak; telepathy 120 ft.

trait.name: Delirium Healing
entries: As an action, the liminal herald can touch a delirium shard to regain 10 ({@dice 3d6}) hit points. Once the liminal herald has used a delirium shard in this way, the shard can't be used in this manner again for 24 hours.

trait.name: Eldritch Sight
entries: Magical darkness doesn't impede the liminal herald's darkvision.

trait.name: Fully Contaminated
entries: The liminal herald is immune to contamination, and has advantage on saving throws against contaminated spells.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The liminal herald makes two attacks with its eldritch beams. It can also use mind scramble or warp call.

action.name: Contaminated Touch
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}10 ({@damage 3d6}) necrotic damage. The target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or gain 1 Contamination Level.

action.name: Eldritch Beams
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 4} to hit, range 120 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 4d6}) force damage.

action.name: Mind Scramble {@recharge 5}
entries: The liminal herald launches a psychic barrage in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 13} Intelligence saving throw. A creature takes 14 ({@damage 4d6}) psychic damage on a failed saving throw, or half as much on a successful one. If a creature in the area is {@status concentration||concentrating} on a spell, it makes the saving throw with disadvantage, and suffers an additional 21 ({@damage 6d6}) psychic damage on a failed saving throw.

action.name: Warp Call
entries: The liminal herald pulls a creature it can see within 90 feet of it through space. The target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Charisma saving throw. On a failed saving throw, the target takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) psychic damage and is teleported to an unoccupied space the liminal herald can see within 60 feet. The chosen space must be on a surface or in a liquid that can support the target without the target having to squeeze.

bonus.name: Dimension Hop
entries: The liminal herald teleports up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

reaction.name: Reflect Pain
entries: If the liminal herald takes damage from an attack or a spell which targets only it, it can use its reaction to cause the attacking creature or spellcaster to take psychic damage equal to damage dealt by the triggering attack or spell.

name: Entropic Watcher
languages: understands all languages but does not speak; telepathy 120 ft.

trait.name: Delirium Healing
entries: As an action, the entropic watcher can touch a delirium shard to regain 10 ({@dice 3d6}) hit points. Once the entropic watcher has used a delirium shard in this way, the shard can't be used in this manner again for 24 hours.

trait.name: Fully Contaminated
entries: The entropic watcher is immune to contamination, and has advantage on saving throws against contaminated spells.

trait.name: Eldritch Blood
entries: A creature within 5 feet of the entropic watcher takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) necrotic damage whenever it hits the watcher with a melee attack.

trait.name: Eldritch Sight
entries: Magical darkness doesn't impede the entropic watcher's darkvision.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the entropic watcher fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The entropic watcher has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Withering Gaze
entries: The entropic watcher's eye projects an area of withering magic in a 150-foot line that is 10 feet wide. At the start of each of its turns, the entropic watcher decides which way the line faces and whether the line is active. Creatures in the area of the line are vulnerable to necrotic damage and cannot regain hit points.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The entropic watcher makes one insanity beam attack and four attacks with its tendrils. One or more tendril attacks can be replaced with a contaminating grasp attack instead.

action.name: Tendrils
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 40 ft., one creature. {@h}17 ({@damage 3d8 + 4}) bludgeoning damage and 9 ({@damage 2d8}) necrotic damage, and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 17}) if it is a Huge or smaller creature. Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained}, and the entropic watcher can't use the same tendril on another target. The entropic watcher has ten tendrils.

action.name: Insanity Beam
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 9} to hit, range 60 ft., one target. {@h}22 ({@damage 4d10}) necrotic damage, and the beam then leaps to another target. The watcher can repeat the attack against a new target within 30 feet of the first target. A creature can be targeted by only one of the beams each time the watcher uses this attack. For each additional creature hit in this way, the damage increases by 5 ({@damage 1d10}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Shadow Crash {@recharge 5}
entries: The entropic watcher unleashes a blast of entropy centered on a point it can see within 150 feet of it. Creatures within 20 feet of the point must make a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw. They suffer {@damage 8d8} necrotic damage on a failed saving throw, or half as much damage on a successful one. The area becomes a pool of clutching shadows which last until the start of the monster's next turn. Creatures who end their turn in the area suffer {@damage 8d8} necrotic damage.

bonus.name: Force Barrier
entries: The entropic watcher creates a shimmering octarine 100-foot-by-100-foot wall of force at a point chosen within 150 feet of it which lasts for 1 minute or until the entropic watcher is {@condition incapacitated} or dies. The wall appears in any orientation it chooses, as a horizontal or vertical barrier or at an angle. It can be free floating or resting on a solid surface. If the wall cuts through a creature's space when it appears, the creature is pushed to one side of the wall (GM's choice which side).

Nothing can physically pass through the wall. It is immune to all damage and can't be dispelled by {@spell dispel magic}. A {@spell disintegrate} spell destroys the wall instantly, however. The wall also extends into the Ethereal Plane, blocking ethereal travel through the wall.

legendary.name: Tendril
entries: The entropic watcher makes one tendril attack.

legendary.name: Glide
entries: The entropic watcher moves up to its speed.

legendary.name: Insanity Beam (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The entropic watcher uses its insanity beam.

name: Striga
languages: the languages it knew in life

trait.name: Blood Frenzy
entries: The striga has advantage on melee attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all its hit points.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The striga regains 10 hit points at the start of each of its turns if it has at least 1 hit point and isn't in sunlight. If the striga takes radiant damage, this trait doesn't function until the start of the striga's next turn.

trait.name: Delirium Healing
entries: As an action, the striga can touch a delirium shard to regain 10 ({@dice 3d6}) hit points. Once the striga has used a delirium shard in this way, the shard can't be used in this manner again for 24 hours.

trait.name: Fully Contaminated
entries: The striga is immune to contamination, and has advantage on saving throws against contaminated spells.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The striga can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Sunlight Hypersensitivity
entries: The striga takes 20 radiant damage when it starts its turn in sunlight. While in sunlight, it has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The striga makes three attacks, two with its claws and one with its bite. If both claw attacks hit the same creature, that creature must make a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or take 14 ({@dice 4d6}) extra necrotic damage and gain 1 Contamination Level.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d4 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) slashing damage.

name: The Duchess
languages: understands all languages but does not speak; telepathy 120 ft.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting (Psionics)
headerEntries: The duchess casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 20}, {@hit 12} to hit with spell attacks):

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The Duchess can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Delerium Healing
entries: As an action, the Duchess can touch a delerium shard to regain 10 ({@dice 3d6}) hit points. Once a monster has used a delerium shard in this way, the shard can't be used in this manner again for 24 hours.

trait.name: Fully Contaminated
entries: The Duchess is immune to contamination, and has advantage on saving throws against contaminated spells. They can cast contaminated spells even though they do not gain contamination levels.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the Duchess fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The Duchess has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Moisture Regeneration
entries: The Duchess regains 20 hit points at the start of each of her turns if she is submerged at least partially in water. She dies only if she starts her turn at zero hit points and does not regenerate.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Duchess makes three tentacle attacks. If she is grappling a creature, she can make one bite attack as a bonus action against it.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 3d6 + 6}) piercing damage.

action.name: Tentacle
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. {@h}20 ({@damage 4d6 + 6}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 19}). At the start of each of its turns until the grapple ends, it must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or gain Contamination Level. The Duchess can have up to four targets {@condition grappled} at a time.

action.name: Fling
entries: One Large or smaller object held or creature {@condition grappled} by the Duchess is thrown up to 60 feet in a direction of the Duchess's choice and knocked {@condition prone}. If a thrown target strikes a solid surface, the target takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) bludgeoning damage for every 10 feet it was thrown. If the target is thrown at another creature, that creature must succeed on a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw or take the same damage and be knocked {@condition prone}.

bonus.name: Deep Domination {@recharge 5}
entries: The Duchess targets one creature it can see. The target must succeed on a {@dc 20} Wisdom saving throw or be magically {@condition charmed} by the Duchess until the Duchess dies.

reaction.name: Sacrificial Pawn
entries: When the Duchess takes damage from an attack, she can choose one ally or creature {@condition charmed} by she can see within 30 feet. That creature takes the damage from the attack.

legendary.name: Tentacle or Fling
entries: The Duchess makes one tentacle attack or uses fling.

legendary.name: Call of the Deep (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: The Duchess calls forth up to five {@creature deep dreg|GuideDrakkenheim|deep dregs} or one {@creature deep knight|GuideDrakkenheim}. The creatures appear in unoccupied spaces within 30 feet of the Duchess and remain until destroyed. These creatures act after the Duchess on the same initiative count and are under her control.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The deep siren casts one of the following spells, using Charisma as her spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 15}, {@hit 7} to hit with spell attacks):

2e: {@spell vanish to the space between worlds|GuideDrakkenheim}

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The deep siren can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Fully Contaminated
entries: This creature is immune to contamination, and has advantage on saving throws against contaminated spells. This creature can cast contaminated spells even though it does not gain contamination levels.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The siren makes two storm lash attacks.

action.name: Storm Lash
entries: {@atk ms,rs} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 90 ft. {@h}18 ({@damage 4d8}) thunder damage, and the target is pushed up to 10 feet away from the siren.

action.name: Discordant Song (Recharges on a Short or Long Rest)
entries: The siren unleashes a cacophony of psychic screams. The magic erupts in a 30-foot-radius sphere originating from the siren. Each creature of the siren's choice in that area must make a {@dc 15} Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 21 ({@damage 6d6}) psychic damage, and suffers from discordant reverberations for 1 minute. During that time, it rolls a {@dice d6} and subtracts the number rolled from all its attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws. The target can make an Intelligence saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Illusory Appearance
entries: The siren covers herself and anything she is wearing or carrying with a magical illusion that makes her look like another creature of her general size and humanoid shape. The illusion ends if the siren takes a bonus action to end it or if she dies.

bonus.name: Misty Step
entries: The siren magically teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 30 feet of it.

trait.name: Abyssal Aura
entries: While the deep knight is not {@condition incapacitated}, it and its allies within 30 feet who can see and hear it have advantage on saving throws against being {@condition charmed} or {@condition frightened}.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The deep knight can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Delerium Healing
entries: As an action, the deep knight can touch a delerium shard to regain 10 ({@dice 3d6}) hit points. Once a monster has used a delerium shard in this way, the shard can't be used in this manner again for 24 hours.

trait.name: Fully Contaminated
entries: This creature is immune to contamination, and has advantage on saving throws against contaminated spells.

trait.name: Unwavering Sentinel
entries: Creatures provoke opportunity attacks from the deep knight even if they take the Disengage action before leaving its reach.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The deep knight makes two attacks: one with its harpoon and one with its bite.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Harpoon
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) piercing damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 14} Strength saving throw or be pulled up to 20 feet toward the deep knight.

bonus.name: Shield Bash
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d4 + 4}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is Huge or smaller, it must succeed on a {@dc 14} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The deep dreg can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Catch of the Day
entries: Once per turn, the deep dreg can deal an extra 7 ({@damage 2d6}) damage to a {@condition prone} or {@condition restrained} creature it hits with a weapon attack.

trait.name: Delerium Healing
entries: As an action, the deep dreg can touch a delerium shard to regain 10 ({@dice 3d6}) hit points. Once a monster has used a delerium shard in this way, the shard can't be used in this manner again for 24 hours.

trait.name: Fully Contaminated
entries: This creature is immune to contamination, and has advantage on saving throws against contaminated spells.

trait.name: Normal Semblance
entries: The deep dreg has advantage on {@skill Deception} checks to pass itself off as a normal humanoid creature.

trait.name: Watery Camouflage
entries: The deep dreg has advantage on {@skill Stealth} checks to hide in any area obscured by murky water or aquatic features.

action.name: Spear
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d6 + 1}) piercing damage, or 5 ({@damage 1d8 + 1}) piercing damage when used in two hands to make a melee attack.

action.name: Net
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 3} to hit, range 5/15 ft., one Large or smaller creature. {@h}The target is {@condition restrained}. A creature can use its action to make a {@dc 10} Strength check to free itself or another creature in a net, ending the effect on a success. Dealing 5 slashing damage to the net (AC 10) frees the target without harming it and destroys the net.

hp.special: 60 + 10 for each spell level above 5th

trait.name: Amorphous Form (Animated Sludge, Entropic Flame, and Living Haze)
entries: The delerium elemental can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Deep Haze (Living Haze Only)
entries: The delerium elemental can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. A creature who enters or starts its turn in the same space as the delerium elemental must make a Constitution saving throw. It takes {@damage 2d6} necrotic damage on a failed saving throw.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The delerium elemental makes a number of slam or hurl flame attacks equal to half this spell's level (rounded down).

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hitYourSpellAttack} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 1d10 + 4 + summonSpellLevel} bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Hurl Flame (Entropic Flame Only)
entries: {@atk rw} {@hitYourSpellAttack} to hit, range 120 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 1d10 + 2 + summonSpellLevel} fire damage. Before or after making this attack, the delerium elemental can teleport up to 10 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

action.name: Grasping Tide (Animated Sludge Only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hitYourSpellAttack} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}{@damage 2d8 + 4 + summonSpellLevel} bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 16).

action.name: Shard Slam (Walking Geode Only)
entries: A creature hit by the delerium elemental's melee attacks must make a Strength saving throw. On a failed saving throw, it is pushed 10 feet away from the delerium elemental.

renames.rename: Amorphous Form (Animated Sludge, Entropic Flame, and Living Haze)

items.name: Multiattack
entries: Animated Sludge makes a number of slam attacks equal to half this spell's level (rounded down).

Additionally, on its next turn, it must choose whether it gets a move, an action, or a bonus action; it gets only one of the three.

name: Constance Kleinkessel
languages: the languages it knew in life

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: If Constance isn't in sunlight or running water, it can use its action to polymorph into a Tiny bat or a Medium cloud of mist, or back into its true form.

While in bat form, Constance can't speak, its walking speed is 5 feet, and it has a flying speed of 30 feet. Its statistics, other than its size and speed, are unchanged. Anything it is wearing transforms with it, but nothing it is carrying does. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

While in mist form, Constance can't take any actions, speak, or manipulate objects. It is weightless, has a flying speed of 20 feet, can hover, and can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. In addition, if air can pass through a space, the mist can do so without squeezing, and it can't pass through water. It has advantage on Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution saving throws, and it is immune to all nonmagical damage, except the damage it takes from sunlight.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If Constance fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Misty Escape
entries: When it drops to 0 hit points outside its resting place, Constance transforms into a cloud of mist (as in the Shapechanger trait) instead of falling {@condition unconscious}, provided that it isn't in sunlight or running water. If it can't transform, it is destroyed.

While it has 0 hit points in mist form, it can't revert to its vampire form, and it must reach its resting place within 2 hours or be destroyed. Once in its resting place, it reverts to its vampire form. It is then {@condition paralyzed} until it regains at least 1 hit point. After spending 1 hour in its resting place with 0 hit points, it regains 1 hit point.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: Constance regains 20 hit points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hit point and isn't in sunlight or running water. If Constance takes radiant damage or damage from {@item Holy Water (Flask)|PHB|holy water}, this trait doesn't function at the start of Constance's next turn.

trait.name: Vampire Weaknesses

items.name: Forbiddance
items.entry: Constance can't enter a residence without an invitation from one of the occupants.

items.name: Harmed by Running Water
items.entry: Constance takes 20 acid damage if it ends its turn in running water.

items.name: Stake to the Heart
items.entry: If a piercing weapon made of wood is driven into Constance's heart while Constance is {@condition incapacitated} in its resting place, Constance is {@condition paralyzed} until the stake is removed.

items.name: Sunlight Hypersensitivity
items.entry: Constance takes 20 radiant damage when it starts its turn in sunlight. While in sunlight, it has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

action.name: Bite (Bat or Vampire Form Only)

The target's hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken, and Constance regains hit points equal to that amount. The reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0. A humanoid slain in this way and then buried in the ground rises the following night as a {@creature vampire spawn} under Constance's control.

action.name: Charm
entries: Constance targets one humanoid it can see within 30 feet of it. If the target can see Constance, the target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw against this magic or be {@condition charmed} by Constance. The {@condition charmed} target regards Constance as a trusted friend to be heeded and protected. Although the target isn't under Constance's control, it takes Constance's requests or actions in the most favorable way it can, and it is a willing target for Constance's bite attack.

Each time Constance or Constance's companions do anything harmful to the target, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success. Otherwise, the effect lasts 24 hours or until Constance is destroyed, is on a different plane of existence than the target, or takes a bonus action to end the effect.

action.name: Children of the Night (1/Day)

While outdoors, Constance can call {@dice 3d6} {@creature wolf||wolves} instead. The called creatures arrive in {@dice 1d4} rounds, acting as allies of Constance and obeying its spoken commands. The beasts remain for 1 hour, until Constance dies, or until Constance dismisses them as a bonus action.

While {@condition poisoned} in this way, the target takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) poison damage at the start of each of its turns. The target can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Velomachus casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability:

1e: {@spell contact other plane} (as an action, contacting a long-dead spirit)

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If Velomachus fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Velomachus makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 18} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 1d10 + 10}) piercing damage plus 6 ({@damage 1d12}) thunder damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 18} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 1d6 + 10}) slashing damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it is knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Battle Tide Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: Velomachus exhales thunderous sound in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 25} Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 45 ({@damage 7d12}) force damage and 45 ({@damage 7d12}) thunder damage and is pushed up to 20 feet in a horizontal direction of Velomachus' choice. On a success, the creature takes half as much damage and isn't pushed. Objects that aren't being worn or carried take the damage and are pushed as if they were creatures that failed the saving throw.

legendary.name: Claw
entries: Velomachus makes one Claw attack.

legendary.name: Chaotic Flow (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Velomachus moves up to half her flying speed. If a creature hits or misses her with an opportunity attack during this move, the attacker takes 19 ({@damage 3d12}) thunder damage.

legendary.name: Repeating History (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: Velomachus magically summons {@dice 1d4} {@creature spirit statue mascot|SCC|statue mascots} in unoccupied spaces she can see within 60 feet of herself. The spirit statues obey her commands and take their turns immediately after hers. Any creature, other than a spirit statue or Velomachus, is {@condition restrained} if it starts its turn within 5 feet of one or more of these spirit statues. This {@condition restrained} condition lasts until the end of the creature's turn. These spirit statues disappear after 10 minutes, when Velomachus dies, or when she uses this action again.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Tanazir casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 24}):

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If Tanazir fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Tanazir makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 16} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 1d10 + 9}) piercing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) force damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 16} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 2d6 + 9}) slashing damage. If the target is a creature, it is addled by recursive thoughts, reducing its speed to 0 until the start of Tanazir's next turn.

action.name: Diminution Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: Tanazir exhales a weakening equation in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 23} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 45 ({@damage 13d6}) force damage and 45 ({@damage 13d6}) psychic damage and is weakened until the start of Tanazir's next turn. While weakened, it has disadvantage on the following rolls that rely on Strength: attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't weakened.

action.name: Teleport
entries: Tanazir teleports to an unoccupied space she can see within 100 feet of herself.

legendary.name: Claw
entries: Tanazir makes one Claw attack.

legendary.name: Fold Space (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Tanazir uses Teleport, and each other creature within 20 feet of the space she left must succeed on a {@dc 24} Strength saving throw or be pulled up to 30 feet closer to the center of that space and take 16 ({@damage 3d10}) force damage.

legendary.name: Fractal Refraction (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: Tanazir magically summons {@dice 1d4} {@creature fractal mascot|SCC|fractal mascots} in unoccupied spaces she can see within 120 feet of herself. The fractals obey her commands and take their turns immediately after hers. While any of these fractals remain, attack rolls made against Tanazir have disadvantage. A summoned fractal disappears after 1 minute, when it or Tanazir dies, or when she uses this action again.

trait.name: Campus Knowledge
entries: While at Strixhaven, the guide can't become lost by magical or nonmagical means. The guide also has advantage on ability checks made to locate creatures or objects at Strixhaven.

trait.name: Univocal Speech
entries: When the guide speaks, any creature that knows at least one language and can hear the guide understands what it says.

trait.name: Unusual Nature
entries: The guide doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The guide makes two Slam attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Smile and Wave
entries: Each creature of the guide's choice that is within 30 feet of the guide must succeed on a {@dc 11} Wisdom saving throw or be magically {@condition charmed} by the guide for 1 hour.

A {@condition charmed} target must move on its turn toward the guide, trying to get within 5 feet of the guide. The target doesn't move into obviously dangerous ground, such as a fire or a pit. Whenever the {@condition charmed} target takes damage, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success.
A target that successfully saves is immune to any guide's Smile and Wave ability for the next 24 hours.

bonus.name: Need Directions
entries: The guide takes the Help action.

name: Spirit Statue Mascot
languages: any languages it knew in life

trait.name: Death Burst
entries: When the spirit statue is reduced to 0 hit points, the statue crumbles, and the spirit returns to the afterlife in a burst of ghostly white flame. Each creature within 5 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or take 3 ({@damage 1d6}) radiant damage.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Counsel of the Past (2/Day)
entries: The spirit statue touches one creature. Once within the next 10 minutes, that creature can roll a {@dice d4} and add the number rolled to one ability check of its choice, immediately after rolling the {@dice d20}.

entries: Magical darkness doesn't impede the professor's darkvision.

action.name: Multiattack

action.name: Ink Lance
entries: {@atk ms,rs} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 3d8 + 4}) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw be {@condition blinded} until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Radiant Strike

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The pledgemage casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 13}):

action.name: Ink Blade
entries: {@atk ms,rs} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) piercing damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) psychic damage.

bonus.name: Demotivate (2/Day)
entries: The pledgemage hurls magical insults at one creature it can see within 30 feet of itself. The target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw or become {@condition frightened} of the pledgemage for 1 minute. While {@condition frightened} in this way, the target can't take reactions, its speed is halved, and any hit the pledgemage scores against the creature is a critical hit. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

reaction.name: Rousing Verse
entries: When a creature the pledgemage can see within 30 feet of it fails a saving throw, the pledgemage magically weaves together stirring prose, allowing the creature to reroll the saving throw and use the higher result.

reaction.name: Rousing Verse
entries: When a creature the apprentice can see within 30 feet of it fails a saving throw, the apprentice magically weaves together stirring prose, allowing the creature to reroll the saving throw and use the higher result.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Shadrix casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 23}):

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 14} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 1d6 + 7}) slashing damage. If the target is a creature, it is wracked with despair and has disadvantage on attack rolls until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Illuminating Shadow Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: Shadrix exhales an entwined burst of blinding radiance and unnerving shadow in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 21} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 31 ({@damage 7d8}) radiant damage and 31 ({@damage 7d8}) psychic damage and is {@condition blinded} until the start of Shadrix's next turn. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't {@condition blinded}.

legendary.name: Claw
entries: Shadrix makes one Claw attack.

legendary.name: Shadow Slip (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Shadrix becomes an inky cloud of shadow and can move up to half his flying speed without provoking opportunity attacks, then resumes his true form. During this movement, he can move through creatures and objects as if they were {@quickref difficult terrain||3}. If he moves through a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 21} Constitution saving throw or become {@condition blinded} until the end of its next turn. If Shadrix ends this move inside an object, he takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) force damage and is shunted to the nearest unoccupied space.

legendary.name: Flash of Inspiration (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: Shadrix magically summons {@dice 1d4} {@creature inkling mascot|SCC|inkling mascots} in unoccupied spaces he can see within 60 feet of himself. The inklings obey his commands and take their turns immediately after his. While any of these inklings live, Shadrix has advantage on attack rolls and saving throws. These inklings disappear after 10 minutes, when Shadrix dies, or when he uses this action again.

name: Ruin Grinder
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

trait.name: Fire Absorption
entries: Whenever the ruin grinder is subjected to fire damage, it regains a number of hit points equal to half the fire damage dealt.

trait.name: Siege Monster
entries: The ruin grinder deals double damage to objects and structures.

trait.name: Tunneler
entries: The ruin grinder can burrow through solid rock at half its burrowing speed and leaves a 10-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ruin grinder makes two Excavator attacks.

action.name: Excavator
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d6 + 6}) force damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 17} Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 10 feet away and knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) slashing damage, and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 15}). The relic sloth can grapple no more than two targets at a time.

reaction.name: Slow but Sturdy
entries: When the relic sloth is subjected to an effect that would move it out of its current space or knock it {@condition prone}, it is neither moved nor knocked {@condition prone}.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting

entries: The professor makes two Heuristic Lance attacks. It can also use Overriding Theorem, if available.

action.name: Heuristic Lance
entries: {@atk ms,rs} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one creature. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) psychic damage, and the target is {@condition poisoned} until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Overriding Theorem {@recharge 4}
entries: The professor magically influences the mind of up to two creatures it can see within 60 feet of itself. Each target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Intelligence saving throw or become {@condition charmed} by the professor until the start of the professor's next turn. The {@condition charmed} creature must immediately use its reaction, if available, to move up its speed toward another creature of the professor's choice and make one melee attack against that other creature.

reaction.name: Divide by Zero (2/Day)
entries: When the professor sees another creature within 60 feet of itself casting a spell, the professor can try to nullify the spell's formation. The creature must succeed on a {@dc 15} saving throw using the spell's spellcasting ability, or the spell fails and is wasted.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The professor makes two Spatial Blade attacks.

action.name: Spatial Blade
entries: {@atk ms,rs} {@hit 7} to hit (the target can't benefit from cover less than {@quickref Cover||3||total cover}), reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) force damage, or 22 ({@damage 4d8 + 4}) force damage if the professor is Large or larger, and the professor can push the target horizontally up to 10 feet away.

bonus.name: Dilation {@recharge 5}
entries: The professor magically alters its physical form until it uses this bonus action again, until it is {@condition incapacitated} or dies, or until it dismisses the effect (no action required). Choose one of the following options:

bonus.name: Expand
entries: The professor becomes Large if there is sufficient room for it to grow. It has advantage on attack rolls and on ability checks and saving throws that rely on Strength.

bonus.name: Contract
entries: The professor becomes Small. Its walking speed increases to 60 feet, attack rolls against it have disadvantage, and it has advantage on ability checks and saving throws that rely on Dexterity.

reaction.name: Avoidant Translation (2/Day)
entries: When the professor is hit by an attack roll, it can increase its AC by 3 against that attack, potentially causing it to miss. The professor can then teleport, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

entries: {@atk ms,rs} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) cold damage.

entries: The professor is momentarily surrounded by a swirling wave of water and moves up to 30 feet. When the professor moves within 5 feet of any other creature during this bonus action, that creature must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw, or the creature is knocked {@condition prone} and it can't take reactions until the start of its next turn. A creature can suffer this effect only once during a turn.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting

entries: The professor makes three Cinder Strike attacks.

entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) fire damage.

action.name: Lightning Flourish {@recharge}
entries: The professor unleashes arcs of magical lightning at up to two creatures it can see within 60 feet of itself. Each target must make a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw, taking 35 ({@damage 10d6}) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

bonus.name: Flaming Leap
entries: The professor is wreathed in flames and jumps up to 30 feet in any direction. When the professor lands, the flames erupt in a 10-foot radius around the professor and then vanish. Each creature of the professor's choice in that area must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or take 7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The pledgemage casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 13}):

trait.name: Evasion
entries: If the pledgemage is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, the pledgemage instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw and only half damage if it fails, provided it isn't {@condition incapacitated}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The pledgemage makes two Elemental Strike attacks.

action.name: Elemental Strike
entries: {@atk ms,rs} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 3d6 + 2}) fire or cold damage (the pledgemage's choice).

action.name: Showstopper (1/Day)
entries: The pledgemage shines with elemental magic, targeting one creature it can see within 60 feet of itself. The target must make a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 28 ({@damage 8d6}) fire or cold damage (the pledgemage's choice) and is {@condition stunned} until the start of the pledgemage's next turn. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage and isn't {@condition stunned}.

bonus.name: Surge of Artistry {@recharge 4}
entries: The pledgemage moves up to its speed, surrounding itself with elemental magic as it moves. Until the end of its turn, the pledgemage can move through the space of other creatures. The first time the pledgemage enters a creature's space on a turn, that creature must succeed on a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}. If the pledgemage ends its turn in another creature's space, the pledgemage takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) force damage and is pushed into the nearest unoccupied space.
