entries: The abhorrent overlord makes two attacks with its claws.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) slashing damage plus 14 ({@damage 4d6}) necrotic damage. The abhorrent overlord regains hit points equal to half the amount of necrotic damage dealt if the target is a creature.

action.name: Storm of Crows {@recharge}
entries: The abhorrent overlord conjures a swarm of spectral crows and harpies in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on a point the overlord can see within 120 feet of it. The sphere remains for 1 minute or until the overlord loses {@status concentration} (as if {@status concentration||concentrating} on a spell), and its area is lightly obscured and {@quickref difficult terrain||3}.

Any creature that moves into the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there must make a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw. A creature takes 16 ({@damage 3d10}) slashing damage plus 16 ({@damage 3d10}) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

name: Colossus of Akros
languages: understands Common and Celestial but can't speak

trait.name: Crumbling Destruction
entries: When the colossus drops to 0 hit points, it crumbles and is destroyed. Any creature on the ground within 30 feet of the crumbling statue must make a {@dc 22} Dexterity saving throw, taking 22 ({@damage 4d10}) bludgeoning damage and 22 ({@damage 4d10}) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

trait.name: Fire Absorption
entries: Whenever the colossus is subjected to fire damage, it takes no damage and instead regains a number of hit points equal to the fire damage dealt.

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: The colossus is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The colossus's weapon attacks are magical.

trait.name: Siege Monster
entries: The colossus deals double damage to objects and structures.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The colossus of Akros makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Spear
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 16} to hit, reach 15 ft., or range 200/600 ft., one target. {@h}23 ({@damage 4d6 + 9}) piercing damage, or 27 ({@damage 4d8 + 9}) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack. If the colossus makes a ranged attack with this spear, the spear magically returns to its hand after the attack.

action.name: Sword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 16} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}36 ({@damage 6d8 + 9}) slashing damage.

action.name: Flames of Akros {@recharge}
entries: Magical flames issue from the colossus toward up to three creatures the colossus can see within 90 feet of it. Each target must make a {@dc 24} Dexterity saving throw, taking 36 ({@damage 8d8}) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. On a failed save, a target also magically catches fire for 1 minute. At the end of each of its turns thereafter, the burning target repeats the saving throw. It takes 18 ({@damage 4d8}) fire damage on a failed save, and the effect ends on a successful one.

trait.name: Spell Turning
entries: The chimera has advantage on a saving throw against any spell that targets only the chimera (not an area). If the chimera's saving throw is successful and the spell is of 4th level or lower, the spell has no effect on the chimera and instead targets the caster.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The chimera makes three attacks: one with its claws, one with its head, and one with its tail. When its breath weapon is available, it can use the breath in place of its head or its claws.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) slashing damage.

action.name: Head
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 1d12 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Breath Weapon {@recharge 5}
entries: The chimera exhales fire in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw, taking 32 ({@damage 5d12}) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

name: Underworld Cerberus
languages: understands all languages but can't speak

trait.name: Aggressive
entries: As a bonus action, the cerberus can move up to its speed toward a hostile creature that it can see.

trait.name: Multiheaded
entries: The cerberus can't be {@status surprised}, and it has advantage on saving throws against being knocked {@condition unconscious}.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The cerberus has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the cerberus's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't {@condition incapacitated}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The cerberus makes three bite attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) piercing damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) fire damage.

action.name: Breath Weapon {@recharge 5}
entries: The cerberus exhales a 30-foot cone of molten rock. Each creature in the cone must make a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw, taking 21 ({@damage 6d6}) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. On a failed save, a creature is also {@condition restrained} by the hardening rock. A creature can make a {@dc 15} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check as an action, freeing itself or a creature within reach from the rock on a success. The rock has AC 17 and 20 hit points, and it is immune to fire, poison, and psychic damage.

trait.name: Aggressive
entries: As a bonus action, the cerberus can move up to its speed toward a hostile creature that it can see.

trait.name: Multiheaded
entries: The cerberus can't be {@status surprised}, and it has advantage on saving throws against being knocked {@condition unconscious}.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The cerberus has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the cerberus's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't {@condition incapacitated}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The cerberus makes two bite attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) piercing damage plus 2 ({@damage 1d4}) fire damage.

action.name: Breath Weapon {@recharge 5}
entries: The cerberus exhales a 15-foot cone of molten rock. Each creature in the cone must make a {@dc 12} Dexterity saving throw, taking 10 ({@damage 3d6}) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. On a failed save, a creature is also {@condition restrained} by the hardening rock. A creature can make a {@dc 12} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check as an action, freeing itself or a creature within reach from the rock on a success. The rock has AC 17 and 10 hit points, and it is immune to fire, poison, and psychic damage.

trait.name: Pounce
entries: If the lion moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a claw attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}. If the target is {@condition prone}, the lion can make one bite attack against it as a bonus action.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 2d10 + 5}) piercing damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) slashing damage.

trait.name: Charge
entries: If the bull moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a gore attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 19 ({@damage 3d12}) piercing damage.

action.name: Gore
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 2d12 + 5}) piercing damage.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The ashen rider's spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save {@dc 18}). The rider can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

trait.name: Aura of Silence
entries: When a creature starts its turn within 30 feet of the ashen rider, the rider can force that creature to make a {@dc 18} Wisdom saving throw if the rider can see it. On a successful save, the creature is immune to this aura for the next 24 hours. On a failed save, the creature can't speak and is {@condition deafened} until the start of its next turn.

trait.name: Mount
entries: If the ashen rider isn't mounted, it can use a bonus action to magically teleport onto the creature serving as its mount, provided the ashen rider and its mount are on the same plane of existence. When it teleports, the ashen rider appears astride the mount along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying.

While mounted and not {@condition incapacitated}, the ashen rider can't be {@status surprised}, and both it and its mount have advantage on Dexterity saving throws. If the ashen rider is reduced to 0 hit points while riding its mount, the mount is reduced to 0 hit points as well.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ashen rider makes three attacks with its ashen blade or two attacks with its bolt of ash.

action.name: Ashen Blade
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) slashing damage plus 13 ({@damage 2d12}) radiant damage.

action.name: Bolt of Ash
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 10} to hit, range 120 ft., one creature. {@h}22 ({@damage 4d10}) necrotic damage, and the target can't regain hit points until the start of the ashen rider's next turn.

legendary.name: Attack
entries: The ashen rider makes an attack using its ashen blade or bolt of ash.

legendary.name: Coordinated Assault (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The ashen rider makes an attack using its ashen blade or bolt of ash, and then its mount can use its reaction to make a melee weapon attack.

legendary.name: Reduce to Ash (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: The ashen rider targets a creature it can see within 60 feet of it. The target must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw, or it takes 27 ({@damage 5d10}) necrotic damage and its hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. If the target's hit point maximum is reduced to 0, its body and everything it is wearing and carrying, except for magic items, are reduced to ash. A creature reduced to ash can't be revived by any means short of a {@spell wish} spell.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The archon's spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save {@dc 17}, {@hit 9} to hit with spell attacks). The archon can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The archon has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Mount
entries: If the archon isn't mounted, it can use a bonus action to magically teleport onto the creature serving as its mount, provided the archon and its mount are on the same plane of existence. When it teleports, the archon appears astride the mount, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying. While mounted and not {@condition incapacitated}, the archon can't be {@status surprised}, and both it and its mount have advantage on Dexterity saving throws. If the archon is reduced to 0 hit points while riding its mount, the mount is reduced to 0 hit points as well.

trait.name: Radiant Rebirth (Recharges after a Long Rest)
entries: If the archon is reduced to 0 hit points, it regains 30 hit points and springs back to its feet with a burst of radiance. Each creature of the archon's choice within 30 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw, or the creature takes 13 ({@damage 3d8}) radiant damage and is {@condition blinded} until the start of the archon's turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The archon makes two attacks with its radiant spear.

action.name: Radiant Spear
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) piercing damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) radiant damage.

legendary.name: Attack
entries: The archon makes a radiant spear attack or casts {@spell guiding bolt}.

legendary.name: Coordinated Assault (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The archon makes a radiant spear attack, and then its mount can use its reaction to make a melee weapon attack.

legendary.name: Return to Nyx (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: The archon causes a corpse it can see within 30 feet of it to burst into a shower of radiant stars leaving no trace of it behind. Everything it is wearing or carrying remains. Each creature within 10 feet of the corpse when it bursts must succeed on a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw or take 22 ({@damage 4d10}) radiant damage.

name: Gold-Forged Sentinel
languages: understands one language of its creator but can't speak

trait.name: Charge
entries: If the sentinel moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a ram attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 10 ({@damage 3d6}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Spell Turning
entries: The sentinel has advantage on saving throws against any spell that targets only the sentinel (not an area). If the sentinel's saving throw succeeds and the spell is of 4th level or lower, the spell has no effect on the sentinel and instead targets the caster.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The sentinel makes two ram attacks.

action.name: Ram
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Fire Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: The sentinel exhales fire in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw, taking 27 ({@damage 6d8}) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

name: Burnished Hart
languages: understands one language of its creator but can't speak

trait.name: Charge
entries: If the hart moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with an antlers attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 13} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Heated Body
entries: A creature that touches the hart or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) fire damage.

trait.name: Sure-Footed
entries: The hart has advantage on Strength and Dexterity saving throws made against effects that would knock it {@condition prone}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hart makes two attacks: one with its antlers and one with its hooves.

action.name: Antlers
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Hooves
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) bludgeoning damage plus 2 ({@damage 1d4}) fire damage.

name: Bronze Sable
languages: understands one language of its creator but can't speak

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the sable remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal statue.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The sable has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the sable's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't {@condition incapacitated}.

trait.name: Surprise Attack
entries: If the sable surprises a creature and hits it with an attack during the first round of combat, the target takes an extra 10 ({@damage 3d6}) damage from the attack.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The sable makes two bite attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) piercing damage.

name: Anvilwrought Raptor
languages: understands one language of its creator but can't speak

trait.name: Keen Sight
entries: The raptor has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight.

trait.name: Recorded Mimicry
entries: The raptor can mimic any sound, including voices, it has heard in the last 24 hours. A creature that hears the sounds can tell they are imitations with a successful {@dc 12} Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) check.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The raptor makes two attacks with its beak.

action.name: Beak
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) piercing damage.

variant.name: Anvilwrought Raptor Familiar
entries: Some anvilwrought raptors are created expressly to be familiars. Such creatures have the following trait.

entries.name: Familiar
entries: The anvilwrought can serve another creature as a familiar, forming a magical, telepathic bond with its willing master. While the two are bonded, the master can sense what the anvilwrought senses, as long as they are within 1 mile of each other.

trait.name: Petrifying Gaze
entries: When a creature that can see the medusa's eyes starts its turn within 30 feet of the medusa, the medusa can force it to make a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw if the medusa isn't {@condition incapacitated} and can see the creature. If the saving throw fails by 5 or more, the creature is instantly {@condition petrified}. Otherwise, a creature that fails the save begins to turn to stone and is {@condition restrained}. The {@condition restrained} creature must repeat the saving throw at the end of its next turn, becoming {@condition petrified} on a failure or ending the effect on a success. The petrification lasts until the creature is freed by the {@spell greater restoration} spell or other magic.

Unless {@status surprised}, a creature can avert its eyes to avoid the saving throw at the start of its turn. If the creature does so, it can't see the medusa until the start of its next turn, when it can avert its eyes again. If the creature looks at the medusa in the meantime, it must immediately make the save.
If the medusa sees itself reflected on a polished surface within 30 feet of it and in an area of bright light, the medusa is, due to its curse, affected by its own gaze.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The medusa makes either three melee attacks—one with its snake hair, one to constrict, and one with its shortsword—or two ranged attacks with its longbow.

action.name: Snake Hair
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing damage plus 14 ({@damage 4d6}) poison damage.

action.name: Shortsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Longbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 5} to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) piercing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) poison damage.

action.name: Constrict
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 2d6}) bludgeoning damage, and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 11}). Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained}, and the medusa can't constrict another target.

trait.name: Charge
entries: If Antigonos moves at least 10 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a gore attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 9 ({@damage 2d8}) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 14} Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 10 feet away and knocked {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Labyrinthine Recall
entries: Antigonos can perfectly recall any path he has traveled.

trait.name: Reckless
entries: At the start of his turn, Antigonos can gain advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls he makes during that turn, but attack rolls against him have advantage until the start of his next turn.

trait.name: Decrepit State
entries: Antigonos has disadvantage on his attack rolls.

action.name: Greataxe
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 2d12 + 4}) slashing damage.

action.name: Gore
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Amphora
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one Medium or smaller creature. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) bludgeoning damage. If there is not already a creature inside the amphora, the target is {@condition restrained} inside. As an action, the {@condition restrained} creature can make a {@dc 14} Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics}) check, escaping from the amphora on a success. The effect also ends if the amphora is destroyed. The amphora has AC 8, 20 hit points, and immunity to poison and psychic damage.

hp.special: 85 (10d8 + 40) plus 85 (10d8 + 40) per player character

trait.name: Intimidating Aura
entries: Elias projects a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} of imposing command. An ally that start its turn in the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on the first attack roll it makes before the start of its next turn. A {@variantrule Hostile [Attitude]|XPHB|Hostile} creature that starts its turn in the Emenation takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Thunder damage and is subjected to the following effect. {@actSave wis} {@dc 16}. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition until the start of its next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} The target is immune to Elias's Intimidating Aura for 24 hours.

action.name: Elias always takes his turn on Initiative count 20
entries: On his turn, Elias can use his movement and interaction as normal. However, he does not take an action or {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on his turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, Elias takes one of the following {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim|Epic Actions} at the end of each player character's turn:

items.name: Lord Commander's Blade
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 12}, reach 5 ft. {@h}25 ({@damage 4d8 + 7}) Slashing damage, and Elias can apply one of the following martial masteries to the target:

items.name: Wound
entries: The target has the {@condition Bleeding|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition ({@dice 4d4}).

items.name: Topple
entries: The target has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

items.name: Sap
entries: The target has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on the next attack roll it makes before the start of start of Elias's next turn.

items.name: Longbow
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 12}, range 150/600 ft. {@h}25 ({@damage 4d8 + 7}) Piercing damage, and Elias can apply one of the following martial masteries to the target:

items.name: Push
entries: If the target is Large or smaller, it is pushed up to 10 feet away from Elias.

items.name: Slow
entries: The target has the {@condition Slowed|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition ({@dc 15} Constitution save ends).

action.name: Command
entries: Elias chooses one ally he can see. If the ally can see and hear him, it can use its {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to make one weapon attack with {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB}. On a hit, the attack deals an extra 10 ({@damage 3d6}) damage.

action.name: Flare (1/Round)
entries: Elias chooses a point he can see within 60 feet and fires at flare at it, signaling the Hooded Lantern's bombardment. Elias recharges his Artillery Strike. He can only use this {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} if it's the first {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} he has taken this round.

action.name: Artillery Strike (Recharge Special)
entries: Elias can only use this {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} if it's the last {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} he takes this round. {@actSave dex} {@dc 17}, each creature in a 20-foot radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on the point Elias chose with his Flare {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim}. {@actSaveFail} 18 ({@damage 4d8}) Piercing damage plus 14 ({@damage 4d6}) Fire damage, and the target has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

action.name: Epic Resistance
entries: Elias chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting him and rolls {@dice 1d20}. On an 11+, the effect ends on him. Elias can use this action even if he would otherwise be unable to take actions, his actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters his game statistics.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Petra makes three attacks.

action.name: Shortsword
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, reach 5 ft. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Longbow
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 7}, range 150/600 ft. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) Piercing damage, and the target has the {@condition Slowed|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition until the end of Petra's next turn.

bonus.name: Cunning Action
entries: Petra takes the {@action Dash|XPHB}, {@action Disengage|XPHB}, or {@action Hide|XPHB} action.

reaction.name: Skirmisher
entries: {@actTrigger} A hostile creature Petra can see ends its turn within 5 feet of her. {@actResponse} Petra moves up to her {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} without provoking {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB} action.

trait.name: Evasion
entries: If Ansom is subjected to an effect that allows him to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, he instead takes no damage if he succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if he fails, provided he doesn't have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Ansom makes four attacks.

action.name: Shortsword
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, reach 5 ft. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Longbow
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 7}, range 150/600 ft. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) Piercing damage, and the target has the {@condition Slowed|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition until the end of Ansom's next turn.

bonus.name: Flurry of Blades
entries: Ansom makes two Shortsword attacks.

reaction.name: Parry
entries: {@actTrigger} A creature Ansom can see hits him with an attack. {@actResponse} Ansom adds 3 to his AC against that attack, potentially causing it to miss.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The veteran casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 12}, +4 to spell attacks):

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The veteran makes two attacks.

action.name: Shortsword
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Longbow
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 5}, range 150/600 ft. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) Piercing damage, and the target has the {@condition Slowed|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition until the end of the veteran's next turn.

bonus.name: Quarry
entries: The veteran casts {@spell Hunter's Mark|XPHB}, using the spellcasting ability from Spellcasting.

bonus.name: Quick Ascent
entries: The veteran moves up to 30 feet in a straight line in any direction, provided it ends its turn adjacent to a solid surface.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The apothecary casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 12}, +4 to spell attacks):

action.name: Shortsword
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4}, reach 5 ft. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Hand Crossbow
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 4}, range 30/120 ft. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) Piercing damage. {@actSave con} {@dc 12}. {@actSaveFail} 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Poison damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

action.name: Medical Treatment (3/Day)
entries: The apothecary touches another creature. The target regains 20 ({@dice 4d8 + 2}) {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, and the apothecary ends one disease or condition affecting the target, choosing from the {@condition Blinded|XPHB}, {@condition Deafened|XPHB}, {@condition Paralyzed|XPHB}, and {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} conditions.

bonus.name: Adrenaline Boost
entries: One ally within 5 feet of the apothecary can use its {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to move up to its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} and make an attack.

spellcasting.name: Smoke Bomb (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
headerEntries: The trapper casts {@spell Fog Cloud|XPHB} without the need for components, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability.

trait.name: Powder Keg

entries: While the Queen of Thieves is wearing light or no armor and wielding no shield, her AC includes her Intelligence modifier (included above).

trait.name: Masked Identity
entries: The Queen of Thieves is immune to any effect that would sense her emotions or read her thoughts, as well as any divination spell that she refuses. Wisdom ({@skill Insight|XPHB}) checks made to ascertain her intentions or sincerity have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}.

trait.name: Memory Thief
entries: Creatures are not aware when the Queen of Thieves reads their thoughts or imposes the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition on them. Additionally, when a spell cast by the her that causes creatures to become {@condition Charmed|XPHB} ends, she can make affected creatures lose their memories. Each creature must succeed on a {@dc 18} Intelligence saving throw or forget up to 8 hours of the time spent {@condition Charmed|XPHB} by her. These memories can be restored with a {@spell Heal|XPHB} spell or similar magic.

trait.name: Vexing Aura
entries: The Queen of Thieves projects a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} of bewitching magic. If she deals damage to the creature, the condition ends, and that creature is immune to her Enchanting Presence for 24 hours.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting (1/Round)
headerEntries: The Algorithm casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 27}):

trait.name: Electronic Data Network
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 60 feet of the Algorithm takes 21 ({@damage 6d6}) Lightning damage.

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: The Algorithm is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

trait.name: Predictive Analytics
entries: At the end of each of the Algorithm's turns, it rolls {@dice 1d20} for each player character fighting it. The Algorithm can replace any {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB} made by it or a creature it can see with one of these predictive rolls. It must choose to do so before the roll, and it can replace a roll in this way only once per turn.
Each predictive roll can be used only once. Any unused predictive rolls are lost at the start of the Algorithm's next turn.

action.name: The Algorithm always takes its turn on Initiative count 20
entries: On its turn, the Algorithm can use its movement and interaction as normal. However, it does not take an action or {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on its turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. items.name: Wire
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 26}, one creature the Algorithm can see within 60 feet. {@actSaveFail} 21 ({@damage 2d10 + 10}) Force damage, and if the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 20}). The Algorithm can grapple up to six creatures at a time.

items.name: Algorithmic Manipulation
entries: {@actSave str} {@dc 26}, one Huge or smaller creature or object the Algorithm can see within 120 feet. {@actSaveFail} The Algorithm moves the target up to 30 feet in any direction, and the target has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition. If the Algorithm lifts the target into the air, it is suspended there. The target remains held until the Algorithm releases it (no action required), uses this {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} again, or has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition.

items.name: Deatomization
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 26}, one creature or object the Algorithm can see within 300 feet. {@actSaveFail} 65 ({@damage 10d12}) Necrotic damage. If this damage reduces the target to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, it dies and its body is reduced to atoms. {@actSaveFail} Half damage.

action.name: Reprogram (1/Round)
entries: {@actSave int} {@dc 26}, one creature {@condition Grappled|XPHB} by the algorithm. {@actSaveFail} 55 ({@damage 10d10}) Piercing damage. If this damage reduces the target to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, it dies and its brain is replaced with mechanical components. The target reanimates at the start of its next turn as a Construct under the Algorithm's control. It resembles the original creature, but its eyes glow with synthetic green light, and its body is covered in protruding wires, metal scraps, and glowing tubes.

action.name: Assuming Direct Control (1/Round)
entries: The Algorithm targets a Construct within 120 feet and immediately enters and takes control of it. The Algorithm can still use its {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim|Epic Actions} as normal and replaces the Construct's game statistics with its own, except the Construct's {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. When the Construct is reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, the Algorithm reemerges in an unoccupied space within 15 feet of it.

action.name: Epic Resistance
entries: The Algorithm chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting them and rolls {@dice 1d20}. On an 11+, the effect ends on it. The Algorithm can use this action even if it would otherwise be unable to take actions, its actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters its game statistics.

headerEntries: The Whispered Promise casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 25}):

trait.name: Alluring Aura
entries: The Whispered Promise projects a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} of beguiling enchantment. A creature that ends its turn in the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} has the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition for 1 hour. Each time the creature takes damage other than Psychic damage, it makes a {@dc 25} Wisdom saving throw. On a success, the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition ends for that creature, and it is immune to the Alluring Aura of the Whispered Promise for 24 hours.

trait.name: Change Shape
entries: The Whispered Promise has no true form and chooses how they manifest to each creature (no action required). Their form can be anything they wish; they can appear like a creature, object, or even as a multisensory representation of an abstract concept. They can appear to be any form that is Large or smaller, but their game statistics are the same in each form.

trait.name: Inscrutable
entries: The Whispered Promise is immune to any effect that would sense their emotions or read their thoughts, as well as any divination spell that they refuse. Wisdom ({@skill Insight|XPHB}) checks made to ascertain the Whispered Promise's intentions or sincerity have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}.

trait.name: Glibness
entries: When they make a Charisma ({@skill Deception|XPHB}) check, the Whispered Promise treats any roll of 14 or less on the {@dice d20} as 15.

trait.name: Unravelling Resolve
entries: Creatures {@condition grappled} by the Whispered Promise can't benefit from {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} and {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to Psychic damage or the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition.

action.name: The Whispered Promise always takes their turn on Initiative count 20
entries: On their turn, the Whispered Promise can use their movement and interaction as normal. However, they do not take an action or {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on their turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, the Whispered Promise takes one of the following {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim|Epic Actions} at the end of each player character's turn:

items.name: Tendril
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 17}, reach 10 ft. {@h}28 ({@damage 4d8 + 10}) Force damage, and the target has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 25}). While {@condition Grappled|XPHB}, the target has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition.

items.name: Whispers (1/Round)
entries: {@actSave int} {@dc 25}. one creature the Whispered Promise can see within 300 feet. {@actSaveFail} 35 ({@damage 10d6}) Psychic damage, and the target is {@condition Dazed|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} (save ends). {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage. Failure by five or more: Double damage, and the target is {@condition Stunned|XPHB} until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Promises (1/Round)
entries: {@actSave cha} {@dc 25}, one creature the Whispered Promise can see within 300 feet. {@actSaveFail} 35 ({@damage 10d6}) Psychic damage, and the target is {@condition Jinxed|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} ({@dice 1d10}) (save ends). {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage. Failure by 5 or more: Double damage, and the target becomes cursed. While cursed, the target can't regain {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} and gains no benefits from taking a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

action.name: Unfettered Glide
entries: The Whispered Promise moves up to their {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} without provoking {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB} action.

action.name: Dominate (1/Round)
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 25}, one creature the Whispered Promise can see within 300 feet. {@actSaveFail} The creature has the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn. While {@condition Charmed|XPHB}, the target obeys the Whispered Promise's commands and can't take Reactions. Failure by 5 or More: The {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition instead lasts for 24 hours or until the Whispered Promise is reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. Each time the target takes damage, it repeats the save, ending the effect on itself on a success. {@actSaveSuccess} The target has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on its next attack roll against the Whispered Promise.

action.name: Epic Resistances
entries: The Whispered Promise chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting them and rolls {@dice 1d20}. On an 11+, the effect ends on them. The Whispered Promise can use this action even if they would otherwise be unable to take actions, their actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters their game statistics.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting (Psionics; 1/Round)
headerEntries: The Thing with the Writhing Tail casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 26}):

trait.name: Avoidance
entries: If the Thing with the Writhing Tail is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a saving throw to take only half damage, it instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if it fails.

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The Thing with the Writhing Tail can move through other creatures and objects as if they were {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB}. It takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

trait.name: Inscrutable
entries: The Thing with the Writhing Tail is immune to any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, as well as any divination spell that it refuses. Wisdom ({@skill Insight|XPHB}) checks made to ascertain the being's intentions or sincerity have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}.

trait.name: Purring Aura
entries: The Thing with the Writhing Tail projects a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} of madness and dread. A creature that ends its turn in the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} has the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition for 1 hour. A creature can take an action to attempt to overcome its fear, making a {@dc 25} Wisdom saving throw. {@actSaveFail} The target takes 27 ({@damage 5d10}) Psychic damage. {@actSaveSuccess} The {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition ends for that creature, and it becomes immune to the Purring Aura of the Thing with the Writhing Tail for 24 hours.

trait.name: Quantum Displacement
entries: The Thing with the Writhing Tail shifts between realities and timelines. Attack rolls against it have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}, and it has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws. If it is hit by an attack or fails a saving throw, this trait is disrupted until it uses Phase Displacement. This trait is also disrupted while the Thing with the Writhing Tail has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition or a {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} of 0.

action.name: The Thing with the Writhing Tail always takes its turn on Initiative count 20
entries: On its turn, The Thing with the Writhing Tail can use its movement and interaction as normal. However, it does not take an action or {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on its turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, The Thing with the Writhing Tail takes one of the following {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim|Epic Actions} at the end of each player character's turn:

action.name: Cosmic Claw
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 15}, reach 10 ft. {@h}29 ({@damage 4d10 + 8}) Force damage.

action.name: Tail Whip
entries: {@actSave int} {@dc 26}, one creature the Thing with the Writhing Tail can see within 30 feet. {@actSaveFail} 35 ({@damage 10d6}) Psychic damage, and the target has the {@condition Dazed|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition (save ends). Failure by 5 or More: 70 ({@damage 20d6}) Psychic damage, and the target instead has the {@condition Stunned|XPHB} condition (save ends). {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

action.name: Manifest Duplicate (1/Round)
entries: The Thing with the Writhing Tail creates a perfect visual illusion of itself in an unoccupied space it can see within 300 feet. The illusion is intangible and doesn't occupy its space. The duplicate lasts for 1 minute, but it ends early if the Thing with the Writhing Tail dismisses it (no action required) or has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition. The Thing with the Writhing Tail can have a up to eight illusory duplicates at a time. While it has one or more duplicates, it has the following benefits:

action.name: Attacks and Spells
entries: The Thing with the Writhing Tail can cast spells, use Tail Whip, and make Claw attacks as if was in an illusory duplicate's space.

action.name: Aura Expansion
entries: Each illusory duplicate emanates a Purring Aura. The effects of multiple overlapping auras do not stack; a creature is only affected once by the Purring Aura even if it is within range of multiple Emanations.

action.name: Move
entries: Each time the Thing with the Writhing Tail takes this {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim}, it can move any number of illusions up to 60 feet to unoccupied spaces within 300 feet of itself.

action.name: Distract
entries: When both the Thing with the Writhing Tail and one of its illusory duplicates are within 10 feet of a creature that can see them, the Thing with the Writhing Tail has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on attack rolls against that creature.

action.name: Sense
entries: The Thing with the Writhing Tail can see and hear through each of its illusory duplicates.

action.name: Phase Displacement
entries: The Thing with the Writhing Tail teleports, swapping places with one of its illusory duplicates. If its Quantum Displacement trait was disrupted, it is no longer disrupted.

action.name: Epic Resistance
entries: The Thing with the Writhing Tail chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting it and rolls {@dice 1d20}. On an 11+, the effect ends on it. The Thing with the Writhing Tail can use this action even if it would otherwise be unable to take actions, its actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters its game statistics.

entries: On his turn, He Who Laughs Last can use his movement and interaction as normal. entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 16}, reach 120 ft. {@h}30 ({@damage 5d8 + 8}) Force damage, and if the target is Large or smaller, it is pulled 30 feet toward He Who Laughs Last.

entries: He Who Laughs Last moves up to half his {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}.

action.name: Sleep No More (1/Round)
entries: He Who Laughs Last casts {@spell Power Word Kill|XPHB}.

action.name: Out Brief Candle (1/Round)

entries: He Who Laughs Last casts {@spell Disintegrate|XPHB} (save {@dc 24}).

action.name: Cage of Sorrows (1/Round)
entries: He Who Laughs Last creates a wall of bone on a solid surface it can see within 120 feet of himself. The wall appears as a flat surface made up of one 10-foot-square panel. The wall is 1 foot thick and lasts for 1 minute or until the wall is destroyed (AC 15, 20 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to Poison and Psychic damage, {@variantrule Vulnerability|XPHB} to Bludgeoning and Thunder damage).

If the wall cuts through a creature's space when it appears, the creature is pushed to one side of the wall (GM's choice) and subjected to the following effect. {@actSave dex} {@dc 16}. {@actSaveFail} 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Epic Resistance
entries: He Who Laughs Last chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting him and rolls {@dice 1d20}. On an 11+, the effect ends on him. He Who Laughs Last can use this action even if he would otherwise be unable to take actions, his actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters his game statistics.

trait.name: Fully Contaminated
entries: The sentient planetoid is immune to {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} and has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against contaminated spells. The sentient planetoid may cast contaminated spells even though it does not gain {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} levels.

trait.name: Delerium Healing
entries: As an action, the sentient planetoid can touch a delerium shard to regain 10 ({@dice 3d6}) {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. Once the sentient planetoid has used a delerium shard in this way, the shard can't be used in this manner again for 24 hours.

trait.name: Alien Intellect
entries: The sentient planetoid is immune to any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, as well as any divination spell that it refuses. Wisdom ({@skill Insight|XPHB}) checks made to ascertain the sentient planetoid's intentions or sincerity have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}.

trait.name: Beyond Space and Time
entries: The sentient planetoid always acts on {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} count 20. Additionally, it can't be moved, teleported, or sent to another plane of existence against its will.

trait.name: Gravitational Pull
entries: The sentient planetoid exerts its own force of gravity in a 100-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation}. A creature that starts its turn in the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} falls towards the sentient planetoid, taking falling damage as appropriate if it collides with the planetoid. A creature can make a {@dc 22} Dexterity saving throw to grab onto a fixed object it can reach, avoiding the fall on a success.

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: The sentient planetoid is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The sentient planetoid has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The sentient planetoid makes four attacks, only one of which can be an Unfathomable Knowledge attack.

action.name: Unfathomable Knowledge
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 14}, reach 5 ft. or range 250 ft. {@h}39 ({@damage 6d12}) Psychic damage, and the target has the {@condition Addled|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} and {@condition Weakened|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} conditions until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Crashing Comet
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 14}, range 150 ft. {@h}27 ({@damage 6d8}) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the {@condition Burning|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition ({@dice 3d8} Fire).

action.name: All-Knowing Magic {@recharge 5}
entries: The sentient planetoid casts any spell of level 5 or lower, using Intelligence as its spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 22}, +14 to spell attacks).

trait.name: Fully Contaminated
entries: The star warden is immune to {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} and has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against contaminated spells. The star warden may cast contaminated spells even though it does not gain {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} levels.

trait.name: Delerium Healing
entries: As an action, the star warden can touch a delerium shard to regain 10 ({@dice 3d6}) {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. Once the star warden has used a delerium shard in this way, the shard can't be used in this manner again for 24 hours.

trait.name: Alien Intellect
entries: The sentient planetoid is immune to any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, as well as any divination spell that it refuses. Wisdom ({@skill Insight|XPHB}) checks made to ascertain the sentient planetoid's intentions or sincerity have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}.

trait.name: Cosmic Aura
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of the star warden is subjected to the following effect. {@actSave cha} {@dc 17}. {@actSaveFail} The target is hurled through time and space, witnessing every moment of existence in a single second. It takes 17 ({@damage 5d6}) Psychic damage and is teleported to an unoccupied space it can see within 30 feet.

trait.name: Lords of Time and Space
entries: When the star warden is reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, roll a {@dice d20}. On a 1 or 20, the star warden regains all of its {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} and another creature of its choice within 30 feet is reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The star warden makes two attacks.

action.name: Staff of Stars
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 8}, reach 5 ft. or range 60/120 ft. {@h}22 ({@damage 5d6 + 4}) Radiant damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Force damage.

action.name: Nebulae Grasp
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 8}, reach 5 ft. {@h}27 ({@damage 5d8 + 4}) Piercing damage, and the star warden can teleport the target to an unoccupied space the star warden can see within 120 feet.

action.name: Stardust
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 17}, each creature in a 30-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}. {@actSaveFail} 18 ({@damage 4d6 + 4}) Radiant damage and the target has the {@condition Burning|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition ({@dice 4d6} Radiant).

bonus.name: The Cold Void of Space
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 17}, one creature within 120 feet of the star warden that teleported this turn. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Frozen|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition. {@actSaveSuccess} 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Cold damage.

reaction.name: Outside Time and Space
entries: {@actTrigger} A creature hits the star warden with an attack. {@actResponse} The star warden switches places with another creature within 30 feet, and the attack hits that creature instead.

trait.name: From Another World
entries: The void pirate doesn't have the standard Aberrant Traits other creatures in the Space Between Worlds have.

trait.name: Keen Eye, Sharp Wit
entries: The void pirate has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} rolls.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The void pirate makes three attacks.

action.name: Void Longsword
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 9}, reach 5 ft. {@h}21 ({@damage 3d10 + 5}) Force damage.

action.name: Pirate Pistol
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 9}, range 30/120 ft. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) Piercing damage.

bonus.name: Bark Orders
entries: One void pirate squib or quartermaster within 60 feet of the void pirate can use its {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to move up to half its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} or make an attack.

reaction.name: Captain's Command (2/Day)
entries: {@actTrigger} A {@variantrule Friendly [Attitude]|XPHB|Friendly} creature within 30 feet of the void pirate fails an attack roll. {@actResponse} If the creature can hear the void pirate, it can reroll the attack roll and use the higher result.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The void pirate casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 14}, +6 to spell attacks):

trait.name: From Another World
entries: The void pirate doesn't have the standard Aberrant Traits other creatures in the Space Between Worlds have.

trait.name: Magical Chaos
entries: When the void pirate or a creature within 30 feet of it is targeted by a spell, roll a {@dice d6}. On a 4-5, an {@table Arcane Anomalies|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} triggers on the caster. On a 6, the spell fails and an {@table Arcane Anomalies|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} triggers on the caster.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The void pirate makes three Void Blast attacks.

action.name: Void Blast
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. {@h}19 ({@damage 3d10 + 3}) Force damage, and the target is knocked 10 feet away from the void pirate.

bonus.name: Summon Elemental (1/Day)
entries: The void pirate magically summons an {@creature Entropic Flame|MonstersOfDrakkenheim}, {@creature Walking Geode|MonstersOfDrakkenheim}, {@creature Living Deep Haze|MonstersOfDrakkenheim}, or {@creature Animated Delerium Sludge|MonstersOfDrakkenheim}. The elemental appears in an unoccupied space within 60 feet of the void pirate, whom it obeys. It takes its turn immediately after the void pirate. It lasts for 1 hour, until it or the void pirate dies, or the void pirate dismisses it as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}.

trait.name: Captain's Orders
entries: While within 60 feet of a void pirate captain, the void pirate has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws to avoid or end the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} and {@condition Frightened|XPHB} conditions.

trait.name: From Another World
entries: The void pirate doesn't have the standard Aberrant Traits other creatures in the Space Between Worlds have.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The void pirate makes two Void Cutlass attacks or uses its Sturdy Net.

action.name: Void Cutlass
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) Slashing damage.

action.name: Sturdy Net
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft. or range 15/30 ft. {@h}The target has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} and {@condition Defenseless|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} conditions. A creature can take an action to free itself or another creature in a net with a successful {@dc 14} Strength check. Dealing 10 Slashing damage to the net (AC 12) frees the target without harming it and destroys the net.

bonus.name: Man the Cannons
entries: The void pirate loads an artillery weapon, such as a cannon or ballista.

trait.name: Captain's Orders
entries: While within 60 feet of a void pirate captain, the void pirate has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws to avoid or end the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} and {@condition Frightened|XPHB} conditions.

trait.name: Duel to the Death
entries: Once per turn, if the Void Pirate is within 5 feet of an enemy, and no other creatures are within 5 feet of them, the void pirate can deal an extra 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Slashing damage with their Voidblade attack.

trait.name: From Another World
entries: The void pirate doesn't have the standard Aberrant Traits other creatures in the Space Between Worlds have.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The void pirate makes two attacks.

action.name: Voidblade
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, reach 5 ft. {@h}18 ({@damage 3d8 + 4}) Force damage.

action.name: Boltgun
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 6}, range 150/600 ft. {@h}13 ({@damage 3d6 + 3}) Piercing damage, and the target has the {@condition Slowed|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition until the end of its next turn.

bonus.name: Bark Orders
entries: One void pirate squib within 60 feet of the void pirate can use its {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to move up to half its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} or make an attack.

trait.name: Fully Contaminated
entries: The warp marauder is immune to {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} and has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against contaminated spells. The warp marauder may cast contaminated spells even though it does not gain {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} levels.

trait.name: Delerium Healing
entries: As an action, the warp marauder can touch a delerium shard to regain 10 ({@dice 3d6}) {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. Once the warp marauder has used a delerium shard in this way, the shard can't be used in this manner again for 24 hours.

trait.name: Alien Intellect
entries: The warp marauder is immune to any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, as well as any divination spell that it refuses. Wisdom ({@skill Insight|XPHB}) checks made to ascertain the warp marauder's intentions or sincerity have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}.

trait.name: Extraplanar Gullet
entries: The warp marauder's back opens into a large mouth that leads to an extradimensional gullet. Anything it swallows is transported into this extraplanar space, which manifests as a rhizomatic network of slurping tunnels and fleshy passages. This space can hold any number of creatures of any size, and nothing inside the space can harm the warp marauder.

A creature within the gullet can take an action to attempt to escape, making a {@dc 15} Intelligence saving throw. On a success, it reappears in the nearest unoccupied space within 5 feet of the warp marauder. On a failure, it takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Psychic damage. If the warp marauder dies, everything inside the extraplanar gullet appears in the nearest unoccupied spaces to its corpse.

trait.name: Grasping Tentacles
entries: The warp marauder can have up to four tentacles at a time. Each tentacle has AC 20, 10 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, and {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to Poison and Psychic damage. Destroying a tentacle deals no damage to the warp marauder, which can extrude a replacement tentacle on its next turn. A creature within 5 feet can take an action to break a tentacle with a successful {@dc 15} Strength check.

trait.name: Swirling Color Field
entries: A field of shimmering color reverberates around the warp marauder, distorting reality. A creature that hits the warp marauder with an attack suffers one of the following effects, determined randomly (roll {@dice 1d6}). A creature {@condition Grappled|XPHB} and adjacent to the warp marauder isn't affected by the Swirling Color Field.

trait.name: 1-2: Blue
entries: The attacker is teleported to an unoccupied space the warp marauder can see within 20 feet. The chosen space must be on a surface or in a liquid that can support the target. The attacker is then subjected to the following effect. {@actSave cha} {@dc 15}. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Immobilized|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition (save ends).

trait.name: 3-4: Yellow
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 15}. {@actSaveFail} 21 ({@damage 6d6}) Lightning damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

trait.name: 5-6: Red
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 15}. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Staggered|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition (save ends).

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The warp marauder makes four Tentacle attacks, uses Reel, and makes one Bite attack.

action.name: Tentacle
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, reach 60 ft. {@h}The target has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 15}). While {@condition Grappled|XPHB}, the target has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition and has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on Strength checks and saving throws, and the warp marauder can't use this tentacle against another target.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, reach 5 ft, one creature {@condition Grappled|XPHB} by the warp marauder. {@h}16 ({@damage 2d10 + 5}) Piercing damage, and the warp marauder swallows the target. The target, along with everything it is wearing and carrying, appears in the warp marauder's Extraplanar Gullet.

action.name: Reel
entries: The warp marauder pulls each creature {@condition Grappled|XPHB} by it up to 30 feet straight toward it.

bonus.name: Dimensional Jump
entries: The warp marauder teleports to an unoccupied space within 120 feet. Alternatively, it travels from the Material Plane to the Space Between Worlds or vice versa.

reaction.name: Reality Hunter
entries: {@actTrigger} A creature {@condition Grappled|XPHB} by the warp marauder attempts to teleport. {@actResponse d}{@actSave int} {@dc 15}. {@actSaveFail} 21 ({@damage 6d6}) Force damage, and the teleport fails. {@actSaveSuccess} The teleport fails, but no resources are wasted.

name: Psychophant
languages: Common (only repeats phrases it has heard)

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The psychophant makes two Psychic Grasp attacks.

action.name: Psychic Grasp
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Psychic damage and the target has the {@condition Immobilized|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition (Wisdom saving throw {@dc 14} save ends).

action.name: Final Scream {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 14}, each creature in a 30-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}. {@actSaveFail} 40 ({@damage 9d8}) Psychic damage, and the target has the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition (save ends). {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage, and the target is immune to this psychophant's Final Scream for 24 hours.

action.name: Shape-Shift
entries: The psychophant shape-shifts into a Small or Medium Humanoid it has seen or reverts to its true form. Its game statistics are the same in each form.

bonus.name: Life Siphon
entries: The psychophant deals 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Necrotic damage to a creature it damaged this turn with Psychic Grasp, then regains {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to the Necrotic damage dealt.

bonus.name: Teleport
entries: The psychophant teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 30 feet. It can bring one creature {@condition Immobilized|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} by its Psychic Grasp, which teleports to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the psychophant's destination space.

trait.name: Spell Vessel
entries: After using its Consume Spell {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB}, the phage stores the spell until the spell is digested or the phage dies. When the phage dies, the spell takes effect. If the original caster of the spell sees the phage die, it can choose the area or target(s) of the spell as if they had cast it from the phage's space. Otherwise, the spell affects a random area or target(s) from those within range.

trait.name: Warped Space
entries: The phage magically warps space in a 10-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation}. Attacks targeting the phage from outside the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}, and the phage has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and effects that originate from outside the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation}.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 10 ft. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) Piercing damage. If the phage isn't storing a spell, it makes this attack with {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} and deals an extra 14 ({@damage 4d6}) Piercing damage on a hit.

action.name: Spit
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 4}, range 60/120 ft. {@h}14 ({@damage 3d6 + 3}) Acid damage.

action.name: Digest Spell
entries: The phage digests the spell it has stored, teleporting to an unoccupied space it can see within 30 feet and making a Spit attack with {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB}.

reaction.name: Consume Spell
entries: {@actTrigger} A creature within 120 feet of the phage casts a spell while the phage isn't storing a spell. {@actResponse} The spell has no effect and is stored in the phage.

trait.name: Fully Contaminated
entries: The eldritch crawler is immune to {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} and has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against contaminated spells. The eldritch crawler may cast contaminated spells even though it does not gain {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} levels.

trait.name: Delerium Healing
entries: As an action, the eldritch crawler can touch a delerium shard to regain 10 ({@dice 3d6}) {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. Once the eldritch crawler has used a delerium shard in this way, the shard can't be used in this manner again for 24 hours.

trait.name: Alien Intellect
entries: The eldritch crawler is immune to any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, as well as any divination spell that it refuses. Wisdom ({@skill Insight|XPHB}) checks made to ascertain the eldritch crawler's intentions or sincerity have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}.

trait.name: Insectoid Limbs
entries: The eldritch crawler can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check. It ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 12}, one target within 5 ft. {@actSaveFail} 18 ({@damage 4d8}) Necrotic damage, and the target gains one {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} level. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

action.name: Contaminated Venom
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 12}, one target within 40 feet. {@actSaveFail} 18 ({@damage 4d8}) Necrotic damage, and the target gains one {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} level. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

bonus.name: Void Walker
entries: The eldritch crawler climbs through a tear in reality, traveling from the Material Plane to the Space Between Worlds or vice versa.

reaction.name: Fractured Reality
entries: {@actTrigger} A creature misses the eldritch crawler with an attack. {@actResponse} The eldritch crawler teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 30 feet, briefly leaving behind a fractured image of itself being hit by the attack.

name: Lurker on the Threshold
languages: telepathy 120 ft. understands all languages but can't speak

trait.name: Fully Contaminated
entries: The lurker is immune to {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} and has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against contaminated spells. The lurker may cast contaminated spells even though it does not gain {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} levels.

trait.name: Delerium Healing
entries: As an action, the lurker can touch a delerium shard to regain 10 ({@dice 3d6}) {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. Once the lurker has used a delerium shard in this way, the shard can't be used in this manner again for 24 hours.

trait.name: Alien Intellect
entries: The lurker is immune to any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, as well as any divination spell that it refuses. Wisdom ({@skill Insight|XPHB}) checks made to ascertain the lurker's intentions or sincerity have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}.

trait.name: Eldritch Blood
entries: A creature that deals Piercing or Slashing damage to the lurker while within 5 feet of it takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) Necrotic damage.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The lurker has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The lurker makes three Tendril attacks. It can replace each Tendril attack with a use of Cosmic Rays.

action.name: Tendril
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 8}, reach 30 ft. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) Bludgeoning damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) Necrotic damage, and if the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 16}). While {@condition Grappled|XPHB}, the target has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition. The lurker has ten tendrils, each of which can grapple one creature.

action.name: Cosmic Rays
entries: The lurker randomly shoots one of the following magical rays at a target it can see within 120 feet (roll {@dice 1d4}; reroll if the lurker has already used that ray this turn):

items.name: Disintegrating Ray
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 16}. {@actSaveFail} 27 ({@damage 6d8}) Force damage. If this damage reduces the target to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, it disintegrates into dust.

items.name: Memory Lapse Ray
entries: {@actSave int} {@dc 16}. {@actSaveFail} The target's memories become distant for 1 minute. While its memories are distant, the target can't take the {@action Magic|XPHB} action, use class features, or understand language, and has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on ability checks. At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the save, ending the effect on itself on a success.

items.name: Contaminating Ray
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 16}. {@actSaveFail} 16 ({@damage 3d10}) Necrotic damage, and the target gains one {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} level. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

items.name: Existential Dread Ray
entries: On the target's next turn, each time it takes an action other than the Dodge action, moves more than 5 feet, or takes a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, it takes 14 ({@damage 4d6}) Psychic damage.

name: Liminal Herald
languages: telepathy 120 ft. understands all languages but can't speak

trait.name: Fully Contaminated
entries: The liminal herald is immune to {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} and has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against contaminated spells. The liminal herald may cast contaminated spells even though it does not gain {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} levels.

trait.name: Delerium Healing
entries: As an action, the liminal herald can touch a delerium shard to regain 10 ({@dice 3d6}) {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. Once the liminal herald has used a delerium shard in this way, the shard can't be used in this manner again for 24 hours.

trait.name: Alien Intellect
entries: The liminal herald is immune to any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, as well as any divination spell that it refuses. Wisdom ({@skill Insight|XPHB}) checks made to ascertain the liminal herald's intentions or sincerity have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The liminal herald makes two Eldritch Beam or contaminated touch attacks. It can also use Mind Scramble or Warp Call.

action.name: Contaminated Touch
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 13}, one target within 5 ft. {@actSaveFail} 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Necrotic damage and the target gains one {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} level. {@actSaveSuccess} half damage only.

action.name: Eldritch Beam
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 5}, range 120 ft. {@h}12 ({@damage 3d6 + 2}) Force damage.

action.name: Mind Scramble {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave int} {@dc 13}, each creature in a 30-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone} (creatures maintaining {@status Concentration|XPHB} have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}). {@actSaveFail} 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Psychic damage, or 28 ({@damage 8d6}) Psychic damage if the target is maintaining {@status Concentration|XPHB}.

action.name: Warp Call
entries: {@actSave cha} {@dc 13}, one creature the liminal herald can see within 90 feet. {@actSaveFail} 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Psychic damage, and the target is teleported into an unoccupied space the liminal herald can see within 60 feet. The chosen space must be on a surface or in a liquid that can support the target without the target having to squeeze.

bonus.name: Dimension Hop
entries: The liminal herald teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 30 feet.

reaction.name: Reflect Pain
entries: {@actTrigger} The liminal herald takes damage from an attack or spell that only targets it. {@actResponse} The attacker or spellcaster takes Psychic damage equal to the damage dealt by the triggering attack or spell.

name: Interloper
languages: telepathy 90 ft. (conveys simple emotions) understands all languages but can't speak

trait.name: Fully Contaminated
entries: The interloper is immune to {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} and has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against contaminated spells. The interloper may cast contaminated spells even though it does not gain {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} levels.

trait.name: Delerium Healing
entries: As an action, the interloper can touch a delerium shard to regain 10 ({@dice 3d6}) {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. Once the interloper has used a delerium shard in this way, the shard can't be used in this manner again for 24 hours.

trait.name: Alien Intellect

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The interloper makes one Spindly Claw attack and one Suckered Bite attack. If the interloper has used Siphon Spell since the end of its last turn, it can instead make three Spindly Claw or Suckered Bite attacks.

action.name: Spindly Claw
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 11}, one creature within 5 ft. {@actSaveFail} 14 ({@damage 4d6}) Necrotic damage and the target gains one {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} level. Succes: half damage only.

action.name: Suckered Bite
entries: {@actSave cha} {@dc 15}, one creature within 5ft. {@actSaveFail} 14 ({@damage 4d6}) Psychic damage and the target has the {@condition Bewildered|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition (save ends) and the interloper regains 10 ({@dice 3d6}) {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. {@actSaveSuccess} half damage only.

action.name: Delerium Healing
entries: The interloper touches a delerium shard and regains 10 ({@dice 3d6}) {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. Once the interloper has used a delerium shard in this way, that shard can't be used in this manner again for 24 hours.

bonus.name: Teleport
entries: The interloper teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 30 feet.

reaction.name: Siphon Spell
entries: {@actTrigger} A spell is cast by a creature within 60 feet of the interloper. Response - Intelligence Saving throw: {@dc 14}, that creature. {@actSaveFail} 11 ({@damage 2d10}) Psychic damage and the spell fails, but no resources are expended by the spell's casting.

entries: The lepidoptera is immune to {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} and has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against contaminated spells. trait.name: Delerium Healing
entries: As an action, the lepidoptera can touch a delerium shard to regain 10 ({@dice 3d6}) {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. Once the lepidoptera has used a delerium shard in this way, the shard can't be used in this manner again for 24 hours.

trait.name: Alien Intellect
entries: The lepidoptera is immune to any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, as well as any divination spell that it refuses. Wisdom ({@skill Insight|XPHB}) checks made to ascertain the lepidoptera's intentions or sincerity have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}.

trait.name: Energy Form
entries: The lepidoptera can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so, and it can enter a creature's space and stop there. The first time it enters a creature's space on a turn, that creature is moved 20 feet in a random direction.

trait.name: Incomprehensible Vision
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of the lepidoptera and can see it is subjected to the following effect. {@actSave wis} {@dc 13}. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Staggered|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition until the start of its next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} The target is transported to the Border Ethereal. If the target is already on the Border Ethereal, they are transported to the Material Plane instead.

Unless {@status surprised|XPHB}, a creature can avert their eyes to avoid the saving throw at the start of their turn. If the creature does so, it can't see the lepidoptera until the start of its next turn. If the creature looks at the lepidoptera in the meantime, that creature must immediately make the saving throw.

trait.name: Multidimensional Presence
entries: If the lepidoptera is reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} but hasn't taken damage from a source on both the Material Plane and the Border Ethereal in the last round, it drops to 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} instead.

trait.name: Phototaxis
entries: If a source of {@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB} is within 100 feet of the lepidoptera, it attempts to move closer to the light on its turn.

trait.name: Unraveling Reality
entries: {@actSave cha} {@dc 13}, each creature in a 60-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the lepidoptera when it dies. {@actSaveSuccess} The target is transported from the Material Plane to the Border Ethereal, or vice versa.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The lepidoptera makes two Fractal Wing attacks.

action.name: Fractal Wing
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 11}, reach 10 ft. {@h}35 ({@damage 5d10 + 7}) Force damage.

action.name: Tessellation {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 17}, each creature in a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the lepidoptera that doesn't have {@variantrule Cover|XPHB|Total Cover}. {@actSaveFail} 44 ({@damage 8d10}) Force damage, and the target begins its next turn by moving up to its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} in a random direction.

If the target has the {@condition Staggered|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition, it instead takes no damage, that condition ends, and the target has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition (save ends). While {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB}, the target mutters rhymes in a singsong voice and dances to an unheard rhythm, moving up to its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} in a random direction at the start of each of its turns.

reaction.name: Criss Cross
entries: {@actTrigger} A creature within 60 feet of the lepidoptera touches it or hits it with an attack. {@actResponse d}{@actSave cha} {@dc 17}, the attacker. {@actSaveFail} The attack deals no damage and the attacker is transported from the Material Plane to the Border Ethereal, or vice versa.
