trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The entropic watcher has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Withering Gaze
entries: The entropic watcher's eye creates a 150-foot long, 10-foot wide {@variantrule Line [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Line} of withering magic. At the start of each of its turns, the entropic watcher decides which way the line faces and whether the line is active. Creatures in the {@variantrule Line [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Line} have {@variantrule Vulnerability|XPHB} to Necrotic damage and can't regain {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}.

action.name: The entropic watcher always takes its turn on Initiative count 20
entries: On its turn, the entropic watcher can use its movement and interaction as normal. However, it does not take an action or {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on its turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, the entropic watcher takes one of the following {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim|Epic Actions} at the end of each player character's turn:

items.name: Tendrils
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 10}, reach 40 ft. {@h}17 ({@damage 3d8 + 4}) Bludgeoning damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) Necrotic damage, and if the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 18}). While {@condition Grappled|XPHB}, the target has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition. The entropic watcher has ten tendrils, each of which can grapple one creature.

items.name: Insanity Beam (1/Round)
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 10}, range 60 ft. {@h}22 ({@damage 4d10}) Necrotic damage, and the beam leaps to another target. The entropic watcher makes another Insanity Beam attack against a new target within 30 feet of the first. A creature can be targeted by only one Insanity Beam per turn. For each additional creature the beam hits, its damage increases by 5 ({@dice 1d10}).

action.name: Dimensional Glide
entries: The entropic watcher moves up to its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} without provoking {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB} action.

action.name: Shadow Crash {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 18}, each creature in a 30-foot radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on a point the entropic watcher can see within 150 feet. {@actSaveFail} 36 ({@damage 8d8}) Necrotic damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage. {@actSaveSuccessOrFail} The {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere}'s area is filled with magical {@variantrule Darkness|XPHB} for 1 minute or until the entropic watcher uses Shadow Crash again. A creature that ends its turn in the area takes 36 ({@damage 8d8}) Necrotic damage.

action.name: Contaminated Grasp
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 18}, one creature {@condition Grappled|XPHB} by the entropic watcher. {@actSaveFail} 16 ({@damage 3d10}) Necrotic damage, and the target gains one {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} level. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

action.name: Force Barrier
entries: The entropic watcher creates a shimmering octarine 10-foot-by-10-foot wall of force centered on a point within 150 feet. The wall lasts for 1 minute or until the entropic watcher has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition or dies. The wall appears in any orientation it chooses, and can be free floating or resting on a solid surface. If the wall cuts through a creature's space when it appears, the creature is pushed to one side of the wall (the entropic watcher's choice).

Nothing can physically pass through the wall. It is immune to all damage and can't be dispelled by {@spell Dispel Magic|XPHB}. A {@spell Disintegrate|XPHB} spell destroys the wall instantly, however. The wall also extends into the Ethereal Plane, blocking ethereal travel through the wall.

action.name: Epic Resistance
entries: The entropic watcher chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting them and rolls {@dice 1d20}. On an 11+, the effect ends on it. The entropic watcher can use this action even if it would otherwise be unable to take actions, its actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters its game statistics.

reaction.name: Fey Escape
entries: {@actTrigger} The host takes damage. {@actResponse} The host has the {@condition Invisible|XPHB} condition and teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 60 feet. The host remains {@condition Invisible|XPHB} until the start of its next turn or until it makes an attack roll, deals damage, or casts a spell.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The host casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 17}, +9 to spell attacks):

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The host makes two Fiery Claws attacks and uses Hellfire Chain, if available.

action.name: Fiery Claws
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 9}, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. {@h}19 ({@damage 4d6 + 5}) Fire damage, and the target has the {@condition Burning|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition ({@dice 4d6} Fire).

action.name: Hellfire Chain {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave str} {@dc 17}, one creature the host can see within 30 feet. {@actSaveFail} 18 ({@damage 4d8}) Fire damage, and the target has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition. While {@condition Restrained|XPHB}, the target takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Fire damage at the start of each of its turns. At the end of each of its turns, the target makes a {@dc 17} Strength check, ending the effect on itself on a success.

bonus.name: Fiendish Agility
entries: The host takes the {@action Dash|XPHB} or {@action Disengage|XPHB} action.

reaction.name: Hellish Rebuke
entries: The host casts {@spell Hellish Rebuke|XPHB} ({@dc 17}, level 4 version) in response to that spell's trigger, using the spellcasting ability in Spellcasting.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The skinwing has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the skinwing's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition.

trait.name: Disturbing Bleating
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of the skinwing is subjected to the following effect. {@actSave wis} {@dc 14}. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Staggered|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition until the start of its next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} The target is immune to the Disturbing Bleating of all skinwings for 24 hours.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The skinwing makes one Bite attack and one Talons attack.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d8 + 3}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Talons
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) Slashing damage.

name: Ripper
languages: understands the languages it knew in life but can't speak

trait.name: Dismemberment
entries: Creatures killed by attacks made by the ripper can't be restored to life except by a {@spell Resurrection|XPHB} spell or similar magic.

trait.name: Feed on Fear
entries: {@condition Frightened|XPHB} creatures have the {@condition Helpless|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} and {@condition Defenseless|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} conditions against attacks made by the ripper.

trait.name: Insensitive to Pain
entries: Critical Hits against the ripper become normal hits.

action.name: Whirling Bonesaw
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 11}, reach 10 ft. {@h}20 ({@damage 4d6 + 6}) Slashing damage, and the ripper can immediately make another Whirling Bonesaw attack against the same target. This attack ignores {@spell Resistance|XPHB} and {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to Slashing damage.

action.name: Gory Display {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 15}, each creature that can see the ripper. {@actSaveFail} 14 ({@damage 4d6}) Psychic damage, and the target has the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition (save ends). While {@condition Frightened|XPHB}, the target's {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} becomes 0 and can't increase.

reaction.name: Unstoppable Lurch
entries: {@actTrigger} A creature deals damage to the ripper. {@actResponse} The ripper moves up to half its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} toward that creature without provoking {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB} action. If the ripper ends this movement within reach of the creature, it gains {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on its next attack roll against the creature.

hp.special: 42 (4d10 + 20) plus 42 (4d10 + 20) per player character

trait.name: Writhing Aura
entries: The ground within 30 feet of the ravenous flora is filled with plant roots and becomes {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB}. A creature that starts its turn in the aura takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Poison damage.

trait.name: Poison Ivy
entries: If the ravenous flora would take Poison damage, it instead takes no damage and regains {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to the Poison damage it would have received.

action.name: The ravenous flora always takes its turn on Initiative count 20
entries: On its turn, the ravenous flora can use its movement and interaction as normal. However, it does not take an action or {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on its turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, the ravenous flora takes one of the following {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim|Epic Actions} at the end of each player character's turn:

items.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, reach 10 ft. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d10 + 4}) Piercing damage, and the target has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 15}). Until this grapple ends, the target has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition and the ravenous flora can't Bite another target.

items.name: Spit Acid
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 7}, range 150/600 ft. {@h}14 ({@damage 3d6 + 4}) Acid damage, and the target has the {@condition Burning|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition ({@dice 2d4} Acid). While {@condition Burning|MonstersOfDrakkenheim}, the target has the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} condition.

items.name: Swallow
entries: The ravenous flora makes one Bite attack against a Medium or smaller target it has {@condition Grappled|XPHB}. If the attack hits, the target is swallowed and the grapple ends. The swallowed target has the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} and {@condition Restrained|XPHB} conditions, has {@variantrule Cover|XPHB|Total Cover} from attacks and effects outside the flora, and takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Acid damage at the start of each of its turns. The flora can have up to four targets swallowed at a time.

If the flora takes 15 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, it must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which land with the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition in unoccupied spaces within 10 feet of it. If the flora dies, a swallowed creature no longer has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition and can escape from the corpse using 5 feet of movement, exiting with the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Hypnotic Pollen (1/Round)
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 16}, each creature in a 60-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the ravenous flora. {@actSaveFail} 9 ({@damage 2d8}) Psychic damage, and the target has the {@condition Weakened|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition (save ends). While {@condition Weakened|MonstersOfDrakkenheim}, the target must spend all of its movement on each of its turns to move directly toward the ravenous flora. During this movement, the target ignores {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB} caused by the flora's Writhing Aura.

action.name: Epic Resistance
entries: The ravenous flora chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting them and rolls {@dice 1d20}. On an 11+, the effect ends on it. The ravenous flora can use this action even if it would otherwise be unable to take actions, its actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters its game statistics.

name: Reautomata Wrecker
languages: understands the languages it knew in life but can't speak

trait.name: Siege Monster
entries: The reautomata deals double damage to objects and structures.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The reautomata makes one Drill attack and one Wrecking Ball attack.

action.name: Drill
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 12}, reach 5 ft. {@h}21 ({@damage 4d6 + 7}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Wrecking Ball
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 12}, reach 20 ft. {@h}21 ({@damage 4d6 + 7}) Bludgeoning damage. {@actSave str} {@dc 20}. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Dazed|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition (save ends) and the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Destructive Rampage {@recharge}
entries: The reautomata moves up to its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} in a straight line, moving through the space of any Medium or smaller creature on its path. The first time its enters each creature's space during this move, it can make a Drill or Wrecking Ball attack against that creature.

bonus.name: Overdrive Engine (1/Day; {@status Bloodied|XPHB} Only)
entries: The reautomata's Destructive Rampage recharges, and it gains {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to all damage and conditions until the end of its next turn. For the duration, the reautomata automatically succeeds on all saving throws and Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution-based ability checks and has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on attack rolls. It can't be forced to move or affected by spells of level 8 or lower unless it chooses to be. Features and effects that ignore {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB|Resistances} and {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB|Immunities}, such as a Vorpal Weapon, don't function against the reautomata unless those effects are caused by a level 9 spell or an artifact.

At the end of its next turn, the reautomata dies and explodes. {@actSave dex} {@dc 20}, each creature in a 20-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the reautomata when it dies. {@actSaveFail} 20 ({@damage 8d4}) Acid damage plus 36 ({@damage 8d8}) Necrotic damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

name: Scrap Reautomata
languages: understands the languages it knew in life but can't speak

trait.name: Combustion
entries: While the reautomata has the {@condition Burning|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition, its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} becomes 50 feet and its melee weapon attacks deal an extra 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Fire damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The reautomata makes two attacks.

action.name: Rusty Weapon
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) Slashing damage.

bonus.name: Ignition (Recharges after a Short Rest)
entries: The reautomata has the {@condition Burning|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition ({@dice 2d6} Fire).

name: Reautomata
languages: understands the languages it knew in life but can't speak

trait.name: Relentless Endurance
entries: If damage reduces the reautomata to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, it must make a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 5 plus the damage taken, unless the damage is from a {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB}. On a success, the reautomata drops to 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} instead.

trait.name: Standing Leap
entries: The reautomata's {@variantrule Long Jump|XPHB} is up to 50 feet and its {@variantrule High Jump|XPHB} is up to 30 feet, with or without a running start.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The reautomata makes two Arm Blade attacks and one Entrapping Rend attack.

action.name: Arm Blade
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 9}, reach 5 ft. {@h}15 ({@damage 3d6 + 5}) Slashing damage, and if the target is Large or smaller, it is pushed up to 5 feet away from the reautomata and has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Entrapping Rend
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 9}, reach 5 ft., one {@condition Prone|XPHB} target. {@h}15 ({@damage 3d6 + 5}) Piercing damage, and if the target is Large or smaller, it has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 17}). While {@condition Grappled|XPHB}, the target has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition and the reautomata can't make Entrapping Rend attacks against another target.

bonus.name: Aggressive
entries: The reautomata moves up to its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} toward a {@variantrule Hostile [Attitude]|XPHB|Hostile} creature it can see. This movement doesn't provoke {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB} action.

trait.name: Plague Symptoms
entries: The plague carrier is host to a disease created by a pathogenist, chosen from the options below. A creature infected by this disease is subjected to the chosen effect at the start of each of its turns. {@actSave con} {@dc 13}. {@actSaveFail} 18 ({@damage 4d8}) Necrotic damage, and the target suffers the disease's effect. Third Success: The disease ends.

trait.name: Coughing Fits
entries: The target is unable to speak until the start of its next turn.

trait.name: Fatigue
entries: The target's {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is reduced by 5 feet until the start of its next turn.

trait.name: Shivers
entries: The target shakes uncontrollably. Each time it fails its saving throw, it drops whatever it is holding.

action.name: Festering Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 2}, reach 5 ft. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d8}) Piercing damage. {@actSave con} {@dc 13}. {@actSaveFail} The target is infected with the plague carrier's Plague Symptoms.

action.name: Bile Spreader
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 13}, each creature in a 15-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}. {@actSaveFail} 9 ({@damage 2d8}) Necrotic damage, and the target is infected with the plague carrier's Plague Symptoms. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

trait.name: Hazardous Fumes
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of the ooze has the {@condition Burning|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition ({@dice 4d4} Acid). While {@condition Burning|MonstersOfDrakkenheim}, the creature also has the {@condition Slowed|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition. While the creature remains within 10 feet of the ooze, the {@condition Burning|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition cannot be removed in any way.

trait.name: Liquid Form
entries: The ooze can squeeze through a space as narrow as 1 inch, and can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. The first time it enters a creature's space on a turn, that creature takes 10 ({@damage 4d4}) Acid damage. The ooze has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on ability checks it makes to initiate or escape a grapple.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The ooze can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ooze makes two Pseudopod attacks.

action.name: Pseudopod
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 10 ft. {@h}10 ({@damage 4d4}) Acid damage.

trait.name: Aquatic Camouflage
entries: The leech has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth|XPHB}) checks made to hide in aquatic terrain.

trait.name: Spell Glands
entries: The leech has a spell gland, which can store up to ten levels of spells. When encountered, roll {@dice 1d10} to determine how many spell levels it has stored.

action.name: Attach
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 3}, reach 0 ft. {@h}The leech attaches to the target. While attached, the leech doesn't attack, and moves with the target, using none of the leech's movement. The leech can detach itself using 5 feet of movement, and detaches immediately if its blood bags are filled or if the target dies.

A creature within 5 feet can take an action to detach the leech with a successful {@dc 13} Wisdom ({@skill Medicine|XPHB}) check. {@actSaveFail} The leech is still detached, but the target has the {@condition Bleeding|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition ({@dice 2d4}). Failure by 5 or More: The leech isn't detached and the target takes 8 ({@damage 2d4 + 3}) Piercing damage.

bonus.name: Spell Drain
entries: The leech can use this {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} only when it is attached to a creature. The attached creature is subjected to the following effect. {@actSave int} {@dc 13}. {@actSaveFail} 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Psychic damage, and the target has the {@condition Bewildered|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition until the start of the leech's next turn. If the target has spell slots, the leech drains one randomly determined spell slot which can be no higher than level 3. It then fills its spell glands with the same number of spell levels.

bonus.name: Arcane Transfusion
entries: The leech can use this {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} only when it is attached to a creature and has at least one level worth of spells in its Spell Glands. The leech empties any number of spell levels from its Spell Glands, and the creature it is attached to regains an equal number of spell levels worth of spell slots.

trait.name: Aquatic Camouflage
entries: The leech has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth|XPHB}) checks made to hide in aquatic terrain.

trait.name: Memory Bank
entries: The leech has three memory banks in its body. When encountered, roll {@dice 1d3} to determine how many memory banks are filled with grey matter. The rest are empty.

action.name: Attach
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 3}, reach 0 ft. {@h}The leech attaches to the target. While attached, the leech doesn't attack, and moves with the target, using none of the leech's movement. The leech can detach itself using 5 feet of movement, and detaches immediately if its blood bags are filled or if the target dies.

A creature within 5 feet can take an action to detach the leech with a successful {@dc 13} Wisdom ({@skill Medicine|XPHB}) check. {@actSaveFail} The leech is still detached, but the target has the {@condition Bleeding|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition ({@dice 2d4}). Failure by 5 or More: The leech isn't detached and the target takes 8 ({@damage 2d4 + 3}) Piercing damage.

bonus.name: Brain Drain
entries: The leech can use this {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} only when it is attached to a creature. That creature is subjected to the following effect. {@actSave int} {@dc 11}. {@actSaveFail} The target's Intelligence score is reduced by {@dice 1d4}, and one of the leech's memory banks is filled. If this effect reduces the target's Intelligence score to 0, it has the {@condition Unconscious|XPHB} condition until it regains at least 1 point of Intelligence. Otherwise, the reduction lasts until the creature finishes a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

bonus.name: Thought Transfusion
entries: The leech can use this {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} only when it is attached to a creature and has at least one filled memory bank. The attached creature gains {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Intelligence-based {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB|D20 Tests} for 1 minute, and the leech empties one of its filled memory banks.

trait.name: Aquatic Camouflage
entries: The leech has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth|XPHB}) checks made to hide in aquatic terrain.

trait.name: Blood Bags
entries: The leech has three blood bags in its body. When encountered, roll {@dice 1d3} to determine how many blood bags are filled with blood. The rest are empty.

action.name: Attach
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 3}, reach 0 ft. {@h}The leech attaches to the target. While attached, the leech doesn't attack, and moves with the target, using none of the leech's movement. The leech can detach itself using 5 feet of movement, and detaches immediately if its blood bags are filled or if the target dies.

A creature within 5 feet can take an action to detach the leech with a successful {@dc 13} Wisdom ({@skill Medicine|XPHB}) check. {@actSaveFail} The leech is still detached, but the target has the {@condition Bleeding|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition ({@dice 2d4}). Failure by 5 or More: The leech isn't detached and the target takes 8 ({@damage 2d4 + 3}) Piercing damage.

bonus.name: Blood Drain
entries: The leech can use this {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} only when it is attached to a creature. The attached creature loses 10 ({@dice 3d6}) {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} due to blood loss, and the blood leech fills one of its empty blood bags with some of the target's blood.

bonus.name: Blood Transfusion
entries: The leech can use this {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} only when it is attached to a creature and has at least one filled blood bag. The attached creature regains 10 {@dice 3d6} {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, and the leech empties one of its filled blood bags.

name: Kingkiller Hydra

hp.special: 92 (8d12 + 40) plus 92 (8d12 + 40) per player character

languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

trait.name: Corrosive Aura
entries: The area within 30 feet of the hydra is filled with corrosive fumes and is {@variantrule Lightly Obscured|XPHB}. A creature that starts its turn in the fumes takes 20 ({@damage 8d4}) Acid damage.

trait.name: Head Count
entries: The hydra can't make more Bite or Spit Acid attacks each round than it has heads, and each head can only be used to make one Bite or Spit Acid attack each round.

trait.name: Multiple Heads
entries: The hydra has five heads. Whenever the hydra takes 25 damage or more in a single turn, one of its heads dies. The hydra dies if all of its heads are dead.

trait.name: Reactive Heads
entries: For each head the hydra has beyond one, it gets an extra {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} that can be used only for {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB} action.

trait.name: Special Immunities
entries: The hydra is immune to the {@condition Burning|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} (Acid only) condition.

trait.name: Wakeful
entries: While the hydra sleeps, at least one of its heads is awake.

action.name: The hydra always takes its turn on Initiative count 20
entries: On its turn, the hydra can use its movement and interaction as normal. However, it does not take an action or {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on its turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, the hydra takes one of the following {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim|Epic Actions} at the end of each player character's turn:

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 14}, reach 20 ft. {@h}26 ({@damage 4d8 + 8}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Spit Acid
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 14}, range 150/600 ft. {@h}20 ({@damage 8d4}) Acid damage, and the target has the {@condition Burning|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition ({@dice 8d4} Acid). While {@condition Burning|MonstersOfDrakkenheim}, the target has the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Grow Heads
entries: The hydra can only perform this {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} if one or more of its heads died this round, unless the head was killed by Fire damage. The hydra grows two heads, and regains 20 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}.

action.name: Hydra Fury (1/Round)
entries: The hydra makes one Bite attack or one Spit Acid attack for each head that hasn't yet made an attack this round.

action.name: Trample (1/Round)
entries: The hydra moves up to its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} without provoking {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB} action. During this movement, it can move through the spaces of Huge or smaller creatures. Each creature the hydra moves over is subjected to the following effect. {@actSave dex} {@dc 22}. {@actSaveFail} 35 ({@damage 10d6}) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Tail (1/Round)
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 14}, reach 15 ft. {@h}34 ({@damage 4d12 + 8}) Bludgeoning damage, and the target is pushed up to 20 feet away from the hydra.

action.name: Epic Resistance
entries: The hydra chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting them and rolls {@dice 1d20}. On an 11+, the effect ends on it. The hydra can use this action even if it would otherwise be unable to take actions, its actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters its game statistics.

trait.name: Normal Semblance
entries: The harvester has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Charisma ({@skill Deception|XPHB}) and Dexterity ({@skill Stealth|XPHB}) checks to pass itself off as an ordinary Small Humanoid such as a Human urchin or a Halfling.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The harvester makes two Surgical Claw attacks.

action.name: Surgical Claw
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) Slashing damage, and the target has the {@condition Bleeding|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition ({@dice 2d4}).

action.name: Syringe (1/Day)
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) Piercing damage. {@actSave con} {@dc 11}. {@actSaveFail} 28 ({@damage 8d6}) Poison damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage. {@actSaveSuccessOrFail} If this Poison damage reduces the target to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, it is stabilized but has the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition for 1 hour, even if it regains {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. While {@condition Poisoned|XPHB}, the target has the {@condition Paralyzed|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Latch {@recharge 5}
entries: The harvester moves up to its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}. If it ends this movement within 5 feet of a Medium or larger creature, it can make one Surgical Claw attack against that creature. {@h}The harvester attaches to the target. While attached, the harvester has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on attack rolls against the target. The attached harvester moves with the target, using none of the harvester's movement. The harvester can detach itself by using 5 feet of movement on its turn. A creature within 5 feet, including the target, can take an action to detach the harvester with a successful {@dc 13} Strength ({@skill Athletics|XPHB}) check.

bonus.name: Cunning Action
entries: The harvester takes the {@action Dash|XPHB}, {@action Disengage|XPHB}, or {@action Hide|XPHB} action.

name: Injector
languages: understands the languages it knew in life but can't speak

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The injector makes four Syringe attacks. It can replace any number of attacks with uses of Booster Dose instead.

action.name: Syringe
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 10}, reach 5 ft. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d4 + 6}) Piercing damage, and the target is subjected to one of the following effects (roll {@dice 1d4}; reroll if the injector has already used that effect during this turn):

items.name: Lethal Injection
entries: The target takes 21 ({@damage 6d6}) Poison damage.

items.name: Numbing Solution
entries: The target takes 9 ({@damage 2d8}) Cold damage and is subjected to the following effect: {@actSave con} {@dc 16}. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Frozen|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition ({@dc 16}).

items.name: Mind Dampener
entries: The target takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Psychic damage and is subjected to the following effect: {@actSave int} {@dc 16}. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Bewildered|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition (save ends).

items.name: Induced Necrosis
entries: The target takes 9 ({@damage 2d8}) Necrotic damage and is subjected to the following effect: {@actSave str} {@dc 16}. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Weakened|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition (save ends).

action.name: Booster Dose
entries: The injector administers a tincture to a {@variantrule Friendly [Attitude]|XPHB|Friendly} creature it can see within 5 feet that isn't a Construct, choosing from the effects below. Once a creature benefits from a tincture, it can't gain that benefit again until it finishes a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

action.name: Adrenaline Rush
entries: The target can use its {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to move up to its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} without provoking {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB} action or make one weapon attack with {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB}.

action.name: Inoculation
entries: The injector chooses Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Necrotic, or Poison damage. The target gains {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to the chosen damage type for 1 minute.

action.name: Restorative Fluid
entries: The target regains 35 {@dice 10d6} {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. If the target is already at its {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} Maximum, it gains these as {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} instead.

action.name: Focus
entries: The target has the {@condition Valor|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition {@dice 1d4} for 1 minute.

reaction.name: Unstable Tank
entries: {@actTrigger} The injector would take damage. {@actResponse} The injector reduces that damage to 0, and one of its tanks violently explodes. The injector chooses one of the effects of its Syringe or Booster Dose. Each creature within 20 feet of it is affected as if the Injector hit it with its Syringe or used Booster Dose on it. The injector can't use that effect until it finishes a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The psyche can move through other creatures and objects as if they were {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB}. It takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The psyche makes two Electroshock attacks. It can also use Hypnotize, if available.

action.name: Electroshock
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 8}, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft. {@h}35 ({@damage 10d6}) Lightning damage. {@actSave con} {@dc 16}. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Dazed|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition until the end of the psyche's next turn.

action.name: Hypnotize {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 16}, each creature of the psyche's choice in a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the psyche. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition (save ends). While {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB}, the target has the {@condition Immobilized|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition.

action.name: Mental Possession
entries: {@actSave int} {@dc 16}, one creature the psyche can see within 5 feet. {@actSaveSuccess} The target is immune to this psyche's Mental {@variantrule Possession|XPHB} for 24 hours. {@actSaveFail} The target is possessed by the psyche; the psyche disappears, and the target has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition and loses control of its body. The psyche now controls the body, but the target retains awareness. The psyche can't be targeted by any attack, spell, or other effect, except ones that specifically target Undead. The psyche's game statistics are the same, except it uses the possessed target's {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}, as well as the target's Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution modifiers.

The possession lasts until the body drops to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} or the psyche leaves as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}. Whenever the target takes damage, it repeats the save, ending the possession on a success. When the possession ends, the psyche appears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the target, and the target is immune to this psyche's Mental {@variantrule Possession|XPHB} for 24 hours.

bonus.name: Teleport
entries: The psyche teleports to an unoccupied space within 60 feet.

trait.name: Amorphous Form
entries: The chemystral can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing.

trait.name: Cold Vulnerability
entries: If the chemystral takes Cold damage, it becomes {@condition Frozen|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} ({@dc 15}). While it has the {@condition Frozen|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition, it loses its {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB|Immunities} to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage and its {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Force damage, and it gains {@variantrule Vulnerability|XPHB} to Thunder damage. In addition to the normal means, the {@condition Frozen|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition ends if the chemystral takes 20 points of Force, Piercing, Thunder, or Slashing damage.

trait.name: Elemental Reaction
entries: If the Chemystral takes Acid, Fire, Lightning, Poison, or Necrotic damage, it takes on elemental properties which change the damage type of its Chemical Spray and Engulf actions to match that damage type. In addition, it causes an additional effect when it hits with its Chemical Spray attack:

trait.name: Acid
entries: On a hit, the target has the {@condition Burning|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition ({@dice 4d6} Acid).

trait.name: Fire
entries: On a hit, the target has the {@condition Burning|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition ({@dice 4d6} Fire).

trait.name: Lightning
entries: On a hit, the target has the {@condition Shocked|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Poison
entries: On a hit, the target has the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Necrotic
entries: On a hit, the chemystral regains {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to the Necrotic damage dealt.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The chemystral regains 25 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} at the start of its turn. If the chemystral takes Cold or Thunder damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of its next turn. The chemystral dies only if it starts its turn with 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} and doesn't regenerate.

trait.name: Sonic Neutralization
entries: When the chemystral takes Thunder damage, it loses any active benefit from its Elemental {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} trait.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The chemystral makes two Chemical Spray attacks and uses Engulf.

action.name: Chemical Spray
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 9}, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft. {@h}35 ({@damage 10d6}) Acid damage.

action.name: Engulf
entries: The chemystral moves up to its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}. While doing so, it can enter Large or smaller creatures' spaces. Whenever the chemystral enters a creature's space, the creature is subjected to the following effect. {@actSave dex} {@dc 17}. {@actSaveSuccess} The creature can choose to be pushed 5 feet back or to the side of the chemystral. A creature that chooses not to be pushed suffers the consequences of a failed saving throw.

{@actSaveFail} The chemystral enters the creature's space, and the creature takes 35 ({@damage 10d6}) Acid damage and is engulfed. The engulfed creature can't breathe, has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition, and takes 35 ({@damage 10d6}) Acid damage at the start of each of the chemystral's turns. The engulfed creature has {@variantrule Cover|XPHB|Total Cover} from effects outside the chemystral. When the chemystral moves, the engulfed creature moves with it.

The chemystral can hold only one Large creature or up to four Medium or smaller creatures inside it at a time. An engulfed creature can take an action to escape with a successful {@dc 17} Strength check, entering a space of its choice within 5 feet of the ooze.

name: Cerebrograft
languages: telepathy 30 ft. The languages of its creator

trait.name: Dual Minds
entries: The cerebrograft has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws to avoid or end the {@condition Blinded|XPHB}, {@condition Charmed|XPHB}, {@condition Deafened|XPHB}, {@condition Frightened|XPHB}, {@condition Stunned|XPHB}, and {@condition Unconscious|XPHB} conditions.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The cerebrograft makes two Slam attacks and uses Telekinetic Grip.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 9}, reach 5 ft. {@h}23 ({@damage 4d8 + 5}) Bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Telekinetic Grip
entries: The cerebrograft reaches out with its mind to hold one creature or object it can see within 120 feet of it in its psychic grasp. If the target is a creature, it is subjected to the following effect. {@actSave str} {@dc 16}. {@actSaveFail} The target is moved up to 30 feet in any direction and has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition until the start of the cerebrograft's next turn or until the cerebrograft has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition.

If the target is an object weighing 300 pounds or less that isn't being worn or carried, it is telekinetically moved up to 30 feet in any direction. The cerebrograft can also exert fine control on objects with its telekinesis, such as manipulating a simple tool or opening a door or a container.

action.name: Psychic Crush {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave int} {@dc 16}, each creature in a 20-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the cerebrograft. {@actSaveFail} 22 ({@damage 4d10}) Psychic damage, and the target has the {@condition Dazed|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition (save ends). Failure by 5 or More: The target instead has the {@condition Stunned|XPHB} condition (save ends). {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

name: Body Snatcher
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

trait.name: Clinging Shadows
entries: A creature in {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} or {@variantrule Darkness|XPHB} has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on ability checks to escape the body snatcher's grapple. Each time a creature attempts to escape the body snatcher's grapple while it is in {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} or {@variantrule Darkness|XPHB}, the creature takes 18 ({@damage 4d8}) Necrotic damage. If this Necrotic damage reduces the target to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, the target is stabilized but has the {@condition Paralyzed|XPHB} condition for 1 hour, even if it regains {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}.

trait.name: Sunlight Weakness
entries: The body snatcher takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Radiant damage if it ends its turn in sunlight, and has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on attack rolls and ability checks while in sunlight.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The body snatcher makes four Grabbing Hands attacks.

action.name: Grabbing Hands
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, reach 10 ft. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) Bludgeoning damage, and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 15}). Until this grapple ends, the body snatcher can't use this hand against another target. The body snatcher has four hands, each of which can grapple one target.

bonus.name: Shadow Teleport
entries: The body snatcher teleports up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space that it can see that is in {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} or {@variantrule Darkness|XPHB}. It can bring any Medium or smaller creature it is grappling, teleporting that creature to an unoccupied space it can see within 5 feet of its destination that is also in {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} or {@variantrule Darkness|XPHB}. An unwilling creature can make a {@dc 13} Charisma saving throw to resist being teleported. On a successful save, neither the creature nor the body snatcher {@spell Teleport|XPHB}.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The Apex regains 20 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} at the start of its turn. If the Apex takes Necrotic damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of its next turn. The Apex dies only if it starts its turn with 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} and doesn't regenerate.

trait.name: Standing Leap
entries: The Apex's {@variantrule Long Jump|XPHB} is up to 50 feet and its {@variantrule High Jump|XPHB} is up to 30 feet, with or without a running start.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Apex makes two Slam attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 10}, reach 10 ft. {@h}27 ({@damage 4d10 + 5}) Bludgeoning damage.

bonus.name: Lightning Bolt
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 18}, each creature in a 120-foot long, 5-foot wide {@variantrule Line [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Line}. {@actSaveFail} 22 ({@damage 4d10}) Lightning damage, and the target has the {@condition Shocked|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition until the end of its next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

bonus.name: Fire Blast
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 10}, range 120 ft. {@h}23 ({@damage 4d8 + 5}) Fire damage, and the target and each creature within 10 feet of it is subjected to the following effect. {@actSave dex} {@dc 18}. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Burning|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition ({@dice 4d8} Fire).

bonus.name: Cold Snap
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 18}, one creature the Apex can see within 120 feet. {@actSaveFail} 45 ({@damage 10d8}) Cold damage, and the target has the {@condition Frozen|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition ({@dc 18}). {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

reaction.name: Rapid Adaptation
entries: {@actTrigger} The Apex takes damage that isn't Necrotic or Psychic. {@actResponse} The Apex gains {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to that damage type until it is reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} or finishes a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the skull remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary humanoid skull.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4}, reach 5 ft. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Disparaging Remarks
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 12}, one creature the skull can see within 10 feet. {@actSaveFail} 5 ({@damage 2d4}) Psychic damage, and the target has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on the next attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn.

reaction.name: Guiding Words
entries: {@actTrigger} A creature the skull can see within 10 feet makes an ability check. {@actResponse} The target can roll {@dice 1d4} and add the result to that check.

name: Helpful Hand
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The hand can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Finger Jab
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}1 Bludgeoning damage. {@actSave con} {@dc 10}. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Latch
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}The hand attaches itself to the target. While latched, the hand cannot attack. Instead, at the start of each of the hand's turns, the latched creature takes 2 ({@damage 1d4}) Necrotic damage. A creature within 5 feet can take an action to detach the hand with a successful {@dc 13} Strength check. The hand can also detach itself at any time during its turn (no action required).

bonus.name: Helper
entries: The hand takes the Help action.

hp.special: 100 (8d10 + 56) plus 100 (8d10 + 56) per palyer character

trait.name: Fully Contaminated
entries: The Think Tank is immune to {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} and has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against contaminated spells. The Think Tank may cast contaminated spells even though it does not gain {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} levels.

trait.name: Life Support System
entries: The Think Tank is protected by three machine nodes that make up its Life Support System. The nodes are positioned in a triangle, each no further than 30 feet apart from the rest. Each node is a Large object with AC 20, 25 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} per player character, and {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to Poison and Psychic damage. The Think Tank can't move or be moved more than 60 feet away from any two of its Life Support System nodes.

trait.name: Nightmare Aura
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 120 feet of the Think Tank takes 14 ({@damage 4d6}) Psychic damage.

trait.name: Shield Generator
entries: As long as at least one machine node in the Life Support System remains, the Think Tank's {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB|Immunities} can't be ignored except by effects caused by level 9 spells or artifacts. If all nodes are destroyed, the Think Tank loses its {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB|Immunities}.

trait.name: Telepathic Eavesdropping
entries: The Think Tank can project its consciousness to see and hear any creature or location within 5 miles as if it had cast {@spell Scrying|XPHB} (no action required). It can read the thoughts of creatures in this area, communicate with them telepathically, and listen in on telepathic communications which occur between other creatures in the region. It remains aware of its own surroundings while doing so. It cannot observe the area within a Private Sanctum spell or locations and creatures protected by magic which blocks divination or scrying sensors.

action.name: The Think Tank always takes its turn on Initiative count 20
entries: On its turn, the Think Tank can use its movement and interaction as normal. However, it does not take an action or {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on its turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, the Think Tank takes one of the following {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim|Epic Actions} at the end of each player character's turn:

items.name: Contaminated Blast
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 12}, reach 10 ft., or range 120 ft. {@h}32 ({@damage 4d12 + 6}) Necrotic damage. {@actSave con} {@dc 20}. {@actSaveFail} The target gains a {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} level.

items.name: Telekinetic Grip
entries: The Think Tank reaches out with its mind to hold one creature or object it can see within 120 feet of it in its psychic grasp. If the target is a creature, it is subjected to the following effect. {@actSave str} {@dc 20}. {@actSaveFail} 28 ({@damage 8d6}) Force damage, and the target is moved up to 30 feet in any direction and has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition until it escapes or the Think Tank has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition. The Think Tank can hold up to two creatures or objects in its grip at one time. On its turn, a held creature can take an action to repeat the save, escaping the grip on a success.

If the target is an object weighing 1,000 pounds or less that isn't being worn or carried, it is telekinetically moved up to 30 feet in any direction. The Think Tank can also exert fine control on objects with its telekinesis, such as manipulating surgical tools or opening a door or a container.

items.name: Pluck the Puppet Strings
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 20}, one creature within 120 feet of the Think Tank. {@actSaveFail} 14 ({@damage 4d6}) Psychic damage, and the target must use its {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to move up to its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} directly toward a creature of the Think Tank's choice. If the target ends this movement within reach of the chosen creature, it must make a melee weapon attack against that creature with {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB}.

action.name: Mind Cage (1/Round)
entries: {@actSave int} {@dc 20}, one creature the Think Tank can see within 120 feet. {@actSaveSuccess} 33 ({@damage 6d10}) Psychic damage. {@actSaveFail} 33 ({@damage 6d10}) Psychic damage, and the target perceives itself to be trapped within a nightmare conjured forth from the depths of its own psyche until it escapes. While trapped, the target has the {@condition Immobilized|MonstersOfDrakkenheim}, {@condition Blinded|XPHB}, and {@condition Deafened|XPHB} conditions. On its turn, the target can take an action to repeat the save. Each time it does, it takes 33 ({@damage 6d10}) psychic damage. On a success, the effect ends for it.

action.name: Unbind Gravity (1/Round)
entries: The Think Tank controls gravity in a 200-foot {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cube} centered on itself until the end of the next round. Each time the Think Tank uses this {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim}, it decides which direction gravity pulls within the area. All creatures and objects that aren't somehow anchored to the ground in the area fall in the chosen direction until they reach the edge of the area. A creature can make a {@dc 20} Dexterity saving throw to grab onto a fixed object it can reach, avoiding the fall on a success.

If some solid object (such as a ceiling) is encountered in this fall, falling objects and creatures strike it just as they would during a normal downward fall. If an object or creature reaches the edge of the area without striking anything, it remains there, oscillating slightly, for the duration.

Alternatively, the Think Tank can decide to prevent gravity from acting within the area. When it does, creatures within the area without a {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB} levitate in midair, and must move by pushing or pulling against a fixed object or surface within reach (such as a wall or a ceiling), which allows them to move as if they were climbing. Unattended objects float around randomly.
If the Think Tank doesn't use this {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} during the next round, the effect ends and affected objects and creatures fall back down.

action.name: Epic Resistance
entries: The Think Tank chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting them and rolls {@dice 1d20}. On an 11+, the effect ends on it. The Think Tank can use this action even if it would otherwise be unable to take actions, its actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters its game statistics.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The Reanimator casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 17}, +9 to spell attacks):

trait.name: Special Immunities
entries: Dr. Everett Freed, Reanimator is immune to the {@condition Weakened|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Reanimator makes two Electric Jolt or Necrotic Blast attacks.

action.name: Electric Jolt
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 9}, reach 5 ft. {@h}35 ({@damage 10d6}) Lightning damage, and the target has the {@condition Shocked|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition until the end of the Reanimator's next turn.

action.name: Necrotic Blast
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 9}, reach 10 ft. or range 120 ft. {@h}36 ({@damage 8d8}) Necrotic damage, and the target has the {@condition Weakened|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition until the end of the Reanimator's next turn.

action.name: Touch of Death (1/Day)
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 9}, reach 5 ft. {@h}200 Poison damage. This damage ignores {@spell Resistance|XPHB} and {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to Poison damage and can't be reduced or prevented in any way. If the target is reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, it automatically fails death saving throws until it finishes a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. A Heal or {@spell Greater Restoration|XPHB} spell ends this effect early.

action.name: Reanimate {@recharge 5}
entries: The Reanimator targets the corpse of one of its destroyed creations it can see within 30 feet. The target returns to life with 45 ({@dice 10d8}) {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. The target has {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to all damage and {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws until the end of its next turn.

bonus.name: Creator's Command
entries: The Reanimator chooses a creature it can see that was reanimated or created by it. The target can use its {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to make an attack with {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} or move up to its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} without provoking {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB} action.

reaction.name: Bodyguard
entries: {@actTrigger} A creature the Reanimator can see targets it with an attack or spell that targets only the reanimator. {@actResponse} The Reanimator chooses one of its creations within 10 feet and switches spaces with it. The creation becomes the target instead.

trait.name: Laboratory Adaptation
entries: The pathogenist is immune to disease.

trait.name: Mutated Strains
entries: The pathogenist's attacks and effects ignore the target's {@spell Resistance|XPHB} or {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to Poison damage and {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition and disease.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The pathogenist makes two Poison Needle attacks.

action.name: Poison Needle
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 8}, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) Piercing damage plus 35 ({@damage 10d6}) Poison damage. If this damage reduces the target to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, it is stabilized and has the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition for 1 hour, even if it regains {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. While {@condition Poisoned|XPHB}, the target has the {@condition Paralyzed|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Pestilent Infection {@recharge 5}
entries: The pathogenist infects one creature it can see within 30 feet with a magical disease. At the start of each of its turns, the target is subjected to the following effect. {@actSave con} {@dc 16}. {@actSaveFail} 18 ({@damage 4d8}) Necrotic damage, and the target gaines one {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} level. Third Success: The disease ends.

action.name: Plague Wind (1/Day)
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 16}, each creature in a 60-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}. {@actSaveFail} 22 ({@damage 5d8}) Poison damage plus 23 ({@damage 5d8}) Necrotic damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage. {@actSaveSuccessOrFail} If the target has 25 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} or fewer after taking this damage, it dies and its flesh turns to ash, leaving a weathered skeleton.

bonus.name: Heightened Tolerance
entries: The pathogenist ends the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} or {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition on itself.

reaction.name: Outbreak
entries: {@actTrigger} A creature the pathogenist can see that is infected by its Pestilent Infection is reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} or dies. {@actResponse} The pathogenist spreads the disease to another creature it can see within 30 feet of the infected creature.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The mutagenist casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 15}, +7 to spell attacks):

trait.name: Noxious Blood
entries: When a creature hits the mutagenist with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it, the creature takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Poison damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The mutagenist makes two Scalpel attacks and uses Forced Mutation.

action.name: Scalpel
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, reach 5 ft. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) Slashing damage, and the target has the {@condition Bleeding|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition ({@dice 4d6}).

action.name: Forced Mutation
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 15}, one creature the mutagenist can see within 60 feet. {@actSaveFail} 18 ({@damage 4d8}) Necrotic damage, and the target gains a randomly determined mutation. The mutation lasts for 1 minute, and afterwards, any lost body parts are restored. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

action.name: Transmogrifying Elixir (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: The mutagenist injects itself with a transmogrifying elixir. The mutagenist transforms, using the Grotesque Gargantuan stat block for their altered form. The mutagenist reverts to its normal form after 1 hour or if its transmogrified form is reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}.

bonus.name: Anatomical Precision
entries: The mutagenist gains {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Scalpel attacks until the start of its next turn, as long as it has not moved this turn. The mutagenist's {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} becomes 0 until the start of its next turn.

reaction.name: Desperate Transformation
entries: {@actTrigger} The mutagenist is reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. {@actResponse} The mutagenist uses Transmogrifying Elixir, if available.

trait.name: Blessed Weapons
entries: When the Exorcist hits with any weapon, the weapon unleashes holy fire, causing the target to have the {@condition Burning|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition ({@dice 4d6} Radiant; included in the attacks below).

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The exorcist makes two attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Grasping Ghost.

action.name: Radiant Sword
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, reach 5 ft. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) Slashing damage, and the target has the {@condition Burning|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition ({@dice 4d6} Radiant).

action.name: Blessed Crossbow
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 7}, range 80/320 ft. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d10 + 4}) Piercing damage, and the target has the {@condition Burning|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition ({@dice 4d6} Radiant).

action.name: Grasping Ghost
entries: {@actSave str} {@dc 15}, one creature the exorcist can see within 60 feet. {@actSaveFail} 18 ({@damage 4d8}) Necrotic damage, and the target is moved 30 feet in a horizontal direction of the exorcist's choice. At the end of this movement, the target has the {@condition Immobilized|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition until the end of the exorcist's next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

action.name: Expel Evil (1/Day)
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 15}, each Celestial, Fey, Fiend, and Undead that can see and hear the exorcist. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} and {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} conditions and must move as far from the exorcist as it can on its turns. The effect lasts for 1 minute or until the target takes damage, the exorcist has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition, or the exorcist dies.

action.name: Last Rites {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 15}, one creature the exorcist can see within 60 feet that isn't a Celestial or Construct (Fiends and Undead have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}). {@actSaveFail} 36 ({@damage 8d8}) Radiant damage. If the target is a Fiend or Undead, it instead takes 64 Radiant damage and is turned to ash if the effect reduces it to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

bonus.name: Spiritual Healing
entries: One creature the exorcist can see regains 35 {@dice 10d6} {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. Once a creature benefits from Spiritual {@variantrule Healing|XPHB}, it can't do so again until it finishes a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

reaction.name: Negate Spell (3/Day)
entries: {@actTrigger} A creature the exorcist can see within 60 feet is casting a spell. {@actResponse} If the spell is level 3 or lower, the spell fails, but any spell slots or charges aren't wasted.

trait.name: Critical Condition
entries: A creature that rolls a natural 1 on a saving throw against the chemist's attacks or effects takes maximum damage from the attack or effect.

trait.name: Special Immunities
entries: Chemist is immune to the {@condition Burning|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The chemist makes one Caustic Grip attack and uses either Chemical Spray or Explosive Concoction, if available.

action.name: Caustic Grip
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 9}, reach 5 ft. {@h}24 ({@damage 8d4 + 4}) Acid damage, and the target has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 17}). Until the grapple ends, the target has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition and the chemist can't use Caustic Grip against another target. At the end of each of its turns, the target takes 24 ({@damage 8d4 + 4}) Acid damage.

action.name: Chemical Spray
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 17}, each creature in a 30-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}. {@actSaveFail} 28 ({@damage 8d6}) Acid, Cold, Fire, or Lightning damage (the chemist's choice). {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

action.name: Explosive Concoction {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 17}, each creature in a 20-foot radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on a point within 120 feet of the chemist. {@actSaveFail} 45 ({@damage 10d8}) Acid, Cold, Fire, or Lightning damage (the chemist's choice), and the target has the {@condition Burning|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition ({@dice 4d6}, same damage type). {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

action.name: Acid Rain (1/Day)
entries: The chemist conjures a storm of acid rain in a 20-foot radius, 20-foot tall {@variantrule Cylinder [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cylinder} centered on a point it can see within 120 feet. Exposed flames in the area are doused. Chemical pools accumulate in the area and emit thick fumes, rendering it {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB} and {@variantrule Lightly Obscured|XPHB}. The storm and the pools evaporate after 1 minute.

A creature that enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there is subjected to the following effect. {@actSave dex} {@dc 17}. {@actSaveFail} 30 ({@damage 12d4}) Acid damage, and the target has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

bonus.name: Emergency Dose
entries: The chemist administers a restorative poultice to itself or a creature it can see within 5 feet that isn't a Construct or Undead. The target regains 35 {@dice 10d6} {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. Once a creature benefits from Emergency Dose, it can't do so again until it finishes a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The alienist casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 16}, +8 to spell attacks):

trait.name: Lie Detection
entries: The alienist always knows if it hears a lie, and has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Wisdom ({@skill Insight|XPHB}) checks.

trait.name: Unmatched Intellect
entries: The alienist adds its Intelligence modifier to its {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} rolls.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The alienist makes three Mind Thrust attacks.

action.name: Mind Thrust
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 8}, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. {@h}26 ({@damage 4d10 + 4}) Force damage, and the target is pushed 10 feet in any horizontal direction.

action.name: Mass Manipulation {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave int} {@dc 16}, up to six creatures within 60 feet of the alienist that can see and hear it. {@actSaveFail} The target must use its {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to move up to its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} and make a weapon attack or cast a cantrip. The alienist chooses the direction of the movement and the target of the attack or cantrip.

action.name: Nerve Gas (1/Day)
entries: The alienist creates a 10-foot radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} of psychoactive fog centered on a point it can see within 60 feet. The fog spreads around corners and renders its area {@variantrule Heavily Obscured|XPHB}. It lasts for 1 minute or until a strong wind disperses it.

A creature that enters the fog for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there is subjected to the following effect. {@actSave int} {@dc 16}. {@actSaveFail} 35 ({@damage 10d6}) Psychic damage, and the target has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition until the start of its next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

bonus.name: Teleport
entries: The alienist teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 60 feet.

reaction.name: Mind Over Matter
entries: {@actTrigger} The alienist takes damage. {@actResponse} The alienist gains {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to the triggering damage.

hp.special: 39 (6d8 + 12) plus 39 (6d8 + 12) per player character

trait.name: Aura of Storms
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of the Crimson Countess takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Lightning damage.

trait.name: Pluck
entries: The Crimson Countess doesn't need to spend extra movement to drag a Medium or smaller creature {@condition Grappled|XPHB} by it.

action.name: The Crimson Countess always takes their turn on Initiative count 20
entries: On their turn, the Crimson Countess can use their movement and interaction as normal. However, they do not take an action or {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on their turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, the Crimson Countess takes one of the following {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim|Epic Actions} at the end of each player character's turn:

items.name: Grasping Talons
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 8}, reach 5 ft. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d4 + 5}) Piercing damage, and if the target is Medium or smaller, it has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 15}).

items.name: Lightning Javelin
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 8}, reach 5 ft. or range 30/60 ft. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) Lightning damage.

action.name: Aerial Acrobat
entries: The Crimson Countess flies up to her {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} without provoking {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB} action.

action.name: Frightful Screech (1/Round)
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 15}, one creature within 120 feet of the Crimson Countess that can hear them. {@actSaveFail} 14 ({@damage 4d6}) Psychic damage, and the target has the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition (save ends). While {@condition Frightened|XPHB}, the target must take the {@action Dash|XPHB} action and move away from the Crimson Countess by the safest available route on each of its turns unless there is nowhere to move.

action.name: Lightning Strike {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 15}, each creatures in a 60-foot long, 5-foot wide {@variantrule Line [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Line}. {@actSaveFail} 36 ({@damage 8d8}) Lightning damage, and the target has the {@condition Shocked|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition until the end of its next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

action.name: Epic Resistance
entries: The Crimson Countess chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting them and rolls {@dice 1d20}. On an 11+, the effect ends on them. The Crimson Countess can use this action even if they would otherwise be unable to take actions, their actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters their game statistics.

trait.name: Pluck
entries: The harpy doesn't need to spend extra movement to drag a Medium or smaller creature {@condition Grappled|XPHB} by it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The harpy makes three attacks.

action.name: Grasping Talons
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) Piercing damage, and if the target is Medium or smaller, it has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 15}). Until the grapple ends, the harpy can't use its Grasping Talons on another target.

action.name: Barbed Javelin
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 7}, reach 5 ft. or range 30/60 ft. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) Piercing damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Lightning damage.

bonus.name: Aerial Maneuver
entries: The harpy takes the Dash or Disengage action.

reaction.name: Chorus
entries: {@actTrigger} The harpy is within the area of another harpy's song. {@actResponse} The harpy joins in on the song, choosing a creature within 30 feet. The target has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on its next saving throw against the song.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The harpy makes two attacks.

action.name: Talons
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Longbow
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 5}, range 150/600 ft. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) Piercing damage.

bonus.name: Aerial Maneuver
entries: The harpy takes the {@action Dash|XPHB} or {@action Disengage|XPHB} action.

reaction.name: Chorus
entries: {@actTrigger} The harpy is within the area of another harpy's song. {@actResponse} The harpy joins in on the song, choosing a creature within 30 feet. The target has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on its next saving throw against the song.

action.name: Talons
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Crone Songs
entries: The harpy sings a magical melody in a 60-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation}, choosing one of the following effects. Allies of the Crone are unaffected.

action.name: Breakneck Hymn
entries: Each creature in the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} that can hear the harpy has {@variantrule Vulnerability|XPHB} to Bludgeoning damage from falling until the start of the harpy's next turn.

action.name: Disarming Tune
entries: {@actSave cha} {@dc 15}, each creature in the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} that can hear the harpy. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Weakened|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition until the start of the harpy's next turn.

action.name: Mesmerizing Melody
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 15}, each creature in the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} that can hear the harpy. {@actSaveFail} 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Psychic damage, and the target has the {@condition Slowed|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition until the start of the harpy's next turn.

action.name: Piercing Notes
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 15}, each creature in the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} that can hear the harpy. {@actSaveFail} 21 ({@damage 6d6}) Thunder damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

bonus.name: Aerial Maneuver
entries: The harpy takes the {@action Dash|XPHB} or {@action Disengage|XPHB} action.

hp.special: 95 (7d12 + 49) plus 95 (7d12 + 49) per player character

trait.name: Protective Aura
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of Minazorond takes 14 ({@damage 4d6}) Lightning damage.

trait.name: Construct Resilience
entries: If damage reduces Minazorond to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, it must make a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 5 plus the damage taken, unless the damage is Radiant or from a {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB}. On a success, Minazorond drops to 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} instead.

action.name: Minazorond always takes its turn on Initiative count 20
entries: On its turn, Minazorond can use its movement and interaction as normal. However, it does not take an action or {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on its turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, Minazorond takes one of the following {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim|Epic Actions} at the end of each player character's turn:

items.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 14}, reach 10 ft. {@h}33 ({@damage 4d12 + 7}) Piercing damage, and if the target is Medium or smaller, it has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 17}). While {@condition Grappled|XPHB}, the target has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition.

items.name: Claw
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 14}, reach 10 ft. {@h}17 ({@damage 3d6 + 7}) Slashing damage.

action.name: Tail
entries: {@actSave str} {@dc 22}, one creature Minazorond can see within 20 feet. {@actSaveFail} 14 ({@damage 4d6}) Force damage, and if the target is Medium or smaller, it has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Shocking Burst
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 20}, one target Minazorond can see within 120 feet. {@actSaveFail} 22 ({@damage 4d10}) Lightning damage, and the target has the {@condition Shocked|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

action.name: Terrifying Roar (Recharges after a Short Rest)
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 20}, each creature in a 120-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from Minazorond that can hear it. {@actSaveFail} 18 ({@damage 4d8}) Thunder damage, and the target has the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition (save ends).

action.name: Breathe Deep (1/Round)
entries: Minazorond's Breath Weapon recharges. Minazorond can only use this {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} if it's the first {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} it has taken this round.

action.name: Breath Weapon (Special Recharge)
entries: Minazorond uses one of the following breath weapons. It can only use this {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} if it's the last {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} it takes this round.

action.name: Lightning Breath
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 22}, each creature in a 120-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}. {@actSaveFail} 81 ({@damage 16d8}) Lightning damage, and the target has the {@condition Shocked|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

action.name: Thunder Breath
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 22}, each creature in a 120-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}. {@actSaveFail} 66 ({@damage 12d10}) Thunder damage, and the target is pushed 20 feet away from Minazorond and has the {@condition Dazed|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition (save ends). Failure by 5 or More: Double damage, and the target also has the {@condition Deafened|XPHB} condition (save ends). {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

action.name: Epic Resistance
entries: Minazorond chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting them and rolls {@dice 1d20}. On an 11+, the effect ends on it. Minazorond can use this action even if it would otherwise be unable to take actions, its actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters its game statistics.

reaction.name: Draconic Rebuke
entries: {@actTrigger} Minazorond becomes {@status Bloodied|XPHB}. It can use this {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} even if it has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition or is otherwise unable to take Reactions. {@actResponse} All conditions and spells on Minazorond immediately end unless it chooses to be affected by them, and it can fly up to its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} without provoking {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB} action and ignoring {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB}. Minazorond recharges and immediately uses its Terrifying Roar.

name: Grasping Shadow
languages: understands the languages it knew in life but mostly just screams

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The shadow can move through other creatures and objects as if they were {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB}. It takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

action.name: Spectral Grasp
entries: The shadow causes one creature it can see within 5 feet to have the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition. A target that takes an action to escape automatically ends the grapple.

action.name: Death Row
entries: The shadow moves up to its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}, pulling a creature it has {@condition Grappled|XPHB} with it.

hp.special: 250 (20d12 + 140) plus 250 (20d12 + 140) per player character

trait.name: Dimensional Anchor
entries: The Executioner can't be teleported or sent to another plane of existence unless it chooses to be.

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: The Executioner is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

trait.name: Rejuvenation
entries: If the Executioner is destroyed, it reforms with all of its {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} 1 minute later unless a {@spell Wish|XPHB} spell is used to stop it. A {@spell Wish|XPHB} spell used in this manner is always stressful, and the caster must roll to determine whether or not they can cast the {@spell Wish|XPHB} spell ever again.

trait.name: Necrotic Vents
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of the Executioner takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Necrotic damage.

trait.name: Stoic
entries: The Executioner can't take Reactions.

trait.name: Bound to Slaughter
entries: If the Executioner begins its turn more than 100 feet away from Slaughterstone Square, it disappears into the Haze and reappears 1 minute later at the center of Slaughterstone Square.

action.name: The Executioner always takes its turn on Initiative count 20
entries: On its turn, the Executioner can use its movement and interaction as normal. However, it does not take an action or {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on its turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect.
