Instead, the Executioner takes one of the following {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim|Epic Actions} at the end of each player character's turn:

action.name: Lumber Forward (1/Round)
entries: The Executioner moves up to its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}.

action.name: Death Grip
entries: Spectral chains appear around one creature within 300 feet of the Executioner. The target has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 15}), and it has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition until the grapple ends. The condition ends if the Executioner uses Death Grip against a different target

action.name: Guillotine Blade
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 18}, reach 10 ft. or range 60 ft. {@h}45 ({@damage 10d6 + 10}) Slashing damage which ignores any {@spell Resistance|XPHB} or {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to Slashing damage. Immediately after making a ranged attack, this weapon flies back to the Executioner's hands. Critical {@h}The target dies unless it has the Epic {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} action or Legendary {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} trait.

action.name: Destroyer (1/Round)
entries: The Executioner chooses a Huge or smaller object or structure within 5 feet of it. Alternatively, it can choose a spell or magical effect within 30 feet of it. The object or structure is destroyed, or the spell or effect ends.

action.name: Summon Grasping Shadows (1/Round)
entries: The Executioner targets {@dice 1d4} corpses within 300 feet of it. Each target's spirit rises as a {@creature Grasping Shadow|MonstersOfDrakkenheim|Grasping Shadows} in the nearest unoccupied space. The spirits act each round on {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} count 20, and disappear if the Executioner is destroyed.

action.name: Epic Resistance
entries: The Executioner chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting them and rolls {@dice 1d20}. On an 11+, the effect ends on it. The Executioner can use this action even if it would otherwise be unable to take actions, its actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters its game statistics.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The dragon can breathe air and water.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the dragon remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an inanimate bronze statue.

trait.name: Faultless Tracker
entries: The creatures that caused the dragon to animate become its quarries. The dragon knows the direction and distance to its quarries as long the quarries remain within Drakkenheim or until the dragon is destroyed.

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: The dragon is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The dragon has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Rejuvenation
entries: If the dragon is destroyed, it reforms with all of its {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} in 1 hour unless a {@spell Disintegrate|XPHB} spell is cast on its remains.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dragon makes three Rend attacks.

action.name: Rend
entries: {@atkr m} + 9, reach 10 ft. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d6 + 6}) Slashing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Force damage.

action.name: Breath Weapons {@recharge 5}
entries: The dragon uses one of the following breath weapons.

action.name: Lightning Breath
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 15}, each creature in a 60-foot long, 5-foot wide {@variantrule Line [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Line}. {@actSaveFail} 55 ({@damage 10d10}) Lightning damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

action.name: Repulsion Breath
entries: {@actSave str} {@dc 15}, each creature in a 30-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}. {@actSaveFail} The target is pushed up to 40 feet away from the dragon.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the gargoyle remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an inanimate statue.

trait.name: Faultless Tracker
entries: The creature that caused the gargoyle to animate becomes its quarry. The gargoyle knows the direction and distance to its quarry as long the quarry remains within Drakkenheim or until the gargoyle is destroyed.

trait.name: Rejuvenation
entries: If the wall gargoyle is destroyed, it reforms with all of its {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} in 1 hour unless a {@spell Disintegrate|XPHB} spell is cast on its remains.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The gargoyle makes one Bite attack and one Claw attack.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4}, reach 5 ft. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4}, reach 5 ft. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) Slashing damage.

hp.special: 87 (6d20 + 24) plus 87 (6d20 + 24) per player character

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting (Psionics)
headerEntries: The Duchess casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 20}):

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The Duchess can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Aura of the Deep
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 60 feet of the Duchess takes 14 ({@damage 4d6}) Psychic damage.

trait.name: Delerium Healing
entries: As an action, a creature can touch one of the Duchess's Delerium shards to regain 10 ({@dice 3d6}) {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. Once a Delerium shard restores {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} in this way, it can't do so again for 24 hours.

trait.name: Fully Contaminated
entries: The Dutchess is immune to {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} and has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against contaminated spells. The Dutchess may cast contaminated spells even though it does not gain {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} levels.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The Duchess has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Moisture Regeneration
entries: The Duchess regains 20 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} at the start of each of her turns if she is submerged at least partially in water. She dies only if she starts her turn at 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} and does not regenerate.

action.name: The Duchess always takes her turn on Initiative count 20
entries: On her turn, the Duchess can use her movement and interaction as normal. However, she does not take an action or {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on her turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, the Duchess takes one of the following {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim|Epic Actions} at the end of each player character's turn:

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 12}, reach 10 ft. {@h}16 ({@damage 3d6 + 6}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Tentacle
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 12}, reach 20 ft. {@h}20 ({@damage 4d6 + 6}) Bludgeoning damage, and if the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 20}). The Duchess can have up to four creatures {@condition Grappled|XPHB} at a time.

At the start of each of its turns until the grapple ends, the target is subjected to the following effect. {@actSave con} {@dc 17}. {@actSaveFail} The target gains one {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} level.

action.name: Fling
entries: One Large or smaller object held or creature {@condition Grappled|XPHB} by the Duchess is thrown up to 60 feet in a direction of the Duchess's choice and has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition. If a thrown target strikes a solid surface, the target takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) Bludgeoning damage for every 10 feet it was thrown. If the target is thrown at another creature, that creature must succeed on a {@dc 20} Dexterity saving throw or take the same damage and have the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Deep Domination (1/Round)
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 20}, one creature The Duchess can see. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition. The target is under the Duchess's control and can't take Reactions. The Duchess and the target can communicate telepathically over any distance.

Whenever the target takes damage, it repeats the save, ending the effect on itself on a success. On a failure, it gains one {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} level. Once every 24 hours, if the creature is at least 1 mile away from the Duchess, it can repeat the saving throw.

If the target undergoes a Monstrous Transformation, it becomes a {@creature Deep Dreg Warrior|MonstersOfDrakkenheim}, a {@creature Deep Knight|MonstersOfDrakkenheim}, or a {@creature Deep Siren|MonstersOfDrakkenheim}, and is forever in thrall to the Duchess.

action.name: Call of the Deep (1/Round)
entries: The Duchess calls forth up to five {@creature Deep Dreg Warrior|MonstersOfDrakkenheim|Deep Dregs} or one {@creature Deep Knight|MonstersOfDrakkenheim}. The creatures appear in unoccupied spaces within 30 feet of the Duchess and remain until destroyed. The creatures act after the Duchess on the same {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} count and are under her control.

action.name: Epic Resistance
entries: The Duchess chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting her and rolls {@dice 1d20}. On an 11+, the effect ends on her. The Duchess can use this action even if she would otherwise be unable to take actions, her actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters her game statistics.

reaction.name: Sacrificial Pawn
entries: {@actTrigger} The Duchess takes damage from an attack. {@actResponse} The Duchess chooses an ally or a creature {@condition Charmed|XPHB} by her to take the attack's damage instead.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The deep siren casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 15}, +7 to spell attacks):

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The deep siren can breathe air and water.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The deep siren makes two Storm Lash attacks.

action.name: Storm Lash
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 7}, reach 5 ft. or range 90 ft. {@h}18 ({@damage 4d8}) Thunder damage, and the target is pushed up to 10 feet away from the deep siren.

action.name: Discordant Song (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: {@actSave int} {@dc 15}, each creature of the deep siren's choice in a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the deep siren. {@actSaveFail} 21 ({@damage 6d6}) Psychic damage, and the target must roll {@dice 1d6} and subtract the result from each {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB} it makes. At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the save, ending the effect on itself on a success. It automatically succeeds after 1 minute.

action.name: Illusory Appearance
entries: The deep siren covers herself and anything she is wearing or carrying with a magical illusion that makes her look like another creature of her general size and shape. The illusion ends if the siren takes a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to end it or if she dies.

The changes wrought by this effect fail to hold up to physical inspection. For example, the siren could appear to have smooth skin, but someone touching them would feel their fishy flesh. Otherwise, a creature must take an action to visually inspect the illusion and succeed on a {@dc 15} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation|XPHB}) check to discern that the siren is disguised.

bonus.name: Misty Step
entries: The deep siren magically teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 30 feet.

trait.name: Abyssal Aura
entries: Allies within 30 feet who can see and hear the deep knight have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws to avoid or end the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} and {@condition Frightened|XPHB} conditions. The deep knight can't use this trait if it is {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB}.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The deep knight can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Unwavering Sentinel
entries: Creatures provoke {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB} action from the deep knight even if they take the {@action Disengage|XPHB} action before leaving its reach.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The deep knight makes one Harpoon attack and one Bite attack.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Harpoon
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) Piercing damage, and if the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it is subjected to the following effect. {@actSave str} {@dc 14}. {@actSaveFail} The target is pulled up to 20 feet toward the deep knight.

bonus.name: Shield Bash
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d4 + 4}) Bludgeoning damage, and if the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it is subjected to the following effect. {@actSave str} {@dc 14}. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The deep dreg can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Watery Camouflage
entries: The deep dreg has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth|XPHB}) checks to {@action Hide|XPHB} in any area {@variantrule Lightly Obscured|XPHB} by murky water or aquatic features.

trait.name: Catch of the Day (1/Turn)
entries: The deep dreg can deal an extra 7 ({@damage 2d6}) damage to a {@condition Prone|XPHB} or {@condition Restrained|XPHB} creature it hits with a weapon attack.

action.name: Spear
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 4}, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) Piercing damage, or 6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) Piercing damage if wielded with two hands to make a melee attack.

action.name: Net
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 3} to hit, range 5/15 ft., one Large or smaller creature. {@h}The target has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition. A creature can take an action to free itself or another creature in a net with a successful {@dc 10} Strength check. Dealing 5 Slashing damage to the net (AC 10) frees the target without harming it and destroys the net.

hp.special: 66 (7d10 + 28) plus 66 (7d10 + 28) per player character

trait.name: Aura of Hunger
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of the Lord of the Feast takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Necrotic damage.

trait.name: Close-Quarters Hunter
entries: Being within 5 feet of a {@variantrule Hostile [Attitude]|XPHB|Hostile} creature doesn't impose {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on the Lord of the Feast's ranged attack rolls.

trait.name: Hunter's Sense
entries: The Lord of the Feast has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on attack rolls against a {@status Bloodied|XPHB} creature.

trait.name: Predatory Senses
entries: The Lord of the Feast has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|XPHB}) checks. He can pinpoint the position of any creature within 120 feet of him with the {@condition Invisible|XPHB} condition.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The Lord of the Feast regains 20 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} at the start of his turn if he has at least 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} remaining.

action.name: The Lord of the Feast always takes his turn on Initiative count 20
entries: On its turn, the Lord of the Feast can use his movement and interaction as normal. However, he does not take an action or {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on his turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, the Lord of the Feast takes one of the following {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim|Epic Actions} at the end of each player character's turn:

items.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 9}, reach 5 ft. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d10 + 4}) Piercing damage plus 18 ({@damage 4d8}) Necrotic damage. {@actSave con} {@dc 17}. {@actSaveFail} The target gains one {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} level.

items.name: Claws
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 9}, reach 10 ft. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) Slashing damage, and the target has the {@condition Bleeding|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition ({@dice 4d4}).

items.name: Poison Arrow
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 9}, range 150/600 ft. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) Piercing damage plus 18 ({@damage 4d8}) Poison damage. {@actSave con} {@dc 17}. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition (save ends).

items.name: Ensnaring Arrow
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 9}, range 150/600 ft. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) Piercing damage, and the target has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition ({@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw ends).

items.name: Harpoon Arrow
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 9}, range 150/600 ft. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) Piercing damage, and if the target is Huge or smaller, it is pulled up to 20 feet toward the Lord of the Feast.

action.name: Reposition
entries: The Lord of the Feast moves up to his {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} without provoking {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB} action.

action.name: Call of the Hunt (1/Round)
entries: The Lord of the Feast releases a blood-curdling howl that can be heard all across Drakkenheim. All garmyr in the city heed this call and rush towards the Lord of the Feast's current position. Each garmyr within 60 feet who can see and hear the Lord of the Feast can use its {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to move up to half its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} and make one melee or ranged attack with {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB}.

action.name: Epic Resistance
entries: The Lord of the Feast chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting him and rolls {@dice 1d20}. On an 11+, the effect ends on him. The Lord of the Feast can use this action even if he would otherwise be unable to take actions, his actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters his game statistics.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The garmyr has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the garmyr's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The garmyr makes two attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Spear
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) Piercing damage, or 7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) Piercing damage if wielded with two hands to make a melee attack.

bonus.name: Feast
entries: The garmyr makes a Bite attack against a {@status Bloodied|XPHB} target.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The war dog has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the war dog's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) Piercing damage, and if the target is Medium or smaller, it has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

bonus.name: Feast
entries: The war dog makes a Bite attack against a {@status Bloodied|XPHB} target.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The garmyr casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 15}, +7 to spell attacks):

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The garmyr has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the garmyr's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition.

trait.name: Aura of the Blood Moon
entries: The garmyr projects a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} of carnage. Creatures have the {@status Bloodied|XPHB} condition while within the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation}, even if they have more than half of their {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} remaining. This effect ends if the garymyr is {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The garmyr makes three attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Spear

action.name: Blood Call
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 7}, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft. {@h}18 ({@damage 4d8}) Necrotic damage, and the target has the {@condition Bleeding|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition ({@dice 2d4}).

bonus.name: Feast
entries: The garmyr makes a Bite attack against a {@status Bloodied|XPHB} target.

trait.name: Reckless
entries: At the start of its turn, the garmyr can gain {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on all melee weapon attack rolls during that turn, but attack rolls against it have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} until the start of its next turn.

trait.name: Scent of Blood
entries: The garmyr's melee attacks deal an extra 7 ({@damage 2d6}) damage to a {@status Bloodied|XPHB} creature.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The garmyr makes three Battleaxe attacks. It can also Howl, if available.

action.name: Battleaxe
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 8}, reach 5 ft. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) Slashing damage, and if the target is Large or smaller, it is pushed up to 10 feet straight away from the garmyr. Critical {@h}The target has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Howl {@recharge}
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 16}, each {@variantrule Hostile [Attitude]|XPHB|Hostile} creature in a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the garmyr that can hear it. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition (save ends).

bonus.name: Aggressive
entries: The garmyr takes the {@action Dash|XPHB} action to move toward a {@variantrule Hostile [Attitude]|XPHB|Hostile} creature it can see.

reaction.name: Retaliate
entries: {@actTrigger} A creature hits the garmyr with a melee attack. {@actResponse} The garmyr makes a Battleaxe attack against that creature.

spellcasting.name: Hunter's Quarry
headerEntries: The garmyr casts {@spell Hunter's Mark|XPHB}, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The garmyr has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the garmyr's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition.

trait.name: Skilled Hunter
entries: The garmyr's ranged attacks ignore Half and {@variantrule Cover|XPHB|Three-Quarters Cover}.

trait.name: Kill Shot
entries: The garmyr's ranged attacks deal an extra 7 ({@damage 2d6}) damage to a {@status Bloodied|XPHB} creature.

action.name: Multiattack

entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Longbow
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 7}, range 150/600 ft. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) Piercing damage, and the target has the {@condition Slowed|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition until the start of the garmyr's next turn.

reaction.name: Skirmisher
entries: {@actTrigger} A {@variantrule Hostile [Attitude]|XPHB|Hostile} creature ends its movement within 5 feet of the garmyr. {@actResponse} The garmyr moves up to its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} without provoking {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB} action.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The Rat Crown-Prince has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|XPHB}) checks that rely on smell.

trait.name: Verminous Aura
entries: The Rat Crown-Prince emits a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} of verminous contamination. A creature that starts its turn in the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Necrotic damage.

action.name: The Rat Crown-Prince always takes his turn on Initiative count 20
entries: On his turn, The Rat Crown Prince can use his movement and interaction as normal. However, he does not take an action or {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on his turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, the Rat Crown-Prince takes one of the following {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim|Epic Actions} at the end of each player character's turn:

action.name: Contaminated Bite (1/Round)
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 10}, reach 5 ft. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d4 + 6}) Piercing damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Necrotic damage. {@actSave con} {@dc 15}. {@actSaveFail} The target gains one {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} level.

action.name: Delerium-Infused Blades
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 10}, reach 5 ft. or range 30/60 ft. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d6 + 6}) Necrotic damage, and the target suffers one of the following effects of the Rat Crown-Prince's choice (he can't select the same option more than once per round):

items.name: Poison
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 16}. {@actSaveFail} 18 ({@damage 4d8}) Poison damage, and the target has the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition for 1 minute (save ends). {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

items.name: Acid Burn
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 16}. {@actSaveFail} 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Acid damage, and the target has the {@condition Burning|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition ({@dice 3d6} Acid). {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

items.name: Mindkiller
entries: If the target is maintaining {@status Concentration|XPHB} on a spell, it takes an extra 25 ({@damage 5d10}) Psychic damage unless it chooses to end its {@status Concentration|XPHB}.

action.name: Call Ratlings (1/Round)
entries: {@dice 2d4} {@creature Ratling Warrior|MonstersOfDrakkenheim|Ratling Warriors} appear, burrowing up from below unoccupied spaces within 60 feet of the Rat Crown-Prince. The warriors have 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} each and remain until killed.

action.name: Meld into Shadow (1/Round)
entries: The Rat Crown-Prince has the {@condition Invisible|XPHB} condition until he makes an attack.

action.name: Swift Stride
entries: The Rat Crown-Prince moves up to his {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}.

action.name: Epic Resistance
entries: The Rat Crown-Prince chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting him and rolls {@dice 1d20}. On an 11+, the effect ends on him. The Rat Crown-Prince can use this action even if he would otherwise be unable to take actions, his actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters his game statistics.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The Rat Prince has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|XPHB}) checks that rely on smell.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The Rat Prince has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the Rat Prince's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Rat Prince makes three attacks: two with his Shortswords and one with his Contaminated Bite.

action.name: Shortsword
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Contaminated Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d4 + 4}) Piercing damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Necrotic damage. {@actSave con} {@dc 11}. {@actSaveFail} The target gains one {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} level.

action.name: Hand Crossbow
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 6}, range 30/120 ft. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) Piercing damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Poison damage.

bonus.name: Ratling Cunning
entries: The Rat Prince takes the {@action Dash|XPHB}, {@action Disengage|XPHB}, or {@action Hide|XPHB} action.

reaction.name: Sacrificial Pawn
entries: {@actTrigger} The Rat Prince is targeted by an attack or spell that targets only him. {@actResponse} The Rat Prince redirects the attack or spell to another ratling within 5 feet of him, causing the ratling to become the target instead.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The Rat King casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 16}):

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Rat King makes two Tail Whip attacks, then uses Psychic Blast or Spellcasting.

action.name: Tail Whip
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 8}, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. {@h}33 ({@damage 8d6 + 5}) Psychic damage. {@actSave int} {@dc 16}. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Dazed|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} and {@condition Slowed|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} conditions until the end of the Rat King's next turn.

action.name: Psychic Blast {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave int} {@dc 16}, each creature in a 60-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}. {@actSaveFail} 21 ({@damage 6d6}) Psychic damage, and the target is {@condition Jinxed|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} {@dice 1d10} (save ends).

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The ratling casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 16}):

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The ratling has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|XPHB}) checks that rely on smell.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4}, reach 5 ft. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Death Toll
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 16}, one creature the ratling can see within 120 feet. {@actSaveFail} 45 ({@damage 10d8}) Necrotic damage, and the target has the {@condition Weakened|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition (save ends). {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

action.name: Squeak of Doom (1/Day)
entries: {@actSave cha} {@dc 16}, each {@variantrule Hostile [Attitude]|XPHB|Hostile} creature in a 60-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the ratling that can hear it. {@actSaveFail} 55 ({@damage 10d10}) Psychic damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

bonus.name: Ratling Cunning
entries: The ratling takes the {@action Dash|XPHB}, {@action Disengage|XPHB}, or {@action Hide|XPHB} action.

reaction.name: Tail Barbs
entries: {@actTrigger} A creature the ratling can see within 60 feet succeeds on a {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB}. {@actResponse} The ratling forces the triggering creature to reroll the {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB} and use the lower roll.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The maw vermin has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The maw vermin makes one Bite attack and three Claw attacks, and it can use Grasping Maw or Glob Launcher.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 10}, reach 5 ft. {@h}22 ({@damage 3d10 + 6}) Piercing damage, and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it is swallowed. A swallowed creature has the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} and {@condition Restrained|XPHB} conditions, and has {@variantrule Cover|XPHB|Total Cover} from effects originating outside the maw vermin. At the start of each of the maw vermin's turns, a swallowed creature takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Acid damage and must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or gain one {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} level.

The maw vermin can swallow up to three creatures at a time. If the maw vermin takes 20+ damage in a single turn from a creature inside it, the maw vermin must succeed on a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, each of which land in spaces within 10 feet of the maw vermin with the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition. If the maw vermin dies, a swallowed creature no longer has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition and can escape from the corpse using 10 feet of movement, exiting with the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 10}, reach 10 ft. {@h}19 ({@damage 3d8 + 6}) Slashing damage, and if the target is Huge or smaller, it has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 16}). Until the grapple ends, the maw vermin can't use this Claw on another target. The maw vermin has three Claws.

action.name: Grasping Maw
entries: {@actSave str} {@dc 18}, one Medium or smaller creature the maw vermin can see within 15 feet. {@actSaveFail} The target is pulled into an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the maw vermin.

action.name: Glob Launcher
entries: The maw vermin coats a swallowed creature in acidic goo and launches it at a point within 120 feet of it. {@actSave dex} {@dc 15}, each creature within 10 feet of the launched creature as it lands (the launched creature automatically fails). {@actSaveFail} 21 ({@damage 6d6}) Acid damage, and the target has the {@condition Burning|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition ({@dice 4d6} Acid). While {@condition Burning|MonstersOfDrakkenheim}, the target has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The ratling has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|XPHB}) checks that rely on smell.

trait.name: Plaguebringer Aura
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 14}, a creature that starts its turn within 5 feet of the ratling. {@actSaveFail} 5 ({@damage 1d10}) Necrotic damage.

action.name: Filthy Blade
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, reach 5 ft. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d4 + 4}) Piercing damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Necrotic damage.

action.name: Infection (3/Day)
entries: The ratling causes one creature it can see within 60 feet to be infected with a disease. At the start of each of its turns, the target is subjected to the following effect. Constitution SavingThrow: {@dc 14}. {@actSaveFail} 13 ({@damage 2d12}) Necrotic damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage. After three successes, the disease ends. {@actSaveSuccessOrFail} A {@spell Lesser Restoration|XPHB} spell ends the disease early.

action.name: Metastasize
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 14}, one creature within 15 feet that is infected with a disease. {@actSaveFail} The target has one of the following conditions (the ratling's choice): {@condition Addled|MonstersOfDrakkenheim}, {@condition Clumsy|MonstersOfDrakkenheim}, or {@condition Enfeebled|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} (save ends). The condition immediately ends and is replace by a new condition if the ratling uses Metastasize on the target again. {@actSaveSuccessOrFail} 9 ({@damage 2d8}) Necrotic damage.

bonus.name: Rampant Sickness
entries: The ratling spreads its Infection from an infected target to another creature adjacent to that target.

trait.name: Swarm
entries: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Small ratling. The swarm can't regain {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} or gain {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}.

trait.name: Chittering Mass
entries: The swarm has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on attack rolls against any creature in its space.

trait.name: Scampering Survivors
entries: When the swarm is reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, it leaves behind {@dice 1d4} {@creature Ratling Warrior|MonstersOfDrakkenheim|Ratling Warriors} in its space.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The swarm makes one Bite attack against each creature in its space.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 0 ft. {@h}28 ({@damage 8d6}) Piercing damage, or 14 ({@damage 4d6}) Piercing damage if the swarm has the {@status Bloodied|XPHB} condition. If the target is a creature, it has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 14}).

bonus.name: Scurrying Horde
entries: The swarm takes the {@action Dash|XPHB} action.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The ratling has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|XPHB}) checks that rely on smell.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The ratling has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the ratling's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ratling makes three Repeating Crossbow attacks.

action.name: Bite

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting (1/Round)
headerEntries: The Pale Man casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 18}, {@hit 10} to hit with spell attacks):

trait.name: Aura of Fleshy Insects
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 18}, each creature of the Pale Man's choosing who starts its turn within 60 feet of the Pale Man. {@actSaveFail} 22 ({@damage 5d8}) Necrotic damage and the target gains one level of {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim}.

trait.name: Crawling Flesh
entries: When the Pale Man is reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, he breaks apart into a {@creature Swarm of Contaminated Insects|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} in the same space. Unless the swarm is destroyed, the Pale Man's swarm returns to its cocoon and reforms into the Pale Man {@dice 1d6} days later.

trait.name: Insect Body
entries: The Pale Man can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the Pale Man can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny insect.

action.name: The Pale Man always takes his turn on Initiative count 20
entries: On his turn, the Pale Man can use his movement and interaction as normal. However, he does not take an action or {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on his turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, the Pale Man takes one of the following {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim|Epic Actions} at the end of each player character's turn.

action.name: Contaminating Touch
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 10}, reach 10 ft. {@h}10 ({@damage 3d6}) Necrotic damage, it is subjected to the following effect. {@actSave con} {@dc 18}. {@actSaveFail} The target gains one level of {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim}.

action.name: Forced Mutation
entries: The Pale Man targets a creature within 60 feet who has one or more mutations and magically alters the mutation. The Pale Man chooses one of the target's existing mutations to remove and replaces it with a different one of his choice.

action.name: Infest the Flesh (1/Round)
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 16}, each creature in a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} from the Pale Man. {@actSaveFail} 22 ({@damage 5d8}) Necrotic damage, and the target gains the {@condition Burning|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} ({@dice 3d8} Necrotic) condition. A target also has the {@condition Dazed|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition while it is burning in this way. Failure by 5 or more: The target also has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition (save ends) due to masses of swarming fleshy bugs. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

action.name: Contaminate (1/Round)
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 16}, each creature {@condition Restrained|XPHB} by the Pale Man's Infest the Flesh action. {@actSaveFail} The target gains one level of {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim}.

action.name: Abrupt Contaminant (1/Round)
entries: The Pale Man targets a creature within 60 feet who has one or more levels of {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim}. That creature takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Necrotic damage for each level of {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} it has.

action.name: Epic Resistance
entries: The Pale Man chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting him and rolls {@dice 1d20}. On an 11 or higher, the effect ends on him. The Pale Man can use this {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} even if it would otherwise be unable to take actions, its actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters its game statistics.

action.name: Octarine Wall (1/Day)
entries: Lenore summons a shimmering wall within 120 feet of her. The wall can be up to 90 feet long, 30 feet high, and 1 inch thick. Alternatively, she can shape the wall into a sphere up to 30 feet in diameter centered on a point she can see within range. The wall has three octarine layers. When a creature attempts to reach into or pass through the wall, it does so one layer at a time through all the wall's layers. {@actSave con} {@dc 19}. Failure:

Layer 1: 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Necrotic damage and the target gains one level of {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} and has the {@condition Dazed|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition; Layer 2: 17 ({@damage 5d6}) Necrotic damage, and the target gains two levels of {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} and has the {@condition Defenseless|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition; Layer 3: 35 ({@damage 10d6}) Necrotic damage, and the target gains three levels of {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} and the {@condition Helpless|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only. The wall can be destroyed by taking at least 100 Radiant or Force damage.

If Lenore sees her reflection within the {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}, she gains the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} and {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} conditions for {@dice 1d6} hours and can't take the Epic {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} for the duration.

entries: The dreg makes two attacks with its Claws.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) Slashing damage plus 14 ({@damage 4d6}) Necrotic damage. Critical {@h}{@actSave con} {@dc 12}. {@actSaveFail} The target gains one level of {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim}.

bonus.name: Bounding Leap
entries: The dreg jumps 20 feet. This movement does not count toward its total movement for the round.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The dreg casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 15}):

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dreg makes two Psychic Blast attacks.

action.name: Psychic Blast
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft. {@h}17 ({@damage 4d6 + 3}) Psychic damage and the dreg pushes the target 10 feet straight away from itself.

action.name: Synaptic Shock {@recharge}
entries: The dreg unleashes a storm of psychic energy in a 10-foot-radius sphere centered on a point within 60 feet of it. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 13} Intelligence saving throw or take 14 ({@damage 4d6}) Psychic damage and has the {@condition Dazed|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition (save ends).

bonus.name: Hazewarp Hex
entries: The dreg chooses a creature it can see within 60 feet of it and one of the following conditions: {@condition Addled|MonstersOfDrakkenheim}, {@condition Clumsy|MonstersOfDrakkenheim}, {@condition Enfeebled|MonstersOfDrakkenheim}, or {@condition Sickened|MonstersOfDrakkenheim}. {@actSave cha} {@dc 13}, the targeted creature. {@actSaveFail} The target becomes cursed by the dreg for one minute or until the dreg dies or uses this ability again. While cursed in this manner, a creature becomes vulnerable to Psychic damage and gains the chosen condition (sane ends). {@actSaveSuccess} The target is immune to the dreg's Hazewarp Hex for 24 hours.

trait.name: Displacement
entries: Attack rolls against the dreg have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}. If it is hit by an attack roll, this trait does not apply until the end of its next turn. This trait does not apply while the dreg has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition or has a {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} of 0.

action.name: Talons
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) Slashing damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Necrotic damage.

bonus.name: Teleport {@recharge 4}
entries: The dreg teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space it can see. Before or after teleporting, the dreg can make one melee attack. If this attack hits, it deals an extra 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Psychic damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dreg makes two Refracted Beam attacks.

action.name: Refracted Beam
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. {@h}21 ({@damage 4d8 + 3}) Radiant damage, and the target has the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} condition until the start of the dreg's next turn. If this attack deals a different damage type due to Refract Elements, it has additional effects:

action.name: Acid or Fire
entries: The target is also {@condition Burning|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} ({@dice 2d6}) of the corresponding damage type.

action.name: Cold
entries: The target has the {@condition Frozen|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} {@variantrule Condition|XPHB} ({@dc 13}).

action.name: Lightning
entries: The target has the {@condition Shocked|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} {@variantrule Condition|XPHB} until the end of its next turn.

reaction.name: Refract Elements
entries: {@actTrigger} The dreg takes Acid, Cold, Fire, or Lightning damage. {@actResponse} The dreg gains {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to the triggering damage type, including the triggering damage, until the end of its next turn. During its next turn, its Refracted Beam attack deals damage of that damage type instead of Radiant damage.

trait.name: No Escape
entries: When the dreg hits a creature with an {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB} action, that creature's {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} becomes 0 until the end of its turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dreg makes two Bone Blade attacks.

action.name: Bone Blade
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft. {@h}14 ({@damage 3d6 + 4}) Force damage, and the target has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on attack rolls against any creature other than the dreg until the end of its next turn.

reaction.name: Sentinel Strike
entries: {@actTrigger} A creature within 5 feet of the dreg takes the {@action Disengage|XPHB} action or makes a melee attack roll against a target other than the dreg. {@actResponse} The dreg makes an {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB} action against that creature.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The dreg can breathe air and water.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) Bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Acid Spray {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 11}, each creature in a 15-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}. {@actSaveFail} 5 ({@damage 2d4}) Acid damage and is {@condition Burning|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} ({@dice 2d4} Acid).

trait.name: Misty Camouflage
entries: A dreg has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth|XPHB}) checks when taking the {@action Hide|XPHB} action in any area obscured by mist or fog, including the Haze.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4}, reach 5 ft. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) Slashing damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Necrotic damage. Critical {@h}{@actSave con} {@dc 10}. {@actSaveFail} The target gains one level of {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim}.

hp.special: 205 (10d20 + 100) plus 205 (10d20 + 100) per player character

trait.name: Delerium Storm Aura
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 120 feet of the World Ender takes 21 ({@damage 6d6}) Lightning damage and is subjected to the following effect. {@actSave con} {@dc 24}. {@actSaveFail} The target gains one {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} level.

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: The World Ender is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

trait.name: Mutations Abound
entries: A creature that gains a {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} level from the World Ender's Delerium Storm Aura must roll {@dice 2d6} and take the lower result to determine if they mutate. Whenever a creature within the aura gains a mutation, that creature must roll twice on the {@table Mutations|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} table and gains both mutations.

trait.name: Rejuvenation
entries: If the World Ender is destroyed, it regains all of its {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} in 1 hour unless a {@spell Wish|XPHB} spell is used to prevent it from rejuvenating. This is a stressful use of the {@spell Wish|XPHB} spell.

trait.name: Siege Monster
entries: The World Ender deals double damage to objects and structures.

trait.name: Unbound Arcana
entries: Whenever the World Ender is the target of a spell, an {@table Arcane Anomalies|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} is triggered on the caster.

action.name: The World Ender always takes its turn on Initiative count 20
entries: On its turn, the World Ender can use its movement and interaction as normal. However, it does not take an action or {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on its turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, the World Ender takes one of the following {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim|Epic Actions} at the end of each player character's turn:

action.name: Necrotic Claw
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 19}, reach 15 ft. {@h}37 ({@damage 5d10 + 10}) Necrotic damage.

action.name: Bite (1/Round)
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 19}, reach 15 ft. {@h}26 ({@damage 3d10 + 10}) Piercing damage, and if the target is a creature, it has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 27}). While {@condition Grappled|XPHB}, the target has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition and the World Ender can't Bite another target.

action.name: Charge Eradication Beam {@recharge 5}
entries: Octarine energy ripples through the body of the World Ender from its tail up to its head. The World Ender's Eradication Beam recharges, and it chooses the direction it will face to unleash its Eradication Beam.

The World Ender can only use this {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} if it's the first {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} it has taken this round. After using this {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim}, The World Ender can't use Bite, Bellowing Roar, or Devour until the start of the next round.

action.name: Eradication Beam (Special Recharge)
entries: The World Ender can only use this {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} if it's the last {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} it takes this round. {@actSave con} {@dc 27}, each creature and object in a 1000-foot long, 20-foot wide {@variantrule Line [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Line}. {@actSaveFail} 110 ({@damage 20d10}) Force damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage. {@actSaveSuccessOrFail} A creature is disintegrated along with anything it is wearing or carrying if this damage leaves it with 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, and can't be revived except by a {@spell Wish|XPHB} spell.

The Eradication Beam destroys any {@spell Wall of Force|XPHB}, {@spell Forcecage|XPHB}, or {@spell Prismatic Wall|XPHB} spell within its area. It also damages unattended magic items in its area, including artifacts.

action.name: Octarine Lightning Strike
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 27}, each creature in a 10-foot radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on a point within 500 feet. {@actSaveFail} 54 ({@damage 12d8}) Lightning damage, and the target has the {@condition Shocked|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition until the start of its next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

action.name: Bellowing Roar (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 27}, each creature in a 120-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the World Ender that can hear it. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Deafened|XPHB} condition (save ends). While {@condition Deafened|XPHB}, the target has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on attack rolls and ability checks.

action.name: Ground Slam (1/Round)
entries: {@actSave str} {@dc 27}, each creature on the ground in a 30-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}. {@actSaveFail} 26 ({@damage 4d12}) Bludgeoning damage, and the target is pushed 10 feet away from the World Ender and has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition. {@actSaveSuccessOrFail} The {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone} becomes {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB} until the start of the World Ender's next turn.

action.name: Devour
entries: The World Ender can't take this {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} if it has used its Bite {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} this round. The World ender makes a Bite attack against a Large or smaller creature it has {@condition Grappled|XPHB}. If the attack hits, the target takes the Bite's damage, the target is swallowed, and the grapple ends. While swallowed, the creature has the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} and {@condition Restrained|XPHB} conditions, it has {@variantrule Cover|XPHB|Total Cover} against effects originating from outside the World Ender, and it takes 56 ({@damage 16d6}) Acid damage and gains a {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} level at the start of each of the World Ender's turns.

If the World Ender takes 60 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the World Ender must succeed on a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which land in unoccupied spaces within 10 feet of the World Ender with the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition. If the World Ender dies, a swallowed creature no longer has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition and can escape from the corpse by using 30 feet of movement, exiting with the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Epic Resistance
entries: The World Ender chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting them and rolls {@dice 1d20}. On an 11+, the effect ends on it. The World Ender can use this {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} even if it would otherwise be unable to take actions, its actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters its game statistics.

name: Warp Witch
languages: The languages it knew in life

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The warp witch can move through other creatures and objects as if they were {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB}. It takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

action.name: Balefire Lantern
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. {@h}21 ({@damage 4d8 + 3}) Cold damage, and the target has the {@condition Slowed|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition until the end of the warp witch's next turn.

action.name: Psychic Scream
entries: {@actSave int} {@dc 13}, each creature in a 30-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}. {@actSaveFail} 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Psychic damage, and the target has the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition (save ends).

action.name: Possession
entries: {@actSave cha} {@dc 13}, one Humanoid the warp witch can see within 5 feet. {@actSaveFail} The target is possessed by the Warp Witch. The witch disappears, and the target has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition and loses control of its body. The witch controls the target's body but doesn't deprive the target of awareness. The witch can't be targeted by any attack, spell, or other effect, except ones that turn undead. The witch retains its alignment, Intelligence, Wisdom, Charisma, and {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} and {@condition Frightened|XPHB} conditions. It otherwise uses the possessed target's game statistics, but doesn't gain access to the target's knowledge, class features, or proficiencies.

The possession lasts until the body drops to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, the witch ends it as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, or the witch is turned or forced out by an effect like the {@spell Dispel Evil and Good|XPHB} spell. When the possession ends, the witch reappears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the body. If the target succeeds on its save or the effect ends for it, it is immune to this warp witch's {@variantrule Possession|XPHB} for 24 hours.

bonus.name: Mutate Host
entries: {@actSave cha} {@dc 13}, one creature the warp witch is possessing. {@actSaveFail} The target gains one {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} level and a mutation.

trait.name: Displacement
entries: The polyp's form is constantly shifting and moving through reality in unnatural ways. Attack rolls against the polyp have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}. If the polyp takes damage, this trait ceases to function until the start of its next turn. This trait is suppressed while the polyp has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} or {@condition Restrained|XPHB} conditions or is otherwise unable to move.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The polyp makes two Mucus attacks.

action.name: Mucus
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft. {@h}13 ({@damage 3d6 + 3}) Acid damage, and a 5-foot radius centered on the target is covered in acidic slime for 1 minute. A creature other than the polyp that enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there is subjected to the following effect. {@actSave con} {@dc 15}. {@actSaveFail} 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Acid damage, and the target has the {@condition Burning|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition ({@dice 3d6} Acid).

action.name: Slip Space
entries: The polyp teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 20 feet. {@actSave con} {@dc 15}, each creature in a 10-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the polyp when it reappears. {@actSaveFail} 16 ({@damage 3d10}) Force damage. Failure by 5 or More: The target triggers an {@table Arcane Anomalies|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} centered on itself. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

bonus.name: Shift Step
entries: The polyp teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 60 feet.

reaction.name: Confused Realities
entries: {@actTrigger} The polyp takes damage from a creature it can see within 30 feet. {@actResponse} The triggering creature is teleported to an unoccupied space the polyp can see within 30 feet of its original space. The destination must be on a surface or liquid that can support the target without the target having to squeeze.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The skretch makes two attacks.

action.name: Beak
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}8 ({@damage 2d4 + 3}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Spittle
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 5}, range 120/300 ft., one target directly underneath the skretch. {@h}15 ({@damage 6d4}) Acid damage.

action.name: Expel Waste {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 13}, each creature in a 10-foot radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} directly beneath the skretch. {@actSaveFail} 20 ({@damage 8d4}) Acid damage, and the target has the {@condition Burning|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition ({@dice 4d4} Acid). Each time the target takes damage from this condition, it must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or gain one {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} level. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

trait.name: Amorphous Form
entries: The skin crawler can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The skin crawler makes two Claw attacks and one Bind attack.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4}, reach 5 ft. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d8 + 2}) Slashing damage.

action.name: Bind
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4}, reach 5 ft. {@h}15 ({@damage 3d8 + 2}) Bludgeoning damage, and if the target is Medium or smaller, it has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 12}). While {@condition Grappled|XPHB}, the target has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition and {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on Strength checks and Strength saving throws, and the skin crawler can't Bind another target.

bonus.name: Crush and Consume
entries: {@actSave str} {@dc 12}, one creature {@condition Grappled|XPHB} by the skin crawler. {@actSaveFail} 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Bludgeoning damage, and the skin crawler regains an equal number of {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. If this damage kills the target, the skin crawler assumes its form. The skin crawler's game statistics are the same in each form. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The manticore makes two Claw attacks and one Stinger attack

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, reach 5 ft. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d10 + 4}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, reach 5 ft. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) Slashing damage. If the manticore flies 30+ feet straight toward the target immediately before the hit, the target has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition and the manticore can make a Bite attack against it as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}.

action.name: Stinger
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, reach 20 ft. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) Piercing damage. {@actSave con} {@dc 15}. {@actSaveFail} 24 ({@damage 7d6}) Necrotic damage. Failure by 5 or More: The target also gains one {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} level. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

action.name: Wing Shards {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 15}, each creature in a 20-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the manticore (flying creatures have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}). {@actSaveFail} 28 ({@damage 8d6}) Piercing damage, and if the target is flying, it has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

trait.name: Instinctive Ambusher
entries: At the start of the sewer thing's first turn of each combat, if the sewer thing attacks a creature, it can make one additional Tendril Lash attack as part of its Multiattack action.

trait.name: Poison Absorption
entries: Whenever the sewer thing takes Poison damage, it takes no damage and regains a number of {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to the Poison damage dealt.

trait.name: Toxic Aura
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 5 feet of the sewer thing is subjected to the following effect. {@actSave con} {@dc 12}. {@actSaveFail} 5 ({@damage 1d10}) Poison damage.

trait.name: Unexpected Appearance
entries: If the sewer thing is motionless at the start of combat, it has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on its {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} roll. Additionally, if a creature hasn't observed the sewer thing move or act, that creature must succeed on a {@dc 18} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation|XPHB}) check to discern that the sewer thing is animate.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The sewer thing makes two attacks and uses Engulf.

action.name: Tendril Lash
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 8}, reach 30 ft. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 16}).

action.name: Reel
entries: The sewer thing pulls each creature {@condition Grappled|XPHB} by it up to 20 feet straight toward it.

action.name: Engulf
entries: The sewer thing engulfs a Medium or smaller creature within 5 feet of it that is {@condition Grappled|XPHB} by it. The grapple ends. The target has the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} and {@condition Restrained|XPHB} conditions, is suffocating, and is subjected to the following effect at the start of each of the sewer thing's turns. {@actSave con} {@dc 16}. {@actSaveFail} 11 ({@damage 2d10}) Poison damage plus 11 ({@damage 2d10}) Acid damage.

If the sewer thing moves, the target moves with it. The sewer thing can have up to four creatures engulfed at a time. An engulfed creature can take an action to escape with a successful {@dc 16} Strength ({@skill Athletics|XPHB}) check, landing in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the sewer thing.

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: The reality cyst is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

trait.name: Unhinged Reality
entries: The reality cyst emits a 120-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} of unhinged reality. A creature that starts its turn in the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} is subjected to the following effect. {@actSave wis} {@dc 15}. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Immobilized|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition until it leaves the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation}. While {@condition Immobilized|MonstersOfDrakkenheim}, the target believes itself to be in an altered and confused environment of shifting forms, and can't see or hear anything else. The target does not perceive itself to be stationary, and instead believes it is walking through a bizarre landscape. It can take an action on its turn to repeat the save, ending the effect on itself on a success. If the creature succeeds on its save or the effect ends for it, it is immune to the reality cyst's Unhinged Reality for 24 hours.

trait.name: Unusual Nature
entries: The reality cyst doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

action.name: Psychic Whip
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 7}, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. {@h}19 ({@damage 4d6 + 5}) Psychic damage, and the target has the {@condition Dazed|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition until the end of the reality cyst's next turn. The reality cyst can target a creature {@condition Immobilized|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} by its Unhinged Reality with this attack even if the creature has {@variantrule Cover|XPHB|Total Cover}.

bonus.name: Feed
entries: Each creature {@condition Immobilized|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} by Unhinged Reality takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Psychic damage. The reality cyst regains {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to the total damage dealt, and its {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} Maximum increases by the same amount.

reaction.name: Fracture
entries: {@actTrigger} The reality cyst takes damage. {@actResponse d}{@actSave int} {@dc 15}, each creature in a 60-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the reality cyst. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Addled|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition (save ends).

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The maunder makes one Grasp or Bite attack against each creature within its reach. Alternatively, it makes two Eye Beam attacks.

action.name: Grasp
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) Bludgeoning damage, and if the target is Medium or smaller, it has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 13}). The maunder has countless hands and can grapple any number of creatures.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft., one creature {@condition Grappled|XPHB} by the maunder. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d10 + 4}) Piercing damage. A {@condition Dazed|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} target that is {@condition Grappled|XPHB} by the maunder is {@condition Helpless|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} against this attack.

action.name: Eye Beam
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 6}, range 60 ft. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) Radiant damage.

bonus.name: Babble
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 10}, each creature in a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the maunder that can hear it. {@actSaveFail} 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Psychic damage, and the target has the {@condition Dazed|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition until the start of its next turn.

trait.name: Enraged
entries: While {@status Bloodied|XPHB}, the octarine tree gains {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on all attack rolls.

trait.name: Plant Camouflage
entries: The octarine tree has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth|XPHB}) checks made to {@action Hide|XPHB} in forests.

trait.name: Siege Monster
entries: The octarine tree deals double damage to objects and structures.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The octarine tree makes three attacks.

action.name: Thwack
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 10}, reach 10 ft. {@h}19 ({@damage 2d12 + 6}) Bludgeoning damage, and if the target is Large or smaller, it is pushed 10 feet and has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Crushing Roots
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 10}, reach 20 ft. {@h}25 ({@damage 3d12 + 6}) Bludgeoning damage, and if the target is Large or smaller, it has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 16}). While {@condition Grappled|XPHB}, the target has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition. The octarine tree can grapple up to four creatures at a time.

action.name: Delerium Fruit
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 10}, range 60/120 ft. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d8 + 6}) Necrotic damage. {@actSave con} {@dc 18}. {@actSaveFail} The target gains one {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} level. Failure by 5 or More: The target triggers an {@table Arcane Anomalies|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} centered on itself.

bonus.name: Take Root
entries: If the octarine tree has not moved this round, it can plant itself into the ground. It regains 18 ({@dice 4d8}) {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} and has the {@condition Immobilized|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition until the start of its next turn. While {@condition Immobilized|MonstersOfDrakkenheim}, the octarine tree has {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to the {@condition Grappled|XPHB}, {@condition Prone|XPHB}, and {@condition Restrained|XPHB} conditions, and its AC increases to 20. These benefits end early if the tree takes Fire damage.

trait.name: Standing Leap
entries: The lob frog's long jump is up to 30 feet and its high jump is up to 20 feet, with or without a running start.

trait.name: Poison Skin
entries: When a creature within 5 feet of the lob frog hits it with a melee attack, that creature takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) Poison damage.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4}, reach 5 ft. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) Piercing damage, and the target has the {@condition Distracted|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition.

action.name: Throw Frogspawn
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 4}, range 30/60 ft. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) Bludgeoning damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Acid damage. If the target is a creature, the egg sticks to the target's body, melding with its flesh. A creature within 5 feet of the egg can take an action to remove the egg, dealing 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Acid damage to the target in the process. If the egg is still attached to the target at the end of its next turn, the target is infected with a disease and has the {@condition Sickened|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition until the disease ends. The disease can't be cured except by magic.

Every hour, the target is subjected to the following effect. {@actSave con} {@dc 12}. {@actSaveFail} The target gains one {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} level. {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} levels gained in this way can't be removed until the disease is cured. If the target suffers a Monstrous Transformation, it dies and its flesh falls away, birthing a Lob Frog.

trait.name: Digestive Enzymes
entries: The gag fly has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on attack rolls against a {@condition Burning|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} target.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The gag fly can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Proboscis
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Acid Spray {@recharge}
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 13}, each creature in a 15-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}. {@actSaveFail} 5 ({@damage 2d4}) Acid damage, and the target has the {@condition Burning|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition ({@dice 2d4} Acid). {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

reaction.name: Bloat Burst
entries: {@actTrigger} The gag fly is reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} or takes damage from a {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB}. {@actResponse d}{@actSave dex} {@dc 12}, each creature in a 10-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the gag fly. {@actSaveFail} 5 ({@damage 2d4}) Acid damage, and the target has the {@condition Burning|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition ({@dice 2d4} Acid).

hp.special: 70 (4d20 + 28) plus 70 per player character (4d20 + 28)

trait.name: Digestive Aura
entries: A creature that starts its turn in the living city's space takes 10 ({@damage 4d4}) Acid damage. At the start of its turn, the living city decides whether its Digestive Aura is active until the start of its next turn (no action required).

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the living city remains motionless in its Structural Form, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary structure or vehicle, such as a house or a sailing ship.

trait.name: Structural Form
entries: The living city can spend 10 minutes in {@status Concentration|XPHB} to shape-shift into a Gargantuan structure or back into its true, amorphous form. Its game statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

While in the form of a structure, the living city takes up its entire space and creates floors, walls, doorways, and windows within its space which resemble and behave like normal structures, while leaving behind open space within it to create rooms. Creatures can pass through the open spaces and stop there as if moving through a normal structure.

The walls and floors of the living city can be damaged and thus breached. Each 5-foot-by-5-foot section has AC 15 and 30 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. Reducing a section to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} destroys it and deals 30 damage to the living city. A living city can only take this damage once per turn.

In addition, the living city extrudes pieces of itself inside its space which resemble furnishings and everyday objects. The extrusions appear, feel, sound, and behave exactly like the mimicked objects. A thin, slimy tendril connects any furnishings or objects to the body of the living city. The tendril has AC 15 and 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point}. If the tether is severed or destroyed, the simulacra melts into goo, but does no harm to the living city.

trait.name: No Exit
entries: When it rolls for {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB}, the living city reflexively closes the windows, doors, and other egress points on the outside of its body, preventing creatures inside it from leaving its space.

A creature in the living city's space that attempts to leave its space using teleportation or planar travel is subjected to the following effect. {@actSave cha} {@dc 20}. {@actSaveFail} 27 ({@damage 5d10}) Psychic damage. {@actSaveSuccessOrFail} The teleportation or planar travel fails.

action.name: The living city always takes its turn on Initiative count 20
entries: On its turn, the living city can use its movement and interaction as normal. However, it does not take an action or {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on its turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, the living city takes one of the following {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim|Epic Actions} at the end of each player character's turn:

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 10}, reach 0 ft. {@h}23 ({@damage 4d8 + 5}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Grasping Tendril
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 10}, reach 10 ft. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) Bludgeoning damage, and the target is pushed or pulled 10 feet (the living city's choice).

action.name: Haunting Whispers
entries: {@actSave int} {@dc 15}, one creature in the living city's space. {@actSaveFail} 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Psychic damage, and the target has the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition (save ends).

action.name: Shifting Form
entries: The living city alters the composition of a 10-foot-by-10-foot area inside it, creating walls, doors, windows, stairs, or furnishings. It can choose to make the area {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB}. Creatures inside the living city who are not directly observing the shift must succeed on a {@dc 20} Wisdom ({@skill Perception|XPHB}) check to notice the change.

If the living city creates a wall that cuts through another creature's space when it appears, the creature is pushed to one side of the wall (the living city's choice). If a creature would be surrounded on all sides by the wall (or the wall and another solid surface), that creature can make a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw. On a success, it can use its {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to move up to its speed so that it is no longer enclosed by the wall.

action.name: Epic Resistance
entries: The living city chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting them and rolls {@dice 1d20}. On an 11+, the effect ends on it. The living city can use this {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} even if it would otherwise be unable to take actions, its actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters its game statistics.

trait.name: Eternal Torment
entries: If a last memory dies, it reappears {@dice 1d4} days later, unleashing a howling scream that can be heard up to 300 feet away.

trait.name: Silhouette
entries: The last memory can only move along contiguous flat surfaces, such as walls or floors. It cannot fly or swim and must always be in contact with a surface. Additionally, the last memory ignores all natural {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB} and can climb without making an ability check.

trait.name: Unusual Nature
entries: The last memory doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

action.name: Sorrowful Touch
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 4}, reach 5 ft. or range 30 ft. {@h}12 ({@damage 3d6 + 2}) Psychic damage, and the target has the {@condition Slowed|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Anguish {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 10}, each creature in a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the last memory that can hear it. {@actSaveFail} 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Psychic damage and the target becomes {@condition Jinxed|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} {@dice 1d6} (save ends).

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The kronen makes two Claw attacks and uses Loathsome Presence.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, reach 5 ft. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) Slashing damage.

action.name: Loathsome Presence
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 15}, each creature that can see the kronen. {@actSaveFail} 18 ({@damage 4d8}) Psychic damage, and the target has the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition for 1 minute (save ends). If the creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, it is immune to the kronen's Loathsome Presence for 24 hours.

bonus.name: Scuttle
entries: The kronen takes the {@action Dash|XPHB} action.

reaction.name: Infestation
entries: {@actTrigger} A creature ends its turn within 5 feet of the kronen. {@actResponse d}{@actSave dex} {@dc 15}. {@actSaveFail} The target is covered in cockroaches. It takes 14 ({@damage 4d6}) Piercing damage at the end of each of its turns until a creature takes an action to swipe the cockroaches off its body.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the eldritch blossom remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary flower.

action.name: Contaminated Touch
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 2}, reach 5 ft. {@h}10 ({@damage 3d6}) Necrotic damage. {@actSave con} {@dc 10}. {@actSaveFail} The target gains one {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} level. If the target is {@condition Charmed|XPHB} by the eldritch blossom, it is hit automatically and has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on its save.

action.name: Hypnotic Pollen (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 10}, each creature in a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the eldritch blossom. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition for 1 minute. While {@condition Charmed|XPHB}, the target has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition and must approach the eldritch blossom on its turns, taking the most direct path possible and moving through hazards. The effect ends early if a creature takes an action to shake the target out of its stupor.
