reaction.name: Spell Reflection
entries: {@actTrigger} The eldritch blossom succeeds on its save against a spell that targets only the eldritch blossom and doesn't have an area of effect, or a spell attack misses the eldritch blossom. {@actResponse} The eldritch blossom chooses a creature it can see within 30 feet as the spell's new target (the original caster is a valid target). If the spell forces a saving throw, the new target makes its own save. If the spell has an attack roll, the original caster rerolls the attack against the new target.

action.name: Proboscis
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 8}, reach 5 ft. {@h}14 ({@damage 4d6}) Psychic damage. If the target has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition, its Intelligence score is reduced by {@dice 1d4} until it finishes a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. The target dies if this effect reduces its Intelligence score to 0.

action.name: Delerium Dust {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 13}, each creature in a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the hazewing moth. {@actSaveFail} 14 ({@damage 4d6}) Radiant damage, and the target has the {@condition Addled|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition (save ends).

bonus.name: Hypnotic Flutter
entries: {@actSave int} {@dc 13}, each creature in a 60-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} of the hazewing moth that can see it (hazewing moths automatically succeed). {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Slowed|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition (save ends). If the target is already {@condition Slowed|MonstersOfDrakkenheim}, it instead has the {@condition Immobilized|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition (save ends). If the target is already {@condition Immobilized|MonstersOfDrakkenheim}, it also has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition (save ends both).

trait.name: Anchored
entries: The chrysalis is firmly anchored in place. It can't be forced to move or teleport unless it chooses to be.

trait.name: Haze Aura
entries: The chrysalis conjures Deep Haze in a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation}, which renders its area {@variantrule Lightly Obscured|XPHB}. A creature that starts its turn in the area is subjected to the following effect. {@actSave con} {@dc 10}. {@actSaveFail} The target gains one {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} level. {@actSaveSuccessOrFail} 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Necrotic damage.

action.name: Harden
entries: The chrysalis regains 7 ({@dice 2d6}) {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, gaining any excess healing as {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}.

reaction.name: Sudden Emergence
entries: {@actTrigger} The chrysalis is reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. {@actResponse} Roll {@dice 1d6}. On a 6, a Hazewing Moth Adult emerges from the chrysalis, sharing its {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} count. On a 1-5, vile goo spills out of the chrysalis, and each creature within 5 feet of it is subjected to the following effect. {@actSave con} {@dc 15}. {@actSaveFail} The target gains one {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} level. {@actSaveSuccessOrFail} 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Acid damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Necrotic damage.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 3}, reach 5 ft. {@h}3 ({@damage 1d4 + 1}) Piercing damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Necrotic damage.

name: Haze Wight
languages: The languages it knew in life

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The haze wight makes two Contaminated Blast attacks.

action.name: Contaminated Blast
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft. {@h}13 ({@damage 3d6 + 3}) Necrotic damage. The first time the target is hit by a Contaminated Blast each turn, it is subjected to the following effect. {@actSave con} {@dc 13}. {@actSaveFail} The target gains one {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} level.

bonus.name: Animate Haze Husk
entries: The haze wight reanimates the corpse of a haze husk it can see within 60 feet. The haze husk is revived with 5 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} and immediately stands.

name: Haze Husk
languages: understands the languages it knew in life but can't speak

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 3}, reach 5 ft. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d6 + 1}) Bludgeoning damage.

reaction.name: Death Burst
entries: {@actTrigger} The haze husk is reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} by damage that isn't Radiant or from a {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB}. {@actResponse d}{@actSave con} {@dc 10}, each creature in a 5-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the haze husk. {@actSaveFail} 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Necrotic damage. Failure by 5 or More: The target gains one {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} level.

hp.special: 73 (7d10 + 35) plus 73 per player character (7d10 + 35)

trait.name: Dazzling Aura
entries: The gravekeeper sheds {@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB} in a 60-foot radius. A creature that starts its turn in the {@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB} takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Radiant damage.

action.name: The gravekeeper always takes its turn on Initiative count 20
entries: On its turn, the gravekeeper can use its movement and interaction as normal. However, it does not take an action or {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on its turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, the gravekeeper takes one of the following {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim|Epic Actions} at the end of each player character's turn:

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 9}, reach 10 ft. {@h}22 ({@damage 4d8 + 4}) Bludgeoning damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Necrotic damage.

action.name: Lantern Blast
entries: Magical octarine beams flash from one of the Gravekeeper's many lanterns at one creature it can see within 120 feet that is not behind {@variantrule Cover|XPHB|Total Cover}, subjecting it to one of the following effects (the gravekeeper can only use each blast once per round):

items.name: Dispelling Blast
entries: {@actSave int} {@dc 18}. {@actSaveFail} 35 ({@damage 10d6}) Psychic damage. Any spell or magical effect on the target ends, and it has the {@condition Bewildered|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition (save ends). {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

items.name: Forceful Blast
entries: {@actSave str} {@dc 18}. {@actSaveFail} 35 ({@damage 10d6}) Force damage, and the target is pushed 20 feet away from the gravekeeper and has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

items.name: Blinding Blast
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 18}. {@actSaveFail} 35 ({@damage 10d6}) Radiant damage, and the target has the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} condition (save ends). {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

items.name: Contaminating Blast
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 18}. {@actSaveFail} 35 ({@damage 10d6}) Necrotic damage, and the target gains one {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} level. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

items.name: Igniting Blast
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 18}. {@actSaveFail} 35 ({@damage 10d6}) Fire damage, and the target has the {@condition Burning|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition ({@dice 10d6} Fire). {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

items.name: Freezing Blast
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 18}. {@actSaveFail} 35 ({@damage 10d6}) Cold damage, and the target has the {@condition Frozen|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition ({@dc 18}). {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

action.name: Glide (1/Round)
entries: The gravekeeper moves up to its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} without provoking {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB} action.

action.name: Sludge Column {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 18}, each creature in a 10-foot radius, 60-foot tall {@variantrule Cylinder [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cylinder}, centered on a point within 120 feet of the Gravekeeper. {@actSaveFail} 42 ({@damage 12d6}) Necrotic damage, and the target gains one {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} level. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

action.name: Animate Walls {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 18}, each creature within 10 feet of any number of walls within 120 feet of the gravekeeper. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 18}). The wall sprouts limbs to facilitate this grapple, which disappear when the condition ends.

action.name: Epic Resistance
entries: The gravekeeper chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting it and rolls {@dice 1d20}. On an 11+, the effect ends on it. The gravekeeper can use this {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} even if it would otherwise be unable to take actions, its actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters its game statistics.

trait.name: Swarm
entries: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through an opening large enough for a Small creature. The swarm can't regain {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} or gain {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The swarm makes two Slam attacks.

action.name: Psychic Slam
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}13 ({@damage 4d4 + 3}) Psychic damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The graffiti casts one of the following spells,requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 15}):

trait.name: Antimagic Susceptibility
entries: The graffiti is incapacitated while in the area of antimagic. If targeted by {@spell Dispel Magic|XPHB}, the graffiti must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against the caster's spell save DC or become Unconscious for 1 minute.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The graffiti regains 10 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} at the start of each of its turns. If the graffiti is splashed with water, targeted by {@spell Prestidigitation|XPHB}, or takes Cold damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of its next turn. Its body is destroyed only if it starts its turn with 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} and doesn't regenerate.

trait.name: Solvent Susceptibility
entries: The graffiti is instantly destroyed by Universal Solvent.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The graffiti can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Surface Bound
entries: The graffiti can only move along contiguous flat surfaces, such as walls or floors.

action.name: Satire
entries: The graffiti shapes itself into a satirical representation of a foe. {@actSave wis} {@dc 15}, one creature within 60 feet that can see the graffiti. {@actSaveFail} 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Psychic damage and the target has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on attack rolls and ability checks until the start of the graffiti's next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

action.name: Transposition
entries: The air quivers around creatures near the graffiti. {@actSave cha} {@dc 15}, up to five creatures the graffiti can see within 120 feet. {@actSaveFail} The creature teleports to an unoccupied space capable of supporting the creature within 120 feet.

action.name: Summon Public Opinion {@recharge}
entries: The graffiti conjures a swarm of Drakkenheim citizen spirits within 120 feet of itself. The swarm uses the Chorus stat block. The chorus acts immediately after the graffiti on the same {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} count, and it obeys the graffiti. The chorus disappears after 1 minute or the graffiti dies

trait.name: Air Form
entries: The eldritch cataclysm can enter a {@variantrule Hostile [Attitude]|XPHB|Hostile} creature's space and stop there. It can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing.

trait.name: Cyclonic Storm
entries: The eldritch cataclysm emits a 120-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} of high winds that disperse gases and vapors and extinguish unprotected flames. Ranged attacks that pass through the area have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}. Objects that are not worn or carried are blown away {@dice 1d6 x 5} feet in a random direction. A creature that starts its turn in the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} is subjected to the following effect. {@actSave str} {@dc 17} (flying creatures have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}). {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Slowed|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition until the start of its next turn. Failure by 5 or More: The target is flung {@dice 1d6 x 5} feet in a random direction, landing with the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The eldritch cataclysm uses Chain Lighting or Icy Bolt, then uses Meteor Stike or Quake.

action.name: Chain Lightning
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 12}, range 120 ft. {@h}21 ({@damage 3d8 + 7}) Lightning damage, the target has the {@condition Shocked|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition until the end of the cataclysm's next turn, and the lightning leaps to another creature of the cataclysm's choice within 15 feet of the first target. The cataclysm makes a separate {@spell Chain Lightning|XPHB} attack against the target. The cataclysm can make any number of {@spell Chain Lightning|XPHB} attacks in this way, but a creature can be targeted only once each time the cataclysm takes this action.

action.name: Icy Bolt
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 12}, range 120 ft. {@h}21 ({@damage 3d8 + 7}) Cold damage. {@hom}The target and each creature within 5 feet of it are subjected to the following effect. {@actSave dex} {@dc 17}. {@actSaveFail} 18 ({@damage 4d8}) Cold damage, and the target has the {@condition Frozen|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition ({@dc 17}).

action.name: Meteor Strike
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 17}, each creature in a 15-foot radius, 40-foot tall {@variantrule Cylinder [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cylinder} centered on a point the cataclysm can see within 120 feet. {@actSaveFail} 18 ({@damage 4d8}) Fire damage plus 18 ({@damage 4d8}) Bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Quake
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 17}, each creature in a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the cataclysm. {@actSaveFail} 28 ({@damage 8d6}) Thunder damage, and the target has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

trait.name: Death Burst
entries: The elemental explodes when it dies and it hasn't taking Force, Radiant, or Thunder damage since its last turn. {@actSave con} {@dc 16}, each creature in a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the elemental. {@actSaveFail} 42 ({@damage 12d6}) Necrotic damage, and the target gains one {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} level. {@actSaveSuccessOrFail} The explosion triggers a random {@table Arcane Anomalies|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} (see Appendix C).

trait.name: Earth Glide
entries: The elemental can burrow through nonmagical, unworked earth and stone. While doing so, the elemental doesn't disturb the material it moves through.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The elemental makes two Shard Slam attacks.

action.name: Shard Slam
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 8}, reach 10 ft. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) Bludgeoning damage. {@actSave con} {@dc 16}. {@actSaveFail} 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Necrotic damage, and the target gains one {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} level.

trait.name: Fog Form
entries: The elemental can enter a {@variantrule Hostile [Attitude]|XPHB|Hostile} creature's space and stop there. It can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing.

trait.name: Deep Haze
entries: A creature that enters the same space as the elemental or starts its turn there is subjected to the following effect. {@actSave con} {@dc 13}. {@actSaveFail} 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Necrotic damage, and the target gains one {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} level.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The elemental makes two Slam attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 8}, reach 5 ft. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) Bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Fire Form
entries: The elemental can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing.

trait.name: Enduring Flame
entries: Flames within 10 feet of the elemental can't be extinguished, and the {@condition Burning|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition can't end for creatures within 10 feet of the elemental.

trait.name: Illumination
entries: The elemental sheds {@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB} in a 30-foot radius and {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} in an additional 30 feet.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The elemental makes three Dancing Flame attacks.

action.name: Dancing Flame
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. {@h}13 ({@damage 3d6 + 3}) Fire damage, and the target has the {@condition Burning|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition ({@dice 3d6} Fire).

bonus.name: Flickerjump
entries: The elemental teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 60 feet.

trait.name: Invisible in Sludge
entries: The elemental has the {@condition Invisible|XPHB} condition while fully submerged in delerium sludge.

trait.name: Sludge Form
entries: The elemental can enter a {@variantrule Hostile [Attitude]|XPHB|Hostile} creature's space and stop there. It can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing.

action.name: Contaminated Touch
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, reach 5 ft. {@h}10 ({@damage 3d6}) Necrotic damage. {@actSave con} {@dc 15}. {@actSaveFail} The target gains one {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} level.

action.name: Engulf
entries: {@actSave str} {@dc 15}, each Large or smaller creature in the elemental's space. {@actSaveSuccess} The target is pushed out of the elemental's space. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 15}). While {@condition Grappled|XPHB}, the target has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition. The elemental can grapple one Large creature or two Medium or smaller creatures at a time.

At the start of each of the elemental's turns, the target takes 28 ({@damage 8d6}) Necrotic damage and is subjected to the following effect. {@actSave con} {@dc 15}. {@actSaveFail} The target gains one {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} level.
A creature within 5 feet of the elemental can take an action to pull a creature or object out of it with a successful {@dc 15} Strength ({@skill Athletics|XPHB}) check.

trait.name: Altered Reality
entries: The cnidarian has the {@condition Invisible|XPHB} condition for creatures {@condition Charmed|XPHB} by it.

trait.name: Hallucinogenic Bioluminescence
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 60 feet of the cnidarian and can see it is subjected to the following effect unless the cnidarian chooses otherwise. {@actSave wis} {@dc 16}. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition (save ends). While {@condition Charmed|XPHB}, the target regards all other creatures as enemies except the cnidarian, whom it regards as an ally.

Whenever the target makes an attack or casts a detrimental spell, it must choose its target at random from the creatures it can see within range. If a creature provokes an {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB} action from the target, it must make the attack, if able. If the target ends its turn without taking an Attack or {@action Magic|XPHB} action, it takes 14 ({@damage 4d6}) Psychic damage.

Unless {@status surprised|XPHB}, a creature can avert its eyes to avoid the saving throw at the start of its turn. If the creature does so, it has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on attack rolls against the cnidarian until the start of its next turn. If the creature looks at the cnidarian in the meantime, that creature must immediately make the saving throw.

trait.name: Neon Illumination
entries: The cnidarian sheds {@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB} in a 30-foot radius and {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} for an additional 30 feet.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The cnidarian makes two Tendrils attacks.

action.name: Tendrils
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 8}, reach 10 ft. {@h}27 ({@damage 6d8}) Necrotic damage, or 48 Necrotic damage if the target is {@condition Charmed|XPHB} by the cnidarian.

reaction.name: Reflexive Flash
entries: {@actTrigger} A creature the cnidarian can see within 30 feet deals damage to it. {@actResponse d}{@actSave con} {@dc 16}, each creature in a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the cnidarian that can see it. {@actSaveFail} 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Radiant damage and the target has the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} condition (save ends). {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

trait.name: Contaminated Regeneration
entries: The sewer gator regains 10 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} at the start of its turn as long as it is in contaminated water. The gator dies only if it starts its turn with 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} and doesn't regenerate.

trait.name: Amphibious Lunge
entries: If the sewer gator swims 20+ feet on its turn, it can long jump or high jump up to 60 feet. If it ends this jump within 5 feet of a creature, it has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on its next Crushing Bite attack against that creature, and that attack deals an additional 40 ({@damage 9d8}) Piercing damage.

trait.name: Predatory Stealth
entries: The sewer gator has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth|XPHB}) checks to {@action Hide|XPHB} in water.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The sewer gator makes two attacks. It can't make both a Crushing Bite attack and a Tail Strike attack against the same target.

action.name: Crushing Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 11}, reach 15 ft. {@h}33 ({@damage 4d12 + 7}) Piercing damage, and if the target is Large or smaller, it has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 19}). While {@condition Grappled|XPHB}, the target has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition and the sewer gator can't use Crushing Bite against another target.

action.name: Tail Strike
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 11}, reach 15 ft. {@h}25 ({@damage 4d6 + 7}) Bludgeoning damage, and the target is pushed 20 feet away from the sewer gator and has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Death Roll
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 11}, reach 15 ft., one creature {@condition Grappled|XPHB} by the sewer gator. {@h}33 ({@damage 4d12 + 7}) Piercing damage. {@actSave str} {@dc 19}. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Dazed|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} and {@condition Helpless|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} conditions until it escapes the sewer gator's grapple.

reaction.name: Submerge
entries: {@actTrigger} The sewer gator takes damage while in water. {@actResponse} The sewer gator swims half its speed and takes the {@action Hide|XPHB} action.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The digipede makes one Bite attack and two Talons attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 9}, reach 5 ft. {@h}22 ({@damage 3d10 + 6}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Talons
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 9}, reach 5 ft. {@h}16 ({@damage 3d6 + 6}) Slashing damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) Lightning damage. {@actSave con} {@dc 15}. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Shocked|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition until the end of the digipede's next turn.

action.name: Eye Beam {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 15}, each creature in a 60-foot long, 5-foot wide {@variantrule Line [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Line}. {@actSaveFail} 35 ({@damage 10d6}) Lightning damage, and the target has the {@condition Slowed|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition. At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the save, ending the effect on itself on a success. {@actSaveFail 2} The target has the {@condition Immobilized|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition. {@actSaveFail 3} The target has the {@condition Paralyzed|XPHB} condition. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dark growth shambler makes two Claw attacks and one Infectious Bite attack.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) Slashing damage.

action.name: Infectious Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) Necrotic damage, and if the target is a creature, it is subjected to the following effect. {@actSave con} {@dc 14}. {@actSaveFail} The target is infected with a disease called Dark Decay. Instead of acting normally on its turn, the target must move toward the closest creature that isn't infected with Dark Decay and make one melee attack against it. If the attack hits, the target of that attack must also make a saving throw against Dark Decay. At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the save. Subsequent Failures: The target gains one {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} level. Third Success: The disease ends.

An infected creature that dies or undergoes a Monstrous Transformation becomes a Dark Growth Shambler. A {@spell Lesser Restoration|XPHB} spell or similar magic that removes diseases ends Dark Decay, as does any magic that removes {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} levels.

reaction.name: Abrupt Decay
entries: {@actTrigger} The dark growth shambler drops to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} and it hasn't taken Fire damage this round. {@actResponse} The dark growth shambler creates a Dark Growth in its space.

trait.name: Mimicry
entries: The dark growth can mimic any sounds it has heard, including voices. A creature that hears the sounds can tell they are imitations with a successful {@dc 14} Wisdom ({@skill Insight|XPHB}) check.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The dark growth regains 10 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} at the start of its turn. If the Dark Growth takes Fire or Radiant damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the dark growth's next turn. The dark growth dies only if it starts its turn with 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} and doesn't regenerate.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dark growth makes three attacks: two with its Entangling Vines and one with its Infection Spores.

action.name: Entangling Vines
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, reach 30 ft. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) Piercing damage, and the target has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 15}) and the target has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition until the grapple ends.

action.name: Infection Spores
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 7}, range 60 ft. {@h}18 ({@damage 4d6 + 4}) Necrotic damage, and if the target is a creature, it is subjected to the following effect. {@actSave con} {@dc 14}. {@actSaveFail} The target is infected with a disease called Dark Decay. Instead of acting normally on its turn, the target must move toward the closest creature that isn't infected with Dark Decay and make one melee attack against it. If the attack hits, the target of that attack must also make a saving throw against Dark Decay. At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the save. Subsequent Failures: The target gains one {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} level. Third Success: The disease ends.

An infected creature that dies or undergoes a Monstrous Transformation becomes a Dark Growth Shambler. A {@spell Lesser Restoration|XPHB} spell or similar magic that removes diseases ends Dark Decay, as does any magic that removes {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} levels.

trait.name: Tunneler
entries: The crater wurm can burrow through solid rock at half its Burrowing {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} and leaves a 10-foot diameter tunnel in its wake.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The crater wurm makes a Bite attack, then makes Bite attacks against each creature adjacent to the first target.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 14}, reach 10 ft. {@h}35 ({@damage 4d12 + 9}) Piercing damage, and if it is Large or smaller, the target is subjected to the following effect. {@actSave dex} {@dc 22}. {@actSaveFail} The target is swallowed by the wurm. The target has the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} and {@condition Restrained|XPHB} conditions, has {@variantrule Cover|XPHB|Total Cover} against effects originating from outside the wurm, and takes 36 ({@damage 8d8}) Necrotic damage at the start of each of the wurm's turns. A creature that takes this Necrotic damage must also succeed on a {@dc 19} Constitution saving throw or gain one {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} level.

If the wurm takes 30+ damage on a single turn from a creature inside it, it must succeed on a {@dc 21} Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which land in spaces within 10 feet of the wurm with the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition. If the wurm dies, a swallowed creature no longer has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition and can escape from the corpse using 20 feet of movement, exiting with the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Breach
entries: The wurm moves up to its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}, entering the spaces of Large or smaller creatures. Each creature whose space it enters is subjected once to the following effect. At the end of its movement, the wurm can make one Bite attack against a {@condition Prone|XPHB} creature as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}. {@actSave str} {@dc 22}. {@actSaveSuccess} The target is pushed 5 feet away from the wurm into a space of its choice. If the target chooses not to move, it suffers the effects of a failure. {@actSaveFail} 35 ({@damage 10d6}) Bludgeoning damage, and the target is pushed 10 feet away from the wurm and has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

trait.name: Running Leap
entries: As long as the chitter has moved 20+ feet this turn, it has a high jump and long jump of 30 feet.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The chitter makes two Sharpened Claws attacks and one Acrid Bite attack. It can also use Chitter, if available.

action.name: Acrid Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) Piercing damage plus 14 ({@damage 4d6}) Necrotic damage.

action.name: Sharpened Claws
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) Slashing damage.

action.name: Chitter {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 13}, each creature within 120 feet of the chitter that can hear it. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Dazed|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition until the end of the chitter's next turn.

bonus.name: Aggressive
entries: The chitter moves up to its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} toward a {@variantrule Hostile [Attitude]|XPHB|Hostile} creature it can see. If it ends this movement adjacent to the creature, it gains {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on attack rolls against that creature until the end of its turn.

reaction.name: Slow Fall
entries: {@actTrigger} The chitter takes falling damage and doesn't have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition. {@actResponse} The triggering damage is reduced to 0.

hp.special: 54 (4d12 + 28) plus 54 (4d12 + 28) per player character

trait.name: Cacophonous Chorus
entries: The cacophonous chimera creates a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} of noise. A creature that starts its turn in the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} that can hear it takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Thunder damage.

trait.name: Keen Sight and Smell
entries: The cacophonous chimera has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|XPHB}) checks that rely on sight or smell.

action.name: The cacophonous chimera always takes its turn on Initiative count 20
entries: On its turn, the cacophonous chimera can use its movement and interaction as normal. However, it does not take an action or {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on its turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, the cacophonous chimera takes one of the following {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim|Epic Actions} at the end of each player character's turn:

items.name: Claws and Talons
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 11}, reach 10 ft. {@h}11 ({@damage 1d10 + 6}) Slashing damage, and if the target is Large or smaller, it has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

items.name: Contaminated Bite (1/Round)
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 11}, reach 10 ft. {@h}17 ({@damage 2d10 + 6}) Piercing damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Necrotic damage. {@actSave con} {@dc 17}. {@actSaveFail} The target gains a {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} level.

action.name: Lamprey Tail
entries: Melee {@variantrule Attack Roll|XPHB}:+11, reach 30 ft. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d6 + 6}) Piercing damage, and the target has the {@condition Bleeding|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition ({@dice 2d4}).

action.name: Aerial Maneuver (1/Round)
entries: The cacophonous chimera flies up to its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} without provoking {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB} action.

action.name: Cacophony (1/Round)
entries: The cacophonous chimera's three heads sing a discordant song. The effect of the song varies based on which of the chimera's head is taking the lead. Each time the cacophonous chimera uses this {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim}, it can't use the same effect it chose last round.

action.name: Bewildering Chitter (Ratling)
entries: {@actSave int} {@dc 17}, each creature in a 300-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the chimera that can hear it. {@actSaveFail} 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Psychic damage, and the target has the {@condition Bewildered|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition (save ends).

action.name: Chilling Howl (Garmyr)
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 17}, each creature in a 300-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the cacophonous chimera that can hear it. {@actSaveFail} 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Cold damage, and the target has the {@condition Immobilized|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition (save ends).

action.name: Staggering Screech (Harpy)
entries: {@actSave cha} {@dc 17}, each creature in a 300-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the cacophonous chimera that can hear it. {@actSaveFail} 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Necrotic damage, and the target has the {@condition Staggered|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition (save ends).

action.name: Wing Blast
entries: {@actSave str} {@dc 17}, each creature within 15 feet of the cacophonous chimera. {@actSaveFail} 13 ({@damage 2d6 + 6}) Thunder damage, and the target is pushed 10 feet away from the chimera. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

action.name: Epic Resistance
entries: The cacophonous chimera chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting them and rolls {@dice 1d20}. On an 11+, the effect ends on it. The cacophonous chimera can use this {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} even if it would otherwise be unable to take actions, its actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters its game statistics.

reaction.name: Crescendo of Chaos (1/Day)
entries: {@actTrigger} The cacophonous chimera becomes {@status Bloodied|XPHB}. It can take this {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} even if it has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition or is otherwise unable to take Reactions. {@actResponse} All conditions and spells on the cacophonous chimera immediately end unless it chooses to be affected by them, and it can move up to its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} without provoking {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB} action and ignoring {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB}.

It then unleashes a blast of thunderous power. Creatures within 300 feet of it who can hear it are subjected to the following effect. {@actSave wis} {@dc 17}. {@actSaveFail} 17 ({@damage 5d6}) Thunder damage plus 17 ({@damage 5d6}) Psychic damage, and the target has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition and can't stand until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The bojack can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the bojack remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal animal corpse.

trait.name: Sudden Death
entries: Creatures that haven't yet taken a turn in combat are {@condition Helpless|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} against attacks made by the bojack.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The bojack makes two attacks, using Impaling Limbs or Corrosive Mucus in any combination.

action.name: Impaling Limbs
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft. {@h}18 ({@damage 4d6 + 4}) Piercing damage and the target is {@condition Bleeding|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} ({@dice 2d6}). While {@condition Bleeding|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} in this way, the target is also {@condition Slowed|MonstersOfDrakkenheim}.

action.name: Corrosive Mucus
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 7} to hit, range 30/60 ft. {@h}14 ({@damage 4d4 + 4}) Acid damage and the target is {@condition Burning|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} ({@dice 2d4} Acid). While {@condition Burning|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} in this way, the target's AC becomes 10 + its Dexterity modifier.

bonus.name: Predatory Cunning
entries: The bojack takes the {@action Dash|XPHB}, {@action Disengage|XPHB}, or {@action Hide|XPHB} action.

trait.name: Swarm
entries: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny insect. The swarm can't regain {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} or gain {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}.

action.name: Contaminated Bites
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4}, reach 0 ft. {@h}10 ({@damage 3d6}) Necrotic damage, or 3 ({@damage 1d6}) Necrotic damage if the swarm has the {@status Bloodied|XPHB} condition. {@actSave con} {@dc 10}. {@actSaveFail} The target gains one {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} level.

trait.name: Insect Swarm
entries: The bloated hive emits a 10-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} of buzzing insects. A creature that starts its turn in the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Necrotic damage.

trait.name: Disrupt the Hive
entries: When the bloated hive dies, it immediately spawns a {@creature Swarm of Contaminated Insects|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} in its space.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Bloated Hive makes two attacks.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d8 + 3}) Slashing damage.

action.name: Spawn Swarm {@recharge 5}
entries: The bloated hive creates a {@creature Swarm of Contaminated Insects|MonstersOfDrakkenheim}, which appears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet. The swarm takes its turn immediately after the bloated hive.

bonus.name: Distracting Swarm
entries: The bloated hive causes its Insect Swarm to fly in the face of a creature within 5 feet of it. The target can't take Reactions until the end of the bloated hive's turn.

hp.special: 74 (4d20 + 32) plus 74 (4d20 + 32) per player character

trait.name: Rejuvenation
entries: If Bigger Linda is destroyed and her corpse is left within an area of the Deep Haze for 1 hour, she is revived with all of her {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: When Bigger Linda starts her turn in an area of the Deep Haze, she regains 20 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. Bigger Linda dies only if she starts her turn with 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} and doesn't regenerate.

trait.name: Haze Aura
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of Bigger Linda is subjected to the following effect. {@actSave con} {@dc 22}. {@actSaveFail} The target gains a {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} level. {@actSaveSuccessOrFail} 14 ({@damage 4d6}) Necrotic damage.

trait.name: Siege Monster
entries: Bigger Linda deals double damage to objects and structures.

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: Bigger Linda has {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to any spell or effect that would alter her form.

action.name: Bigger Linda always takes her turn on Initiative count 20
entries: On her turn, Bigger Linda can use her movement and interaction as normal. However, she does not take an action or {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on her turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, Bigger Linda takes one of the following {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim|Epic Actions} at the end of each player character's turn:

items.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 15}, reach 10 ft. {@h}35 ({@damage 4d12 + 9}) Piercing damage, and if the target is Large or smaller, it has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 23}). While {@condition Grappled|XPHB}, the target has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition and Bigger Linda can't Bite another target.

items.name: Tail
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 15}, reach 15 ft. {@h}22 ({@damage 3d8 + 9}) Bludgeoning damage, and if the target is Large or smaller, it is pushed 20 feet away from Bigger Linda and has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

items.name: Stomp
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 15}, reach 5 ft. {@h}25 ({@damage 3d10 + 9}) Bludgeoning damage. {@actSave con} {@dc 23}. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Staggered|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition (save ends).

action.name: Breathe Deep
entries: Bigger Linda's Breath Weapon recharges. Bigger Linda can only take this {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} as the first {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} she uses this round. After using this {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim}, Bigger Linda can't take her Bite {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} until the start of the next round.

action.name: Breath Weapon (Special Recharge)
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 22}, each creature in a 60-foot long, 5-foot wide {@variantrule Line [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Line}. {@actSaveFail} 31 ({@damage 7d8}) Necrotic damage plus 31 ({@damage 7d8}) Force damage, and the target gains a {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} level. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

action.name: Trampling Rampage (Recharges When {@status Bloodied|XPHB})
entries: Bigger Linda moves up to her {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} in a straight line, moving through the space of Large or smaller creatures in her path. She makes one Stomp attack against each creature she moves through.

action.name: Teleport (1/Round)
entries: Bigger Linger teleports up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space she can see within the Deep Haze.

action.name: Epic Resistance
entries: Bigger Linda chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting them and rolls {@dice 1d20}. On an 11+, the effect ends on her. Bigger Linda can use this {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} even if she would otherwise be unable to take actions, her actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters her game statistics.

trait.name: Rejuvenation
entries: If Big Linda is destroyed and her corpse is left within an area of the Deep Haze for 1 hour, she is revived with all of her {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: When Big Linda starts her turn in an area of the Deep Haze, she regains 10 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. Big Linda dies only if she starts her turn with 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} and doesn't regenerate.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Big Linda makes one Bite attack and one Tail attack.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 11}, reach 10 ft. {@h}33 ({@damage 4d12 + 7}) Piercing damage, and if the target is Medium or smaller, it has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 19}). While {@condition Grappled|XPHB}, the target has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition and Big Linda can't Bite another target.

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 11}, reach 10 ft. {@h}20 ({@damage 3d8 + 7}) Bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Acid Spew {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 16}, each creature in a 30-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}. {@actSaveFail} 63 ({@damage 14d8}) Acid damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

trait.name: Flyby
entries: The belfray doesn't provoke {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB} action when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

trait.name: Keen Hearing
entries: The belfray has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|XPHB}) checks that rely on hearing.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The belfray makes two Claws attacks and one Bite attack. It can replace its Bite with Sonic Blast, if available.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, reach 10 ft. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d10 + 4}) Slashing damage.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, reach 5 ft. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) Piercing damage, and the target has the {@condition Enfeebled|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition until the end of the belfray's next turn. The belfray regains {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to the damage dealt by its Bite.

action.name: Sonic Blast {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 15}, each creature in a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the belfray that can hear it. {@actSaveFail} 22 ({@damage 4d8 + 4}) Thunder damage, and the target has the {@condition Weakened|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition (save ends). {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The arcane wraith casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 14}):

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The arcane wraith can move through other creatures and objects as if they were {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB}. It takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

While {@condition Blinded|XPHB}, the target has the {@condition Immobilized|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition. The effect ends for the target if it takes damage or another creature takes an action to shake it out of its nightmare. When the effect ends, the target takes 14 ({@damage 4d6}) Psychic damage.

trait.name: Snail Trail
entries: When the anomollusk moves through a space, it fills the space with contaminated mucus that remains for 10 minutes. A creature that ends its turn in the mucus is covered in goop and subjected to the following effect. {@actSave dex} {@dc 17}. {@actSaveFail} 20 ({@damage 8d4}) Acid damage, and the target has the {@condition Slowed|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition. Each time the creature ends its turn with the {@condition Slowed|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition, it gains a {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} level. A creature within 5 feet can take an action to clean away the goop, ending the {@condition Slowed|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} condition.

action.name: Slobber
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 8}, reach 5 ft. {@h}20 ({@damage 8d4}) Acid damage.

action.name: Creep
entries: The anomollusk moves up to its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}, and can enter the spaces of Large or smaller creatures as it does. Each creature whose space it enters is subjected once to the following effect. {@actSave str} {@dc 17}. {@actSaveSuccess} The target is pushed 5 feet away from the anomollusk into a space of its choice. If the target chooses not to move, it suffers the effects of a failure. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition and is subjected to Snail Trail.

reaction.name: Shell Reflection
entries: {@actTrigger} The anomollusk takes damage from a spell or magical attack. {@actResponse} The attacker takes Radiant damage equal to the triggering damage and causes an {@table Arcane Anomalies|MonstersOfDrakkenheim}.

trait.name: Contaminating Presence

trait.name: Immutable Form

trait.name: Malignancy
entries: The Amalgamation can't be teleported or travel to another plane against its will.

trait.name: Rejuvenation
entries: If the Amalgamation is destroyed in the Mortal World, it reappears {@dice 1d10} days later with all of its {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} unless its roots in the Space Between Worlds are also destroyed.

trait.name: Ultimate Corruption
entries: Necrotic damage dealt by the Amalgamation ignores {@spell Resistance|XPHB} and treats {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} as {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} instead.

action.name: The Amalgamation always takes its turn on Initiative count 20
entries: On its turn, the Amalgamation can use its movement and interaction as normal. However, it does not take an action or {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on its turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, the Amalgamation takes one of the following Epic Actions at the end of each player character's turn

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 17}, reach 10 ft. {@h}36 ({@damage 4d12 + 10}) Force damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature {@condition Grappled|XPHB} by the Amalgamation, the grapple ends and the target is swallowed. While swallowed, the target has the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} and {@condition Restrained|XPHB} conditions, has {@variantrule Cover|XPHB|Total Cover} from effects originating from outside the Amalgamation, and takes 42 ({@damage 12d6}) Necrotic damage and gains a {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} level at the start of each of the Amalgamation's turns.

If the Amalgamation takes 50+ damage in a single turn from a creature inside it, it must succeed on a {@dc 25} Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which land in spaces within 10 feet of the Amalgamation and have the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition. If the Amalgamation dies, a swallowed creature no longer has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition and can escape the corpse using 15 feet of its movement, exiting with the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Tentacle
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 17}, reach 60 ft. {@h}28 ({@damage 4d8 + 10}) Force damage, and the target has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 25}). While {@condition Grappled|XPHB}, the target has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition. The Amalgamation has twelve tentacles, each of which can grapple one target. Fling. One Large or smaller object held or creature {@condition Grappled|XPHB} by the Amalgamation is thrown up to 60 feet, landing with the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition. If the target strikes a solid surface, it takes 35 ({@damage 10d6}) Force damage. If the target is thrown at another creature, that creature must succeed on a {@dc 25} Dexterity saving throw or take the same damage and have the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Mind-Breaking Whispers {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave int} {@dc 25}, one creature within 120 feet of the Amalgamation. {@actSaveFail} The target becomes insane until it finishes a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. While insane, the target can't take actions, understand other creatures, read, or speak anything but gibberish. A Greater Restoration or {@spell Heal|XPHB} spell ends the effect early. {@actSaveSuccessOrFail} 70 ({@damage 20d6}) Psychic damage.

action.name: Forced Mutation (1/Round)
entries: Each creature within 120 feet of the Amalgamation with one or more {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} levels takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Necrotic damage and gains a randomly determined mutation.

action.name: Epic Resistance

The Amalgamation can use this Epic {@variantrule Action|XPHB} even if it would otherwise be unable to take actions, its actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters its game statistics.

entries: The warrior has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the warrior's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Spear
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 3}, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d6 + 1}) Piercing damage.

trait.name: Demonic Restoration
entries: If the vrock dies outside the Abyss, its body dissolves into ichor, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} somewhere in the Abyss.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The vrock has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The vrock makes two Shred attacks.

action.name: Shred
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) Piercing damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Poison damage.

action.name: Spores {@recharge}
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 15}, each creature in a 20-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the vrock. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition and repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. While {@condition Poisoned|XPHB}, the target takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) Poison damage at the start of each of its turns. Emptying a flask of {@item Holy Water|XPHB} on the target ends the effect early.

action.name: Stunning Screech (1/Day)
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 15}, each creature in a 20-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the vrock (demons succeed automatically). {@actSaveFail} 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Thunder damage, and the target has the {@condition Stunned|XPHB} condition until the end of the vrock's next turn.

spellcasting.name: Hunger of Hadar {@recharge 5}
headerEntries: The vampire casts {@spell Hunger of Hadar|XPHB} (level 5 version), requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 18}).

spellcasting.name: Beguile
headerEntries: The vampire casts {@spell Command|XPHB}, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 18}). The vampire can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day, or 4/Day in Lair)
entries: If the vampire fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Shadow Escape
entries: If the vampire drops to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} outside its resting place, it teleports into its resting place unless it is in running water or sunlight. If it can't teleport, it is destroyed. Once inside its resting place, it has the {@condition Paralyzed|XPHB} condition for 1 hour, after which it regains 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point}.

trait.name: Vampire Weakness
entries: The vampire has these weaknesses:

items.name: Forbiddance
entries: The vampire can't enter a residence without an invitation from an occupant.

items.name: Running Water
entries: The vampire takes 20 Acid damage if it ends its turn in running water.

items.name: Stake to the Heart
entries: If a weapon that deals Piercing damage is driven into the vampire's heart while the vampire has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition in its resting place, the vampire has the {@condition Paralyzed|XPHB} condition until the weapon is removed.

items.name: Sunlight
entries: The vampire takes 20 Radiant damage if it starts its turn in sunlight. While in sunlight, it has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on attack rolls and ability checks.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The vampire makes two attacks, using Grave Strike or Sickening Ray in any combination.

action.name: Grave Strike
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 10}, reach 5 ft. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d8 + 5}) Slashing damage plus 13 ({@damage 3d8}) Necrotic damage.

action.name: Sickening Ray
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 10}, range 120 ft. {@h}16 ({@damage 2d10 + 5}) Necrotic damage, and the target has the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition until the start of the vampire's next turn.

bonus.name: Sanguine Drain
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 18}, one creature the vampire can see within 30 feet that isn't a Construct or an Undead. {@actSaveFail} 14 ({@damage 4d6}) Necrotic damage. The target's {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} maximum decreases by an amount equal to the damage taken, and the vampire regains {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to that amount.

legendary.name: Umbral Strike
entries: The vampire moves up to half its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}, and it makes one Grave Strike or Sickening Ray attack.

spellcasting.name: Charm {@recharge 5}
headerEntries: The vampire casts {@spell Charm Person|XPHB}, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 17}), and the duration is 24 hours. The {@condition Charmed|XPHB} target is a willing recipient of the vampire's Bite, the damage of which doesn't end the spell. When the spell ends, the target is unaware it was {@condition Charmed|XPHB} by the vampire.

spellcasting.name: Beguile
headerEntries: The vampire casts {@spell Command|XPHB}, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 17}). The vampire can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

entries: If the vampire fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Misty Escape
entries: If the vampire drops to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} outside its resting place, the vampire uses Shape-Shift to become mist (no action required). If it can't use Shape-Shift, it is destroyed.

While it has 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} in mist form, it can't return to its vampire form, and it must reach its resting place within 2 hours or be destroyed. Once in its resting place, it returns to its vampire form and has the {@condition Paralyzed|XPHB} condition until it regains any {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, and it regains 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} after spending 1 hour there.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The vampire can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 9}, reach 5 ft. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Necrotic damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 14}) from one of two hands.

action.name: Bite (Bat or Vampire Form Only)
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 17}, one creature within 5 feet that is willing or that has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB}, {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB}, or {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition. {@actSaveFail} 6 ({@damage 1d4 + 4}) Piercing damage plus 13 ({@damage 3d8}) Necrotic damage. The target's {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} maximum decreases by an amount equal to the Necrotic damage taken, and the vampire regains {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to that amount. A Humanoid reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} by this damage and then buried rises the following sunset as a {@creature Vampire Spawn|XMM} under the vampire's control.

bonus.name: Shape-Shift
entries: If the vampire isn't in sunlight or running water, it shape-shifts into a Tiny bat ({@variantrule Speed|XPHB} 5 ft., {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB} 30 ft.) or a Medium cloud of mist ({@variantrule Speed|XPHB} 5 ft., {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB} 20 ft. [hover]), or it returns to its vampire form. Anything it is wearing transforms with it.
While in bat form, the vampire can't speak. Its game statistics, other than its size and {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}, are unchanged.

While in mist form, the vampire can't take any actions, speak, or manipulate objects. It is weightless and can enter an enemy's space and stop there. If air can pass through a space, the mist can do so, but it can't pass through liquid. It has {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to all damage, except the damage it takes from sunlight.

legendary.name: Deathless Strike
entries: The vampire moves up to half its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}, and it makes one Grave Strike attack.

trait.name: Sunlight Hypersensitivity
entries: The vampire takes 10 Radiant damage if it starts its turn in sunlight. While in sunlight, it has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on attack rolls and ability checks.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The vampire makes one Bite attack and one Shadow Strike attack.

action.name: Bite

The target's {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} maximum decreases by an amount equal to the Necrotic damage taken, and the vampire regains {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to that amount.

action.name: Shadow Strike
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, reach 5 ft. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) Slashing damage plus 14 ({@damage 4d6}) Cold damage.

bonus.name: Shadow Stealth
entries: While in {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} or {@variantrule Darkness|XPHB}, the vampire takes the {@action Hide|XPHB} action.

bonus.name: Deathless Agility
entries: The vampire takes the {@action Dash|XPHB} or {@action Disengage|XPHB} action.

trait.name: Vampiric Connection
entries: While the familiar and its vampire master are on the same plane of existence, the vampire can communicate with the familiar telepathically, and the vampire can perceive through the familiar's senses.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The familiar makes two Umbral Dagger attacks.

action.name: Umbral Dagger
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) Piercing damage plus 7 ({@damage 3d4}) Necrotic damage. If the target is reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} by this attack, the target becomes {@variantrule Stable|XPHB} but has the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition for 1 hour. While it has the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition, the target has the {@condition Paralyzed|XPHB} condition.

bonus.name: Deathless Agility
entries: The familiar takes the {@action Dash|XPHB} or {@action Disengage|XPHB} action.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The unicorn casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 14}):

spellcasting.name: Unicorn's Blessing (3/Day)
headerEntries: The unicorn touches another creature with its horn and casts {@spell Cure Wounds|XPHB} or {@spell Lesser Restoration|XPHB} on that creature, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the unicorn fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The unicorn has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The unicorn makes one Hooves attack and one Radiant Horn attack.

action.name: Hooves
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, reach 5 ft. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) Bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Radiant Horn
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, reach 5 ft. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d10 + 4}) Radiant damage.

legendary.name: Charging Horn
entries: The unicorn moves up to half its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} without provoking {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB|Opportunity Attacks}, and it makes one Radiant Horn attack.

legendary.name: Shimmering Shield
entries: The unicorn targets itself or one creature it can see within 60 feet of itself. The target gains 10 ({@dice 3d6}) {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}, and its AC increases by 2 until the end of the unicorn's next turn. The unicorn can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

trait.name: Tunneler
entries: The umber hulk can burrow through solid rock at half its {@variantrule Burrow Speed|XPHB} and leaves a 10-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The umber hulk makes three Rend attacks.

action.name: Rend
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 8}, reach 10 ft. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) Slashing damage.

bonus.name: Confusing Gaze {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 14}, each creature in a 30-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}. {@actSaveFail} The target can't take Reactions until the start of the umber hulk's next turn, and the target rolls {@dice 1d8} to determine what it does on its next turn:

items.entry: The target does nothing.
The target takes no action or {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} and uses all its movement to move in a random direction.
The target makes a melee attack against a random creature within its reach or does nothing if it can't make such an attack.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting

spellcasting.name: Fiendish Guile {@recharge 4}
headerEntries: The ultroloth casts {@spell Dispel Magic|XPHB}, {@spell Invisibility|XPHB} (self only), {@spell Misty Step|XPHB}, or {@spell Suggestion|XPHB}, requiring no Material components and using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

trait.name: Fiendish Restoration
entries: If the ultroloth dies outside Gehenna, its body dissolves into ichor, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} somewhere in Gehenna.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The ultroloth has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ultroloth uses Hypnotic Gaze and makes two Mercurial Whip attacks.

action.name: Mercurial Whip
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 9}, reach 15 ft. {@h}25 ({@damage 6d6 + 4}) Force damage, and the ultroloth can teleport the target up to 10 feet to an unoccupied space the ultroloth can see that isn't in the air.

action.name: Hypnotic Gaze
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 17}, each creature in a 30-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}. {@actSaveFail} 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Psychic damage, and the target has the {@condition Stunned|XPHB} condition until the start of the ultroloth's next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} The target is immune to this ultroloth's Hypnotic Gaze for 24 hours.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The limb regains 5 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} at the start of each of its turns. If the limb takes Acid or Fire damage, this trait doesn't function on the limb's next turn. The limb dies only if it starts its turn with 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} and doesn't regenerate.

trait.name: Troll Spawn
entries: The limb uncannily has the same senses as a whole troll. If the limb isn't destroyed within 24 hours, roll {@dice 1d12}. On a 12, the limb turns into a {@creature Troll|XMM}. Otherwise, the limb withers away.

action.name: Rend
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d4 + 4}) Slashing damage.

trait.name: Loathsome Limbs (4/Day)
entries: If the troll ends any turn {@status Bloodied|XPHB} and took 15+ Slashing damage during that turn, one of the troll's limbs is severed, falls into the troll's space, and becomes a {@creature Troll Limb|XMM}. The limb acts immediately after the troll's turn. The troll has 1 {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} level for each missing limb, and it grows replacement limbs the next time it regains {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The troll regains 15 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} at the start of each of its turns. If the troll takes Acid or Fire damage, this trait doesn't function on the troll's next turn. The troll dies only if it starts its turn with 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} and doesn't regenerate.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The troll makes three Rend attacks.

action.name: Rend
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, reach 10 ft. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) Slashing damage.

bonus.name: Charge
entries: The troll moves up to half its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} straight toward an enemy it can see.

trait.name: Stench
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 12}, any creature (other than a troglodyte) that starts its turn in a 5-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the troglodyte. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition until the start of its next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} The target is immune to the Stench of all troglodytes for 1 hour.

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the troglodyte has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on ability checks and attack rolls.

action.name: Rend
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4}, reach 5 ft. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) Slashing damage.

action.name: Hail of Bark
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 10}, range 180 ft. {@h}28 ({@damage 4d10 + 6}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Animate Trees (1/Day)
entries: The treant magically animates up to two trees it can see within 60 feet of itself. Each tree uses the Treant stat block, except it has Intelligence and Charisma scores of 1, it can't speak, and it lacks this action. The tree takes its turn immediately after the treant on the same {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} count, and it obeys the treant. A tree remains animate for 1 day or until it dies, the treant dies, or it is more than 120 feet from the treant. The tree then takes root if possible.

trait.name: Pack Tactics

entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d8 + 3}) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, the tough pushes the target up to 10 feet straight away from itself.

action.name: Heavy Crossbow
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 4}, range 100/400 ft. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d10 + 2}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Heavy Crossbow
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 3}, range 100/400 ft. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d10 + 1}) Piercing damage.

entries: The thri-kreen makes three Psionic Lance attacks.

action.name: Psionic Lance
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 7}, reach 10 ft. or range 120 ft. {@h}18 ({@damage 4d6 + 4}) Psychic damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The thri-kreen makes two attacks, using Gythka or Chatkcha in any combination.

action.name: Gythka
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 3}, reach 5 ft. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d8 + 1}) Slashing damage plus 2 ({@damage 1d4}) Poison damage.

action.name: Chatkcha
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 4}, range 30/120 ft. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) Slashing damage.

entries: The thri-kreen jumps up to 15 feet by spending 5 feet of movement.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (6/Day)
entries: If the tarrasque fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The tarrasque has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Reflective Carapace
entries: If the tarrasque is targeted by a {@spell Magic Missile|XPHB} spell or a spell that requires a ranged attack roll, roll {@dice 1d6}. On a 1-5, the tarrasque is unaffected. On a 6, the tarrasque is unaffected and reflects the spell, turning the caster into the target.

trait.name: Siege Monster
entries: The tarrasque deals double damage to objects and structures.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The tarrasque makes one Bite attack and three other attacks, using Claw or Tail in any combination.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 19}, reach 15 ft. {@h}36 ({@damage 4d12 + 10}) Piercing damage, and the target has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 20}). Until the grapple ends, the target has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition and can't teleport.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 19}, reach 15 ft. {@h}28 ({@damage 4d8 + 10}) Slashing damage.

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 19}, reach 30 ft. {@h}23 ({@damage 3d8 + 10}) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Thunderous Bellow {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 27}, each creature and each object that isn't being worn or carried in a 150-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}. {@actSaveFail} 78 ({@damage 12d12}) Thunder damage, and the target has the {@condition Deafened|XPHB} and {@condition Frightened|XPHB} conditions until the end of its next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

bonus.name: Swallow
entries: {@actSave str} {@dc 27}, one Large or smaller creature {@condition Grappled|XPHB} by the tarrasque (it can have up to six creatures swallowed at a time). {@actSaveFail} The target is swallowed, and the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition ends. A swallowed creature has the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} and {@condition Restrained|XPHB} conditions and can't teleport, it has {@variantrule Cover|XPHB|Total Cover} against attacks and other effects outside the tarrasque, and it takes 56 ({@damage 16d6}) Acid damage at the start of each of the tarrasque's turns.

If the tarrasque takes 60 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the tarrasque must succeed on a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, each of which falls in a space within 10 feet of the tarrasque and has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition. If the tarrasque dies, any swallowed creature no longer has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition and can escape from the corpse using 20 feet of movement, exiting {@condition Prone|XPHB}.

legendary.name: Onslaught
entries: The tarrasque moves up to half its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}, and it makes one Claw or Tail attack.

legendary.name: World-Shaking Movement
entries: The tarrasque moves up to its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}. At the end of this movement, the tarrasque creates an instantaneous shock wave in a 60-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from itself. Creatures in that area lose {@status Concentration|XPHB} and, if Medium or smaller, have the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition. The tarrasque can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

trait.name: Incubus Form
entries: When the succubus finishes a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, it can shape-shift into an {@creature Incubus|XMM}, using that stat block instead of this one.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The succubus makes one Fiendish Touch attack and uses Charm or Draining Kiss.

action.name: Fiendish Touch
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, reach 5 ft. {@h}16 ({@damage 2d10 + 5}) Psychic damage.

action.name: Charm
entries: The succubus casts {@spell Dominate Person|XPHB} (level 8 version), requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 15}).

action.name: Draining Kiss
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 15}, one creature {@condition Charmed|XPHB} by the succubus within 5 feet. {@actSaveFail} 13 ({@damage 3d8}) Psychic damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage. {@actSaveSuccessOrFail} The target's {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} maximum decreases by an amount equal to the damage taken.

bonus.name: Shape-Shift
entries: The succubus shape-shifts to resemble a Medium or Small Humanoid or back into its true form. Its game statistics are the same in each form, except its {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB} is available only in its true form. Any equipment it's wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The giant casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 18}):

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The giant can breathe air and water.

action.name: Multiattack

name: Shield Guardian
languages: understands commands given in any language but can't speak

trait.name: Bound
entries: The guardian is magically bound to an amulet. While the guardian and its amulet are on the same plane of existence, the amulet's wearer can telepathically call the guardian to travel to it, and the guardian knows the distance and direction to the amulet. If the guardian is within 60 feet of the amulet's wearer, half of any damage the wearer takes (round up) is transferred to the guardian.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The guardian regains 10 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} at the start of each of its turns if it has at least 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point}.

trait.name: Spell Storing
entries: A spellcaster who wears the guardian's amulet can cause the guardian to store one spell of level 4 or lower. To do so, the wearer must cast the spell on the guardian while within 5 feet of it. The spell has no effect but is stored within the guardian. Any previously stored spell is lost when a new spell is stored. The guardian can cast the spell stored with any parameters set by the original caster, requiring no spell components and using the caster's spellcasting ability. The stored spell is then lost.

reaction.name: Protection
