trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The swarm has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on smell.

trait.name: Swarm
entries: The swarm of vermin can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a tiny beast.

action.name: Unarmed Strike
entries: {@atk mw} {@hitYourSpellAttack} to hit, reach 0 ft., one target in the swarm's space. {@h}8 ({@damage 2d6 + 1}) damage.

trait.name: Alluring Cry
entries: The cry of the Weeping Willow attracts creatures in a 120-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} from the willow. At the start of each of its turns, a creature within the area must succeed on a {@dc 18} Charisma save or have the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition for 1 hour. On a success, the target is immune to this Weeping Willow's Alluring Cry for 24 hours.

While {@condition Charmed|XPHB}, the target also has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition. On each of its turns, a {@condition Charmed|XPHB} creature must use its movement to approach the Weeping Willow by the most direct route, stopping when it is within 5 feet of the Weeping Willow. It doesn't avoid {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB|Opportunity Attacks}, but if this movement would obviously cause damage (such as by walking through fire), the creature repeats the save before entering that space.

trait.name: Deep Rooted
entries: The Weeping Willow is immune to effects that would move it.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The Weeping Willow has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Weeping Willow makes two Slam attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk m} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}25 ({@damage 4d10 + 3}) Bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Lignify
entries: {@actSave con}, one creature within 5 feet: {@dc 17}. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition and repeats the save at the end of its next turn if it is still {@condition Restrained|XPHB}, ending the effect on itself on a success. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Petrified|XPHB} condition instead of the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition, becoming a tree permanently. {@spell Greater Restoration|XPHB} or similar magic returns an affected creature to their original form.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The Weeping Willow casts one of the following spells without the need for components, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 18}):

name: Verminous Abomination
languages: all languages known before the curse

trait.name: Tunneler
entries: The Verminous Abomination can burrow through solid rock at half its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} and leaves a 10-foot-wide, 10-foot-high tunnel in its wake.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Verminous Abomination makes two attacks: one with its Bite and one with its Claws.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk m} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d8 + 3}) Piercing damage. {@actSave con} {@dc 15}. {@actSaveFail} 13 ({@damage 3d8}) Poison damage and have the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition for 1 minute. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atk m} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) Slashing damage.

action.name: Birth Ratlings {@recharge 5}
entries: The Verminous Abomination spawns {@dice 1d4+2} {@creature Swarm of Rats|XMM} within 5 feet of it. The swarms may immediately move and use actions. On later turns, they move and take actions on the same {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} as the Verminous Abomination.

name: Sightless Agony
languages: all languages known before the curse

trait.name: Shared Agony
entries: When a Sightless Agony takes damage, it emits a wave of energy, causing each creature within 5 feet of it to take an amount of Psychic damage equal to half the triggering damage (rounding down).

trait.name: Stunted Flight
entries: When a Sightless Agony chooses to fly, it must land by the end of its turn or have the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Sightless Agony makes one Bite attack, two Claw attacks, and one Tail attack.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk m} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) Piercing damage plus 14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) Psychic damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk m} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) Slashing damage plus 14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) Psychic damage. If both Claw attacks hit the same creature, the target has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 17}). Checks made to escape the grapple have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}.

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atk m} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) Piercing damage plus 18 ({@damage 3d8 + 5}) Psychic damage, and the target is subjected to the following effect. {@actSave str} {@dc 17}. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

reaction.name: Wave of Agony (1/Day)
entries: {@actTrigger} The Sightless Agony becomes {@status Bloodied|XPHB}. {@actResponse} {@actSave con} {@dc 17}, each creature within a 20-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation}. {@actSaveFail} 45 ({@damage 10d8}) Psychic damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

name: Plague Carrion
languages: all languages known before the curse

trait.name: Cloud of Blight
entries: A miasma surrounds the Plague Carrion in a 20-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation}. Each time another creature starts its turn or enters the area, it gains a -1 penalty to damage rolls. Multiple instances of this penalty stack, but a creature can't gain it more than once each round. The penalty is removed when the creature finishes a {@variantrule Alternative Resting System|GrimHollowCG24|Quick}, {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short}, or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

trait.name: Death Burst
entries: When the Plague Carrion dies, it explodes in a cloud of sickening gas. {@actSave con} {@dc 17}, each creature in a 10-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} centered on the Plague Carrion. {@actSaveFail} 27 ({@damage 6d8}) Poison damage, and the creature's {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} maximum is reduced by an amount equal to half the Poison damage taken (rounding down). {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.
The {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} maximum reduction lasts until the creature finishes a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Plague Carrion makes one Bite attack and one Plague Touch attack, or two Plague Beam attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk m} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}20 ({@damage 4d8 + 2}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Plague Touch
entries: {@atk m} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}49 ({@damage 10d8 + 4}) Poison damage. {@actSave con} {@dc 17}. {@actSaveFail} The target's {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} maximum is reduced by an amount equal to half the Poison damage taken (rounding down).

action.name: Plague Beam
entries: {@atk r} {@hit 8} to hit, range 60 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 3d8 + 3}) Poison damage, and the target has the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition until the end of the Plague Carrion's next turn.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The Plague Carrion casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material component and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 16}, {@hit 8} to hit with spell attacks):

trait.name: Displacement
entries: Attack rolls against the Mind Siphon have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}, since it projects an illusion that makes it appear near its actual location. This trait is suppressed while the Mind Siphon has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The Mind Siphon has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The Mind Siphon can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Mind Siphon makes two Tentacle Tongue attacks at different targets.

action.name: Tentacle Tongue
entries: {@atk m} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}26 ({@damage 5d8 + 4}) Psychic damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 16}) from the Mind Siphon's Tentacle Tongue, and the target has the {@condition Stunned|XPHB} condition until the Grapple ends. The Mind Siphon can Grapple up to two creatures at the same time.

action.name: Consume Head {@recharge 6}
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 16}, one creature {@condition Grappled|XPHB} by Tentacle Tongue. {@actSaveFail} 44 ({@damage 8d10}) Piercing damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage. {@actSaveSuccessOrFail} If this damage reduces the target to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, the Mind Siphon kills it and devours its head.

action.name: Synaptic Eruption {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave int} {@dc 16}, each creature within 30 feet of the Mind Siphon. {@actSaveFail} 36 ({@damage 8d8}) Psychic damage, and the target has the {@condition Stunned|XPHB} condition until the end of the Mind Siphon's next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

name: Herald of Calamity
languages: all languages known before the curse

trait.name: Aura of Calamity
entries: An aura of misfortune surrounds the herald in a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation}. Creatures other than the herald within the area have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on {@dice d20} Tests. Whenever a creature in the area other than the herald takes damage from any source other than another creature (such as a trap, a hazard, or a fall), it takes the maximum possible damage.

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The Herald of Calamity can move through other creatures and objects as if they were {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB}. It takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

trait.name: Invisibility
entries: The Herald of Calamity has the {@condition Invisible|XPHB} condition unless it is in an area illuminated by moonlight.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Herald of Calamity makes two Life Drain attacks.

action.name: Life Drain
entries: {@atk m} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}21 ({@damage 4d8 + 3}) Necrotic damage, and the Herald of Calamity regains {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to half the amount of Necrotic damage dealt.

reaction.name: Mishap
entries: {@actTrigger} An attack roll against the Herald of Calamity hits it. {@actResponse} The herald gains a +6 bonus to {@variantrule Armor Class|XPHB|AC} against the triggering attack. If this causes the attack to miss, it is redirected to a creature of the Herald's choice within 5 feet of it. Use the original attack roll to determine the success of the redirected attack.

name: Dream Whisperer
languages: all languages known before the curse

trait.name: Aura of Confusion
entries: A creature that starts its turn or moves within 25 feet of a Dream Whisperer must succeed on a {@dc 13} Intelligence saving throw or be affected as if they had failed a save against the {@spell Confusion|XPHB} spell.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The Dream Whisperer has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The Dream Whisperer can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Dream Whisperer makes three Claw attacks.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk m} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) Slashing damage, and the target is subjected to the following effect. {@actSave int} {@dc 13}. {@actSaveFail} The Dream Whisperer gains {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on attack rolls against the target for 1 minute, and the target rolls on the Lost Memories table.

entries.caption: Lost Memories
outro: A {@spell Remove Curse|XPHB} spell reverses this effect and restores the victim's memory.
rows: The target becomes deeply suspicious of a character or NPC of the GM's choice. They gain the following flaw: "I know they are seeking to betray me. I have to act first—it's me or them!"
The target forgets all memories of a loved one of the GM's choice. The next time the target sees them, it's as if they are meeting them for the first time.
The target becomes stricken with doubt and gains the following flaw: ""The world is out to get me, and I can't win. I may as well give up now."
The target forgets how to speak in one language known, decided by the GM.
The target forgets the location of something important to them, of the GM's choice. It may be the location of a goal, their home settlement, or a hidden treasure.
The target loses an inconsequential memory such as what they ate a few nights ago or the name of an unimportant NPC.

name: Body Snatcher
languages: all languages known before the curse
and all languages known by its host

trait.name: Electric Invigoration
entries: Whenever a Body Snatcher would take Lightning damage, it absorbs the energy and instead gains {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to half the damage, rounded down. The Body Snatcher also immediately recharges its Electric Torrent ability.

trait.name: Skin Sack
entries: The Body Snatcher is physically indistinguishable from its host and cannot be detected by nonmagical means. If the Body Snatcher is reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, and it has been inside its current host for less than 24 hours, the host regurgitates it then has the {@condition Unconscious|XPHB} condition and 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Body Snatcher makes two Slam attacks.

action.name: Invade
entries: {@actSave str} {@dc 15}; one Humanoid creature {@condition Grappled|XPHB} by the Body Snatcher. {@actSaveFail} The Body Snatcher departs its current host and moves into the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} creature. It then regains all {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} and recharges Electric Torrent. If it had been inside its previous host for less than 24 hours, that creature has the {@condition Unconscious|XPHB} condition and 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point}. Otherwise, the previous host body becomes a lifeless skin sack.

action.name: Electric Torrent {@recharge 5}
entries: The Body Snatcher unleashes a large electric pulse. {@actSave dex} {@dc 15}, each other creature within 20 feet of the Body Snatcher. {@actSaveFail} 28 ({@damage 8d6}) Lightning damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

name: Bloated Gastromorph
languages: All languages known before the curse

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The Bloated Gastromorph regains 10 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} at the start of each of its turns. If the Bloated Gastromorph takes Acid or Fire damage, this trait doesn't function on the Bloated Gastromorph's next turn. The Bloated Gastromorph dies only if it starts its turn with 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} and doesn't regenerate.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The Bloated Gastromorph can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Bloated Gastromorph makes three Claw attacks. It can replace one attack with a Tongue attack.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk m} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 3d8 + 5}) Slashing damage, and the target has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 15}) and is moved up to 5 feet toward the Bloated Gastromorph.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk m} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}27 ({@damage 4d10 + 5}) Piercing damage.

If the Bloated Gastromorph takes 40 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, it regurgitates all swallowed creatures at the end of that turn, each of which falls in a space within 10 feet of the gastromorph and has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition. If the Bloated Gastromorph dies, any swallowed creature no longer has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition and can escape from the corpse using 15 feet of movement, exiting with the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Tongue {@recharge 5}
entries: {@atk m} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 25 ft., one target. {@h}31 ({@damage 4d12 + 5}) Acid damage. A creature that is hit by this attack is subjected to the following effect. {@actSave con} {@dc 17}. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Paralyzed|XPHB} condition and is moved up to 20 feet toward the gastromorph. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

bonus.name: Swallow
entries: {@actSave str} {@dc 17}, one Large or smaller creature {@condition Grappled|XPHB} by the gastromorph (it can have up to two creatures swallowed at a time). {@actSaveFail} The target is swallowed by the gastromorph, and the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition ends. A swallowed creature has the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} and {@condition Restrained|XPHB} conditions, has {@variantrule Cover|XPHB|Total Cover} against attacks and other effects outside the gastromorph, and taks 21 ({@damage 6d6}) Acid damage at the start of each of the gastromorph's turns.

name: Avatar of Slaughter
languages: All languages known before the curse

trait.name: Blood Frenzy
entries: The Avatar of Slaughter has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all its {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}.

trait.name: Imprison in Weapon
entries: When the Avatar of Slaughter is reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} by a melee Weapon Attack by a creature within 5 feet, its spirit infests the weapon that struck the blow. The weapon gains the properties and Curse associated with a {@item Berserker Axe|XDMG}, though it retains its original weapon type. Additionally, while the curse remains the weapon is sentient and can telepathically communicate with any creature that wields it, encouraging violence and malice.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The Avatar of Slaughter has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Rejuvenation
entries: If the Avatar of Slaughter is destroyed, and not imprisoned in a weapon, it reforms and regains all its {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} in {@dice 1d6} days unless a {@spell Wish|XPHB} spell is cast on its remains.

trait.name: Silver Weakness
entries: Damage dealt by Silver weapons ignores the avatar's {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage.

trait.name: Standing Leap
entries: The Avatar of Slaughter's {@variantrule Long Jump|XPHB} is up to 60 feet and its {@variantrule High Jump|XPHB} is up to 30 feet, with or without a running start.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Avatar of Slaughter makes four Fist attacks. It can replace one attack with a Gore attack.

action.name: Fist
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 2d8 + 8}) Bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Gore
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}26 ({@damage 4d8 + 8}) Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature and the Avatar of Slaughter moved at least 20 feet straight toward it immediately before the hit, the target takes an extra 9 ({@damage 2d8}) Piercing damage and has the {@condition Stunned|XPHB} condition until the end of the target's next turn.

name: Watchful Priest
languages: one regional language plus one other language

trait.name: Enraging Sacrifice
entries: When the priest dies, each ally within 20 feet who can see the priest gains 10 {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} and a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls for 1 minute.

trait.name: Zealous Aura
entries: The priest radiates an aura of zeal in a 20-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from it. Each ally in the area has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} checks, and their successful attacks deal an extra {@damage 1d4} Radiant damage. This aura becomes inactive if the priest has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The priest makes two Castigating Word attacks.

action.name: Castigating Word
entries: {@atk ms,rs} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 2d6}) Radiant damage, and one ally of the priest within 20 feet of the target can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to make a melee attack.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The priest casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 13}):

bonus.name: Righteous Morale (1/Day)
entries: The priest chooses up to three other creatures it can see within 20 feet of it. Each target regains 4 ({@damage 1d8}) {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} and has  {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} and {@condition Frightened|XPHB} conditions until the start of the priest's next turn.

name: High Priest
languages: one regional language plus two other languages

trait.name: Enraging Sacrifice
entries: When the priest dies, each ally within 40 feet who can see the priest gains 20 {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} and a +4 bonus to attack and damage rolls for 1 hour.

trait.name: Zealous Aura
entries: The priest radiates an aura of zeal in a 40-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from it. Each ally in the area has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} checks, and their successful attacks deal an extra {@damage 3d6} Radiant damage. This aura becomes inactive if the priest has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The high priest makes three Sharp Rebuke attacks.

action.name: Sharp Rebuke
entries: {@atk ms,rs} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 3d8 + 5}) Radiant damage, and one ally of the priest within 20 feet of the target can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to regain 9 ({@damage 1d8 + 5}) {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} and make a melee attack.

action.name: Call Soldiers of the Faith
entries: The high priest calls forth celestials that take the form of {@dice 1d4 + 1||Warrior Veterans} {@creature Warrior Veteran|XMM|Warrior Veterans} or {@dice 1d3||Lions} {@creature Lion|XMM|Lions} that enter the {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} at the end of the high priest's turn. The celestials follow the priest's commands and remain for 1 minute or until slain.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The priest casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 17}):

bonus.name: Inspiring Monologue (3/Day)
entries: The priest chooses any number of allies within 60 feet who can hear the priest. Until the end of the priest's next turn, each target has  {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to the {@condition Charmed|XPHB}, {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB}, and {@condition Frightened|XPHB} conditions and does not provoke {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB|Opportunity Attacks}.

reaction.name: To Me!
entries: {@actTrigger} The priest is attacked or targeted by a spell. {@actResponse} The high priest chooses a Small or Medium ally within 5 feet of itself. The priest and that ally swap places, and the ally gains 10 {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} and becomes the target of the attack or spell instead.

name: Thaumaturge Archmage
languages: one regional language plus five other languages

trait.name: Collaborative Rift Control
entries: When multiple Thaumaturge Archmages capable of creating and controlling Arcane Rifts are present, they can interact with each other's rifts, and for every additional Thaumaturge Archmage, the maximum possible level of each rift increases by 2, up to a maximum of 15.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the archmage fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The archmage has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Personalized Arcane Burst
entries: Each archmage is specialized in one pair of damage types from the following list:

items: Acid and Poison
Bludgeoning and Necrotic
Cold and Fire

entries: When the archmage uses the Arcane Burst action, it can choose to change the attack's damage type from Force to one of the two selected damage types.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The archmage makes four Arcane Burst attacks or makes two Arcane Burst attacks and uses the Spellcasting action.

action.name: Arcane Burst
entries: {@atk ms,rs} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 150 ft., one target. {@h}27 ({@damage 4d10 + 5}) Force damage and the creature is pushed back 10 feet.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The archmage casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 18}):

bonus.name: Misty Step
entries: The archmage casts {@spell Misty Step|XPHB}, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

reaction.name: Arcane Contingency
entries: {@actTrigger} The archmage is reduced to 40 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} or less. {@actResponse} The archmage can cast {@spell Dimension Door|XPHB}. This does not consume a use of the spell.

reaction.name: Arcane Countermeasure
entries: {@actTrigger} The archmage is targeted by a spell, or the archmage is in the area of effect of a spell being cast. {@actResponse} The archmage casts {@spell Shield|XPHB} or {@spell Counterspell|XPHB}, or casts {@spell Dispel Magic|XPHB} targeting a spell in response to seeing that spell take effect. The archmage uses the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

legendary.name: Cast a Spell (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The archmage uses the Spellcasting action.

legendary.name: Create Arcane Rift (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The archmage creates a level 5 Arcane Rift in an unoccupied space the archmage can see within 120 feet. The Arcane Rift is a Large magical object, which hovers, has 10 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} per Arcane Rift level, and has an {@variantrule Armor Class|XPHB|AC} of 17. In addition to standard object properties, the Arcane Rift is Resistant to damage from spells and spell effects and is  {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB|Immune} to all conditions.
Creatures within 30 feet of the Arcane Rift treat all movement away from the Arcane Rift as {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB}.

The Arcane Rift can be dispelled with a {@spell Dispel Magic|XPHB} spell, treating the Arcane Rift's level as its spell level. It can also be destroyed if targeted by a {@spell Disintegrate|XPHB} spell.

items.name: Infuse Arcane Rift
entries: The archmage increases the level of one Arcane Rift it can see within 120 feet by 2, up to a maximum level of 9.

items.name: Ignite Arcane Rift
entries: The archmage causes one Arcane Rift it can see within 120 feet to expand to Huge or Gargantuan size before exploding, destroying the Arcane Rift. All creatures within 30 feet are subjected to the following effect. {@actSave dex} {@dc 18}. {@actSaveFail} 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Force damage per Arcane Rift level. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

items.name: Arcane Rift Summoning
entries: The archmage targets one Arcane Rift it can see within 120 feet, funneling its magic to cast {@spell Summon Dragon|XPHB} using the Arcane Rift level as the Spell Slot level, destroying the Arcane Rift in the process. Upon summoning, the archmage can change the summoned creature's creature type to any of the following: Aberration, Beast, Elemental, Fiend, or Monstrosity. This casting requires no somatic or material components.

name: Thaumaturge Initiated
languages: one regional language plus three other languages

trait.name: Disguise Other
entries: When the initiated casts {@spell Disguise Self|XPHB}, it can choose to have it affect up to 3 additional creatures (including {@variantrule Hostile [Attitude]|XPHB|Hostiles}) that it can see within 60 feet. It can choose the same or different disguises for each affected creature. When cast in this manner, the effect lasts for 1 minute or until the initiated chooses to dismiss it from that creature.

trait.name: Personalized Arcane Burst
entries: Each initiated is specialized in one pair of damage types from the following list:

items: Acid and Poison
Bludgeoning and Necrotic
Cold and Fire

entries: When the initiated uses the Arcane Burst action, it can choose to change the attack's damage type from Force to one of the two selected damage types.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The initiated makes three Arcane Burst attacks.

action.name: Arcane Burst
entries: {@atk ms,rs} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 3d8 + 4}) Force damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The initiated casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 15}):

bonus.name: Malignant Transposition (3/Day)
entries: The initiated creates clouds in a 5-ft radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} in its space and in up to three additional spaces it can see within 60 feet. The Spheres are {@variantrule Heavily Obscured|XPHB} except to the initiated. The Spheres last until the start of the initiate's next turn, or they can be dispersed by a strong wind.

When the clouds appear, the initiated can target one creature in one cloud with the following effect. {@actSave cha} {@dc 15}. {@actSaveFail} The creature swaps places with the initiated. The initiated can also teleport themselves to an unoccupied space within one of the other clouds.

reaction.name: Arcane Reflection (3/Day)
entries: The initiated casts {@spell Shield|XPHB} in response to the spell's trigger, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting. If the triggering attack misses and it is a spell or {@variantrule Magical Effect|XPHB}, the initiated can immediately end the {@spell Shield|XPHB} spell to have the triggering attack target another creature within range of the spell's originator.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The enforcer makes two attacks using their Dagger and Fighting Chain in any combination.

action.name: Dagger
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Fighting Chain
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 12}). The enforcer can only have one creature grappled by its fighting chain.

bonus.name: Strangle
entries: The enforcer deals 4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) Bludgeoning damage to a target {@condition Grappled|XPHB} by its {@item Fighting Chain|GrimHollowPG24}, and the target is unable to speak until the start of the enforcer's next turn or until it is no longer {@condition Grappled|XPHB}.

trait.name: Customized Poison
entries: The assassin prepares and applies specialized poisons to its weapons. The first time each turn that the assassin deals weapon damage to a creature, choose one of the following:

items.name: Abduction
items.entry: {@actSave wis} {@dc 15}. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Unconscious|XPHB} condition for 1 minute. The condition ends if the target takes damage or a creature within 5 feet of it takes an action to wake it. {@actSaveSuccess} The target has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn.

items.name: Annihilation
items.entry: The target takes 28 ({@damage 8d6}) Poison damage.

items.name: Debilitation
items.entry: The target takes 17 ({@damage 5d6}) Poison damage, and has the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition until the start of the assassin's next turn.

items.name: Suffocation
items.entry: The target has the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition for 1 minute. While {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} in this way, the target can't speak or breathe.

trait.name: Evasion
entries: If the assassin is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, the assassin instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the save and only half damage if it fails. It can't use this trait if it has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The assassin makes three attacks using its Daggers or one attack using its Heavy Crossbow.

action.name: Dagger
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 4d4 + 5}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Heavy Crossbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 9} to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. {@h}27 ({@damage 4d10 + 5}) Piercing damage.

bonus.name: Cunning Action

reaction.name: Smoke Bomb (2/Day)
entries: {@actTrigger} The assassin takes damage from another creature. {@actResponse} The assassin creates smoke in a 20-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere}. The area becomes {@variantrule Heavily Obscured|XPHB} for 1 minute or until dispersed by a strong wind. As part of this {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB}, the assassin can move up to its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} and take the {@action Hide|XPHB} action.

entries: The Veteran can don or doff its {@item Shield|XPHB} whenever it changes weapons.

trait.name: Group Discipline
entries: The Veteran has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on all saving throws if at least one of its allies is within 5 feet and both the Veteran and the ally don't have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Longbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 4} to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) Piercing damage.

reaction.name: Tactical Response

trait.name: Silver Tongue
entries: The Trade Factor has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on {@skill Deception|XPHB}, {@skill Insight|XPHB}, and {@skill Persuasion|XPHB} checks when discussing trade deals or contracts.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Trade Factor makes two attacks using its Rapier.

action.name: Rapier
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) Piercing damage, plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) Poison damage.

bonus.name: Gold Talks
entries: The Trade Factor throws 10 GP to creature within 30 feet. The creature must succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw or gain the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition until the end of the factor's next turn.

reaction.name: Paper Shield (1/Day)
entries: {@actTrigger} A creature that the Trade Factor can see makes an attack roll against the factor. {@actResponse} The Trade Factor produces a legal document sealed with a magical ward and imposes {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on the attacker's roll.

trait.name: Academic Specialty
entries: The Preceptor has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on all ability checks using their chosen specialty and gains {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to a type of damage.

items: Biothurge, Master of Warbreed: Medicine, Poison
Blastwright, Master of Machines: Arcana, Fire
Decosopher, Master of Alchemy: Nature, Acid

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Preceptor makes three Scalpel attacks. It can replace one Scalpel attack with an Acid Flask, Incendiary Bomb, or Neurotoxic Cloud.

action.name: Scalpel
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d4 + 5}) Slashing damage, plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Poison damage.

action.name: Acid Flask (Decosopher)
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) Acid damage and 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Acid damage at the end of the target's next turn.

action.name: Incendiary Bomb (Blastwright)
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., {@h}18 ({@damage 4d8}) Fire damage and the target has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Neurotoxic Cloud (Biothurge)
entries: Targets in a 20-ft. Cone take 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Necrotic damage and have the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition for 1 minute. If the target succeeds on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw, it takes half damage and is not {@condition Poisoned|XPHB}.

bonus.name: Impromptu Golem (Biothurge, 1/Day)
entries: The biothurge turns a twisted mass spare bodies parts into a {@b {@creature Zombie|XMM}}. The zombie lasts until the end of the biothurge's next turn or until it is destroyed. The biothurge can use a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to extend the duration for 1 round.

bonus.name: Latent Decoction (Decosopher, 1/Day)
entries: The decosopher activates a potion stored in its blood stream. The decosopher is affected by its choice of: {@i Haste, Healing (Superior), Speed, or Water Breathing}.

bonus.name: Magitek Interference (Blastwright, 1/Day)
entries: The blastwright enjoins a magical item or golem to cease functioning until the beginning of the blastwright's next turn. If the item is held or is a creature, a successful {@dc 17} Intelligence saving throw resists the interference.

items.name: Academic Specialty: Master of Warbreed
entries: The Preceptor has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on all ability checks using {@skill Medicine|XPHB}  and gains {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Poison.

items.name: Academic Specialty: Master of Machines
entries: The Preceptor has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on all ability checks using {@skill Arcana|XPHB}  and gains {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Fire.

items.name: Academic Specialty: Master of Alchemy
entries: The Preceptor has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on all ability checks using {@skill Nature|XPHB}  and gains {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Acid.

trait.name: Bolstering Presence
entries: The biomancer magically emanates life-giving energy within 30 feet of itself. Any ally of the biomancer that starts its turn there regains 5 ({@dice 1d10}) hit points.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The biomancer has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Scimitar
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) slashing damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Zegana is a 15th-level Simic spellcaster. Her spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save {@dc 18}, {@hit 10} to hit with spell attacks). She has the following wizard spells prepared:

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: Zegana can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If Zegana fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Zegana has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Prime Speaker's Trident
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) piercing damage, and the trident emits a thunderous boom. Each creature in a 15-foot cube originating from the prongs of the trident must make a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 9 ({@damage 2d8}) thunder damage and is pushed 10 feet away from Zegana. If the creature is underwater, the damage is increased to 13 ({@dice 3d8}). On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and isn't pushed.

action.name: Deluge {@recharge 4}
entries: Zegana conjures a wave of water that crashes down on an area within 120 feet of her. The area can be up to 30 feet long, up to 10 feet wide, and up to 10 feet tall. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 18 ({@damage 4d8}) bludgeoning damage and is knocked {@condition prone}. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't knocked {@condition prone}. The water spreads out across the ground, extinguishing unprotected flames it comes in contact with, and then vanishes.

legendary.name: Adaptive Skin
entries: Zegana gains resistance to one damage type of her choice-acid, fire, lightning, or thunder-until the start of her next turn.

legendary.name: Trident
entries: Zegana makes one melee attack with the Prime Speaker's Trident.

legendary.name: Enlarge (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Zegana casts {@spell enlarge/reduce} on herself, using the enlarge option, without expending a spell slot.

legendary.name: Deluge (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: Zegana uses Deluge, if available.

trait.name: Speak with Beasts
entries: The horncaller can communicate with beasts as if they shared a language.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The horncaller makes two melee attacks with its staff and uses One with the Worldsoul.

action.name: Staff
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d6 + 1}) piercing damage, or 5 ({@damage 1d8 + 1}) bludgeoning damage if used with two hands.

action.name: One with the Worldsoul
entries: The horncaller chooses one beast it can see within 30 feet of it. If the beast can hear the horncaller, the beast uses its reaction to make one melee attack against a target that the horncaller can see.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If Trostani fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Trostani has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: Trostani's weapon attacks are magical.

trait.name: Speak with Beasts and Plants
entries: Trostani can communicate with beasts and plants as if they shared a language.

trait.name: Tree Stride
entries: Once on her turn, Trostani can use 10 feet of her movement to step magically into one living tree within her reach and emerge from a second living tree within 60 feet of the first tree, appearing in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the second tree. Both trees must be Large or bigger.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Trostani takes three actions: she uses Constrict and Touch of Order, and she casts a spell with a casting time of 1 action.

action.name: Constrict
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}15 ({@damage 3d6 + 5}) bludgeoning damage, and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 19}). Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained}. Trostani can grapple no more than three targets at a time.

action.name: Touch of Order
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 16} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}23 ({@damage 3d8 + 10}) radiant damage, and Trostani can choose one magic item she can see in the target's possession. Unless it's an artifact, the item's magic is suppressed until the start of Trostani's next turn.

action.name: Wrath of Mat'Selesnya {@recharge 5}
entries: Trostani conjures a momentary whirl of branches and vines at a point she can see within 60 feet of her. Each creature in a 30-foot cube on that point must make a {@dc 24} Dexterity saving throw, taking 21 ({@damage 6d6}) bludgeoning damage and 21 ({@damage 6d6}) slashing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

legendary.name: Voice of Harmony
entries: Trostani makes one melee attack, with advantage on the attack roll.

legendary.name: Voice of Life
entries: Trostani bestows 20 temporary hit points on another creature she can see within 120 feet of her.

legendary.name: Voice of Order
entries: Trostani casts {@spell dispel magic}.

legendary.name: Chorus of the Conclave (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Trostani casts {@spell suggestion}. This counts as one of her daily uses of the spell.

legendary.name: Awaken Grove Guardians (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: Trostani animates one or two trees she can see within 120 feet of her, causing them to uproot themselves and become awakened trees (see the Monster Manual for their stat blocks) for 1 minute or until Trostani uses a bonus action to end the effect. These trees understand Druidic and obey Trostani's spoken commands, but can't speak. If she issues no commands to them, the trees do nothing but follow her and take the {@action Dodge} action.

action.name: Club
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 2} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}2 ({@damage 1d4}) bludgeoning damage.

languages: Abyssal plus any one language (usually Common)

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The witch's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 15}, {@hit 7} to hit with spell attacks). The witch can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

trait.name: Blood Witch Dance
entries: The witch can use a bonus action to control the movement of one creature cursed by its {@spell hex} spell that it can see within 30 feet of it. The creature must succeed on a {@dc 15} Charisma saving throw or use its reaction to move up to 30 feet in a direction of the witch's choice.

trait.name: Devil's Sight
entries: Magical darkness doesn't impede the witch's darkvision.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The witch makes two attacks: one with its longsword and one with its shortsword.

action.name: Longsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) slashing damage.

action.name: Shortsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: Rakdos's spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 25}). He can innately cast {@spell hellish rebuke} (at 5th level) at will, requiring no material components.

trait.name: Captivating Presence
entries: Any creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of Rakdos must make a {@dc 25} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature becomes {@condition charmed} by Rakdos for 1 minute or until the creature is farther than 30 feet away from him. On a successful save, the creature becomes immune to Rakdos's Captivating Presence for 24 hours.

trait.name: Cruel Entertainment
entries: When a creature Rakdos can see within 60 feet of him is reduced to 0 hit points, Rakdos gains 25 temporary hit points.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If Rakdos fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Rakdos has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: Rakdos's weapon attacks are magical.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Rakdos makes two attacks with his Curtain-Call Scythe or his claws.

action.name: Curtain-Call Scythe
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 15} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}24 ({@damage 3d10 + 8}) slashing damage plus 13 ({@damage 3d8}) fire damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 15} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 2d8 + 8}) slashing damage.

legendary.name: Sadistic Revelry
entries: Each creature within 60 feet of Rakdos that is his ally or is {@condition charmed} by him must use its reaction to move up to half its speed toward the creature closest to it that it can see, provided it isn't already within 5 feet of that creature. It then must make one melee attack against that creature if it is able to do so.

legendary.name: Scythe (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Rakdos uses Curtain-Call Scythe.

legendary.name: Touch of Pain (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: Rakdos makes a claw attack against one creature within 10 feet of him. The target must succeed on a {@dc 25} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} for 1 minute. While {@condition poisoned} in this way, the creature can't maintain {@status concentration} on a spell or any other effect that requires {@status concentration}. The {@condition poisoned} creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

name: Obzedat Ghost

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The ghost's innate spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save {@dc 16}, {@hit 8} to hit with spell attacks). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no components:
will: {@spell chill touch} (at 5th level, and the ghost regains hit points equal to half the amount of damage the target takes)

trait.name: Council of Five
entries: The ghost has a trait based on who it is, as shown below:

items.name: Enezesku: Enfeebling Ray
items.entry: Enezesku's Innate Spellcasting trait includes {@spell ray of enfeeblement}, which he can cast at will.

items.name: Fautomni: Undead Fortitude
items.entry: If damage reduces Fautomni to 0 hit points, he must make a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 5 + the damage taken, unless the damage is radiant or from a critical hit. On a success, Fautomni drops to 1 hit point instead.

items.name: Karlov: Unnatural Vigor
items.entry: When Karlov regains hit points, he has advantage on attack rolls he makes on his next turn.

items.name: Vuliev: Teleportation
items.entry: Vuliev's Innate Spellcasting trait includes {@spell misty step}, which he can cast at will.

items.name: Xil Xaxosz: Lingering Spite
items.entry: When Xil Xaxosz is reduced to 0 hit points, his incorporeal form explodes in a burst of necrotic energy. Each creature within 5 feet of him must make a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw, taking 14 ({@damage 4d6}) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

trait.name: Ethereal Sight
entries: The ghost can see 60 feet into the Ethereal Plane when it is on the Material Plane, and vice versa.

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The ghost can move through other creatures and objects as if they were {@quickref difficult terrain||3}. It takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (1/Day)

Any creature that comes within 30 feet of the moving wurm for the first time on a turn must succeed on a {@dc 20} Dexterity saving throw or take 10 ({@damage 3d6}) bludgeoning damage and fall {@condition prone}. Any structure or object anchored to the ground that comes within 30 feet of the moving wurm for the first time on a turn takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) force damage.

trait.name: Tunneler
entries: The wurm can burrow through solid rock at half its burrow speed and leaves a 10-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}24 ({@damage 5d6 + 7}) piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 20} Dexterity saving throw or be swallowed by the wurm. A swallowed creature is {@condition blinded} and {@condition restrained}, has {@quickref Cover||3||total cover} against attacks and other effects outside the wurm, and takes 17 ({@damage 5d6}) acid damage at the start of each of the wurm's turns. If the wurm takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the wurm must succeed on a {@dc 21} Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall {@condition prone} in a space within 10 feet of the wurm. If the wurm dies, a swallowed creature is no longer {@condition restrained} by it and can escape from the corpse by using 20 feet of movement, exiting {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Shadow Stealth
entries: While in dim light or darkness, the vampire can take the {@action Hide} action as a bonus action.

The target's hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken, and the vampire regains hit points equal to that amount. The reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if its hit point maximum is reduced to 0.

The target must make a {@dc 14} Intelligence saving throw, with disadvantage if the vampire has previously consumed the target's blood. On a failed save, the target takes 28 ({@damage 8d6}) psychic damage, and the vampire discerns the target's surface emotions and thoughts. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage, and the vampire discerns the target's general emotional state but not its thoughts.

entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft. or range 60/240 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 3d6 + 7}) piercing damage, or 20 ({@damage 3d8 + 7}) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

reaction.name: Protection
entries: When an attacker the giant can see makes an attack roll against a creature within 10 feet of the giant, the giant can impose disadvantage on the attack roll.

action.name: Chain
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 3d6 + 6}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 17}). Until the grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained}, and the giant can't use this attack on anyone else.

action.name: Rock
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 9} to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 3d6 + 6}) bludgeoning damage.

reaction.name: Furious Defense
entries: After a creature the giant can see is dealt damage by a foe within 20 feet of the giant, the giant makes a chain attack against that foe.

name: Felidar
languages: understands Celestial and Common but can't speak

trait.name: Bonding
entries: The felidar can magically bond with one creature it can see, right after spending at least 1 hour observing that creature while within 30 feet of it. The bond lasts until the felidar bonds with a different creature or until the bonded creature dies. This bond has the following effects: The felidar and the bonded creature can communicate telepathically with each other at a distance of up to 100 feet. The felidar can sense the direction and distance to the bonded creature if they're on the same plane of existence. As an action, the felidar or the bonded creature can sense what the other sees and hears, during which time it loses its own sight and hearing. This effect lasts until the start of its next turn.

trait.name: Keen Hearing and Sight
entries: The felidar has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on hearing or sight.

trait.name: Pounce
entries: If the felidar moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and hits it with a claw attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}. If the target is {@condition prone}, the felidar can make one claw attack against it as a bonus action.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The felidar makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 3d8 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 3d6 + 4}) slashing damage.

variant.name: Winged Felidars
entries: Some felidars boast huge, feathered wings. A winged felidar uses the same stat block as an ordinary felidar, with the addition of a flying speed of 40 feet.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The lich is a 14th-level Golgari spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save {@dc 17}, {@hit 9} to hit with spell attacks). The lich has the following wizard spells prepared:

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the lich fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The lich regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn. If the lich takes fire or radiant damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the lich's next turn. The lich dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

trait.name: Turn Resistance
entries: The lich has advantage on saving throws against any effect that turns undead.

trait.name: Undead Fortitude
entries: If damage reduces the lich to 0 hit points, it must make a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 5 + the damage taken, unless the damage is radiant or from a critical hit. On a success, the lich drops to 1 hit point instead.

action.name: Noxious Touch
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}14 ({@damage 4d6}) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} for 1 minute. The {@condition poisoned} target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

legendary.name: Cantrip
entries: The lich casts one of its cantrips.

legendary.name: Noxious Touch (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The lich uses Noxious Touch.

legendary.name: Disrupt Life (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: Each creature within 30 feet of the lich must make a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw, taking 21 ({@damage 6d6}) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The sire's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 18}, {@hit 10} to hit with spell attacks). The sire can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

trait.name: Aura of Mind Erosion
entries: Any creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of the sire must make a {@dc 18} Wisdom saving throw. On a successful save, the creature is immune to this aura for the next 24 hours. On a failed save, the creature has disadvantage for 1 minute on Wisdom and Charisma checks and on Wisdom and Charisma saves. At the start of each of its turns, the sire can suppress this aura until the start of its next turn.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The sire has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The sire makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}25 ({@damage 3d12 + 6}) piercing damage plus 16 ({@damage 3d10}) psychic damage.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 1d8 + 6}) slashing damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) psychic damage.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The master's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 17}). The master can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

trait.name: Aura of Blood Lust
entries: When any other creature starts its turn within 30 feet of the master, that creature must succeed on a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw, or it must immediately take the Attack action, making one melee attack against a random creature within reach. If no creatures are within reach, it makes a ranged attack against a random creature within range, throwing its weapon if necessary.

trait.name: Feed on the Crowd
entries: Whenever a creature within 60 feet of the master dies, the master gains 15 temporary hit points and has advantage on all attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The master has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The master makes two melee attacks with its spear.

action.name: Spear
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) piercing damage, or 13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack, plus 13 ({@damage 3d8}) psychic damage.

action.name: Captivating Presence {@recharge}
entries: Each creature within 120 feet of the master must succeed on a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition charmed} by the master for 1 hour. While {@condition charmed} in this way, a creature's speed is 0. If the {@condition charmed} creature takes damage, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success. A target that succeeds on the saving throw is immune to the Captivating Presence of all masters of cruelties for the next 24 hours.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The cackler's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 11}, {@hit 3} to hit with spell attacks). The cackler can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

trait.name: Last Laugh
entries: When the cackler dies, it releases a dying laugh that scars the minds of other nearby creatures. Each creature within 10 feet of the cackler must succeed on a {@dc 11} Wisdom saving throw or take 2 ({@damage 1d4}) psychic damage.

trait.name: Mimicry
entries: The cackler can mimic any sounds it has heard, including voices. A creature that hears the sounds can tell they are imitations with a successful {@dc 11} Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) check.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Spiked Chain
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) slashing damage.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The dryad's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 17}). The dryad can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The dryad has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Speak with Beasts and Plants
entries: The dryad can communicate with beasts and plants as if they and the dryad shared a language.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dryad makes three attacks, using its vine staff, its longbow, or both.

action.name: Vine Staff
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw or become {@condition restrained} by twisting vines for 1 minute. A target {@condition restrained} in this way can use an action to make a {@dc 17} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) or Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics}) check, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Longbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 8} to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Summon Mount (1/Day)
entries: The dryad magically summons a mount, which appears in an unoccupied space within 60 feet of the dryad. The mount remains for 8 hours, until it or the dryad dies, or until the dryad dismisses it as an action. The mount uses the stat block of an {@creature elk} (see the Monster Manual) with these changes: it is a plant instead of a beast, it has an Intelligence of 6, and it understands Sylvan but can't speak. While within 1 mile of the mount, the dryad can communicate with it telepathically.

action.name: Suppress Magic {@recharge 5}
entries: The dryad targets one magic item it can see within 120 feet of it. If the magic item isn't an artifact, its magical properties are suppressed for 10 minutes, until the dryad is {@condition incapacitated} or dies, or until the dryad uses a bonus action to end the effect.

trait.name: Flyby
entries: The arclight phoenix doesn't provoke an opportunity attack when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

trait.name: Grounded Lightning
entries: The first time on a turn that the arclight phoenix touches the ground, it takes 11 ({@damage 2d10}) force damage.

trait.name: Illumination
entries: The arclight phoenix sheds bright light in a 15-foot radius and dim light for an additional 15 feet.

trait.name: Lightning Form
entries: The arclight phoenix can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing. A creature that touches the phoenix or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 9 ({@damage 2d8}) lightning damage. In addition, the arclight phoenix can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. The first time it enters a creature's space on a turn, that creature takes 9 ({@damage 2d8}) lightning damage.

trait.name: Crackling Death
entries: When the arclight phoenix dies, it explodes. Each creature within 30 feet of it must make a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw, taking 36 ({@damage 8d8}) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The explosion destroys the phoenix but leaves behind a Tiny, warm egg with a mizzium shell. The egg contains the embryo of a new arclight phoenix. It hatches when it is in the area of a spell that deals lightning damage, or if a creature touches the egg and expends spell slots whose combined levels equal 13 or more. When it hatches, the egg releases a new arclight phoenix that appears in the egg's space.

action.name: Arclight Touch
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}27 ({@damage 6d8}) lightning damage, and lightning jumps from the target to one creature of the phoenix's choice that it can see within 30 feet of the target. That second creature must succeed on a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw or take 27 ({@damage 6d8}) lightning damage.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The angel's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 19}, {@hit 11} to hit with spell attacks). The angel can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

trait.name: Exploitation of the Debtors
entries: As a bonus action, the angel targets a creature {@condition charmed} by it that it can see within 30 feet of it. The angel deals 11 ({@damage 2d10}) necrotic damage to the target, and the angel gains temporary hit points equal to the damage dealt.

trait.name: Flyby
entries: The angel doesn't provoke an opportunity attack when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The angel has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The angel makes two attacks with its scythe. It can substitute Chains of Obligation for one of these attacks.

action.name: Scythe
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d4 + 4}) slashing damage plus 27 ({@damage 6d8}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Chains of Obligation
entries: The angel targets one creature {@condition charmed} by it that it can see within 90 feet of it. The target must succeed on a {@dc 19} Charisma saving throw or become {@condition paralyzed} for 1 minute or until it takes any damage.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The archon's innate spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save {@dc 18}, {@hit 10} to hit with spell attacks). The archon can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

trait.name: Eye of the Law
entries: As a bonus action, the archon can target a creature it can see within 120 feet of it and determine which laws that creature has broken in the last 24 hours.

trait.name: Mount
entries: If the archon isn't mounted, it can use a bonus action to magically teleport onto the creature serving as its mount, provided the archon and its mount are on the same plane of existence. When it teleports, the archon appears astride the mount along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying. While mounted and not {@condition incapacitated}, the archon can't be {@status surprised}, and both it and its mount gain advantage on Dexterity saving throws. If the archon is reduced to 0 hit points while riding its mount, the mount is reduced to 0 hit points as well.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The archon makes two Hammer of Justice attacks.

action.name: Hammer of Justice
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) bludgeoning damage plus 18 ({@damage 4d8}) force damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 18} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Pacifying Presence
entries: Each creature of the archon's choice that the archon can see within 120 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 18} Wisdom saving throw, or else the target drops any weapons it is holding, ends its {@status concentration} on any spells or other effects, and becomes {@condition charmed} by the archon for 1 minute. The {@condition charmed} creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the archon's Pacifying Presence for the next 24 hours.

legendary.name: Rejoin Mount
entries: If the archon isn't mounted, it magically teleports to its steed and mounts it as long as the archon and its steed are on the same plane of existence.

legendary.name: Smite (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The archon makes a Hammer of Justice attack, and then its mount can use its reaction to make a melee weapon attack.

legendary.name: Detention (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: The archon targets a creature it can see within 60 feet of it. The target must succeed on a {@dc 18} Charisma saving throw or be magically teleported to a harmless demiplane until the end of the archon's next turn, whereupon the target reappears in the space it left or the nearest unoccupied space if that space is occupied.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The angel's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 18}, {@hit 10} to hit with spell attacks). The angel can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

trait.name: Flyby
entries: The angel doesn't provoke an opportunity attack when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The angel has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Relentless (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: If the angel takes 21 damage or less that would reduce it to 0 hit points, it is reduced to 1 hit point instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The angel makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Longsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 1d8 + 6}) slashing damage, or 11 ({@damage 1d10 + 6}) slashing damage if used with two hands, plus 22 ({@damage 5d8}) fire or radiant damage (angel's choice).

trait.name: Flyby
entries: The angel doesn't provoke an opportunity attack when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The angel has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The angel makes two melee attacks. It also uses Battlefield Inspiration.

action.name: Longsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) slashing damage, or 8 ({@damage 1d10 + 3}) slashing damage if used with two hands, plus 18 ({@damage 4d8}) radiant damage. If the target is within 5 feet of any of the angel's allies, the target takes an extra 2 ({@damage 1d4}) radiant damage.

action.name: Battlefield Inspiration
entries: The angel chooses up to three creatures it can see within 30 feet of it. Until the end of the angel's next turn, each target can add a {@dice d4} to its attack rolls and saving throws.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The merfolk can breathe air and water.

action.name: Spear
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 2} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}3 ({@damage 1d6}) piercing damage, or 4 ({@damage 1d8}) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The sphinx is a 9th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save {@dc 16}, {@hit 8} to hit with spell attacks). It requires no material components to cast its spells. The sphinx has the following wizard spells prepared:

trait.name: Inscrutable
entries: The sphinx is immune to any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, as well as any divination spell that it refuses. Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) checks made to ascertain the sphinx's intentions or sincerity have disadvantage.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The sphinx's weapon attacks are magical.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The sphinx makes two claw attacks.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) slashing damage.

legendary.name: Claw Attack
entries: The sphinx makes one claw attack.

legendary.name: Teleport (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The sphinx magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

legendary.name: Cast a Spell (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: The sphinx casts a spell from its list of prepared spells, using a spell slot as normal.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting (Psionics)
headerEntries: The dragon casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 14}):

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The dragon can breathe both air and water.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dragon makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d10 + 3}) piercing damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) slashing damage.

action.name: Desiccating Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: The dragon exhales yellowish necrotic energy in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 28 ({@damage 8d6}) necrotic damage and is weakened until the end of its next turn. A weakened creature has disadvantage on Strength-based ability checks and Strength saving throws, and the creature's weapon attacks that rely on Strength deal half damage. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and isn't weakened.

variant.name: Customizing Dragons
entries: You can customize any dragon's stat block to reflect the dragon's unique character. Minor changes such as those below are easy to make and have no impact on a dragon's challenge rating.

entries.name: Languages
entries: Most dragons prefer to speak Draconic but learn Common for dealing with allies and minions. But given their high Intelligence and long life span, dragons can easily learn additional languages. You can add languages to a dragon's stat block.

entries.name: Skills
entries: Most dragons are proficient in the {@skill Perception} and {@skill Stealth} skills, and many dragons have additional skill proficiencies. As with languages, you can customize a dragon's skill list (even doubling their proficiency bonus with certain skills) to reflect particular interests and activities. You can also give a dragon tool proficiencies, particularly if the dragon spends time in Humanoid form.

entries.name: Other Traits and Actions
entries: You can borrow traits and actions from other monsters to add unique flavor to a dragon. Consider these examples:

items.name: Change Shape
entries: You can decide that a dragon acquires this action at a younger age than usual, particularly if you want to feature a dragon in Humanoid form in your campaign:

The dragon magically polymorphs into a humanoid or beast that has a challenge rating no higher than its own, or back into its true form. It reverts to its true form if it dies. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying is absorbed or borne by the new form (the dragon's choice).

In a new form, the dragon retains its alignment, hit points, Hit Dice, ability to speak, proficiencies, Legendary Resistance, lair actions, and Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores, as well as this action. Its statistics and capabilities are otherwise replaced by those of the new form, except any class features or legendary actions of that form.

items.name: Flyby
entries: The dragon is an agile flier, quick to fly out of enemies' reach.
The dragon doesn't provoke an opportunity attack when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

items.name: Mimicry
entries: Impersonating characters or their allies could be a fun trick for a crafty dragon.
The dragon can mimic any sounds it has heard, including voices. A creature that hears the sounds can tell they are imitations with a successful {@dc 11} Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) check.

items.name: Rejuvenation
entries: You might decide that dragons in your campaign, being an essential part of the Material Plane, are nearly impossible to destroy. A dragon's life essence might be preserved in the egg from which it first emerged, in its hoard, or in a cavernous hall at the center of the world, just as a lich's essence is hidden in a phylactery.

If it has an essence-preserving object, a destroyed dragon gains a new body in {@dice 1d10} days, regaining all its hit points and becoming active again. The new body appears within 5 feet of the object.

items.name: Special Senses
entries: Most dragons have {@sense blindsight} and {@sense darkvision}. You might upgrade {@sense blindsight} to {@sense truesight}, or you could give a dragon with a burrowing speed {@sense tremorsense|MM}.

legendary.name: Claw

legendary.name: Psionics (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The dragon uses Psychic Step or Spellcasting.

legendary.name: Essential Reduction (Costs 3 Actions)

In a new form, the dragon retains its alignment, hit points, Hit Dice, ability to speak, proficiencies, Legendary Resistance, lair actions, and Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores, as well as this action. Its statistics and capabilities are otherwise replaced by those of the new form, except any class features or legendary actions of that form.

items.name: Flyby
entries: The dragon is an agile flier, quick to fly out of enemies' reach.
The dragon doesn't provoke an opportunity attack when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

items.name: Mimicry
entries: Impersonating characters or their allies could be a fun trick for a crafty dragon.
The dragon can mimic any sounds it has heard, including voices. A creature that hears the sounds can tell they are imitations with a successful {@dc 13} Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) check.

items.name: Rejuvenation
entries: You might decide that dragons in your campaign, being an essential part of the Material Plane, are nearly impossible to destroy. A dragon's life essence might be preserved in the egg from which it first emerged, in its hoard, or in a cavernous hall at the center of the world, just as a lich's essence is hidden in a phylactery.

If it has an essence-preserving object, a destroyed dragon gains a new body in {@dice 1d10} days, regaining all its hit points and becoming active again. The new body appears within 5 feet of the object.

items.name: Special Senses
entries: Most dragons have {@sense blindsight} and {@sense darkvision}. You might upgrade {@sense blindsight} to {@sense truesight}, or you could give a dragon with a burrowing speed {@sense tremorsense|MM}.

items.name: Tunneler
entries: The dragon can burrow through solid rock at half its burrowing speed and leaves a tunnel in its wake.
