spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Zlan casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 19}):

spellcasting.name: Counterspell
headerEntries: Zlan casts {@spell Counterspell|XPHB} in response to the spell's trigger, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

trait.name: Chardalyn Sense
entries: Zlan senses the emotions of anyone touching a piece of chardalyn within 100 miles of itself.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If Zlan fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Zlan has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Next of the Seven (6/Year)
entries: If Zlan dies within 100 miles of a piece of chardalyn at least 4 inches long, it re-forms from that piece of chardalyn in {@dice 1d10} days, regaining all its {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. The new body appears in the unoccupied space nearest to the piece of chardalyn, and another lich's mind in the body seizes psychic control of the body.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Zlan makes three attacks, using Slam or Bewildering Bolt in any combination. It can replace two attacks with a use of Spellcasting.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 11}, reach 10 ft. {@h}12 ({@damage 3d4 + 5}) Bludgeoning damage plus 22 ({@damage 4d10}) Necrotic damage.

action.name: Bewildering Bolt
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 11}, range 120 ft. {@h}27 ({@damage 4d10 + 5}) Psychic damage, and the target has the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn.

legendary.name: Retaliation
entries: Zlan makes one Slam or Bewildering Bolt attack.

legendary.name: Stoke Paranoia
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 19}, one creature Zlan can see within 30 feet (with {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} if the target is holding or wearing chardalyn). {@actSaveFail} 27 ({@damage 6d8}) Psychic damage and the target has the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition for 1 minute or until Zlan dies. While {@condition Charmed|XPHB}, the target doesn't act as an ally to any creature. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only. {@actSaveSuccessOrFail} Zlan can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Zhentilar makes two attacks, using Shortsword or Pistol in any combination. It can replace one attack with a use of Knock Down.

action.name: Shortsword
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4}, reach 5 ft. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) Piercing damage plus 2 ({@damage 1d4}) Poison damage.

action.name: Pistol
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 4}, range 80/320 ft. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d10 + 2}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Knock Down
entries: {@actSave str} {@dc 12}, one creature within 5 feet that the Zhentilar can see. {@actSaveFail} 4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The Zhentilar casts one of the following spells, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 13}):

trait.name: Aura of Dread
entries: Creatures in a 10-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the Zhentilar have their Speeds halved while in the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation}. The Zhentilar can designate creatures to be unaffected by the aura.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Zhentilar makes three attacks, using Dooming Blade or Oppressive Ray in any combination. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting.

action.name: Dooming Blade
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Necrotic damage.

action.name: Oppressive Ray
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 5}, range 90 ft. {@h}16 ({@damage 3d10}) Psychic damage.

trait.name: Flyby (Wyvern or Hybrid Form Only)
entries: The werewyvern doesn't provoke an {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB} action when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The werewyvern makes three attacks, using Javelin or Rend in any combination. It can replace one of these attacks with one Stinger attack.

action.name: Javelin (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 7}, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft. {@h}18 ({@damage 4d6 + 4}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Rend
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, reach 5 ft. {@h}18 ({@damage 4d6 + 4}) Slashing damage.

action.name: Stinger (Wyvern or Hybrid Form Only)
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, reach 5 ft. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) Piercing damage plus 16 ({@damage 3d10}) Poison damage, and the target has the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition until the start of the werewyvern's next turn. If the target is a Humanoid, it is subjected to the following effect. {@actSave con} {@dc 16}. {@actSaveFail} The target is cursed. If the cursed target drops to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, it instead becomes a Werewyvern under the DM's control and has 20 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. {@actSaveSuccess} The target is immune to this werewyvern's curse for 24 hours.

bonus.name: Shape-Shift
entries: The werewyvern shape-shifts into a Medium wyvern-humanoid hybrid or a Large wyvern, or it returns to its true humanoid form. Its game statistics, other than its size, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

spellcasting.name: Illusory Disguise
headerEntries: Valindra casts {@spell Disguise Self|XPHB}, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting. The spell lasts until Valindra drops to 30 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} or fewer or uses her Life-Rending Gaze Legendary Action. Intelligence ({@skill Investigation|XPHB}) checks made to discern her true appearance are made with {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}.

spellcasting.name: Protective Magic
headerEntries: Valindra casts {@spell Counterspell|XPHB} or {@spell Shield|XPHB} in response to the spell's trigger, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day or 5/Day in Lair)
entries: If Valindra fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Spirit Gem
entries: If destroyed, Valindra re-forms in {@dice 1d10} days if her spirit gem is intact, reviving with all her {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. The new body appears in an unoccupied space within her lair.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Valindra makes three attacks, using Eldritch Burst or Paralyzing Touch in any combination. She can replace two attacks with a use of Spellcasting to cast {@spell Lightning Bolt|XPHB} (level 5 version).

action.name: Eldritch Burst
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 12}, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. {@h}31 ({@damage 4d12 + 5}) Force damage.

action.name: Paralyzing Touch
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 12}, reach 5 ft. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) Cold damage, and the target has the {@condition Paralyzed|XPHB} condition until the start of Valindra's next turn.

action.name: Deathly Grasp {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 20}, each creature in a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from Valindra. {@actSaveFail 1} 39 ({@damage 6d12}) Force damage and the target has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition and repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically. Subsequent Failures: 39 ({@damage 6d12}) Necrotic damage, and Valindra gains 20 {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}.

legendary.name: Disrupt Life
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 20}, each creature that isn't Undead in a 20-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from Valindra. {@actSaveFail} 21 ({@damage 6d6}) Necrotic damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage. {@actSaveSuccessOrFail} Valindra can't take this action again until the start of her next turn.

legendary.name: Eldritch Jaunt
entries: Valindra makes one Eldritch Burst attack. Before or after the attack, Valindra can teleport up to 20 feet to an unoccupied space she can see.

legendary.name: Life-Rending Gaze
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 20}, one creature Valindra can see within 30 feet. {@actSaveFail} 22 ({@damage 4d10}) Necrotic damage, and the target has the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

action.name: Longbow (Humanoid Form Only)

entries: When the spore is subjected to Fire damage, each creature in a 5-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the spore takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Fire damage.

entries: The spore doesn't need to expend extra movement to move through {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB}.

entries: The spore makes four Tendril attacks. Alternatively, it makes two Tendril attacks and uses Consume once.

action.name: Tendril
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 10}, reach 20 ft. {@h}11 ({@damage 1d10 + 6}) Piercing damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Acid damage. If the target is Large or smaller, the spore pulls the target 5 feet straight toward itself.

action.name: Consume
entries: {@actSave str} {@dc 18}, one Large or smaller creature within 5 feet. {@actSaveFail} The target is pulled into the spore's space and has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 16}). spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The scion casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 20}):

spellcasting.name: Command
headerEntries: The scion casts {@spell Command|XPHB} (level 2 version), using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting. The scion can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

trait.name: Culling Aura
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 20}, each {@status Bloodied|XPHB} creature in a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the scion at the end of the scion's turn. {@actSaveFail} The target can't regain {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} until the start of the scion's next turn.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the scion fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The scion has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The scion makes two attacks, using Death Touch or Mindwrack Bolt in any combination.

action.name: Death Touch
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 12}, reach 5 ft. {@h}25 ({@damage 4d8 + 7}) Necrotic damage.

action.name: Mindwrack Bolt
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 12}, range 120 ft. {@h}21 ({@damage 6d6}) Psychic damage and the target has the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition until the start of the scion's next turn.

legendary.name: Attack
entries: The scion makes a Death Touch or Mindwrack Bolt attack.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The cultist casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 17}):

trait.name: Nearer to the Dead
entries: While {@status Bloodied|XPHB}, the cultist has {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} and {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} conditions.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The cultist makes three Necrotic Burst attacks.

action.name: Necrotic Burst
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 9}, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. {@h}27 ({@damage 5d10}) Necrotic damage and the target can't regain {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} until the end of the cultist's next turn.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The cultist casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 14}):

trait.name: Blood-Soaked Resolve
entries: While {@status Bloodied|XPHB}, the cultist has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The cultist makes three Cursed Blade attacks. It can replace one of these attacks with a use of Spellcasting.

action.name: Cursed Blade
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 7} (with {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} if the target doesn't have all its {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}), reach 5 ft. or range 20/80 ft. {@h}14 ({@damage 3d6 + 4}) Slashing damage. {@hom}The blade magically returns to the cultist's hand immediately after a ranged attack.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The cultist casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 16}):

trait.name: Determined Survivor
entries: The cultist regains 10 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} at the start of each of its turns if it is {@status Bloodied|XPHB} and has at least 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The cultist makes three attacks, using Gauntlet or Oppressive Burst in any combination. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting to cast {@spell Dominate Person|XPHB}, if available.

action.name: Gauntlet
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 8}, reach 5 ft. {@h}17 ({@damage 3d8 + 4}) Bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Oppressive Burst
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 8}, range 120 ft. {@h}16 ({@damage 2d10 + 5}) Psychic damage, and the target can't take Reactions until the start of the cultist's next turn.

reaction.name: Counterattack
entries: {@actTrigger} The cultist is hit by an attack roll. {@actResponse} The cultist makes one Gauntlet or Oppressive Burst attack against the triggering creature.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Biha Babir casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 17}):

2e: {@spell Control Water|XPHB} (Flood, Part Water, or Redirect Flow only)

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: Biha Babir can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Elemental Restoration
entries: If Biha Babir dies outside the Elemental Plane of Water, her body dissolves into brine, and she gains a new body in {@dice 1d4} days, reviving with all her {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} somewhere on the Plane of Water.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If Biha Babir fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Wishes
entries: Biha Babir knows the {@spell Wish|XPHB} spell but can cast it only on behalf of a non-genie creature who communicates a wish in a way Biha Babir can understand. If Biha Babir casts the spell for a creature, she suffers none of the spell's stress. Once Biha Babir has cast it three times, she can't do so again for 365 days.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Biha Babir makes two Marine Burst attacks. She can replace one of these attacks with a Tail attack.

action.name: Marine Burst
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 10}, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft. {@h}17 ({@damage 2d10 + 6}) Cold damage.

action.name: Tail (Marid Form Only)
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 10}, reach 15 ft. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d6 + 6}) Bludgeoning damage, and if the target is Huge or smaller, it has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

bonus.name: Fluid Form
entries: Biha Babir shape-shifts into a form resembling a Beast or Humanoid that is Medium or smaller, while retaining her game statistics (other than her size), or returns to her true marid form.

legendary.name: Misty Burst
entries: Biha Babir teleports to an unoccupied space she can see within 30 feet of herself and makes one Marine Burst attack.

legendary.name: Whirlpool
entries: {@actSave str} {@dc 18}, each creature in a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from Biha Babir. {@actSaveFail} 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Force damage, and the target is pulled 15 feet straight toward Biha Babir. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only. {@actSaveSuccessOrFail} Biha Babir can't use this action again until the start of her next turn.

trait.name: Amphibious (Sea Form Only)
entries: The beast breathes air and water.

trait.name: Divine Immortality
entries: If the beast dies, its body dissolves into black goo, and it gains a new body after {@dice 1d10} days, reviving with all its {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} in a place of Malar's choosing.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the beast fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The beast has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The beast regains 20 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} at the start of its turn. If the beast takes Radiant damage or damage from a {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB}, this trait doesn't function at the start of the beast's next turn. The beast dies only if it starts its turn with 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} and doesn't regenerate.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The beast makes three attacks, using Bite or Claws in any combination.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 9}, reach 5 ft. {@h}23 ({@damage 4d8 + 5}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Claws (Land or Sky Form Only)
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 9}, reach 5 ft. {@h}18 ({@damage 3d8 + 5}) Slashing damage. If the target is Large or smaller, it has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

bonus.name: Recuperative Shape-Shift
entries: The beast shape-shifts into its land form, sea form, or sky form and regains 9 ({@dice 2d8}) {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. Its game statistics are the same in each form, except where noted. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The aranea casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 12}):

trait.name: Spider Climb (Hybrid or Spider Form Only)
entries: The aranea can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Web Walker
entries: The aranea ignores movement restrictions caused by webs, and it knows the location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The aranea makes two attacks, using Bite, Slam, or Sling in any combination.

action.name: Bite (Hybrid or Spider Form Only)
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) Piercing damage plus 2 ({@damage 1d4}) Poison damage.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) Bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Sling (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 5}, range 30/120 ft. {@h}8 ({@damage 2d4 + 3}) Bludgeoning damage.

bonus.name: Shape-Shift
entries: The aranea shape-shifts into a humanoid form, into a humanoid-spider hybrid form, or back into its true spider form. Its game statistics are the same in each form, except where noted. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

trait.name: Increased Carrying Capacity
entries: The wonder can carry up to 100 pounds.

trait.name: Wind-Up Operation
entries: The wonder has the {@condition Unconscious|XPHB} condition until another creature winds it with the wonder's unique key for 1 minute. Once wound, the wonder operates for 24 hours or until a creature touches the wonder with its key as a {@action Utilize|XPHB} action to deactivate it, after which the wonder has the {@condition Unconscious|XPHB} condition until it is wound again.

bonus.name: Chime
entries: The wonder chirps a merry, metronomic tune. The wonder chooses one ally that it can see within 60 feet. Until the start of the wonder's next turn, the target has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on the next ability check it makes with a Musical Instrument or Tinker's Tools.

bonus.name: Sprint
entries: The wonder takes the {@action Dash|XPHB} action.

trait.name: Mechanical Determination
entries: If damage reduces the wonder to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, it makes a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 5 plus the damage taken unless the damage is Lightning or from a {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB}. On a successful save, the wonder drops to 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} instead.

trait.name: Wind-Up Operation
entries: The wonder has the {@condition Unconscious|XPHB} condition until another creature winds it with the wonder's unique key for 1 minute. Once wound, the wonder operates for 10 days or until a creature touches the wonder with its key as a {@action Utilize|XPHB} action to deactivate it, after which the wonder has the {@condition Unconscious|XPHB} condition until it is wound again.

trait.name: Exploit Opening (3/Day)
entries: When Vivienn makes an attack, she has advantage on the attack roll.

trait.name: Reckless
entries: At the start of her turn, Vivienn can gain advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls made during her turn, but attack rolls made against her have advantage until the start of her next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Vivienn makes three Godslayer Axe attacks.

action.name: Godslayer Axe
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 1d12 + 8}) slashing damage plus 4 ({@damage 1d8}) necrotic damage. If the target is a Celestial, they take an extra 18 ({@damage 4d8}) necrotic damage.

bonus.name: Draconic Rage (3/Day)
entries: Vivienn roars with the might of dragons, entering a rage that lasts for 1 minute or until she is {@condition incapacitated}. While raging, she gains the following benefits:

items: Her size becomes Large.
She has a +2 bonus to weapon damage rolls.
She has advantage on Strength ability checks and saving throws.
She has resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.

bonus.name: Ravenous Bite (Draconic Rage Only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 1d12 + 8}) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 19} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition frightened} of Vivienn for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting (Utility)
headerEntries: In addition to any other spells in this stat block, Draven can cast the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 19}):

trait.name: Exploit Opening (3/Day)
entries: When Draven makes an attack, he has advantage on the attack roll.

trait.name: Profane Sacrifice (1/Turn)
entries: When Draven hits a creature with a melee attack, he can sacrifice his vitality to empower the attack. The target's speed drops to 0 until the start of his next turn, and Draven takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) psychic damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Draven makes three Gloom Dagger attacks.

action.name: Gloom Dagger
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 1d4 + 8}) piercing damage plus 7 ({@damage 3d4}) necrotic damage, and Draven can move the target up to 10 feet horizontally. If the damage from this attack reduces a creature to 0 hit points, Draven regains a use of Blood of the Dragon.

action.name: Blood of the Dragon (1/Day)
entries: Draven boils the blood of up to three creatures he can see within 60 feet of him. Each target takes 33 ({@damage 6d10}) necrotic damage and must succeed on a {@dc 19} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn) and knocked {@condition prone}.

bonus.name: Creeping Dread
entries: Draven chooses a creature he can see within 30 feet of him in an area of dim light or darkness. The creature must succeed on a {@dc 19} Wisdom saving throw or move their speed in a direction chosen by Draven. A creature with advantage on saving throws against being {@condition frightened} has advantage on this saving throw, and a creature who can't be {@condition frightened} automatically succeeds on it.

trait.name: Forest Defense
entries: When Caithas is in forest terrain and is targeted by a ranged attack by an attacker he can see, the attack has disadvantage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Caithas makes three Scimitar or three Scaled Longbow attacks.

action.name: Scimitar
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d6 + 8}) slashing damage.

action.name: Scaled Longbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 11} to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 1d8 + 8}) piercing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature who hasn't attacked Caithas since the end of his last turn, he has advantage on the attack roll.

action.name: Manifestation {@recharge 5}
entries: Caithas calls on his connection with Qazyldrath, and the dragon manifests in Caithas's space and exhales dark energy in a 30-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a {@dc 19} Dexterity saving throw, taking 18 ({@damage 4d8}) acid damage plus 18 ({@damage 4d8}) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Additionally, that area is filled with magical darkness for 1 minute. A creature with darkvision can't see through this darkness, and supernatural light can't illuminate it. The manifestation of Qazyldrath then disappears.

bonus.name: Gaze of the Decay (1/Day)
entries: Caithas chooses a creature he can see within 60 feet of him, magically marking them for 24 hours. While Caithas and the marked creature are on the same plane of existence, he always knows the distance and direction to them. Additionally, a marked creature can't hide from him, and if the marked creature becomes {@condition invisible}, they gain no benefit from that condition against Caithas.

trait.name: Charm Resistant
entries: Athmia has advantage on saving throws she makes to avoid or end the {@condition charmed} condition on herself.

trait.name: Evasion
entries: If Athmia is subjected to an effect that allows her to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, she instead takes no damage if she succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if she fails.

trait.name: Mental Assault (1/Turn)
entries: When Athmia hits a creature with her Soul Blade attack, she can assault their mind. The target must succeed on a {@dc 19} Intelligence saving throw or expend one spell slot of the highest level available with no effect. A creature who fails this saving throw but can't expend a spell slot must instead spend 3 of their Hit Dice with no effect, or if they can't, take an extra 10 ({@damage 3d6}) psychic damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Athmia makes two Soul Blade attacks.

action.name: Soul Blade
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/60 ft., one target. {@h}25 ({@damage 5d6 + 8}) psychic damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 19} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} of Athmia until the end of her next turn.

action.name: Psychic Frenzy (1/Day)
entries: Athmia clouds the minds of her foes.

Each enemy within 60 feet of her must succeed on a {@dc 19} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition dazed|FleeMortals} until the start of her next turn. Athmia gains 5 temporary hit points for each creature who fails this save.

bonus.name: Cunning Action
entries: Athmia takes the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

bonus.name: Sun Eater's Gift (3/Day)
entries: While within 30 feet of Aronar, Athmia swaps places with him if he is willing.

reaction.name: Sun Eater's Mind (3/Day)
entries: When a creature Athmia can see within 60 feet of her makes a spell attack against her or casts a spell that requires her to make a saving throw, she can pierce their mind, and the next attack she makes against that creature is automatically a critical hit.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting (Utility)
headerEntries: In addition to any other spells in this stat block, Aronar can cast the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 19}):

trait.name: Charm Resistant
entries: Aronar has advantage on saving throws he makes to avoid or end the {@condition charmed} condition on himself.

trait.name: Delusions of Grandeur
entries: Whenever Aronar is affected by an effect (such as the {@spell hold person} spell) that allows him to make a saving throw at the end of his turn, he can also repeat that saving throw at the start of his turn. Additionally, whenever Aronar succeeds on a saving throw against an effect, he ends that effect on himself and any ally within 30 feet of him under the same effect.

trait.name: Sun Eater's Grace (3/Day)
entries: When Aronar is within 30 feet of Athmia and casts a spell that restores hit points to another creature, Athmia regains the same number of hit points.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Aronar makes three Divine Mace attacks, or he makes one Divine Mace attack and one God Complex attack.

action.name: Divine Mace
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 1d6 + 8}) bludgeoning damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) necrotic damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 19} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition blinded} until the start of their next turn.

action.name: God Complex (3/Day; 3rd-Level Spell)
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 11} to hit, range 120 ft., one target. {@h}28 ({@damage 8d6}) necrotic damage, and the next attack roll made against this target before the end of Aronar's next turn has advantage.

action.name: Cure Wounds (3/Day; 3rd-Level Spell)
entries: Aronar touches a creature and the target regains 21 ({@dice 3d8 + 8}) hit points.

bonus.name: Vainglory (3/Day; 3rd-Level Spell)
entries: A creature of Aronar's choice within 60 feet of him regains 15 ({@dice 3d4 + 8}) hit points.

reaction.name: Sun Eater's Soul (3/Day)
entries: When a creature Aronar can see within 30 feet of him is hit with an attack, he can halve the attack's damage dealt to them.

trait.name: Assassinate
entries: During his first turn, Scarlet has advantage on attack rolls against any creature who hasn't taken a turn.
The first hit Scarlet scores against a surprised creature is a critical hit.

trait.name: Sneak Attack (1/Turn)
entries: Scarlet deals an extra 14 ({@damage 4d6}) damage when he hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of Scarlet who isn't incapacitated and Scarlet doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Scarlet makes three Shadow Blade or three Shortbow attacks.

action.name: Shadow Blade
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d6 + 7}) necrotic damage. If a target is hit by two or more Shadow Blade attacks on a turn, they must succeed on a {@dc 18} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition blinded} until the end of their next turn.

action.name: Longbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 10} to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 1d8 + 7}) piercing damage.

action.name: Razor Garrote
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 1d8 + 7}) slashing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, they are {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 17}). Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained}, they take 22 ({@damage 5d8}) slashing damage at the start of each of their turns, and Scarlet can't attack another target.

action.name: Umbral Breath {@recharge}
entries: Scarlet exhales dark flame in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 28 ({@damage 8d6}) necrotic damage and is {@condition frightened} of Scarlet for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn). On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't {@condition frightened}.

bonus.name: Cunning Action
entries: Scarlet takes the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

trait.name: Exploit Opening (3/Day)
entries: When Radlee makes an attack, she has advantage on the attack roll.

trait.name: Sure-Footed
entries: Radlee has advantage on saving throws against being moved against her will or knocked {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Tactical Vigilance
entries: Radlee has advantage on initiative checks.
While she isn't {@condition incapacitated}, Radlee and each ally within 30 feet of her who can see or hear her can't be surprised.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Radlee makes three Halberd or three Longbow attacks. Alternatively, she makes one Halberd attack and uses Backswipe.

action.name: Halberd
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 1d10 + 7}) slashing damage.

action.name: Longbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 6} to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Backswipe
entries: Radlee swings her halberd's shaft at a creature within 5 feet of her. The target must succeed on a {@dc 18} Strength saving throw or take 16 ({@damage 3d10}) bludgeoning damage and be knocked {@condition prone}.

reaction.name: Protector
entries: When a creature Radlee can see within 10 feet of her attacks one of her allies, Radlee can make a Halberd attack against the attacker.

trait.name: Elf Glamour (1/Day)
entries: When a creature targets Ellan with an attack, power, or spell, the creature must succeed on a {@dc 18} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition charmed} by him until the end of his next turn (no action required).

trait.name: Resolute Aura
entries: While he is conscious, Ellan and any allies within 20 feet of him who can see him can't be {@condition charmed} or {@condition frightened}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Ellan makes two Bladed Scepter attacks.

action.name: Bladed Scepter
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 1d8 + 7}) bludgeoning damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).

action.name: Command (2nd-Level Spell)
entries: Ellan speaks a one-word command to up to two creatures he can see within 60 feet of him.

Each target must succeed on a {@dc 18} Wisdom saving throw or follow the command on their next turn. The spell has no effect if the target is Undead, doesn't understand Common or Elvish, or would be directly harmed by following the command. If the target can't follow Ellan's command, the spell ends. Some typical commands and their effects follow:

items.name: Approach
entries: The target moves toward Ellan by the shortest and most direct route, ending their turn if they move within 5 feet of Ellan.

items.name: Drop
entries: The target drops whatever they are holding and then ends their turn.

items.name: Flee
entries: The target spends their turn moving away from Ellan by the fastest available means.

items.name: Grovel
entries: The target falls {@condition prone} and then ends their turn.

items.name: Halt
entries: The target doesn't move and takes no actions.

action.name: Unholy Flame (3rd-Level Spell)
entries: Ellan conjures unholy fire around one creature he can see within 60 feet of him. The target must make a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 27 ({@damage 6d8}) fire damage and is enveloped (save ends at end of turn). While enveloped, a creature takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire damage at the start of each of their turns. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage and isn't enveloped.

trait.name: Charm Resistant
entries: Kishina has advantage on saving throws she makes to avoid or end the {@condition charmed} condition on herself.

trait.name: Light Landing
entries: Kishina takes no damage from falling.

trait.name: Standing Leap
entries: Kishina's long jump is up to 45 feet and her high jump is up to 15 feet, with or without a running start.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Kishina makes four Unarmed Strike attacks or three Throwing Knife attacks.

action.name: Unarmed Strike
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 1d8 + 7}) bludgeoning damage, or 20 ({@damage 3d8 + 7}) bludgeoning damage on a critical hit.

action.name: Throwing Knife
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 10} to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d4 + 7}) piercing damage.

action.name: Painful Sprint {@recharge}
entries: Kishina moves up to her speed without provoking opportunity attacks, hitting a pressure point on each enemy she can see who she passes within 5 feet of during this move. Each target must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throwing or be {@condition poisoned} until the start of their next turn. A creature who fails this save by 5 or more also falls {@condition prone}.

bonus.name: Throw
entries: Kishina attempts to throw a Large or smaller enemy she can see within 5 feet of her. The target must succeed on a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw or be moved up to 15 feet away from her and be knocked {@condition prone}.

reaction.name: Shield (3/Day; 1st-Level Spell)
entries: When Kishina is targeted by an attack or a {@spell magic missile} spell, she conjures an {@condition invisible} barrier of force. Until the start of her next turn, she gains a +5 bonus to AC, including against the triggering attack, and takes no damage from magic missile.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting (Utility)
headerEntries: In addition to any other spells in this stat block, Argan can cast the following spells, using Intelligence as his spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 18}):

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Argan has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Pervasive Magic
entries: Damage from Argan's spell attacks ignore the target's damage resistances.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Argan makes three Arcane Lance attacks.

action.name: Arcane Lance (Cantrip)
entries: {@atk ms,rs} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 90 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 5d6}) force damage, and Argan moves the target up to 15 feet horizontally.

action.name: Lightning Volley (3rd-Level Spell)
entries: Argan calls down lightning on up to three creatures he can see within 30 feet of him. Each target must make a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes 21 ({@damage 6d6}) lightning damage and their speed is halved until the end of their next turn. On a successful save, a target takes half as much damage and their speed is not halved.

action.name: Fireball (1/Day; 7th-Level Spell)
entries: Argan sculpts a fiery explosion centered on a point within 90 feet of him. Each creature of his choice in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must make a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw, taking 42 ({@damage 12d6}) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

bonus.name: Misty Step (2/Day; 2nd-Level Spell)
entries: Argan teleports up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space he can see.

trait.name: Exploit Opening (3/Day)
entries: When Victory makes an attack, she has advantage on the attack roll.

trait.name: Mind Link
entries: Victory can communicate telepathically with any Amethyst Knife boss regardless of distance, provided they are on the same plane of existence.

trait.name: Kinetic Buildup
entries: When Victory hits a creature with a melee weapon attack, her speed increases by a cumulative 5 feet and she gains one additional reaction until the start of her next turn.

trait.name: Psionic Wound (3/Day)
entries: When Victory hits a creature with a Mindrazor attack, she can attempt to inflict a psionic wound (no action required). The target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Intelligence saving throw or become vulnerable to psychic damage for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Victory makes three Mindrazor attacks and one Cheap Shot attack.

action.name: Mindrazor
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 1d8 + 7}) piercing damage.

action.name: Cheap Shot
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d4 + 6}) bludgeoning damage, and the target must make a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, Victory can choose for the target to either be knocked {@condition prone} or gain one of the following conditions until the end of the target's next turn: {@condition blinded}, {@condition dazed|FleeMortals}, or {@condition deafened}.

reaction.name: Shared Condition
entries: When Victory is {@condition blinded}, {@condition charmed}, {@condition dazed|FleeMortals}, {@condition deafened}, {@condition frightened}, {@condition paralyzed}, or {@condition stunned}, she chooses a willing Amethyst Knife boss within 60 feet of her who doesn't already have the condition or is immune to it. The chosen creature then gains the condition for the duration, and Victory loses the condition. She can use this reaction even while {@condition incapacitated}.

trait.name: Charm Resistant
entries: Treyvan has advantage on saving throws he makes to avoid or end the {@condition charmed} condition on himself.

trait.name: Mind Link
entries: Treyvan can communicate telepathically with any Amethyst Knife boss regardless of distance, provided they are on the same plane of existence.

trait.name: Telekinetic Bastion
entries: Each ally within 20 feet of Treyvan has a +2 bonus to AC and Dexterity saving throws. Enemies treat the area within 20 feet of Treyvan as difficult terrain.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Treyvan makes two Maul attacks. He can replace one attack with a use of Telekinetic Throw or Choke, if available.

action.name: Maul
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d6 + 6}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, Treyvan can choose to either knock them {@condition prone} or push them up to 10 feet away from him.

action.name: Telekinetic Throw
entries: Treyvan throws his maul with telekinetic force, making a Maul attack with a range of 30 feet. After making this attack, the maul immediately returns to Treyvan's hands.

action.name: Choke (2/Day; 5th-Order Power; Concentration)
entries: Treyvan telekinetically crushes one Large or smaller creature he can see within 30 feet of him. The target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw or be {@condition restrained} for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn). While {@condition restrained} in this way, the target takes 14 ({@damage 4d6}) force damage at the start of each of their turns. If the target is ever more than 30 feet away from Treyvan or has total cover from him, the power ends early.

reaction.name: Shared Condition
entries: When Treyvan is {@condition blinded}, {@condition charmed}, {@condition dazed|FleeMortals}, {@condition deafened}, {@condition frightened}, {@condition paralyzed}, or {@condition stunned}, he chooses a willing Amethyst Knife boss within 60 feet of him who doesn't already have the condition or is immune to it. The chosen creature then gains the condition for the duration, and Treyvan loses the condition. He can use this reaction even while {@condition incapacitated}.

trait.name: Deadly Sharpshooter
entries: Attacking at long range with a ranged weapon doesn't impose disadvantage on Llyvessa's attack rolls.

trait.name: Elf Glamour (1/Day)
entries: When a creature targets Llyvessa with an attack, power, or spell, the creature must succeed on a {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition charmed} by her until the end of her next turn (no action required).

trait.name: Mind Link
entries: Llyvessa can communicate telepathically with any Amethyst Knife boss regardless of distance, provided they are on the same plane of existence.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Llyvessa makes two Scimitar or Longbow attacks. Alternatively, she makes one Longbow attack and uses Psychic Shot, if available.

action.name: Scimitar
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d6 + 6}) slashing damage.

action.name: Longbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 9} to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d8 + 6}) piercing damage.

action.name: Psychic Shot {@recharge 5}
entries: Llyvessa makes a Longbow attack that ignores cover, and which can pass through mundane solid objects up to 5 feet thick that aren't being worn or carried.

bonus.name: Jaunt (1/Day; 3rd-Order Power)
entries: Llyvessa or one willing creature within 5 feet of her teleports to an unoccupied space Llyvessa can see within 30 feet of her.

reaction.name: *Control Projectiles (3/Day; 2nd-Order Power)
entries: When a creature Llyvessa can see within 60 feet of her makes a ranged weapon attack, she gives the creature advantage or disadvantage on the attack roll (her choice).

reaction.name: Shared Condition
entries: When Llyvessa is {@condition blinded}, {@condition charmed}, {@condition dazed|FleeMortals}, {@condition deafened}, {@condition frightened}, {@condition paralyzed}, or {@condition stunned}, she chooses a willing Amethyst Knife boss within 60 feet of her who doesn't already have the condition or is immune to it. The chosen creature then gains the condition for the duration, and Llyvessa loses the condition. She can use this reaction even while {@condition incapacitated}.

trait.name: Mind Link
entries: Jutkarr can communicate telepathically with any Amethyst Knife boss regardless of distance, provided they are on the same plane of existence.

trait.name: Poison Resistant
entries: Jutkarr has advantage on saving throws he makes to avoid or end the {@condition poisoned} condition on himself.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Jutkarr makes two Deserved Transfer attacks.

action.name: *Deserved Transfer (2nd-Order Power)
entries: {@atk mp,rp} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30 ft., one creature. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d6 + 6}) psychic damage, and one creature Jutkarr can see within 30 feet of him gains temporary hit points equal to half the damage dealt.

action.name: Psionic Resilience (2/Day; 4th-Order Power)
entries: Jutkarr touches a willing creature and gives them immunity to one of the following conditions for 1 hour: {@condition blinded}, {@condition charmed}, {@condition dazed|FleeMortals}, {@condition deafened}, {@condition frightened}, {@condition paralyzed}, {@condition petrified}, {@condition poisoned}, or {@condition stunned}. Additionally, if the target suffers from the chosen condition, that condition is suppressed for 1 hour.

reaction.name: Shared Condition
entries: When Jutkarr is {@condition blinded}, {@condition charmed}, {@condition dazed|FleeMortals}, {@condition deafened}, {@condition frightened}, {@condition paralyzed}, or {@condition stunned}, he chooses a willing Amethyst Knife boss within 60 feet of him who doesn't already have the condition or is immune to it. The chosen creature then gains the condition for the duration, and Jutkarr loses the condition. He can use this reaction even while {@condition incapacitated}.

resist.note: from mundane attacks with shadow form

trait.name: Amethyst Die (3/Day)
entries: When Harlo makes an ability check, saving throw, or attack roll, he can roll a {@dice d6} and add the number rolled to the number rolled on the {@dice d20} roll. He then takes psychic damage equal to twice the number rolled on the {@dice d6}.
Harlo can use this die even in his shadow form.

trait.name: Fear Resistant
entries: Harlo has advantage on saving throws he makes to avoid or end the {@condition frightened} condition on himself.

trait.name: Mind Link
entries: Harlo can communicate telepathically with any Amethyst Knife boss regardless of distance, provided they are on the same plane of existence.

trait.name: Telepathic Shroud
entries: Harlo is immune to any effect that would sense his emotions or read his thoughts, as well as to all divination spells.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Harlo makes two Mind Splinter attacks.

action.name: *Mind Splinter (1st-Order Power)
entries: {@atk mp,rp} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. {@h}20 ({@damage 4d6 + 6}) psychic damage, and Harlo is {@condition invisible} to the target until the start of his next turn.

action.name: Shadow Form (1/Day; 4th-Order Power; Concentration)
entries: Harlo transforms his body into an amorphous shadow, along with everything he is wearing or carrying, and gains the following benefits for 10 minutes:

items: He has a flying speed of 60 feet.
He has resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from mundane attacks.
He has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks and can attempt to hide without cover.
He can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

entries: While in this form, Harlo can't pick up or wield objects except for his Amethyst Die.

bonus.name: I'm Over Here
entries: Harlo chooses an enemy within 60 feet of him who he can see but who can't see him. The target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw or make a weapon attack against a creature of Harlo's choice.

bonus.name: Sneaky
entries: Harlo takes the Hide action.

reaction.name: Shared Condition
entries: When Harlo is {@condition blinded}, {@condition charmed}, {@condition dazed|FleeMortals}, {@condition deafened}, {@condition frightened}, {@condition paralyzed}, or {@condition stunned}, he chooses a willing Amethyst Knife boss within 60 feet of him who doesn't already have the condition or is immune to it. The chosen creature then gains the condition for the duration, and Harlo loses the condition. He can use this reaction even while {@condition incapacitated}.

trait.name: Cloak and Dagger
entries: While Vali is hidden, he doesn't give away his location if he makes a weapon attack and misses.

trait.name: Deft-Footed
entries: Vali leaves no tracks or other traces of his presence unless he wants to.

trait.name: Elf Glamour (1/Day)
entries: When a creature targets Vali with an attack, power, or spell, the creature must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition charmed} by him until the end of his next turn (no action required).

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Vali makes two Shortsword attacks, or he makes two Waning Moon attacks and uses Waning Moon Fade, if available.

action.name: Shortsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d6 + 5}) piercing damage.

action.name: Waning Moon
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 7} to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d8 + 5}) piercing damage. If the target is a creature who can't see Vali, the target takes an extra 7 ({@damage 2d6}) force damage.

action.name: Waning Moon Fade (1/Day)
entries: Vali becomes {@condition invisible} for 1 minute and takes the Hide action. This invisibility ends if Vali makes an attack, casts a spell, or manifests a power.

bonus.name: Nimble Escape
entries: Vali takes the Disengage or Hide action.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting (Utility)
headerEntries: In addition to any other spells in this stat block, Tuval-Uthriar can cast the following spells, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 15}):

trait.name: Elf Glamour (1/Day)
entries: When a creature targets Tuval-Uthriar with an attack, power, or spell, the creature must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition charmed} by him until the end of his next turn (no action required).

trait.name: Supernatural Resistance
entries: Tuval-Uthriar has advantage on saving throws against powers, spells, and other supernatural effects.

trait.name: Wheel of Ire
entries: Each enemy within 30 feet of Tuval-Uthriar has disadvantage on attacks against creatures other than him.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Tuval-Uthriar makes three Longsword attacks.

action.name: Longsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d8 + 5}) slashing damage, or 10 ({@damage 1d10 + 5}) slashing damage if used with two hands.

action.name: Call Lightning (3/Day; 3rd-Level Spell)
entries: A magical bolt of lightning flashes down from the sky to a point Tuval-Uthriar can see within 120 feet of him. Each creature within 5 feet of that point must make a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw, taking 16 ({@damage 3d10}) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

action.name: Eye of Sunrise (1/Day)
entries: Tuval-Uthriar's gauntlet emits a fiery explosion in a 30-foot cone. The explosion can be heard 300 feet away. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw, taking 17 ({@damage 5d6}) fire damage plus 17 ({@damage 5d6}) force damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Each structure and mundane object in the area that isn't being worn or carried takes 35 ({@damage 10d6}) fire damage plus 35 ({@damage 10d6}) force damage.

bonus.name: Healing Word (2nd-Level Spell)
entries: Tuval-Uthriar targets one creature who isn't a Construct or an Undead who he can see within 60 feet of him. The target regains 8 ({@dice 2d4 + 3}) hit points.

trait.name: Fey Countenance (1/Turn)
entries: When a creature who can see Sylphise targets her with an attack, power, or spell, the creature must succeed on a {@dc 16} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition blinded} until the start of their next turn (no action required).

trait.name: Speak with Beasts and Plants
entries: Sylphise can communicate with Beasts and Plants as if they shared a language.

trait.name: Supernatural Resistance
entries: Sylphise has advantage on saving throws against powers, spells, and other supernatural effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Sylphise makes three Claw attacks or uses Sibilant Whispers twice.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d6 + 5}) slashing damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) psychic damage.

action.name: Sibilant Whispers
entries: One creature Sylphise can see within 60 feet of her must succeed on a {@dc 16} Charisma saving throw or take 10 ({@damage 3d6}) psychic damage.

action.name: Etherealness
entries: Sylphise magically enters the Ethereal Plane from the Mundane World, or vice versa.

reaction.name: Too Slow!
entries: If a creature misses Sylphise with an attack, she can move up to her speed without provoking opportunity attacks from that creature.

trait.name: Lightning Absorption
entries: Whenever Logger is subjected to lightning damage, they take no damage and instead regain a number of hit points equal to the lightning damage dealt.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Logger makes two Slam attacks. If they are in a fury (see Nature's Fury), they instead make three Slam attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d6 + 6}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Entangling Vines
entries: Vines lash out from Logger's body.

Each enemy within 30 feet of them must succeed on a {@dc 17} Strength saving throw or take 9 ({@damage 1d6 + 6}) bludgeoning damage and be {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 17}) and pulled up to 30 feet directly toward Logger.

bonus.name: Nature's Fury (1/Day)
entries: Logger enters a fury for 1 minute.

While in a fury, Logger has advantage on Strength checks and saving throws, and they can make an extra Slam attack when they use Multiattack. If Logger ends their turn without damaging another creature on that turn, the fury ends early.

trait.name: Supernatural Resistance
entries: Anthracia has advantage on saving throws against powers, spells, and other supernatural effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Anthracia makes three attacks using Stone Touch, Missile Thorn, or both. She can also use Tree Teleport, if available.

action.name: Stone Touch
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 3d8}) necrotic damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition restrained} (save ends at end of turn) as their limbs become heavy. If this attack reduces a creature to 0 hit points, they become stable and are {@condition petrified} into a withered stone tree featuring their tortured likeness. The petrification lasts until the creature is restored by a {@psionic cure ailment|TalPsi} power of 4th order or higher, a {@spell greater restoration} spell, or a similar supernatural effect.

action.name: Missile Thorn
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 9} to hit, range 90 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 2d6}) piercing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) poison damage.

action.name: Tree Teleport (3/Day; 5th-Level Spell)
entries: Anthracia touches a living tree. She instantly teleports to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of another living tree within 500 feet of the first.
Both trees must be Medium or larger.

action.name: Wall of Poison (1/Day)
entries: Anthracia conjures an opaque wall of poisonous gas centered on a point she can see within 150 feet of her. The wall can be up to 50 feet long, 15 feet high, and 5 feet thick. The wall lingers in the air for 1 minute and its area is heavily obscured. Each creature who is in that area when the wall appears or who enters it for the first time on a turn must make a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw, taking 26 ({@damage 4d12}) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Creatures who don't need to breathe automatically succeed on this saving throw. A moderate wind (at least 10 miles per hour) disperses the wall after 4 rounds. A strong wind (at least 20 miles per hour) disperses it after 1 round.

reaction.name: Sudden Quake
entries: When an enemy moves within 15 feet of Anthracia, she creates a small tremor in the ground beneath her. Each creature within 15 feet of her must succeed on a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw or fall {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Evasion
entries: If Qar is subjected to an effect that allows him to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, he instead takes no damage if he succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if he fails.

trait.name: Exploit Opening (3/Day)
entries: When Qar makes an attack, he has advantage on the attack roll.

trait.name: Supernatural Resistance
entries: Qar has advantage on saving throws against powers, spells, and other supernatural effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Qar makes three Unarmed Strike attacks. If he hits the same creature with all three attacks, the target is {@condition dazed|FleeMortals} until the end of their next turn.

action.name: Unarmed Strike
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d6 + 5}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Iron Ring (2/Day)
entries: If not in the Cyst, Qar teleports to the Cyst. If in the Cyst, he teleports to a place he has visited.

reaction.name: No Survivors
entries: When an enemy Qar can see within 40 feet of him drops to 0 hit points, Qar moves up to his speed. If he ends that movement within 5 feet of an enemy, he can make an Unarmed Strike against them.

reaction.name: Voice Stealer (3/Day)
entries: When an enemy Qar can hear within 30 feet of him finishes casting a spell with a verbal component, Qar attempts to steal their voice. The enemy must succeed on a {@dc 15} Intelligence saving throw or be unable to speak for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting (Utility)
headerEntries: In addition to any other spells in this stat block, Avalla can cast the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 15}):

trait.name: Exploit Opening (3/Day)
entries: When Avalla makes an attack, she has advantage on the attack roll.

trait.name: Supernatural Resistance
entries: Avalla has advantage on saving throws against powers, spells, and other supernatural effects.

action.name: Lightning Lash (Cantrip)
entries: {@atk ms,rs} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one creature. {@h}15 ({@damage 3d6 + 5}) lightning damage, and Avalla can move the target up to 15 feet horizontally.

action.name: Iron Terror (1/Day; 4th-Level Spell)
entries: Avalla projects a terrifying illusion of the High Command to each enemy in a 30-foot cone. Each target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or take 21 ({@damage 6d6}) psychic damage and be {@condition frightened} of each member of the High Command for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).

action.name: Iron Shackles (1/Day; 3rd-Level Spell; Concentration)
entries: Avalla conjures animated iron chains at a point she can see on the ground within 60 feet of her. The chains fill a 15-foot- square on the ground centered on that point and last for 1 minute. When a creature enters that area for the first time on a turn or starts their turn there, they must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or be {@condition restrained} (save ends at start of turn). A creature {@condition restrained} in this way takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) bludgeoning damage at the end of each of their turns.

action.name: Iron Ring (2/Day)
entries: If not in the Cyst, Avalla teleports to the Cyst. If in the Cyst, she teleports to a place she has visited.

reaction.name: Escape Ring
entries: When Avalla isn't in the Cyst and an ally she can see within 60 feet of her drops to 0 hit points, she expends a use of Iron Ring and teleports herself to the Cyst along with each willing ally within 60 feet of her who isn't {@condition incapacitated}.

reaction.name: Spellcasting Feedback
entries: When a creature Avalla can see within 60 feet of her casts a spell, she taps into the caster's mind and sabotages their magic. The creature can choose either to cast the spell then take 3 ({@damage 1d6}) psychic damage per level of the spell cast, or to let the spell fail. If the spell fails, the creature's spell slot is expended with no effect and their action is wasted.

trait.name: Exploit Opening (3/Day)
entries: When Cloak makes an attack, she has advantage on the attack roll.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Cloak makes two Shortsword attacks.

action.name: Shortsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d6 + 5}) piercing damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) poison damage, and the target is {@condition poisoned} until the start of Cloak's next turn.

action.name: Light Crossbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 7} to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 5}) piercing damage. If the target is a creature who hasn't moved since the end of Cloak's last turn, the attack deals an extra 7 ({@damage 2d6}) piercing damage.

action.name: Iron Ring (2/Day)
entries: If not in the Cyst, Cloak teleports to the Cyst. If in the Cyst, she teleports to a place she has visited.

bonus.name: Cunning Action
entries: Cloak takes the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

reaction.name: You Should've Been Watching Me
entries: If a creature within 5 feet of Cloak hits one of her allies with an attack, Cloak makes a Shortsword attack against the creature. To use this reaction, Cloak must be able to see the ally and the attacker.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting (Utility)
headerEntries: In addition to any other spells in this stat block, Athenodorus can cast the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 15}):

trait.name: Exploit Opening (3/Day)
entries: When Athenodorus makes an attack, he has advantage on the attack roll.

action.name: Star of Iron
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, they are hexed until the end of their next turn. Whenever a creature hexed in this way makes an attack roll or saving throw, they must roll a {@dice d4} and subtract the number rolled from the attack roll or saving throw.

action.name: Iron Ring (2/Day)
entries: If not in the Cyst, Athenodorus teleports to the Cyst. If in the Cyst, he teleports to a place he has visited.

action.name: Unholy Fire (2/Day; 3rd-Level Spell)
entries: Athenodorus calls unholy black flames from the depths at a point he can see within 90 feet of him. Each enemy in a 15-foot-radius, 30-foot-high cylinder centered on that point must make a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 14 ({@damage 4d6}) fire damage plus 14 ({@damage 4d6}) necrotic damage and is moved up to 15 feet horizontally. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't moved.

bonus.name: Blessing of Ajax (2/Day)
entries: Athenodorus chooses a creature he can see within 30 feet of him. The target regains 14 ({@dice 2d8 + 5}) hit points and Athenodorus can end one of the following conditions affecting the target: {@condition blinded}, {@condition charmed}, {@condition dazed|FleeMortals}, {@condition deafened}, {@condition frightened}, {@condition paralyzed}, {@condition poisoned}, or {@condition stunned}.

trait.name: Exploit Opening (3/Day)
entries: When Erasmus makes an attack, he has advantage on the attack roll.

trait.name: Master Tactician
entries: At the start of a combat encounter, Erasmus chooses when he acts in the initiative order after all other creatures have rolled initiative.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Erasmus makes two Greatsword attacks. He can replace one attack with a use of I'm Right Here.

action.name: Greatsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) slashing damage. If the target is a creature, they have disadvantage on attack rolls against creatures other than Erasmus until the end of their next turn.

action.name: I'm Right Here
entries: Erasmus taunts a creature he can see within 5 feet of him who can hear him. The creature must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or use their reaction, if available, to attack Erasmus. If the creature attacks, an ally within 30 feet of Erasmus who isn't {@condition incapacitated} can make a weapon attack against the creature (no action required).

action.name: Iron Ring (2/Day)
entries: If not in the Cyst, Erasmus teleports to the Cyst. If in the Cyst, he teleports to a place he has visited.

bonus.name: Mark
entries: Erasmus chooses a creature he can see within 60 feet of him and marks them until the start of his next turn. The first time one of Erasmus's allies deals damage to a marked creature on each turn, the creature takes an extra 3 ({@damage 1d6}) damage.

bonus.name: Reposition
entries: Erasmus and each ally within 60 feet of him who can hear him moves up to 5 feet without provoking opportunity attacks.

trait.name: Flyby
entries: Sair doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when they fly out of an enemy's reach.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) slashing damage.

action.name: Psionic Bolt (1st-Order Power)
entries: {@atk rp} {@hit 6} to hit, range 120 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 3d6}) psychic damage. If the target is Large or smaller, they are pushed 5 feet away from Sair.

action.name: *Mind Scream (1/Day; 3rd-Order Power)
entries: Sair psionically pierces the mind of each enemy within 30 feet of them. Each target must make a {@dc 14} Intelligence saving throw, taking 17 ({@damage 5d6}) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature reduced to 0 hit points by this damage is automatically stabilized.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: Klar can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Mimicry
entries: Klar can mimic animal sounds. A creature who hears the sounds can tell they are imitations with a successful {@dc 13} Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) check.

trait.name: Standing Leap
entries: Klar's long jump is up to 40 feet and their high jump is up to 15 feet, with or without a running start.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Klar makes one Bite attack and one Mantis Claws attack.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Mantis Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 f., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) slashing damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, they are {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 14}). While {@condition grappled} in this way, the target is {@condition restrained}. Moving while grappling a Medium or smaller target doesn't halve Klar's speed. Klar can have only one target {@condition grappled} in this way at a time.

bonus.name: Bellowing Roar (1/Day)
entries: Klar lets loose a terrifying roar.

Each creature within 30 feet of Klar who can hear them must succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} of Klar for 1 minute. If a creature {@condition frightened} in this way takes damage, they can repeat this saving throw, ending the effect on themself on a success.

bonus.name: Kangaroo Leap
entries: Klar jumps up to half their speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: Excess can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Excess makes one Bite attack and one Sting attack.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, they are {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 14}). While {@condition grappled}, a target takes 2 ({@damage 1d4}) poison damage at the start of each of Excess's turns, and Excess can't make a Bite attack against another target.

action.name: Sting
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).

action.name: Swallow
entries: Excess makes a Bite attack against a Medium or smaller creature who they are grappling or hidden from.

If the attack hits, the target is swallowed as Excess enlarges their head and stomach. The swallowed target is no longer {@condition grappled}, but they are {@condition blinded} and {@condition restrained}, have total cover against attacks and other effects outside Excess, and take 10 ({@damage 3d6}) acid damage at the start of each of Excess's turns. Excess can have only one target swallowed at a time.
If Excess dies, a swallowed creature is no longer {@condition restrained} by them and can escape from the corpse by using 5 feet of movement, exiting {@condition prone}.

bonus.name: Cunning Action
entries: Excess takes the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

trait.name: Octopodan Camouflage
entries: Ceemal can attempt to hide even when they are only lightly obscured by foliage, heavy rain, falling snow, mist, or other natural phenomena.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Ceemal makes two Fillet Knife or two Acid Spit attacks.

action.name: Fillet Knife
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) slashing damage. If the target is a creature, another Abomination within 5 feet of the target regains hit points equal to half the damage dealt.

action.name: Acid Spit
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 6} to hit, range 20/40 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) acid damage, and the target is {@condition poisoned} until the start of Ceemal's next turn.

bonus.name: To Me, Sweetie (3/Day)
entries: Ceemal chooses an ally within 30 feet of them who can hear them. The ally can use their reaction to move up to their speed toward Ceemal without provoking opportunity attacks.

reaction.name: Wail of Loss
entries: When another Abomination who Ceemal can see is reduced to 0 hit points by an enemy within 60 feet of Ceemal, Ceemal releases a psychic wail. The enemy must make a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw, taking 7 ({@damage 2d6}) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

trait.name: Boog Rampage
entries: If Boog sees another Abomination reduced to 0 hit points, Boog rampages for 1 minute. While rampaging, Boog's melee attacks deal an extra 2 damage.

trait.name: Boog Charge
entries: If Boog moves at least 10 feet straight toward a Medium or smaller creature and then hits them with a Gore attack on the same turn, the target is impaled on Boog's horn and is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 15}). While {@condition grappled} in this way, the target is {@condition restrained} and takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) piercing damage at the start of each of their turns, and Boog can't make a Gore attack against another target.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Boog makes two Slam attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 1d10 + 5}) bludgeoning damage or 12 ({@dice 1d10 + 7}) if rampaging.

action.name: Gore
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d6 + 5}) piercing damage or 10 ({@dice 1d6 + 7}) if rampaging.

action.name: Boog's Ball
entries: Boog throws a 3-inch-radius magic ball at a point they can see within 60 feet of them. If that point is 30 feet or less from Boog, the ball grows to a 5-foot radius. If that point is more than 30 feet from Boog, the ball grows to a 10-foot radius. Each creature in the ball's area when it reaches that point must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or take 14 ({@damage 4d6}) bludgeoning damage. After the ball reaches that point, it shrinks back to its 3-inch radius and teleports into the hand Boog used to throw it.

trait.name: Dying Gasp
entries: When the Horror dies, they begin to rupture in a vile explosion of viscera and necrotic energy. The creature who reduced the Horror to 0 hit points can make a {@dc 15} Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) check to appeal to Elyas's departing soul (no action required). On a successful check, his soul transforms the explosion and each enemy of the Grave Order within 30 feet of the Horror gains 7 ({@dice 2d6}) temporary hit points. On a failed check (or if no check is made), each creature within 15 feet of the Horror must make a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw, taking 4 ({@damage 1d8}) acid damage plus 4 ({@damage 1d8}) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

action.name: Spine Cleaver
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) slashing damage, or 13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) slashing damage against a {@condition grappled} target.

action.name: Bone Hook
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 6} to hit, range 15 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) piercing damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, they are {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 14}) and the Horror can pull the target up to 15 feet toward them.
Until this grapple ends, the Horror can't make a Bone Hook attack against another target.

bonus.name: Valor's Death
entries: Each enemy within 10 feet of the Horror who can hear the Horror must succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} of the Horror for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn). If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for them, the creature is immune to the Horror's Valor's Death for 24 hours.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting (Utility)
headerEntries: In addition to any other spells in this stat block, Mycete can cast the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 13}):

3: {@spell locate animals or plants} {@sup {@cite Casting Times|FleeMortals|A}}

trait.name: Necrotic Absorption
entries: Whenever Mycete is subjected to necrotic damage, she takes no damage and instead regains a number of hit points equal to the necrotic damage dealt.

action.name: Parasitic Spores
entries: {@atk ms,rs} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 2d6}) necrotic damage, and if the target is a creature, Mycete regains 3 ({@dice 1d6}) hit points.

action.name: Fungal Growth
entries: Mycete causes fungi to proliferate from a point she can see within 60 feet of her. Solid surfaces in a 10-foot square centered on that point become difficult terrain, and a creature who enters that area for the first time on a turn or starts their turn there must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).

action.name: Animate Husks (1/Day)
entries: Mycete animates three rotting zombies, who appear in unoccupied spaces Mycete can see within 30 feet of her. The zombies act immediately after Mycete on the same initiative count and follow her verbal orders. If Mycete dies, the zombies are destroyed.

bonus.name: Spore Eruption
entries: Mycete destroys a rotting zombie under her control, and the zombie violently erupts with toxic spores.
Each enemy within 5 feet of the zombie must make a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw, taking 9 ({@damage 2d8}) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting (Utility)
headerEntries: In addition to any other spells in this stat block, Lestheris can cast the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 14}):

trait.name: Charm Resistant
entries: Lestheris has advantage on saving throws to avoid or end the {@condition charmed} condition on herself.

trait.name: Dark Calling
entries: Each other creature within 30 feet of Lestheris has disadvantage on death saving throws.

trait.name: Tome of the Ethereal
entries: Lestheris can see 120 feet into the Ethereal Plane.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Lestheris makes two Grave Grasp or two Necrotic Lance attacks.

action.name: Grave Grasp (Cantrip)
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 2d6}) necrotic damage, and the target can't regain hit points until the start of Lestheris's next turn.

action.name: Necrotic Lance (1st-Level Spell)
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 6} to hit, range 120 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d8}) necrotic damage.
Lestheris can destroy a shade under her control within 30 feet of her and deal an extra 4 ({@damage 1d8}) necrotic damage to the target.

action.name: Animate Spirits (2/Day)
entries: Lestheris animates two shades.

The shades appear in unoccupied spaces Lestheris can see within 30 feet of her. The shades act immediately after Lestheris on the same initiative count and follow her verbal orders. If Lestheris dies, the shades are destroyed.

reaction.name: Ethereal Step (3/Day)
entries: When a creature Lestheris can see within 60 feet of her targets her with an attack, power, or spell while she isn't on the Ethereal Plane, she can choose one of the following effects:

items: Lestheris enters the Ethereal Plane, then returns to the plane and the space she left at the start of her next turn.

entries: If that space is occupied, she returns to the nearest unoccupied space of her choice.
• She teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space she can see.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting (Utility)
headerEntries: In addition to any other spells in this stat block, Jedar can cast the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 12}):

trait.name: Exploit Opening (3/Day)
entries: When Jedar makes an attack, he has advantage on the attack roll.

action.name: Warhammer
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) bludgeoning damage plus 2 ({@damage 1d4}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Nameless Reach (2/Day; 1st-Level Spell)
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 4} to hit, range 120 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 4d6}) necrotic damage, and the next attack roll made against this target before the end of Jedar's next turn has advantage.

action.name: Animate Bones (1/Day)
entries: Jedar animates three {@creature decrepit skeleton|FleeMortals}s, who appear in unoccupied spaces Jedar can see within 30 feet of him. The skeletons act immediately after Jedar on the same initiative count and follow his verbal orders.
If Jedar dies, the skeletons are destroyed.

bonus.name: Bone Shield
entries: Jedar destroys a decrepit skeleton under his control and chooses a creature he can see within 60 feet of him. The target gains 7 ({@dice 2d6}) temporary hit points.

trait.name: Aura of Command
