entries: When Aastrika fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead. When she does so, she can't use Sweltering Heat until the end of her next turn.

trait.name: Molten Flesh
entries: The first time a creature other than a fire giant touches Aastrika or hits her with a melee attack on a turn, that creature takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Aastrika takes the Disengage action and makes up to three attacks using Unarmed Strike, Hurl Flame, or both.

action.name: Unarmed Strike
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}21 ({@damage 4d6 + 7}) bludgeoning damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire damage. If the target is a creature, they are outlined in red light until the start of Aastrika's next turn, and for the duration, attack rolls against them have advantage.

action.name: Hurl Flame
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 10} to hit, range 180 ft., one target. {@h}20 ({@damage 4d6 + 6}) fire damage.

action.name: Lava Pillar {@recharge 5}
entries: Aastrika causes a 20-foot-radius, 60-foot-high cylinder of lava to erupt from the ground at a point she can see within 120 feet of her. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw, taking 38 ({@damage 11d6}) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

bonus.name: Sweltering Heat
entries: Aastrika's inner flame pulses harshly. Each creature within 20 feet of her who doesn't have resistance or immunity to fire damage must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or gain a level of {@condition exhaustion}.

reaction.name: Power of Flame
entries: When another fire giant Aastrika can see within 60 feet of her misses with a weapon attack, Aastrika causes flame to trail from the attacker. The attacker rolls damage for the attack as if they had hit, and the target takes half that amount as fire damage instead of taking the full amount of normal damage.

legendaryHeader: Aastrika has three villain actions. She can take each action once during an encounter after an enemy's turn. She can take these actions in any order but can use only one per round.

legendary.name: Action 1: Forward!
entries: Aastrika and up to three creatures she can see can move up to their speed without provoking opportunity attacks and make one melee attack each.

legendary.name: Action 2: The Manifold Self
entries: Aastrika disappears in a flash of light and teleports, reappearing in an unoccupied space she can see within 30 feet of her. At the same time, five {@creature fire giant trooper|FleeMortals}s appear in unoccupied spaces within 30 feet of the space she teleported from. The troopers act immediately after this villain action is taken and on the same initiative count in subsequent rounds.

legendary.name: Action 3: This. Ends. Now
entries: Aastrika and each willing fire giant within 60 feet of her unleashes a burst of heat. Each creature within 10 feet of Aastrika or one of these fire giants must make a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw, taking 55 ({@damage 10d10}) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the trooper takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, their hit points are reduced to 0. If the trooper takes damage from another effect, they die if the damage equals or exceeds their hit point maximum; otherwise they take no damage.

trait.name: Molten Flesh
entries: The first time a creature other than a fire giant touches the trooper or hits them with a melee attack on a turn, that creature takes 7 fire damage.

action.name: Unarmed Strike (Group Attack)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}3 bludgeoning damage plus 3 fire damage, and the target must succeed on a Strength saving throw or fall {@condition prone}. The DC for this saving throw equals 12 + the number of troopers who joined the group attack.

action.name: Rock (Group Attack)
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 10} to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. {@h}6 bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Heat and Pressure
entries: When an enemy moves out of the red fist's reach, the enemy must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or gain a level of {@condition exhaustion}. Creatures with resistance or immunity to fire damage are immune to this effect.

trait.name: Molten Flesh
entries: The first time a creature other than a fire giant touches the red fist or hits them with a melee attack on a turn, that creature takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The red fist makes two Unarmed Strike attacks.

action.name: Unarmed Strike
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}21 ({@damage 4d6 + 7}) bludgeoning damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire damage. If the same creature is hit twice with this attack on a turn, they are {@condition blinded} until the end of their next turn.

action.name: Hurl Flame
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 10} to hit, range 180 ft., one target. {@h}34 ({@damage 8d6 + 6}) fire damage.

reaction.name: Guardian Block (3/Day)
entries: When an enemy within 10 feet of the red fist hits a creature other than the red fist with an attack, the red fist halves the damage dealt by that attack. The red fist then makes an Unarmed Strike against the attacker.

trait.name: Healing Heat
entries: When the lightbearer targets a fire giant with an attack, spell, or other supernatural effect that deals fire damage, that target instead regains a number of hit points equal to the damage that would be dealt. The target can choose to be hit by this attack or fail their saving throw against this effect.

trait.name: Molten Flesh
entries: The first time a creature other than a fire giant touches the lightbearer or hits them with a melee attack on a turn, that creature takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The lightbearer makes two attacks using Slam, Living Blaze, or both. They can replace one attack with a use of Flamelash.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 3d6 + 6}) bludgeoning damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire damage, and if the target is a Huge or smaller creature, the target must choose between being knocked {@condition prone} or pushed 10 feet away from the lightbearer.

action.name: Living Blaze
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 10} to hit, range 180 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 3d6 + 6}) fire damage, and the lightbearer can ricochet the flame toward another target within 5 feet of the first. The lightbearer makes another spell attack roll against the second target with disadvantage, dealing the same damage on a hit.

action.name: Flamelash
entries: The lightbearer extends a whiplike flame to strike a creature they can see within 30 feet of them. The target must make a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 20 ({@damage 4d6 + 6}) fire damage, and if the target is Large or smaller, the lightbearer moves the target up to 10 feet horizontally.

bonus.name: Travel by Fire (3/Day)
entries: The lightbearer chooses two willing creatures they can see within 30 feet of them. Each target takes 14 ({@damage 4d6}) fire damage and teleports, swapping places with the other target.

hp.special: 7 + seven times caregiver's level (number of d8 Hit Dice equal to their caregiver's level)

trait.name: Earth Glide
entries: The elemental can burrow through mundane, unworked earth and stone. While doing so, the elemental doesn't disturb the material they move through. While they use Earth Glide, the elemental can't be used as a mount.

action.name: Signature Attack (Slam)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3 plus PB} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 1d6 plus PB} bludgeoning damage.

action.name: 1st Level: Stretch Attack (2 Ferocity)
entries: The elemental makes a signature attack with a reach of 10 feet. On a hit, the attack deals an extra {@damage 0d1 + PB|PB} damage, and the elemental can pull the target 5 feet toward them.

action.name: 3rd Level: Earthshaker (5 Ferocity)
entries: The elemental strikes the ground, and each creature within 10 feet of them must succeed on a {@dc 10 plus PB} Dexterity saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}. The elemental's caregiver automatically succeeds on this saving throw.

action.name: 5th Level: Transmute Ground (8 Ferocity)
entries: The elemental picks a 10-foot-square area of ground they can see within 30 feet of them. Each creature standing in the area must succeed on a {@dc 10 plus PB} Strength saving throw or partially sink into the ground and become {@condition restrained}. A creature can use their action to make a {@dc 10 plus PB} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check, freeing themself or another creature within their reach on a success and ending the {@condition restrained} condition for the freed creature.

bonus.name: Toss Me
entries: While the elemental is within 5 feet of their caregiver, they can hurl the caregiver 5 × PB feet in any direction, including up. If the caregiver would normally take damage from a fall after being thrown, they can negate the damage with a successful {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw.

hp.special: Nine times their level (number of d12 Hit Dice equal to their level)

action.name: Signature Attack (Molten Slam)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3 plus PB} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 1d6 + PB} bludgeoning damage plus 4 ({@damage 1d8}) fire damage. A flammable object hit by this attack ignites if it isn't being worn or carried. Beginning at 7th level, the bastion can make this attack twice, instead of once, when they take the Attack action on their turn.

action.name: 3rd Level: Burning Embrace (3/Day)
entries: As an action, the bastion makes a signature attack against a creature within range. If the attack hits, the target is also {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 10 plus PB}). While {@condition grappled} in this way, a target is {@condition restrained} and takes {@damage PBd6} fire damage at the start of each of their turns.

action.name: 5th Level: Melting Grasp (3/Day)
entries: When the bastion hits a creature with a signature attack, the creature takes an extra {@damage PBd4} fire damage. If the target is wielding a mundane metal weapon, the bastion partially melts the target's weapon, giving it a permanent -2 penalty to attack and damage rolls. If the target is wielding a supernatural metal weapon, the penalty lasts for 1 hour instead.

action.name: 7th Level: Eruption (1/Day)
entries: As an action, the bastion erupts, shooting a 30-foot cone of earth and lava from their head. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 10 plus PB} Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes {@damage PBd6} bludgeoning damage plus {@damage PBd6} fire damage and is knocked {@condition prone}. On a successful save, a target takes half as much damage and is not knocked {@condition prone}. The lava spreads around corners and ignites flammable objects in that area that aren't being worn or carried.

hp.special: Seven times their level (number of d8 Hit Dice equal to their level)

action.name: Signature Attack (Blood Curse)
entries: {@atk ms,rs} {@hit 3 plus PB} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 1d4 plus PB} necrotic damage, and the target is {@condition poisoned} until the end of the seneschal's next turn. Beginning at 7th level, the seneschal can make this attack twice, instead of once, when they take the Attack action on their turn.

action.name: 3rd Level: Coagulate (3/Day)
entries: As an action, the seneschal empowers the blood of up to PB creatures within 30 feet of them. Each target can expend 1 Hit Die, rolling it and regaining hit points equal to twice the result plus their Constitution modifier.

action.name: 5th Level: Blood Puppet (3/Day)
entries: As an action, the seneschal chooses a creature they can see within 60 feet of them. The target must succeed on a {@dc 10 plus PB} Wisdom saving throw or move up to their speed in a direction of the seneschal's choice. During this movement, the seneschal can force them to make one attack against a creature of the seneschal's choice (no action required).

action.name: 7th Level: Blood Bondage (1/Day)
entries: As an action, the seneschal arrests the hearts of up to PB creatures within 30 feet of them. Each target must make a {@dc 10 plus PB} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage PBd6} necrotic damage and is {@condition paralyzed} for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn). On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't {@condition paralyzed}.

name: Atæshia

trait.name: Offer to Remembrance (3/Day)
entries: When Atæshia fails a saving throw, a willing creature within 60 feet of her who can see her can give their life to protect her. This creature dies instantly, and Atæshia succeeds on the saving throw.

trait.name: Reborn From War
entries: When Atæshia is reduced to 0 hit points, she disintegrates into ash on a solemn wind. For the next 100 years, if a Celestial, an Elemental, or a Humanoid whose challenge rating or level is 5 or higher dies within 60 feet of where Atæshia died, Atæshia returns to life where she died with 25 hit points.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Atæshia makes three Pale Flame attacks. She can replace one attack with a use of Moment of Loss, if available.

action.name: Pale Flame
entries: {@atk ms,rs} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. {@h}20 ({@damage 4d6 + 6}) radiant damage plus 14 ({@damage 4d6}) fire damage. If this attack reduces a creature to 0 hit points, they die and all their remains burn to nothing.

action.name: Moment of Loss {@recharge}
entries: Atæshia transforms one creature she can see within 60 feet of her into the form of a living ash cloud. While transformed to ash, the target is immune to all damage, can't provide cover to other creatures, and can't take reactions. At the start of the target's next turn, they reform and must make a {@dc 21} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target is reduced to 1 hit point. On a successful save, the target takes 44 ({@damage 8d10}) necrotic damage. This damage can't reduce the target's hit points below 1.

action.name: From Death, Life (1/Day)
entries: Atæshia uses her Kindled Sacrifice villain action, even if it is unavailable, to sacrifice herself.

bonus.name: Flickering Flame
entries: Atæshia forms into a cloud of ash, teleports to an unoccupied space she can see within 60 feet of her, and reforms into her true form. Each creature within 5 feet of the space she left must succeed on a {@dc 21} Dexterity saving throw or take 5 ({@damage 1d10}) fire damage.

reaction.name: Convocation of Ash
entries: When another Elemental Atæshia can see within 60 feet of her is hit with an attack, the damage from the attack is halved and the target can move up to half their speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendaryHeader: Atæshia has three villain actions. She can take each action once during an encounter after an enemy's turn. She can take these actions in any order but can use only one per round.

legendary.name: Action 1: Wave of Sorrow
entries: Atæshia unleashes a pulse of overwhelming sadness. Each enemy Atæshia can see within 120 feet of her must make a {@dc 21} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a creature is {@condition dazed|FleeMortals} for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn). On a successful save, a creature can't take reactions until the end of their next turn.

legendary.name: Action 2: Kindled Sacrifice
entries: Atæshia chooses a willing creature within 60 feet of her to die so their allies may live. The target dies, and up to two other dead creatures within 60 feet of the target return to life. These revived creatures regain the same number of hit points the sacrificed creature had, up to the revived creature's hit point maximum.

legendary.name: Action 3: Life's Finale
entries: Atæshia releases a torrent of primordial anguish to unmake the marrow of creation around her. Each enemy within 60 feet of her must make a {@dc 21} Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, they take 55 ({@damage 10d10}) necrotic damage and can't regain hit points until the end of Atæshia's next turn. On a successful save, they take half as much damage, but suffer no other effect. Succeed or fail, if this damage reduces a creature to 0 hit points, they immediately fail one death saving throw.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the spark takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, their hit points are reduced to 0. If the spark takes damage from another effect, they die if the damage equals or exceeds their hit point maximum; otherwise they take no damage.

trait.name: Whirlpool Suction
entries: If an enemy starts their turn within 5 feet of three or more water sparks, the enemy must succeed on a Strength saving throw or have their speed reduced to 0. The DC for this saving throw equals 14 plus the number of water sparks within 5 feet of the enemy.

action.name: Whelming Wave (Group Attack)
entries: {@atk ms,rs} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30 ft., one target. {@h}10 bludgeoning damage, and if the attack was made by more than one spark, the target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone} and be unable to stand up until the end of the sparks' next turn. The DC for this saving throw equals 14 plus the number of sparks who joined the attack.

trait.name: Corona
entries: The nexus sheds bright sunlight in a 120-foot radius and dim light for another 120 feet.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The nexus makes three Solar Arc attacks. They can replace one attack with a use of Heavenly Collapse or Rejuvenating Flare, if available.

action.name: Solar Arc
entries: {@atk ms,rs} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 2d12 + 5}) radiant damage.

action.name: Heavenly Collapse (2/Day)
entries: The nexus shines harsh light on an enemy they can see within 60 feet of them. Each ally of the nexus within 5 feet of the target regains 20 hit points, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or lose any damage resistances they have and be {@condition blinded} for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).

action.name: Rejuvenating Flare (1/Day)
entries: One ally the nexus can see within 30 feet of them is bathed in rejuvenating light. The ally regains 27 ({@damage 5d10}) hit points, and if they are {@condition charmed}, {@condition dazed|FleeMortals}, {@condition frightened}, or {@condition poisoned}, those conditions end for them.

bonus.name: Convocation of Sunlight (2/Day)
entries: The nexus imbues the power of sunlight in themself or another Elemental they can see within 30 feet of them, granting one of the following effects of that Elemental's choice:

items: {@b Healing Radiance.} The Elemental regains 30 hit points. Until the end of the nexus's next turn, the Elemental refracts shimmering light, and creatures within 10 feet of them who aren't Elementals are {@condition blinded}.

{@b Protective Light.} Four brilliant motes orbit the Elemental for 1 minute. When the Elemental deals damage to a creature with an attack, the Elemental can extinguish one mote (no action required) to deal an extra 14 ({@damage 4d6}) radiant damage to that creature.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The principle regains 20 hit points at the start of their turn if they aren't {@condition incapacitated}. If they take fire damage, they only regain 10 hit points at the start of their next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The principle makes two Hampering Roots attacks or two Vernal Lash attacks.

action.name: Hampering Roots
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}23 ({@damage 4d8 + 5}) bludgeoning damage, and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 15}). While {@condition grappled} in this way, the target is {@condition restrained}.

action.name: Vernal Lash
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 60 ft., one target. {@h}27 ({@damage 4d10 + 5}) slashing damage, and the principle moves the target up to 15 feet horizontally.

action.name: Burst from the Earth (1/Day)
entries: The principle causes three Large trees with whipping branches to sprout from the ground in unoccupied spaces the principle can see within 60 feet of them. Each tree has AC 15, 40 hit points, and immunity to psychic damage.

An enemy who starts their turn within 15 feet of one of these trees must make a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw, taking 14 ({@damage 4d6}) slashing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

bonus.name: Convocation of Verdure (2/Day)
entries: The principle imbues the power of verdancy in themself or another Elemental they can see within 30 feet of them, granting one of the following effects of that Elemental's choice:

items: {@b Roots of the Mind.} For 1 minute, the Elemental can link with each Large or larger plant object they can see within 90 feet of them (no action required). For the duration, the Elemental can perceive, make attacks, and use actions as if they were in the space of a linked plant.

{@b Thunder Burst.} Thorny vines burst from the Elemental. Each enemy the Elemental can see within 30 feet of them must make a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes 27 ({@damage 6d8}) piercing damage and is {@condition restrained} until the end of their next turn. On a successful save, they take half as much damage and aren't {@condition restrained}.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting (Utility)
headerEntries: In addition to any other spells in this stat block, the oracle can cast the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 17}):

trait.name: Turbulent Escalation
entries: When the oracle starts their turn outdoors while not {@condition incapacitated}, they can stoke a thunderstorm (no action required). For 1 minute or until the oracle uses Turbulent Escalation again, the weather in a 1-mile radius centered on the oracle changes as follows:

items: If the sky is cloudless, it becomes cloudy.
If the sky is cloudy, it begins to rain or snow (oracle's choice).
If it's raining or snowing, the weather becomes stormy.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The oracle uses Tempest Bolt twice. They can replace one use with a Cyclone Staff attack.

action.name: Cyclone Staff
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}23 ({@damage 4d8 + 5}) bludgeoning damage plus 22 ({@damage 4d10}) thunder damage, and the oracle moves the target up to 10 feet in any direction.

action.name: Tempest Bolt
entries: A bolt of lightning streaks from the oracle to strike one creature they can see within 90 feet of them, or within 300 feet of them if the target is outdoors and the weather is stormy. The target must make a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw, taking 31 ({@damage 7d8}) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If the target is outdoors and the weather is stormy, they have disadvantage on the saving throw.

bonus.name: Convocation of Storms (2/Day)
entries: The oracle imbues the power of storm in themself or another Elemental they can see within 30 feet of them, granting one of the following effects of that Elemental's choice:

items: {@b Lightning Within.} The Elemental becomes charged with lightning. The next time the Elemental hits a target with an attack within the next minute, the attack deals an extra 33 ({@damage 6d10}) lightning damage.

{@b Thunder Burst.} A concussive shock wave erupts from the Elemental toward four creatures they can see within 60 feet of them. Each target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or take 22 ({@damage 4d10}) thunder damage, be pushed up to 10 feet away from the Elemental, and be {@condition deafened} until the end of the target's next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The force of iron uses Form Stance then makes three Ferrous Blade attacks or three Iron Spike attacks.

action.name: Ferrous Greatblade
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft. (20 ft. in Polearm Form), one target. {@h}19 ({@damage 4d6 + 5}) slashing damage.

action.name: Iron Spike
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 9} to hit, range 30/60 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) piercing damage.

action.name: Form Stance
entries: The force of iron shapes their body to gain one of the following benefits until the start of their next turn:

action.name: Polearm Form
entries: The force of iron's melee attacks have a reach of 20 feet instead of 5 feet.

action.name: Reckless Form
entries: The force of iron has advantage on all melee attack rolls, but attack rolls against the force of iron have advantage.

action.name: Shield Form
entries: The force of iron gains a +3 bonus to AC.

action.name: Fire Form (1/Day)
entries: The force of iron's attacks deal an extra 13 ({@damage 2d12}) fire damage on a hit.

bonus.name: Convocation of Iron (1/Day)
entries: The force of iron imbues the power of iron in themself or another Elemental they can see within 30 feet of them, granting one of the following effects of that Elemental's choice:

items: {@b Earth Reinforcements.} Five {@creature earth spark|FleeMortals}s appear in unoccupied spaces within 20 feet of the Elemental. The sparks understand the Elemental, follow their verbal commands, and act immediately after the Elemental in the initiative order.

{@b Iron Skin.} Metal covers the Elemental, granting them resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage for 1 minute or until their {@status concentration} is broken (as if {@status concentration||concentrating} on a spell).

trait.name: Earth Glide
entries: The force of earth can burrow through mundane, unworked earth and stone. While doing so, the force of earth doesn't disturb the material they move through.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The force of earth makes two Earthbind Strike attacks.

action.name: Earthbind Strike
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) bludgeoning damage, and the target's speed becomes 0 until the start of the force of earth's next turn.

action.name: Shatter Rock
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 7} to hit, range 60/120 ft., one target. {@h}23 ({@damage 3d12 + 4}) bludgeoning damage, or 47 ({@damage 6d12 + 8}) bludgeoning damage if the target is an object or structure.

bonus.name: Convocation of Earth (1/Day)
entries: The force of earth imbues the power of earth in themself or another Elemental they can see within 30 feet of them, granting one of the following effects of that Elemental's choice:

items: {@b Earthen Aura.} Stones rapidly whir around the Elemental in a 10-foot-radius sphere for 1 minute or until they're killed or {@condition incapacitated}. A creature who isn't an Elemental takes 5 slashing damage for every 5 feet they move into or within that area.

{@b Stone Armor.} Stone grows over the Elemental in a protective carapace, and they gain 20 temporary hit points. While the Elemental has these temporary hit points, they are immune to the {@condition dazed|FleeMortals}, {@condition paralyzed}, {@condition petrified}, and {@condition stunned} conditions.

trait.name: Visceral Sight
entries: The force of blood can see any creature within 120 feet of them who isn't a Construct or an Undead. This sight ignores effects that obscure sight.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The force of blood makes three Scarlet Longspear attacks. They can replace one attack with a Rend from Within attack.

action.name: Scarlet Longspear
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 15 ft. or range 30/60 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 2d10 + 7}) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, the force of blood regains 5 hit points.

action.name: Rend from Within
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d6 + 6}) slashing damage plus 26 ({@damage 4d12}) necrotic damage, and the target spends 1 Hit Die with no effect and can't take reactions until the start of their next turn. Miss: 13 ({@damage 2d12}) necrotic damage.

bonus.name: Convocation of Blood
entries: The force of blood imbues the power of blood in themself or another Elemental they can see within 30 feet of them, granting one of the following effects of that Elemental's choice:

items: {@b Boiling Blood.} The Elemental boils the blood of a creature within 5 feet of them who isn't a Construct or an Undead. The target must make a {@dc 19} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target must choose to either take 27 ({@damage 5d10}) fire damage or make an attack with a weapon that has a damage die of {@damage 1d4} or greater against a creature of the Elemental's choice. If the attack hits, it deals an extra 11 ({@damage 2d10}) fire damage.

{@b Essence Thief.} The Elemental steals the essence of two creatures the Elemental can see within 30 feet of them. Each target must make a {@dc 19} Constitution saving throw, taking 19 ({@damage 3d12}) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The Elemental can then teleport to an unoccupied space they can see within 5 feet of one of the targets.

trait.name: Little Flames
entries: The spark sheds bright light in a 15-foot radius and dim light for an additional 15 feet. If an enemy starts their turn within 5 feet of three or more fire sparks, they take 6 fire damage.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the spark takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, their hit points are reduced to 0. If the spark takes damage from another effect, they die if the damage equals or exceeds their hit point maximum; otherwise they take no damage.

action.name: Ember Claw (Group Attack)
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 fire damage.

trait.name: Water Glide
entries: While within 5 feet of a liquid or solid surface, the essence gains a flying speed equal to their swimming speed. While flying, the essence doesn't provoke opportunity attacks.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The essence makes two Water Wing attacks and one Lightning Tail Whip attack.

action.name: Water Wing
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage. If the same creature is hit twice with this attack on a turn, they are vulnerable to lightning damage until the end of the essence's turn.

action.name: Lightning Tail Whip
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 2d6}) lightning damage, and the target is pushed up to 10 feet away from the essence.

bonus.name: Convocation of Water (1/Day)
entries: The essence imbues the power of water in themself or another Elemental they can see within 30 feet, granting one of the following effects of that Elemental's choice:

items: {@b Scalding Steam.} The Elemental spouts blistering steam. Each non-Elemental creature within 15 feet of them must make a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes 18 ({@damage 4d8}) fire damage and is {@condition blinded} until the end of their next turn. On a successful save, a target takes half as much damage and isn't {@condition blinded}.

{@b Waters of Vitality.} The Elemental regains 25 hit points and can end one of the following conditions affecting them: {@condition blinded}, {@condition charmed}, {@condition dazed|FleeMortals}, {@condition deafened}, {@condition paralyzed}, {@condition poisoned}, or {@condition stunned}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The essence makes two Wind Talons attacks. They can replace one attack with a use of Bluster or Lightning Squall, if available.

action.name: Wind Talons
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Bluster
entries: The essence unleashes a 30-foot cone of wind. Each creature in that area must succeed on a {@dc 14} Strength saving throw or be moved up to 10 feet in any direction.

action.name: Lightning Squall (3/Day)
entries: The essence hurls a small lightning storm at a creature they can see within 30 feet of them. The target must make a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 28 ({@damage 8d6}) lightning damage and is {@condition dazed|FleeMortals} for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn). On a successful save, they take half as much damage and aren't {@condition dazed|FleeMortals}.

bonus.name: Convocation of Air (1/Day)
entries: The essence imbues the power of air in themself or another Elemental they can see within 30 feet of them, granting one of the following effects of that Elemental's choice:

items: {@b Rising Whirlwind.} Each creature of the Elemental's choice within 30 feet of them must make a {@dc 14} Strength saving throw against a violent whirlwind. On a failed save, the target rises 10 feet upward and is {@condition restrained} for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn). A target {@condition restrained} in this way rises an additional 10 feet at the start of each of their turns. Another creature who can reach the target can use an action to pull them free of the effect, ending the {@condition restrained} condition for that creature. The whirlwind ends if the Elemental dies or chooses to end it (no action required).
{@b Vortex Terrain.} A vortex swirls around the Elemental. For 1 minute, the area within 20 feet of the Elemental is difficult terrain for enemies.

trait.name: Flowing Form
entries: The essence can enter an enemy's space and stop there, and they can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Gasping Aura
entries: While within 10 feet of the essence, creatures who need to breathe can't take reactions or speak.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The essence makes two Breathless Rend attacks.

action.name: Breathless Rend
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) slashing damage plus 22 ({@damage 4d10}) psychic damage.

bonus.name: Convocation of Breath (2/Day)
entries: The essence imbues the power of breath in themself or another Elemental they can see within 30 feet of them, granting one of the following effects of that Elemental's choice:

items: {@b Hide in Breath.} The Elemental tries to hide inside the body of a creature within 10 feet of them who isn't a Construct, an Elemental, an Ooze, or an Undead. The target must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or the Elemental retreats inside the target until the start of the Elemental's next turn. While inside the target, the Elemental can't take actions and has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the target.

{@b Toxic Breath.} The Elemental exudes a noxious aura 10 feet in every direction for 1 minute or until dispersed by a moderate or stronger wind. That area is lightly obscured, and each creature who needs to breathe who starts their turn in that area must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} until the end of their next turn.

bonus.name: Breathstealer's Shimmer (1/Day)
entries: The essence becomes {@condition invisible} then takes the Hide action. This invisibility ends if the essence makes an attack or uses Convocation of Breath.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the spark takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, their hit points are reduced to 0. If the spark takes damage from another effect, they die if the damage equals or exceeds their hit point maximum; otherwise they take no damage.

trait.name: Trampling Rampage
entries: If an enemy who is touching the ground starts their turn within 5 feet of two or more earth sparks, the enemy must make a Strength saving throw with a DC equal to 12 plus the number of earth sparks within 5 feet of the enemy. On a failed save, the enemy falls {@condition prone}, and they can't stand up until there are fewer than two earth sparks within 5 feet of them.

action.name: Shatter Smash (Group Attack)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Snort Rocks (Group Attack)
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 7} to hit, range 30/60 ft., one target. {@h}5 bludgeoning damage. If the target is a flying creature, they must succeed on a Strength saving throw or fall {@condition prone}. The DC for this saving throw equals 12 plus the number of sparks who joined the attack.

name: Crux of Frost
languages: plus the languages known by a creature reflected by Frosted Reflection

trait.name: Scintillating
entries: The crux can't benefit from being {@condition invisible}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The crux makes two Rimeglass Touch attacks, and they can use Frosted Reflection or It Stares Back, if available.

action.name: Rimeglass Touch
entries: {@atk ms,rs} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 3d8 + 4}) cold damage, and the target can't see or hear creatures other than themself and the crux until the start of the crux's next turn.

action.name: Frosted Reflection
entries: The crux reflects the appearance of a specific Medium or Small creature they've seen within the last week. This appearance is illusory and imperfect, showing a frostbitten version of the creature. The illusion lasts until the crux takes thunder damage, uses this action again, or is {@condition incapacitated}. For the duration, the crux additionally knows any languages that creature knows.

action.name: It Stares Back {@recharge 5}
entries: The crux imposes fragility on a creature within 60 feet of them who is reflected by the crux's Frosted Reflection. If the target can see the crux, the target must make a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target is {@condition frightened} of the crux for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn), or until the crux stops reflecting them. While {@condition frightened} in this way, whenever the target takes damage, they take an extra 11 ({@damage 2d10}) psychic damage. On a successful save, the target isn't {@condition frightened}, and they are immune to the It Stares Back of all cruxes for 24 hours.

bonus.name: Convocation of Ice (1/Day)
entries: The crux imbues the power of ice in themself or another Elemental they can see within 30 feet of them, granting one of the following effects of that Elemental's choice:

items: {@b Frigid Sheen.} The Elemental gains a mirror sheen that reflects damage for 1 minute. When the Elemental is hit with an attack by a creature they can see within 30 feet of them, the Elemental can use a reaction to reflect the attack. The Elemental is unaffected by the attack, and the attacker must make a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the attack's damage and effects are reflected back at the attacker as if the attack originated from the Elemental, turning the attacker into the target. On a successful save, the attacker takes half as much damage, but suffers no other effect.

{@b Frost Squall.} Frost swirls around the Elemental for 1 minute. For the duration, each non-Elemental creature who starts their turn within 15 feet of the Elemental has their speed reduced to 15 feet unless it is already lower until the end of their turn, and the first time they willingly move before the start of their next turn, they take 10 ({@damage 3d6}) cold damage.

trait.name: Ablaze
entries: The crux sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional 20 feet, and they can't benefit from being {@condition invisible}. A creature who starts their turn grappling or {@condition grappled} by the crux takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The crux makes two Flame Tongue or two Sulfurous Rake attacks.

action.name: Sulfurous Rake
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) slashing damage, and the target can't take reactions this turn.

action.name: Flame Tongue
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 6} to hit, range 100 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d12}) fire damage. If the target is a flammable object that isn't being worn or carried, it ignites.

bonus.name: Convocation of Fire (1/Day)
entries: The crux imbues the power of fire in themself or another Elemental they can see within 30 feet of them, granting one of the following effects of that Elemental's choice:

items: {@b Flame Bloom.} The Elemental launches a seed of flame at a point they can see within 60 feet of them. A 10-foot radius sphere centered on that point erupts with fire and burns for 1 minute. Each creature who enters that area for the first time on a turn or starts their turn there takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) fire damage.

{@b Smoke Screen.} The Elemental exudes an aura of smoke 10 feet in every direction for 1 minute or until dispersed by a moderate or stronger wind. The smoky area is heavily obscured for all creatures who aren't fire elementals.

bonus.name: Flame Jet (1/Day)
entries: The crux gains a flying speed of 30 feet until the end of their turn and can move up to their speed.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the spark takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, their hit points are reduced to 0. If the spark takes damage from another effect, they die if the damage equals or exceeds their hit point maximum; otherwise they take no damage.

action.name: Wind Sweep (Group Attack)
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 slashing damage, and if this attack was made by more than one air spark against a Large or smaller creature, the sparks can move that creature up to 5 feet horizontally for each spark that joined the attack.

name: Yserthrax

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: Yserthrax can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Corruption
entries: Poison damage dealt by Yserthrax ignores damage resistance and treats damage immunity as damage resistance. Whenever Yserthrax deals poison damage to a creature who isn't a Construct or an Undead, that creature must succeed on a {@dc 19} Constitution saving throw or be corrupted (save ends at end of turn). The corruption lasts until cured by a {@psionic cure ailment|TalPsi} power, {@spell lesser restoration} spell, or similar supernatural effect.

While corrupted, a creature takes 14 ({@damage 4d6}) psychic damage at the start of each of their turns as their mind and body are ravaged by reality-warping anomalies. If a creature dies while corrupted, their body melts into a gruesome puddle, becoming a {@creature gibbering mouther|FleeMortals} under Yserthrax's control.

trait.name: Withering Resistance (3/Day)
entries: When Yserthrax fails a saving throw, she can take 16 ({@damage 3d10}) necrotic damage and succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Yserthrax makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 16} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}20 ({@damage 2d10 + 9}) piercing damage plus 11 ({@damage 2d10}) poison damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 16} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 2d6 + 9}) slashing damage, and Yserthrax can move the target up to 15 feet horizontally.

action.name: Corrupting Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: Yserthrax exhales poison in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 22} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes 56 ({@damage 16d6}) poison damage and is {@condition poisoned} until the end of their next turn. On a successful save, a target takes half as much damage and isn't {@condition poisoned}.

bonus.name: Ulcerate
entries: Yserthrax magically aggravates a creature she can see within 60 feet of her who is corrupted by her Corruption trait. The target must succeed on a {@dc 19} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition dazed|FleeMortals} until the end of their next turn.

reaction.name: Eldritch Disruption
entries: When a creature Yserthrax can see within 60 feet of her hits her with an attack or succeeds on a saving throw, Yserthrax conjures a reality-warping anomaly around them. The creature must choose to either take 10 ({@damage 3d6}) psychic damage or to reroll the attack or a saving throw and use the new result.

legendaryHeader: Yserthrax has three villain actions. She can take each action once during an encounter after an enemy's turn. She can take these actions in any order but can use only one per round.

legendary.name: Action 1: Summon Monoliths
entries: Yserthrax conjures three monoliths of otherworldly green crystal, which grow out of the ground centered on three points she can see within 500 feet of her. Each monolith is a 10-foot-radius, 60-foot-high cylinder with AC 19, 100 hit points, and immunity to poison and psychic damage. The monoliths don't block Yserthrax's vision. Each creature within 10 feet of a monolith other than Yserthrax is vulnerable to psychic damage. When a monolith is destroyed, each creature within 30 feet of it must make a {@dc 19} Wisdom saving throw, taking 21 ({@damage 6d6}) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

legendary.name: Action 2: Spatial Alteration
entries: Yserthrax bats her wings erratically, releasing foul energy that warps space around her. Each creature within 60 feet of her must succeed on a {@dc 19} Charisma saving throw or be teleported up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space Yserthrax can see.

legendary.name: Action 3: Elder Scream
entries: Yserthrax unleashes an eldritch scream, piercing the mind of each enemy she can see within 120 feet of her. Each target must make a {@dc 19} Wisdom saving throw, taking 77 ({@damage 14d10}) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

name: Xaantikorijek

trait.name: Static Shield (3/Day)
entries: When Xaantikorijek fails a saving throw, he can succeed instead. When he does, his sight, blindsight, and truesight are reduced to a range of 30 feet until the start of his next turn.

trait.name: Storm of the Gods
entries: Lightning and thunder damage dealt by Xaantikorijek ignore damage resistance.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Xaantikorijek makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 16} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}20 ({@damage 2d10 + 9}) piercing damage plus 5 ({@damage 1d10}) lightning damage, and Xaantikorijek can move the target up to 20 feet in any direction.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 16} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 2d6 + 9}) slashing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) thunder damage, and the target is knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Fulminating Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: Xaantikorijek exhales lightning in a line that is 120 feet long and 30 feet wide. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 23} Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 66 ({@damage 12d10}) lightning damage and has disadvantage on saving throws until the end of Xaantikorijek's next turn. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and suffers no other effect.

bonus.name: Lightning Discharge
entries: Xaantikorijek makes one Bite attack. On a hit, Xaantikorijek's teeth spark with energy, dealing an extra 11 ({@damage 2d10}) lightning damage to the target and to one other enemy within 60 feet of the target.

reaction.name: Voice of Negation
entries: When a creature Xaantikorijek can see within 60 feet of him uses an action or bonus action to cast a spell, Xaantikorijek speaks an arcane word, forcing the creature to make a {@dc 23} saving throw using their spellcasting ability. On a failed save, the target takes 16 ({@damage 3d10}) thunder damage and is unable to cast spells until the end of their turn, but the spell slot is not expended and the creature's action is not lost.

legendaryHeader: Xaantikorijek has three villain actions. He can take each action once during an encounter after an enemy's turn. He can take these actions in any order but can use only one per round.

legendary.name: Action 1: Voice of Reverence
entries: Xaantikorijek speaks an ancient word of authority into the mind of each creature of his choice within 60 feet of him. Each target must succeed on a {@dc 20} Wisdom saving throw or fall {@condition prone}. A creature who falls {@condition prone} in this way takes 22 ({@damage 4d10}) thunder damage if they stand up before the end of Xaantikorijek's next turn.

legendary.name: Action 2: Fulguration
entries: Xaantikorijek sheds his physical form to become a being of lightning until the end of his next turn. While in this form, Xaantikorijek gains the following benefits:

items: He is resistant to all damage.
He can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.
His movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks.
He can move through any creature's space, and when he moves into a creature's space for the first time on a turn, that creature takes 16 ({@damage 3d10}) lightning damage.

legendary.name: Action 3: Voice of the Ages
entries: Xaantikorijek recites an ancient lament that reverberates in nearby souls. Each enemy within 60 feet of Xaantikorijek who can hear him must make a {@dc 20} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 44 ({@damage 8d10}) psychic damage, falls {@condition prone}, and is unable to stand up for 1 minute as they weep uncontrollably (save ends at end of turn). On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and suffers no other effect.

name: Qazyldrath

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: Qazyldrath can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Consume Shadow (3/Day)
entries: When Qazyldrath fails a saving throw, they can succeed instead. When they do, any areas of magical darkness in the lair are dispelled, and they can't use Enshroud or Thwart Healing until the end of their next turn.

trait.name: Shadow Strength
entries: Acid and necrotic damage dealt by Qazyldrath ignore damage resistance.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Qazyldrath makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 15} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}19 ({@damage 2d10 + 8}) piercing damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) necrotic damage. If the target is a light source or is wearing or holding a light source, that light is extinguished.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 15} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d6 + 8}) slashing damage, and Qazyldrath can move the target up to 15 feet horizontally.

action.name: Vacuous Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: Qazyldrath exhales dark energy in a line that is 90 feet long and 20 feet wide. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 22} Dexterity saving throw, taking 24 ({@damage 7d6}) acid damage plus 24 ({@damage 7d6}) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

Additionally, that area is filled with magical darkness for 1 minute. A creature with darkvision can't see through this darkness, and no light except a {@spell daylight} spell or a light-creating spell of 5th level or higher can illuminate it.

bonus.name: Enshroud
entries: Shadows cling to one creature Qazyldrath can see within 120 feet of them. The target must succeed on a {@dc 19} Dexterity saving throw or be {@condition blinded} and vulnerable to necrotic damage until the start of Qazyldrath's next turn.

reaction.name: Thwart Healing
entries: When a creature within 60 feet of Qazyldrath regains hit points, Qazyldrath forces them to make a {@dc 19} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature regains half the number of hit points instead.

legendaryHeader: Qazyldrath has three villain actions. They can take each action once during an encounter after an enemy's turn. They can take these actions in any order but can use only one per round.

legendary.name: Action 1: Burning Globs
entries: Qazyldrath spits acid globules at each enemy they can see within 90 feet of them. Each target must succeed on a {@dc 19} Dexterity saving throw or have a globule attached to their body. A creature attached to a globule takes 14 ({@damage 4d6}) acid damage at the start of their turns. A creature can use an action to remove a globule from themself or a creature they can reach.

legendary.name: Action 2: Shadow Form
entries: Qazyldrath becomes semiincorporeal, gaining resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage until the end of their next turn. Qazyldrath then teleports up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space that they can see.

legendary.name: Action 3: Sinking Gloom
entries: Qazyldrath summons sticky black acid centered on a point they can see on the ground within 120 feet of them, creating a 5-foot-deep, 20-foot-radius pool. The pool is difficult terrain and lasts for 1 minute. An enemy who starts their turn in the pool takes 24 ({@damage 7d6}) acid damage and must succeed on a {@dc 19} Strength saving throw or be {@condition restrained} until the start of their next turn. An enemy who starts their turn flying within 30 feet of the pool must succeed on a {@dc 19} Dexterity saving throw or be pulled down by living acid, landing in the nearest unoccupied space of their choice within the pool, take 24 ({@damage 7d6}) acid damage, and be {@condition restrained} until the start of their next turn.

name: Forzaantirilys

trait.name: Hellfire
entries: Fire damage dealt by Forzaantirilys ignores damage resistance.

trait.name: Ireful Defense (3/Day)
entries: When Forzaantirilys fails a saving throw, she can succeed instead. When she does, attack rolls made against her have advantage until the end of her next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Forzaantirilys makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 17} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}21 ({@damage 2d10 + 10}) piercing damage plus 14 ({@damage 4d6}) fire damage, and the target is set on fire for 1 minute or until the target or a creature who can reach them uses an action to extinguish the flames. A creature who is on fire at the start of their turn takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) fire damage. If a creature who is already on fire is set on fire again on a subsequent turn, the damage isn't cumulative, but the duration of the fire resets to 1 minute.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 17} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 2d6 + 10}) slashing damage, and Forzaantirilys can move the target up to 15 feet horizontally.

action.name: Scorching Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: Forzaantirilys exhales fire in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 24} Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 70 ({@damage 20d6}) fire damage, and any mundane metal objects they are wearing or carrying are melted into slag and destroyed. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and their equipment isn't destroyed.

Additionally, the fire remains in that area until the end of Forzaantirilys's next turn. For the duration, that area is difficult terrain, and a creature who enters that area for the first time on a turn or ends their turn there takes 14 ({@damage 4d6}) fire damage.

bonus.name: Blazing Rush
entries: Forzaantirilys moves up to half her speed. If she enters a creature's space during this move, the creature takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) fire damage.

reaction.name: Ignite the Insolent
entries: When a creature within 120 feet of Forzaantirilys attacks her, the attacker must make a {@dc 21} Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the attacker is set on fire for 1 minute or until the attacker or a creature who can reach them uses an action to extinguish the flames. A creature who is on fire at the start of their turn takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) fire damage. If a creature who is already on fire is set on fire again on a subsequent turn, the damage isn't cumulative, but the duration of the fire resets to 1 minute.

legendaryHeader: Forzaantirilys has three villain actions. She can take each action once during an encounter after an enemy's turn. She can take these actions in any order but can use only one per round.

legendary.name: Action 1: Cinderfall
entries: A 30-foot-radius cloud of smoke and cinders surrounds Forzaantirilys until the end of her next turn. That area is heavily obscured for creatures other than Forzaantirilys. An enemy who needs to breathe and starts their turn within the cloud must succeed on a {@dc 21} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).

legendary.name: Action 2: Ashen Armor
entries: Forzaantirilys's skin hardens into a protective armor of ashen scales, granting her 100 temporary hit points. Until all these temporary hit points are gone, a creature within 5 feet of Forzaantirilys who touches her or hits her with an attack takes 14 ({@damage 4d6}) fire damage.

legendary.name: Action 3: Supernova
entries: Forzaantirilys unleashes a massive burst of light and heat. Each creature within 120 feet of her must make a {@dc 21} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 35 ({@damage 10d6}) fire damage plus 35 ({@damage 10d6}) radiant damage and is {@condition blinded}. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't {@condition blinded}. The blindness lasts until cured by a power, a spell, or a similar supernatural effect that removes the {@condition blinded} condition.

name: Durixaviinox

trait.name: Frosted Resistance (3/Day)
entries: When Durixaviinox fails a saving throw, he can succeed instead. When he does, his speed is halved and he can't take the Disengage action until the end of his next turn.

trait.name: Hoarfrost
entries: Cold damage dealt by Durixaviinox ignores damage resistance.

trait.name: Ice Walk
entries: Durixaviinox can move across and climb icy surfaces without needing to make an ability check. Additionally, difficult terrain composed of ice or snow doesn't cost him extra movement.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Durixaviinox makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 14} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}19 ({@damage 2d10 + 8}) piercing damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) cold damage, and the target can't take reactions until the end of their next turn.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 14} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d6 + 8}) slashing damage, and Durixaviinox can move the target up to 15 feet horizontally.

action.name: Numbing Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: Durixaviinox exhales a freezing blast in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 22} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 42 ({@damage 12d6}) cold damage and is {@condition restrained} until the end of their next turn. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't {@condition restrained}.

bonus.name: Icy Grip
entries: Durixaviinox encases a creature he can see within 60 feet of him in ice. The target must make a {@dc 18} Strength saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 22 ({@damage 4d10}) cold damage and is {@condition restrained}. On a successful save, a target takes half as much damage and isn't {@condition restrained}. A creature can use an action to break themself or another creature they can reach out of the ice, ending the {@condition restrained} condition.

reaction.name: Withering Frost
entries: When a creature within 5 feet of Durixaviinox hits him with an attack, Durixaviinox releases a burst of cold energy. Each creature within 5 feet of him must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or take 10 ({@damage 3d6}) cold damage.

legendaryHeader: Durixaviinox has three villain actions. He can take each action once during an encounter after an enemy's turn. He can take these actions in any order but can use only one per round.

legendary.name: Action 1: Raging Blizzard
entries: Durixaviinox beats his wings, and frigid winds and hail swirl around him. Each creature within 120 feet of him must make a {@dc 18} Strength saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 21 ({@damage 6d6}) bludgeoning damage, is pushed 60 feet directly away from Durixaviinox, and is knocked {@condition prone}. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't pushed or knocked {@condition prone}.

legendary.name: Action 2: Royal Defense
entries: Durixaviinox calls the faithful soul of a spectral guard to fight at his side. The guard uses the frost giant wind sprinter stat block, but they are an Undead instead of a Giant. The guard acts immediately after Durixaviinox and follows his verbal commands. While the guard is within 60 feet of Durixaviinox, Durixaviinox gains resistance to all damage. If Durixaviinox dies, the guard is destroyed.

legendary.name: Action 3: Frost Cataclysm
entries: Durixaviinox releases a pulse of frigid energy followed by a shock wave of force in a 120-foot-radius sphere centered on him. Each enemy in that area must make a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw, taking 45 ({@damage 10d8}) cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Immediately after, each enemy in that area must make a {@dc 18} Strength saving throw, taking 45 ({@damage 10d8}) force damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

trait.name: Arcane Acumen
entries: The dragonet has advantage on Intelligence ({@skill Arcana}) checks made to reveal information about supernatural effects and objects they can see. Additionally, they always know if their emotions are being sensed, their thoughts are being read, or they are being targeted or perceived by any divination spells.

trait.name: True Words
entries: When a creature speaks in Draconic, the dragonet has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) checks to determine whether they are lying.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) slashing damage.

action.name: Revealing Breath (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: The dragonet exhales sparkling light in a 15-foot cone. Each object in that area is outlined in light for 1 minute, and each creature in that area must succeed on a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw or also be outlined in light for the duration. Outlined creatures and objects shed dim light in a 5-foot radius, and if any outlined creatures or objects bear magic, the dragonet can learn its school of magic, if any, by looking at it. Any attack roll against an outlined creature or object has advantage if the attacker can see the target, and the outlined creature or object can't benefit from being {@condition invisible}.

action.name: Truesight (Recharges after a Long Rest)
entries: For 1 minute, the dragonet gains truesight out to a range of 60 feet.

hp.special: Eight times their level (number of d10 Hit Dice equal to their level)

action.name: Signature Attack (Daggers)
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 3 plus PB} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. {@h}{@damage 2d4 + PB} piercing damage. Beginning at 7th level, the retainer can make this attack twice, instead of once, when they take the Attack action on their turn.

action.name: 3rd Level: Misleading Strike (3/Day)
entries: As an action, the retainer makes a signature attack. On a hit, the target must use their reaction, if available, to make a weapon attack against a creature of the retainer's choice.

action.name: 5th Level: Adjuration (3/Day)
entries: As a bonus action, the retainer grants an infernal blessing to an ally they can see within 60 feet of them. The next time that ally makes an attack roll before the start of the retainer's next turn, the ally adds a +PB bonus to the roll. If the attack hits, it deals an extra {@damage 0d1 + PB|PB} damage.

action.name: 7th Level: Hellbitten Knives (1/Day)
entries: As a bonus action, the retainer imbues their daggers with hellfire. For 1 minute, their signature attack deals an extra {@damage 0d1 + PB|PB} fire damage and ignores damage resistances.

name: Infernal Chancellor Lazivos

trait.name: Security for Speed (3/Day)
entries: When Lazivos fails a saving throw, he can succeed instead. When he does, his speed is halved and he can't take bonus actions or reactions until the end of his next turn.

trait.name: Supernatural Resistance
entries: Lazivos has advantage on saving throws against powers, spells, and other supernatural effects.

trait.name: True Name

action.name: Infernal Rapier
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d8 + 5}) piercing damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) fire damage, and the target is marked with an infernal sigil until the end of their next turn. While marked, a creature can't hide or benefit from being {@condition invisible}, and attack rolls against them have advantage.

action.name: Chancellor's Decree
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 12} to hit, range 120 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 2d10 + 7}) psychic damage, and the target must make a {@dc 20} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target is {@condition charmed} by Lazivos until the end of his next turn or until Lazivos or one of his allies harms the target.

action.name: Diabolic Deposition {@recharge 5}
entries: Lazivos commands the attention of each enemy within 30 feet of him who can hear him. Each target must make a DC 20 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a creature must choose to either take 27 ({@damage 6d8}) fire damage plus 27 ({@damage 6d8}) psychic damage or be {@condition dazed|FleeMortals} for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn). On a successful save, a creature must either choose to take half as much damage or be {@condition dazed|FleeMortals} until the end of their next turn. Succeed or fail, if a creature is already {@condition dazed|FleeMortals}, they must choose the damage

bonus.name: As I Say

reaction.name: Devilish Charm
entries: When Lazivos is targeted by an attack, power, spell, or other supernatural effect by a creature he can see within 60 feet of him, the creature must make a {@dc 20} Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is {@condition charmed} by Lazivos until the start of the creature's next turn, and Lazivos chooses a new target he can see for the triggering effect. The new target must be within the triggering effect's range.

legendaryHeader: Lazivos has three villain actions. He can take each action once during an encounter after an enemy's turn. He can take these actions in any order but can use only one per round.

legendary.name: Action 1: Welcome, Friends
entries: Lazivos invokes an infernal word of power. Up to three enemies within 60 feet of him who can hear him must make a {@dc 20} Charisma saving throw. On a successful save, a target takes 16 ({@damage 3d10}) psychic damage.

legendary.name: Action 2: Heed My Commands!
entries: Lazivos and each ally within 60 feet of him moves up to their speed without provoking opportunity attacks. Each creature {@condition charmed} by Lazivos moves up to half their speed in a direction he chooses (no action required).

legendary.name: Action 3: Deceptive Stratagem
entries: Lazivos switches places with a willing creature of his choice within 120 feet of him. Immediately afterward, up to five creatures of Lazivos's choice within 120 feet of him can make a melee attack (no action required).

trait.name: Importunity
entries: At the start of the notary's turn, they can grant an infernal blessing to a non-minion ally they can see within 60 feet of them (no action required). The next time that ally makes an attack roll or saving throw before the start of the notary's next turn, the ally can add a +1 bonus to the roll. This bonus increases by 1 (maximum bonus of +5) for each notary who grants an infernal blessing to the creature.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the notary takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, their hit points are reduced to 0. If the notary takes damage from another effect, they die if the damage equals or exceeds their hit point maximum; otherwise they take no damage.

trait.name: True Name
entries: If a creature the notary can hear within 60 feet of them speaks the notary's true name aloud, the notary loses their damage immunities and Importunity trait for 24 hours.

action.name: Brimstone (Group Attack)

action.name: Infernal Knife

action.name: Obsidian Kris

reaction.name: Devilish Charm (2/Day)

On a failed save, the creature is {@condition charmed} by the adjudicator until the start of the creature's next turn, and the adjudicator chooses a new target the adjudicator can see for the triggering effect. name: Aurumvas

trait.name: Abyssal Resistance (Costs 2 Souls)
entries: When Aurumvas fails a saving throw, he succeeds instead.

trait.name: Lethe
entries: When Aurumvas's soul count is 0, he has advantage on attack rolls, disadvantage on saving throws, and his Intelligence score becomes 3 (-4). Additionally, Aurumvas must use his movement on each of his turns to move as close as possible to the nearest creature he can sense with his soulsight, and then if he is able, he must use his action to attack and attempt to kill that creature. Aurumvas can't act with any other purpose until he adds 1 to his soul count.

trait.name: Soul Devourer
entries: When Aurumvas reduces a creature who isn't a Construct or an Undead to 0 hit points or deals damage to a dying creature, the creature must make a {@dc 11} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, Aurumvas consumes the creature's soul and adds 1 to his soul count. A creature whose soul is consumed in this way immediately dies, and they can't be restored to life by any means short of a {@spell wish} spell.

trait.name: Soul Weapons
entries: While Aurumvas's soul count is 2 or higher, his weapon attacks are magical, and allies within 60 feet of him deal an extra 5 ({@damage 1d10}) psychic damage with weapon attacks.

action.name: Multiattack

action.name: Greedy Hands

action.name: Covetous Bolt
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 11} to hit, range 120 ft., one target. {@h}22 ({@damage 5d8}) force damage. If the target has spell slots, Aurumvas can burn 2 souls to force the target to expend their highest-level spell slot available with no effect.

bonus.name: Greed Is Good
entries: Aurumvas chooses an object he can see within 30 feet of him that is worth at least 100 gp. He teleports to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of that object.

reaction.name: Absorb Soul
entries: If a demon with a soul count of 1 or higher who Aurumvas can see dies within 60 feet of him, Aurumvas gains 1 soul.

legendary.name: Action 2: That's Ours
entries: Aurumvas chooses up to three magic items he can see within 30 feet of him that aren't artifacts or of legendary rarity and that don't require attunement. He teleports each item to an ally who he can see within 30 feet of him, placing it either into their hands or at their feet. If a targeted object is being worn or carried by an enemy, the enemy can make a {@dc 19} Charisma saving throw, preventing that object from being teleported on a success.

legendary.name: Action 3: At Any Cost

Creatures who can't be {@condition frightened} succeed on this saving throw automatically.
