name: Ancient Lightning Eel

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The eel can breathe air and water. They can survive out of water for up to 24 hours.

trait.name: Foudroyant Majesty (3/Day)
entries: When the eel fails a saving throw, they can succeed instead. When they do, they can't take the Multiattack action on their next turn.

trait.name: Slippery
entries: The eel has advantage on ability checks and saving throws made to avoid or end the {@condition grappled} condition on themself.

trait.name: Stormsurge
entries: Other lightning eels within 30 feet of the ancient eel deal an extra 4 ({@damage 1d8}) lightning damage with their weapon attacks and Electric Pulse.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The eel makes one Bite attack and uses Electric Pulse.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) piercing damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) lightning damage, and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 17}). While {@condition grappled}, the target is {@condition restrained} and the eel can't make a Bite attack against another target.

action.name: Electric Pulse
entries: The eel channels energy toward a creature within 60 feet of them. The creature must make a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw, made with disadvantage if the target is touching the eel. On a failed save, a creature takes 27 ({@damage 6d8}) lightning damage and is {@condition dazed|FleeMortals} until the end of their next turn. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't {@condition dazed|FleeMortals}.

bonus.name: Coiling Storm
entries: The eel coils around a creature within 5 feet of them. The target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw or be {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 17}).

reaction.name: Heart of the Storm
entries: When another lightning eel that the ancient eel can see within 30 feet of them is reduced to 0 hit points, the ancient eel releases a crackling filament of lightning in their direction. The target is restored to life with 10 hit points. Each lighting eel can be restored to life only once with this reaction.

legendaryHeader: The eel has three villain actions. They can take each action once during an encounter after an enemy's turn. They can take these actions in any order but can use only one per round.

legendary.name: Action 1: Call to the Storm
entries: Every other lightning eel within 30 feet of the ancient eel can use their Electric Pulse action as a reaction.

legendary.name: Action 2: Electric Rush
entries: The eel surges with lightning, moves up to their speed, then makes a Bite attack. On a hit, the Bite attack deals an extra 18 ({@damage 4d8}) lightning damage. A creature who hits the eel with a melee attack during this movement takes 9 ({@damage 2d8}) lightning damage.

legendary.name: Action 3: Fulminous Wave
entries: The eel releases a crackling wave of electricity and uses Electric Pulse against each enemy within 30 feet of them.

name: Deathhawk
languages: understands Common but can't speak it

trait.name: Corpse Sense
entries: Within a range of 5 miles, the deathhawk can sense the presence of Undead or corpses that have been dead for less than 90 days; the deathhawk knows the general direction these are in but not their exact locations. In addition, the deathhawk has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks made to find Undead or corpses that have been dead for less than 90 days.

trait.name: Flyby
entries: The deathhawk doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when they fly out of an enemy's reach.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The deathhawk makes one Beak attack and one Wounding Talons attack.

action.name: Beak
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 3d4 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Wounding Talons
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) slashing damage. If the target is a creature who isn't a Construct or an Undead, they gain a bleeding wound that lasts until they regain at least 1 hit point. A bleeding creature loses 5 ({@damage 1d10}) hit points for each bleeding wound they have at the start of their turn. Any creature who can reach the target can use an action to stanch all the target's wounds, ending the effect.

bonus.name: Bloodcurdling Shriek {@recharge}
entries: The deathhawk shrieks, and each enemy within 300 feet of the deathhawk who can hear them must make a {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw. Creatures who are immune to the {@condition frightened} condition automatically succeed on this saving throw. On a failed save, a creature is horrified for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn). While horrified, each time the creature makes an attack roll or a saving throw, they must roll a {@damage d4} and subtract the number rolled from the attack roll or saving throw.
If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for them, they are immune to the Bloodcurdling Shriek of all deathhawks for the next 24 hours.

trait.name: Beast of Burden
entries: The camel is considered to be one size larger for the purpose of determining their carrying capacity.

trait.name: Desert Dweller
entries: The camel ignores difficult terrain created by dirt or sand. They can tolerate temperatures as high as 120° Fahrenheit.

trait.name: Metabolic Reserves
entries: The camel can go without water for up to 7 days, and without food for up to 90 days.

trait.name: Stubborn
entries: The camel has advantage on saving throws made to avoid or end the {@condition charmed}, {@condition frightened}, or {@condition prone} condition on themself.

action.name: Kick
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d10 + 3}) bludgeoning damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

bonus.name: Bilious Spit {@recharge 5}
entries: The camel vomits bile onto a creature they can see within 10 feet of them. The target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn). If the target fails the save by 5 or more, they are also {@condition blinded} while {@condition poisoned} in this way.

trait.name: Exceptional Vision
entries: The bird has a +10 bonus to Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight.

trait.name: Flyby
entries: The bird doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when they fly out of an enemy's reach.

trait.name: High-Speed Dive (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: If the bird descends at least 30 feet on their turn, they can take the Dash action as a bonus action. When they do, they have advantage on the next attack they make before the end of their turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The bird makes two attacks using Heavy Beak, Rending Talons, or both.

action.name: Heavy Beak
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) piercing damage. On a critical hit, the target is {@condition dazed|FleeMortals} until the start of the bird's next turn.

action.name: Rending Talons
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) slashing damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, they are {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 13}). While grappling a target, the bird's Beak attacks against that target are made with advantage, and the bird can't attack another target. Each time the target makes a check to end the grapple, the target takes 4 ({@damage 1d8}) slashing damage.

action.name: Crushing Grip
entries: The bird's powerful talons crush a {@condition grappled} target. The target must make a {@dc 13} Strength saving throw, taking 17 ({@damage 5d6}) bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If the target fails the save by 5 or more, they are also {@condition dazed|FleeMortals} until the end of their next turn.

bonus.name: Spot
entries: The bird makes a Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check.

trait.name: Exceptional Vision
entries: The bird has a +10 bonus to Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight.

trait.name: Flyby
entries: The bird doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when they fly out of an enemy's reach.

trait.name: High-Speed Dive (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: If the bird descends at least 30 feet on their turn, they can take the Dash action as a bonus action. When they do, they have advantage on the next attack they make before the end of their turn.

action.name: Beak
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Talons
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) slashing damage. If the target is a Tiny creature, they are {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 12}). If the target is a Small or larger creature, the bird attaches to them. While attached, the bird's Beak attacks against that target are made with advantage, and the bird can't attack another target. The target or a creature who can reach them can attempt to detach the bird as an action by making a {@dc 12} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. On a failed check, the attached target takes 2 ({@damage 1d4}) slashing damage. On a successful check, the attached target takes 2 ({@damage 1d4}) slashing damage and is no longer attached. The bird can detach by spending 5 feet of their movement.

bonus.name: Spot
entries: The bird makes a Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check.

trait.name: Exceptional Smell
entries: The bear has a +10 bonus to Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on smell, and they can smell creatures even through dirt, snow, and water.

trait.name: Natural Camouflage
entries: The bear has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks made in their native terrain.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) piercing damage, or maximum damage if the target is a Plant.

action.name: Swat
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) slashing or bludgeoning damage (bear's choice), and the target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Exceptional Smell
entries: The bear has a +10 bonus to Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on smell, and they can smell creatures even through dirt, snow, and water.

trait.name: Natural Camouflage
entries: The bear has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks made in their native terrain.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The bear makes one Bite attack and one Claw attack.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) piercing damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, they are {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 14}). Until this grapple ends, the bear can't use their Bite attack on another target.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d4 + 4}) slashing damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, they are knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Powerful Swipe {@recharge}
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 1d12 + 4}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, they are shoved up to 10 feet away and knocked {@condition prone}. If the target hits a solid surface, they take an extra 7 ({@damage 2d6}) bludgeoning damage.

hp.special: 7 + seven times caregiver's level (number of d8 Hit Dice equal to their caregiver's level)

trait.name: Hold Breath
entries: The clawfish can hold their breath for 15 minutes.

action.name: Signature Attack (Bite)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3 plus PB} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 1d6 plus PB} piercing damage.

action.name: 1st Level: Overwhelming Attack (2 Ferocity)
entries: The clawfish makes a signature attack. On a hit, the attack deals an extra {@damage 0d1 + PB|PB} lightning damage, and the target can't take reactions until the start of the clawfish's next turn.

action.name: 3rd Level: Coiling Claws (5 Ferocity)
entries: The clawfish makes a signature attack against a Medium or smaller creature. On a hit, the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 10 plus PB}). Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained} and the clawfish can't make a signature attack against another target.

action.name: 5th Level: Lightning Bomb (8 Ferocity)
entries: Each creature within 10 feet of the clawfish must make a {@dc 10 plus PB} Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage PBd8} lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

reaction.name: Lightning Retaliation (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: When the clawfish or their caregiver is attacked by a creature the clawfish can see within 5 feet of them, the clawfish shocks the attacker. The attacker must make a {@dc 10 plus PB} Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage PBd6} lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

trait.name: Hold Breath
entries: The clawfish can hold their breath for 15 minutes.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) slashing damage, and if the target is a Small or larger creature, the clawfish can pull themself into the target's space and attach to the target. While attached, the clawfish moves with the target without provoking opportunity attacks, and the clawfish can't make Claw attacks. A creature who can reach the clawfish can use an action to make a {@dc 12} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) or Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics}) check. On a success, the clawfish is detached and shunted into an unoccupied space of the clawfish's choice within 5 feet of the target. The clawfish also detaches if they become {@condition grappled}, {@condition incapacitated}, {@condition prone}, or {@condition restrained}, or if they use 5 feet of movement to detach.

action.name: Electrocute {@recharge}
entries: Each creature touching the clawfish takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) lightning damage. If the clawfish is immersed in water, each other creature within 10 feet of the clawfish who is touching the same body of water must succeed on a {@dc 11} Dexterity saving throw or take the same damage.

hp.special: Seven times their level (number of d8 Hit Dice equal to their level)

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The angulotl yegg can breathe air and water.

action.name: Signature Attack (Poison Knife)
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 3 plus PB} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 1d4 plus PB} piercing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) poison damage. Beginning at 7th level, the yegg can make this attack twice, instead of once, when they take the Attack action on their turn.

action.name: 3rd Level: Death from Above! (3/Day)
entries: As a bonus action, the yegg jumps up to their walking speed without provoking opportunity attacks. If they leap over an enemy during this jump, the yegg can make a signature attack with advantage against that enemy. On a hit, this attack deals an extra {@damage 0d1 + PB|PB} piercing damage.

action.name: 5th Level: Lay Low (3/Day)
entries: When the yegg hits a creature with a signature attack while hidden, the yegg can use their reaction to remain hidden.

action.name: 7th Level: Excoriating Acid (3/Day)
entries: As an action, the yegg throws a flask of acid at a point they can see within 20 feet of them. The flask shatters, and each creature within 10 feet of that point must make a {@dc 10 plus PB} Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage PBd10} acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

trait.name: Acid Burst
entries: When the tadpole is reduced to 0 hit points, their body pops, spraying acid around them. Each creature within 5 feet of the tadpole takes 1 acid damage.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The tadpole can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the tadpole takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, their hit points are reduced to 0. If the tadpole takes damage from another effect, they die if the damage equals or exceeds their hit point maximum; otherwise they take no damage.

trait.name: Noxious Skin
entries: When a creature starts their turn within 5 feet of three or more tadpoles, that creature must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} until the start of their next turn. The DC for this saving throw equals 10 plus the number of tadpoles within 5 feet of the creature.

action.name: Bite (Group Attack)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, one target. {@h}1 piercing damage.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The slink can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The slink can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Toxiferous
entries: When a creature hits the slink with a melee attack while within 5 feet of them or touches the slink, that creature takes 2 ({@damage 1d4}) poison damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The slink makes one Poison Dagger attack and one Tongue Nab attack.

action.name: Poison Dagger
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) piercing damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) poison damage, and the target can't take reactions until the start of their next turn.

action.name: Tongue Nab
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 10 ft., one Medium or smaller creature. {@h}The slink grabs one Small or Tiny object the slink can see that the target is holding or carrying. The slink can catch the object if they have a free hand, otherwise it lands at the slink's feet.

bonus.name: Hop and Hide
entries: The slink jumps a number of feet up to their walking speed, then takes the Hide action.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The seer can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Third Eye
entries: Creatures within 30 feet of the seer can't hide from the seer. Creatures who can't be targeted by divination magic are immune to this effect.

trait.name: Toxiferous
entries: When a creature hits the seer with a melee attack while within 5 feet of them or touches the seer, that creature takes 2 ({@damage 1d4}) poison damage.

action.name: Acid Grasp
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 4d6}) acid damage. If the target is a creature and they attack the seer before the start of the seer's next turn, the target takes 14 ({@damage 4d6}) acid damage.

action.name: Refulgent Beam
entries: The seer fires two magical beams of radiant energy, each beam targeting a creature the seer can see within 120 feet of them. Each target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or take 13 ({@damage 3d8}) radiant damage and shed dim light in a 10-foot radius for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn). While shedding light in this way, attack rolls against the target have advantage, the target can't benefit from being {@condition invisible}, and they can't take the Hide action.

action.name: Noxious Bubble (1/Day)
entries: The seer creates a 5-foot-radius sphere filled with toxic gas in an unoccupied space they can see within 60 feet of them. If undisturbed, this bubble lasts for 1 minute then dissipates harmlessly. If a creature attacks the bubble, touches it, enters its space, or otherwise disturbs it, the bubble bursts, and each creature within 15 feet of it must make a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw, taking 27 ({@damage 6d8}) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

action.name: Psychedelic Drone (1/Day)
entries: Each enemy within 60 feet of the seer who can hear them must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or take 10 ({@damage 3d6}) psychic damage and be {@condition dazed|FleeMortals} for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).

bonus.name: Hop
entries: The seer jumps a number of feet up to their walking speed.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The needler can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Sniper
entries: If the needler misses with a ranged weapon attack while they are hidden, they remain hidden. Additionally, if the needler makes a ranged weapon attack with advantage and hits, the attack deals an extra 3 ({@damage 1d6}) damage.

trait.name: Toxiferous
entries: When a creature hits the needler with a melee attack while within 5 feet of them or touches the needler, that creature takes 2 ({@damage 1d4}) poison damage.

action.name: Poison Shortsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) piercing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) poison damage.

action.name: Blowgun
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 6} to hit, range 25/100 ft., one target. {@h}1 piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn). While {@condition poisoned} in this way, the target takes 14 ({@damage 4d6}) poison damage at the start of each of their turns.

bonus.name: Hop and Hide
entries: The needler jumps a number of feet up to their walking speed, then takes the Hide action.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The blade can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Slippery
entries: Opportunity attacks against the blade are made with disadvantage.

trait.name: Toxiferous
entries: When a creature hits the blade with a melee attack while within 5 feet of them or touches the blade, that creature takes 2 ({@damage 1d4}) poison damage.

action.name: Machete
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) slashing damage.

action.name: Dart
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 4} to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing damage.

bonus.name: Wild Hop
entries: The blade jumps a number of feet up to their walking speed. If the blade uses this bonus action to jump at least 10 feet straight toward a creature, the next Machete attack the blade makes against that creature on the same turn is made with advantage.

trait.name: Alien Mind
entries: {@actSave int} {@dc 22}, any creature that tries to read Valaar's thoughts or deals Psychic damage to it. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Stunned|XPHB} condition and repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day, or 5/Day in Lair)
entries: If Valaara fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Valaara has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: Valaara regains 20 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} at the start of each of its turns. If Valaara takes Radiant damage, this trait doesn't function on Valaara's next turn. Valaara dies only if it starts its turn with 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} and doesn't regenerate.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Valaara makes two attacks, using Chitinous Claw or Chitinous Spine in any combination. It also uses Summon Swarms.

action.name: Chitinous Claw
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 14}, reach 5 ft. {@h}18 ({@damage 2d10 + 7}) Slashing damage.

action.name: Chitinous Spine
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 14}, range 60/180 ft. {@h}17 ({@damage 3d6 + 7}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Summon Swarms
entries: Valaara summons a swarm of insects or arachnids that fills a 10-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on a point Valaara can see within 120 feet, afflicting all creatures in the area with one of the following effects (roll a {@dice 1d6} or choose one), to which Valaara is immune:

items.name: Stinging Wasps
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 22}. {@actSaveFail} 32 ({@damage 5d12}) Piercing damage, and the target has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on attack rolls and ability checks until the end of its next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage and the target doesn't have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on attack rolls.

items.name: Spinning Spiders
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 22}. {@actSaveFail} 27 ({@damage 6d8}) Bludgeoning damage. The target has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition until the web is destroyed (AC 10; HP 5; {@variantrule Vulnerability|XPHB} to Fire damage; {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to Poison and Psychic damage).

items.name: Venomous Centipedes
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 22}. {@actSaveFail} 22 ({@damage 4d10}) Poison damage and the target has the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically.

items.name: Infesting Grubs
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 22}. {@actSaveFail} The target is infested by 4 ({@dice 1d4 + 2}) rot grubs, taking 3 ({@damage 1d6}) Piercing damage per rot grub at the start of each of its turns. If a target infested with rot grubs ends its turn with 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, the rot grubs burrow into its heart, killing it. Any effect that cures disease kills all rot grubs infesting the target, ending the effect. Applying fire to the bite wound before the end of the creature's next turn deals 1 Fire damage to the creature and kills the rot grubs, ending the effect. After this time, the rot grubs are too far under the skin to be burned.

items.name: Discordant Cicadas
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 22}. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition. At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the save, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically. While {@condition Frightened|XPHB}, the target has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition. {@actSaveSuccess} The target has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on future saves against this swarm for 24 hours.

action.name: Psychoactive Beetles
entries: {@actSave int} {@dc 22}. {@actSaveFail} 33 ({@damage 6d10}) Psychic damage.

bonus.name: Teleport
entries: Valaara teleports up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

legendary.name: Throw Spine
entries: Valaara makes one Chitinous Spine attack.

legendary.name: Imaginary Crawlers
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 22}, one creature Valaara can see within 60 feet. {@actSaveFail} 22 ({@damage 4d10}) Psychic damage, and the target immediately loses {@status Concentration|XPHB} on any spell it is {@status Concentration|XPHB|Concentrating} on.

legendary.name: Synthesize Worm
entries: Valaara magically fuses the swarms under its command, forming a Carrion Crawler in an unoccupied space they can see within 90 feet of themself. The Carrion Crawler takes its turn immediately after Valaara on the same {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} count, and it obeys Valaara.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The Forgotten Prince casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 23}, {@hit 15} to hit with spell attacks):

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day or 5/Day in Lair)
entries: If the Forgotten Prince fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The Forgotten Prince has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Stolen Gifts
entries: At the start of each of his turns, the Forgotten Prince causes one creature he can see within 60 feet to make a {@dc 25} Wisdom ({@skill Perception|XPHB}) check. On a failed check, the Forgotten Prince steals one of the following from the target until the start of the his next turn:

items.name: Weapon Skill
entries: For the duration, the target has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on weapon attacks, and the Prince has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Dark Scythe attacks.

items.name: Spellcasting Ability
entries: For the duration, the target has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on spell attacks, and all creatures have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws made to resist the target's spells. Additionally, all creatures have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on saving throws to resist the Prince's spells.

items.name: Speed
entries: The target's {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is reduced by 20 feet (to a minimum of 5 feet). Additionally, the Prince's {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is increased by 20 feet, and he can take the Disengage action as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}.

trait.name: Thelanian Protagonist
entries: If destroyed, the Forgotten Prince reforms in {@dice 1d4} days, reviving with all his {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. The new body appears in an unoccupied space within the Castle of Forgotten Things.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Forgotten Prince makes two Dark Scythe attacks.

action.name: Dark Scythe
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 15}, reach 10 ft. {@h}29 ({@damage 6d6 + 8}) Necrotic damage.

action.name: Threads of Memory {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 23}, up to three creatures the Forgotten Prince can see within 60 feet. {@actSaveFail} 28 ({@damage 8d6}) Psychic damage, and the target's memories are stolen. Until the memories return, the target subtracts 2 ({@dice 1d4}) from all {@dice D20} Tests. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically.

bonus.name: Fey Step
entries: The Forgotten Prince can teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space he can see.

bonus.name: Shadow Stealth
entries: The Forgotten Prince can take the Hide action.

reaction.name: Shadow Burst
entries: {@actTrigger} The Forgotten Prince is reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. {@actResponse} Creatures within 15 feet take 36 ({@damage 8d8}) Necrotic damage.

legendary.name: Dark Scythe
entries: The Forgotten Prince makes one Dark Scythe attack.

legendary.name: Fey Step
entries: The Forgotten Prince uses Fey Step.

legendary.name: Marked for Vengeance
entries: The Forgotten Prince uses Spellcasting to cast {@spell Hex|XPHB} (level 5 version).

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The Forest Queen casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 23}, {@hit 15} to hit with spell attacks):

trait.name: Grace of the Forest Queen
entries: As long as the Forest Queen is within the Endless Weald, her AC is 25.

trait.name: Inscrutable
entries: No magic can observe the Forest Queen remotely or detect her thoughts without her permission. Wisdom ({@skill Insight|XPHB}) checks made to ascertain the Forest Queen's intentions or sincerity are made with {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day, or 5/Day in the Endless Weald)
entries: If the Forest Queen fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The Forest Queen has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Speak with Beasts and Plants
entries: The Forest Queen can communicate with Beasts and Plants as if they shared a language.

trait.name: Thelanian Protagonist
entries: If destroyed, the Forest Queen reforms in {@dice 1d4} days, reviving with all her {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. The new body appears in an unoccupied space within the Endless Weald.

trait.name: Woodland Camouflage
entries: The Forest Queen has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth|XPHB}) checks made to hide in wooded terrain.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Forest Queen makes two attacks, using Grasping Vine and Verdant Staff in any combination.

action.name: Grasping Vine
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 15}, reach 40 ft. {@h}26 ({@damage 4d8 + 8}) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 23}) from a vine that sprouts from the ground.

action.name: Verdant Staff
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 15}, reach 10 ft. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) Bludgeoning damage plus 21 ({@damage 6d6}) Force damage.

bonus.name: Tree Stride
entries: If within 5 feet of a Large or bigger tree, the Forest Queen teleports to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of a second Large or bigger tree that is within 60 feet of the previous tree.

legendary.name: Bludgeon
entries: The Forest Queen makes a Grasping Vine or Verdant Staff attack.

legendary.name: Crushing Grasp
entries: One creature that is {@condition Grappled|XPHB} by the Forest Queen's Grasping Vine takes 27 ({@damage 5d10}) Bludgeoning damage.

legendary.name: Touch of Nature
entries: The Forest Queen uses Spellcasting to cast a spell of her choice.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The sahuagin casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 16}):

trait.name: Blood Frenzy
entries: The sahuagin has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all its {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}.

trait.name: Limited Amphibiousness
entries: The sahuagin can breathe air and water, but it must be submerged at least once every 4 hours to avoid suffocating outside water.

trait.name: Shark Telepathy
entries: The sahuagin can magically control sharks within 120 feet of itself, using a special telepathy.

trait.name: Toughened Carapace
entries: Any {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB} against the sahuagin becomes a normal hit.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The sahuagin makes three attacks, using Crushing Claw or Cutter Claw in any combination. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting.

action.name: Crushing Claw
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 9}, reach 10 ft. {@h}16 ({@damage 2d10 + 5}) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 15}) from the Crushing Claw.

action.name: Cutter Claw
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 9}, reach 10 ft. {@h}24 ({@damage 3d12 + 5}) Slashing damage.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The plasmid can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Receptive Telepathy
entries: The plasmid is considered a shark for the purpose of being magically controlled by any sahuagin's Shark {@variantrule Telepathy|XPHB} trait.

trait.name: Solid State (Object Form Only)
entries: When formed into an inanimate object, the plasmid has an AC of 18 and regains 10 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} at the start of each of its turns. However, the plasmid's {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} becomes 0 in this form and it cannot attack. It can be used as an item or a set of {@item Artisan's Tools|XPHB} when it is in this form.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The plasmid makes three Vicious Pseudopod attacks.

action.name: Vicious Pseudopod
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 10 ft. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) Slashing damage.

action.name: Adaptive Shape-Shift (Amorphous Form Only)
entries: When in its true, amorphous form, the plasmid gains one of the following benefits until it uses this action again:

items.name: Truesight
entries: The plasmid gains {@sense Truesight|XPHB} with a range of 30 feet.

items.name: Blindsight
entries: The plasmid gains {@sense Blindsight|XPHB} with a range of 60 feet.

items.name: Speed
entries: The plasmid's {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} and {@variantrule Swim Speed|XPHB} increase to 30 feet.

items.name: Extra Damage
entries: The plasmid's Vicious Pseudopod deals an extra {@damage 1d6} Acid damage on a hit.

bonus.name: Shape-Shift
entries: The plasmid shape-shifts to resemble a Medium or Small object while retaining its game statistics, or it returns to its true amorphous form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The merfolk casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 14}):

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The merfolk can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Summon Storm
entries: Once per day, one or more merfolk stormcallers can cast {@spell Control Weather|XPHB} as a {@variantrule Ritual|XPHB} that takes 10 minutes to perform. For every additional stormcaller involved in performing the {@variantrule Ritual|XPHB}, the radius of the spell's effect increases by 1 mile, the duration increases by 2 hours, and they can change the weather by one additional stage every {@dice 1d4 x 10} minutes. During the casting, if the stormcallers take any action other than performing the {@variantrule Ritual|XPHB}, they must start over.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The stormcaller makes three Lightning Lash attacks.

action.name: Lightning Lash
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 15 ft. {@h}14 ({@damage 4d6}) Lightning damage.

reaction.name: Thunderous Rebuke
entries: {@actTrigger} A creature within 60 feet of the merfolk deals damage to it. {@actResponse d}{@actSave con} {@dc 14}, the triggering creature. {@actSaveFail} 11 ({@damage 2d10}) Thunder damage, and the target has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

spellcasting.name: Etherealness
headerEntries: The meld cast the {@spell Etherealness|XPHB} spell, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability. The meld is visible on the Material Plane while on the Border Ethereal and vice versa, but it can't affect or be affected by anything on the other plane.

trait.name: Ethereal Sight
entries: The meld can see 60 feet into the Ethereal Plane when it is on the Material Plane and vice versa.

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The meld can move through other creatures and objects as if they were {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB}. It takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object. The meld can also interact with any liquid surface as if it was solid ground.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The meld makes four Withering Slam attacks. It can replace two attacks with a use of Conflicted Soul.

action.name: Withering Slam
entries: {@atk m} +7, reach 10 ft. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) Necrotic damage.

action.name: Conflicted Soul
entries: {@actSave cha} {@dc 14}, one creature the meld can see within 30 feet. {@actSaveFail} The target suffers the effect of the {@spell Confusion|XPHB} spell (no {@status Concentration|XPHB} required to maintain the spell).

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The inspired casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 13}):

trait.name: Dual Mind
entries: The inspired has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Wisdom saving throws.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The inspired makes two Crysteel Dagger attacks. It can replace one attack with {@spell Vicious Mockery|XPHB}.

action.name: Crysteel Dagger
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4}, reach 5 ft. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) Piercing damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Force damage.

variant.name: Quori Vessel
entries: The inspired are vessels for quori spirits, allowing the quori to manifest a portion of their power while the vessel is possessed. An inspired can gain benefits depending on the type of quori possessing it. The quori also gains access to the inspired's knowledge and features.

entries.name: All-Around Vision
entries: The inspired can't be {@status surprised|XPHB}.

entries.name: Enemies Abound (1/Day)
entries: The inspired can cast the {@spell Enemies Abound|XGE} spell (spell save {@dc 13}).

entries.name: Suggestion (3/Day)
entries: The inspired can cast the {@spell Suggestion|XPHB} spell (spell save {@dc 13}), requiring no material components.

entries.name: All Around Vision
entries: The inspired can't be {@status surprised|XPHB}.

entries.name: Arcane Eye (3/Day)
entries: The inspired can cast the {@spell Arcane Eye|XPHB} spell, requiring no material components.

entries.name: Fear (1/Day)
entries: The Inspired can cast the {@spell Fear|XPHB} spell (spell save {@dc 13}), requiring no material components.

items.name: All Around Vision
entries: The inspired can't be {@status surprised|XPHB}.

items.name: All Around Vision
entries: The inspired can't be {@status surprised|XPHB}.

trait.name: Warforged Symbiote
entries: A messenger can only remain active for 8 hours after it detaches from a warforged body, after which time its energy dissipates and it gains the {@condition Unconscious|XPHB} condition. An {@condition Unconscious|XPHB} messenger must complete a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} while attached to a warforged, after which it regains its energy, as well as regaining all lost {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}.

action.name: Dash
entries: The messenger gains extra movement equal to its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}.
{@note Requires Use by a {@race Warforged|EFA}}

A delicate winged creature, this homunculus was designed to facilitate communication between warforged soldiers during the Last War. A {@item Final Messenger|ExploringEberron24} is a Tiny Construct with an AC of 20, 6 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, and a {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB} of 60 feet. It has {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to Poison damage and Psychic damage, and all conditions other than {@condition Unconscious|XPHB|Unconsciousness}. If it is forced to make an ability check or a saving throw, treat all its ability scores as 10 (+0). It has {@sense Darkvision|XPHB} with a range of 60 feet. It has no limbs and the only action it can take on its turn is the {@action Dash|XPHB} action.

If you are a warforged, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to integrate a Final Messenger into your body. While it is part of your body, the messenger cannot be targeted by any attack. You can only have one messenger attached to your body at a time. A messenger can only remain active for 8 hours after it detaches from a warforged body, after which time its energy dissipates and it gains the {@condition Unconscious|XPHB} condition. An {@condition Unconscious|XPHB} messenger must complete a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} while attached to a warforged, after which it regains its energy, as well as regaining all lost {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}.

A Final Messenger holds four pieces of data, accessible only to the warforged it is attached to. While the messenger is attached to you, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to review the data currently stored within the messenger, and if you choose to, change any or all of these data points.

items: A destination for the messenger. This can be very specific (a particular apartment in Sharn) or more general (an open marketplace).
A target individual. This could be a specific person or a category ("Any Karrnathi warforged").
A single image recorded through the eyes of a warforged attached to the messenger.
A message of up to 25 words.

entries: You can release the messenger as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, at which point it flies to its destination by the most direct route possible. Once it reaches the destination it seeks the target individual; if no target has been set, it approaches the nearest warforged.

If you are reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} while a Final Messenger is attached to you, it immediately detaches and seeks out its target. It retains its stored message, but replaces its stored image with the last thing you saw before dropping to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The quori casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 16}):

trait.name: All-Around Vision
entries: The quori can't be {@status surprised|XPHB} while it isn't {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB}.

trait.name: Aura of Fury
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 16}, any creature that starts its turn in a 60-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the quori. {@actSaveFail} The target becomes enraged. While enraged, the target has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on all melee attack rolls, and all attack rolls made against the target have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB}.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The quori has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Track Hatred
entries: When the quori deals damage to any creature, it forms a psychic link with the target for 24 hours. During that time, the quori has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Survival|XPHB}) checks to track the target. The quori can attempt to track the target at any range, even if it is on another plane of existence. Abilities such as the {@spell Pass Without Trace|XPHB} spell or the Ranger's Nature's Veil feature do not impede the quori's ability to track its target. The quori remains alert to danger even when it is tracking while traveling.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The quori makes three Tentacle attacks.

action.name: Tentacle
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 9}, reach 10 ft. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Fire damage, and the target has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 17}) from one of three tentacles. While {@condition Grappled|XPHB}, the target takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Fire damage and 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Psychic damage at the start of each of the quori's turns.

action.name: Possession {@recharge}
entries: {@actSave cha} {@dc 16}, one Humanoid the quori can see within 5 feet. {@actSaveFail} The target is possessed by the quori; the quori disappears and the target has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition and loses control of its body. The quori now controls the body, but the target retains awareness. The quori can't be targeted by any attack, spell, or other effect, except ones that specifically target Aberrations. The quori's game statistics are the same, except it uses the possessed target's {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}, as well as the target's Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution modifiers.

The possession lasts until the body drops to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} or the quori leaves as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}. When the possession ends, the quori appears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the target, and the target is immune to this quori's {@variantrule Possession|XPHB} for 24 hours. {@actSaveSuccess} The target is immune to this quori's {@variantrule Possession|XPHB} for 24 hours.

action.name: Recall Agony {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 16}, one creature the quori can see within 60 feet. {@actSaveFail} 67 ({@damage 15d8}) Psychic damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

reaction.name: Incite Fury
entries: {@actTrigger} A creature under the effects of the quori's Aura of Fury targets the quori with an attack. {@actResponse} The target attacks another creature of the quori's choice within the targets range.

trait.name: Martial Role
entries: The warrior has one of the following traits of your choice:

items.name: Attacker
items.entry: The warrior gains a +2 bonus to attack rolls.

items.name: Defender
items.entry: The warrior gains the Protection reaction below.

action.name: Longsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) slashing damage, or 7 ({@damage 1d10 + 2}) slashing damage if used with two hands.

action.name: Longbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 3} to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d8 + 1}) piercing damage.

reaction.name: Protection (Defender Only)
entries: The warrior imposes disadvantage on the attack roll of a creature within 5 feet of it whose target isn't the warrior. The warrior must be able to see the attacker.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting (Healer)
headerEntries: The spellcaster's spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save {@dc 12}, {@hit 4} to hit with spell attacks). The spellcaster has following cleric spells prepared:

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting (Mage)
headerEntries: The spellcaster's spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save {@dc 12}, {@hit 4} to hit with spell attacks). The spellcaster has following wizard spells prepared:

trait.name: Magical Role
entries: Choose a role for the spellcaster: healer or mage. Your choice determines which Spellcasting trait to use below.

action.name: Quarterstaff
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 2} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}3 ({@damage 1d6}) bludgeoning damage, or 4 ({@damage 1d8}) bludgeoning damage if used with two hands.

trait.name: Helpful
entries: The expert can take the Help action as a bonus action.

trait.name: Tools
entries: The expert has {@item thieves' tools|phb} and a musical instrument.

action.name: Shortsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Dagger
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Shortbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 4} to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) piercing damage.

trait.name: Warforged Resilience
entries: The warforged has advantage on saving throws against being {@condition poisoned} and is immune to disease. Magic can't put it to sleep.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The warforged makes two armblade attacks.

action.name: Armblade
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) slashing damage.

action.name: Javelin
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage.

reaction.name: Protection
entries: When an attacker the warforged can see makes an attack roll against a creature within 5 feet of the warforged, the warforged can impose disadvantage on the attack roll.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The assassin's spellcasting ability is Constitution ({@hit 4} to hit with spell attacks). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

trait.name: Unstable Mark
entries: When the assassin casts an innate spell, each creature within 10 feet of the assassin must make a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw, taking 4 ({@damage 1d8}) force damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The assassin makes two shortsword attacks.

action.name: Shortsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) poison damage.

action.name: Fire Bolt (Cantrip)
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 4} to hit, range 120 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d10}) fire damage. A flammable object hit by this spell ignites if it isn't being worn or carried.

action.name: Chromatic Orb (1/Day)
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 4} to hit, range 90 ft., one creature. {@h}18 ({@dice 4d8}) damage of a type chosen by the assassin: acid, cold, fire, lightning, poison, or thunder.

trait.name: Shifting (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: As a bonus action, the shifter takes on a more bestial form for 1 minute or until it dies. The shifter gains 5 temporary hit points. It can make a bite attack when it activates this trait and also as a bonus action on each of its turns while in its bestial form.

action.name: Shortsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) piercing damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The magewright's spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save {@dc 12}). To cast one of its rituals, the magewright must provide additional material components whose value in gold pieces is 20 times the spell's level. These components are consumed when the ritual is finished. The magewright knows the following spells:

action.name: Dagger
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}3 ({@damage 1d4 + 1}) piercing damage.

trait.name: Dual Mind
entries: The kalashtar has advantage on Wisdom saving throws.

action.name: Dagger
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Mind Thrust
entries: The kalashtar targets a creature it can see within 30 feet of it. The target must succeed on a {@dc 12} Wisdom saving throw or take 11 ({@damage 2d10}) psychic damage.

trait.name: Change Appearance
entries: The changeling can use its action to polymorph into a Medium humanoid it has seen, or back into its true form. Its statistics, other than its size, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The changeling makes two attacks with its dagger.

action.name: Dagger
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Unsettling Visage (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: Each creature within 30 feet of the changeling must succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The knight is an 8th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 14}, {@hit 6} to hit with spell attacks). It has the following paladin spells prepared:

trait.name: Commander of Bones
entries: As a bonus action, the knight can target one skeleton or zombie it can see within 30 feet of it. The target must make a {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target must obey the knight's commands until the knight dies or until the knight releases it as a bonus action. The knight can command up to twelve undead at a time this way.

trait.name: Master of the Pallid Banner
entries: While within 60 feet of the knight, any undead ally of the knight has advantage on saving throws against any effect that turns undead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The knight attacks twice with one of its weapons.

action.name: Greatsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) slashing damage.

action.name: Longbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 4} to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d8 + 1}) piercing damage.

name: Warforged Titan
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

trait.name: Platforms
entries: The warforged titan has two platforms built into its chassis. One Medium or smaller creature can ride on each platform without squeezing. To make a melee attack against a target within 5 feet of the warforged, they must use spears or weapons with reach and the target must be Large or larger.

trait.name: Siege Monster
entries: The warforged titan deals double damage to objects and structures.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The warforged titan makes one axehand attack and one hammerfist attack.

action.name: Axehand
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}19 ({@damage 3d8 + 6}) slashing damage, plus 11 ({@damage 2d10}) slashing damage if the target is {@condition prone}.

action.name: Hammerfist
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}19 ({@damage 3d8 + 6}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 17} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Sweeping Axe {@recharge}
entries: The warforged titan makes a sweep with its axehand, and each creature within 10 feet of it must make a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes 19 ({@damage 3d8 + 6}) slashing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: The colossus is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the colossus fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The colossus has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Siege Monster
entries: The colossus deals double damage to objects and structures.

trait.name: Towering Terror
entries: Any enemy outside the colossus that starts its turn within 30 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 26} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the start of the enemy's next turn. If the enemy's saving throw is successful, it is immune to this colossus's Towering Terror for the next 24 hours.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The colossus makes three attacks—one with its slam and two with its eldritch turrets—and then uses Stomp.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 18} to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. {@h}29 ({@damage 3d12 + 10}) bludgeoning damage, and the colossus can push the target up to 20 feet away from it.

action.name: Eldritch Turret
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 18} to hit, range 300 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 4d8}) force damage, and if the target is a creature, it is knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Stomp
entries: The colossus stomps one of its feet at a point on the ground within 20 feet of it. Any creature in a 20-foot-radius, 20-foot-high cylinder centered on this point must succeed on a {@dc 26} Dexterity saving throw or take 33 ({@damage 6d10}) bludgeoning damage and fall {@condition prone}. Until the colossus uses its Stomp again or moves, the creature is {@condition restrained}. While {@condition restrained} in this way, the creature (or another creature within 5 feet of it) can use its action to make a {@dc 26} Strength check. On a success, the creature relocates to an unoccupied space of its choice within 5 feet of the colossus and is no longer {@condition restrained}.
Structures, as well as nonmagical objects that are neither being worn nor carried, take the same amount of damage if they are in the cylinder (no save).

action.name: Incinerating Beam {@recharge 5}
entries: The colossus fires a beam of light in a 150-foot line that is 10 feet wide. Each creature in the line must make a {@dc 26} Dexterity saving throw, taking 60 ({@damage 11d10}) radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature reduced to 0 hit points by this beam is disintegrated, leaving behind anything it was wearing or carrying.

trait.name: Bonding
entries: The steed can magically bond with one creature it can see, immediately after spending at least 1 hour observing that creature while within 30 feet of it. The bond lasts until the steed bonds with a different creature or until the bonded creature dies. While bonded, the steed and the bonded creature can communicate telepathically with each other at a distance of up to 100 feet.

action.name: Hooves
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Bonding
entries: The hound can magically bond with one creature it can see, immediately after spending at least 1 hour observing that creature while within 30 feet of it. The bond lasts until the hound bonds with a different creature or until the bonded creature dies. While bonded, the hound and the bonded creature can communicate telepathically with each other at a distance of up to 100 feet.

trait.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
entries: The hound has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 13} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Bonding
entries: The hawk can magically bond with one creature it can see, immediately after spending at least 1 hour observing that creature while within 30 feet of it. The bond lasts until the hawk bonds with a different creature or until the bonded creature dies. While bonded, the hawk and the bonded creature can communicate telepathically with each other at a distance of up to 100 feet.

When the possession ends, the quori reappears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the body. action.name: Multiattack
entries: The soldier attacks three times with one of its weapons.

action.name: Longsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) slashing damage, or 8 ({@damage 1d10 + 3}) slashing damage if used with two hands.

action.name: Longbow

reaction.name: Parry

action.name: Vicious Mockery (Cantrip)
entries: The Inspired unleashes a string of insults laced with subtle enchantments at one creature it can see within 60 feet of it. If the target can hear the Inspired, the target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw or take 2 ({@damage 1d4}) psychic damage and have disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn.

variant.name: Quori Vessel
entries: The Inspired are vessels for quori spirits, allowing the quori to manifest a portion of their power while the vessel is possessed. An Inspired can gain benefits depending on the type of quori possessing it. The quori also gains access to the Inspired's knowledge and features.

entries: The Inspired can cast the {@spell suggestion} spell (spell save {@dc 13}), requiring no material components.

entries.name: All Around Vision

entries.name: Fear (1/Day)
entries: The Inspired can cast the {@spell fear} spell (spell save {@dc 13}), requiring no material components.

items.name: All Around Vision
entries: The Inspired can't be {@status surprised}.

name: Iron Defender

trait.name: Keen Senses
entries: The defender has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks.

trait.name: Telepathic Bond
entries: While the defender is on the same plane of existence as its master, it can magically convey what it senses to its master, and the two can communicate telepathically.

name: Expeditious Messenger

trait.name: Telepathic Bond

action.name: Bite

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The hag's spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 15}). She can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The hag has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hag makes two Nightmare Touch attacks.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) slashing damage.

action.name: Nightmare Touch
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}18 ({@damage 4d6 + 4}) psychic damage. If the target is {@condition unconscious}, it takes an extra 10 ({@damage 3d6}) psychic damage and is cursed until the hag dies or the curse is removed. The cursed creature's hit point maximum decreases by 5 ({@dice 1d10}) whenever it finishes a long rest.

reaction.name: Dream Eater
entries: When an {@condition unconscious} creature the hag can see within 30 feet of her regains consciousness, the hag can force the creature to make a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw. Unless the save succeeds, the creature takes 11 ({@damage 2d10}) psychic damage, and the hag regains hit points equal to the amount of damage taken.

trait.name: Dual Consciousness
entries: The dolgrim has advantage on saving throws against being {@condition blinded}, {@condition charmed}, {@condition deafened}, {@condition frightened}, {@condition stunned}, and knocked {@condition unconscious}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dolgrim makes three attacks.

action.name: Morningstar
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Spear
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) piercing damage, or 6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

action.name: Hand Crossbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 4} to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) piercing damage.

trait.name: Evasion
entries: If the dolgaunt is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, the dolgaunt instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if it fails. It can't use this trait if it's {@condition incapacitated}.

trait.name: Unarmored Defense
entries: While the dolgaunt is wearing no armor and wielding no shield, its AC includes its Wisdom modifier.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dolgaunt makes two tentacle attacks and two unarmed strikes. Up to two tentacle attacks can be replaced by Vitality Drain.

action.name: Tentacle
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage. The target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 12}) if it is a Large or smaller creature. Until this grapple ends, the dolgaunt can't use the same tentacle on another target. The dolgaunt has two tentacles.

action.name: Unarmed Strike
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d4 + 4}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Vitality Drain
entries: One creature {@condition grappled} by a tentacle of the dolgaunt must make a {@dc 11} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 9 ({@damage 2d8}) necrotic damage, and the dolgaunt regains a number of hit points equal to half the necrotic damage taken.

trait.name: Quickness {@recharge 5}

trait.name: Pounce
entries: If the clawfoot moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a claw attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a {@dc 11} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}. If the target is {@condition prone}, the clawfoot can make one bite attack against it as a bonus action.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The clawfoot makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) slashing damage.

trait.name: Alien Mind
entries: If a creature tries to read Dyrrn's thoughts or deals psychic damage to it, that creature must succeed on a {@dc 23} Intelligence saving throw or be {@condition stunned} for 1 minute. The {@condition stunned} creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If Dyrrn fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Dyrrn has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: Dyrrn regains 20 hit points at the start of its turn. If Dyrrn takes radiant damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of its next turn. Dyrrn dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

trait.name: Teleport
entries: As a bonus action, Dyrrn can teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Dyrrn makes one Tentacle Whip attack and uses its Corruption once. Dyrrn can replace its Tentacle Whip attack with Extract Brain if it has a creature {@condition grappled}.

action.name: Tentacle Whip
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 15} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}24 ({@damage 3d10 + 8}) slashing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 23}), pulled into an unoccupied space within 5 feet of Dyrrn, and must succeed on a {@dc 23} Intelligence saving throw or be {@condition stunned} until this grapple ends. Dyrrn can't use the same tentacle whip on another target until this grapple ends. Dyrrn has two tentacle whips.

action.name: Corruption
entries: Dyrrn targets one creature it can see within 60 feet of it. The target must succeed on a {@dc 23} Constitution saving throw or take 22 ({@damage 4d6 + 8}) necrotic damage and become corrupted for 1 minute.

A corrupted creature's flesh twists in alien ways. The creature has disadvantage on attack rolls, its speed is reduced by half, and if it tries to cast a spell, it must first succeed on a {@dc 15} Intelligence check or the spell fails and is wasted. The corrupted creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Extract Brain
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 15} to hit, reach 5 ft., one {@condition incapacitated} creature {@condition grappled} by Dyrrn. {@h}55 ({@damage 10d10}) piercing damage. If this damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, Dyrrn kills the target by extracting and devouring its brain.

legendary.name: Tentacle Whip
entries: Dyrrn makes one attack with its Tentacle Whip.

legendary.name: Spawn Aberration (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Dyrrn regurgitates an intellect devourer in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of it. The intellect devourer is under Dyrrn's control and acts immediately after Dyrrn in the initiative order.

legendary.name: Mind Blast (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: Dyrrn magically emits psychic energy in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a {@dc 23} Intelligence saving throw or take 30 ({@damage 5d8 + 8}) psychic damage and be {@condition stunned} for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

trait.name: Alien Mind
entries: If a creature tries to read Belashyrra's thoughts or deals psychic damage to it, that creature must succeed on a {@dc 22} Intelligence saving throw or be {@condition stunned} for 1 minute. The {@condition stunned} creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

trait.name: Eye Thief
entries: Belashyrra can see through the eyes of all creatures within 120 feet of it. It can use its Eye Ray through any creature within 120 feet of it, as though it were in that creature's space.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If Belashyrra fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Belashyrra has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: Belashyrra regains 20 hit points at the start of its turn. If it takes radiant damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of its next turn. Belashyrra dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

trait.name: Teleport
entries: As a bonus action, Belashyrra can teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Belashyrra makes two attacks with its claws and uses its Eye Ray once.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 14} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 3d6 + 7}) slashing damage.

action.name: Eye Ray
entries: Belashyrra shoots one of the following magical eye rays of its choice, targeting one creature it can see within 120 feet of it:

items.name: 1. Psyche-Reconstruction Ray
items.entry: The target must make a {@dc 22} Wisdom saving throw, taking 49 ({@damage 9d10}) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If this damage reduces a creature to 0 hit points, it dies and transforms into a spectator under Belashyrra's control and acts immediately after Belashyrra in the initiative order. The target can't be returned to its original form by any means short of a {@spell wish} spell.

items.name: 2. Domination Ray
items.entry: The target must succeed on a {@dc 22} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition charmed} by Belashyrra for 1 minute or until the target takes damage. Belashyrra can issue telepathic commands to the {@condition charmed} creature (no action required), which it does its best to obey.

items.name: 3. Mind-Weakening Ray
items.entry: The target must succeed on a {@dc 22} Intelligence saving throw or take 36 ({@damage 8d8}) psychic damage and be unable to cast spells or activate magic items for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

items.name: 4. Blinding Ray
items.entry: The target and each creature within 10 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 22} Constitution saving throw or take 19 ({@damage 3d12}) radiant damage and be {@condition blinded} for 1 minute. Until this blindness ends, Belashyrra can see through the {@condition blinded} creature's eyes. The {@condition blinded} creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

legendary.name: Claw
entries: Belashyrra makes one claw attack.

legendary.name: Implant Fear (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Belashyrra targets a creature it can see within 60 feet of it. The target must succeed on a {@dc 22} Wisdom saving throw or take 22 ({@damage 4d10}) psychic damage and immediately use its reaction, if available, to move as far as its speed allows away from Belashyrra.

legendary.name: Rend Reality (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: Belashyrra rips at the bonds of reality in its immediate area. Each creature within 10 feet of Belashyrra must succeed on a {@dc 22} Constitution saving throw or take 19 ({@damage 3d12}) force damage and gain one level of {@condition exhaustion}.

action.name: Battleaxe
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d8 + 3}) slashing damage, or 14 ({@damage 2d10 + 3}) slashing damage if used with two hands.

action.name: Javelin
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) piercing damage.

trait.name: Cunning Action
entries: On each of its turns, Corrin can use a bonus action to take the {@action Dash}, {@action Disengage}, or {@action Hide} action.

trait.name: Sneak Attack (1/Turn)
entries: Corrin deals an extra 7 ({@damage 2d6}) damage when it hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of Corrin that isn't {@condition incapacitated} and Corrin doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

trait.name: Halfling Nimbleness
entries: Corrin can move through a space of a Medium or larger creature.

trait.name: Brave
entries: Corrin has advantage on saving throws against being {@condition frightened}.

trait.name: Stout Resilience
entries: Corrin has advantage on saving throws against poison.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Corrin makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Shortsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Hand Crossbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 4} to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Spear

trait.name: Charge
entries: If the udaak moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a slam attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 27 ({@damage 6d8}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 21} Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 20 feet away from the udaak and knocked {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Siege Monster
entries: The udaak deals double damage to objects and structures.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The udaak makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its slam.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}21 ({@damage 2d12 + 8}) piercing damage, and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 21}). Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained}, and the udaak can't bite another target.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}21 ({@damage 3d8 + 8}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Swallow
entries: The udaak makes one bite attack against a Large or smaller target it is grappling. If the attack hits, the target is also swallowed, and the grapple ends. A swallowed creature is {@condition blinded} and {@condition restrained}, it has {@quickref Cover||3||total cover} against attacks and other effects outside the udaak, and it takes 21 ({@damage 6d6}) acid damage at the start of each of the udaak's turns.

If the udaak takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the udaak must succeed on a {@dc 21} Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall {@condition prone} in a space within 10 feet of the udaak. If the udaak dies, a swallowed creature is no longer {@condition restrained} by it and can escape from the corpse by using 20 feet of movement, exiting {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The basilisk can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Petrifying Secretions
entries: A creature must make a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw if it hits the basilisk with a weapon attack while within 5 feet of it or if it starts its turn {@condition grappled} by the basilisk. Unless the save succeeds, the creature magically begins to turn to stone and is {@condition restrained}, and it must repeat the saving throw at the end of its next turn. On a successful save, the effect ends. On a failure, the creature is {@condition petrified}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The basilisk makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its tail.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}13 ({@damage 3d6 + 3}) piercing damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) poison damage.

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d10 + 3}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 12}).

trait.name: Stench
entries: Any creature that starts its turn within 5 feet of the shadowghast must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} until the start of its next turn. On a successful saving throw, the creature is immune to this Stench for 24 hours.

action.name: Claws

The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

legendary.name: As Water
